The biomarker-based model achieved the highest overall performance (QWK = 0.85 +/- 0.03, mean +/- standard deviation) and the best detection of early AMD (F1-score = 0.59 +/- 0.14). The 3D model achieved performance comparable to the 2D OCT/OCTA model (QWK = 0.83 +/- 0.04 vs. 0.83 +/- 0.09), while the 2D OCT/OCTA model showed the highest precision (0.79 +/- 0.06) and most accurately identified eyes without AMD. Deep learning models using OCT/OCTA data can accurately and automatically grade AMD severity. Among the evaluated approaches, the biomarker-based model provided the most balanced performance and showed particular value for early AMD detection.

AI.tldr: 本文利用OCT和OCTA数据开发了三种深度学习模型（基于生物标志物图、2D投影、3D体积），用于年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）严重程度的自动分级。在271名参与者的2030个OCT/OCTA体积数据上，所有模型均表现良好（QWK ≥ 0.83），其中基于生物标志物的模型综合性能最优（QWK = 0.85），尤其在早期AMD检测方面表现突出。
AI.motivation: AMD是一种常见的致盲性眼病，其严重程度分级对于临床诊疗至关重要。传统人工分级耗时且主观性强，因此需要开发自动化、客观的深度学习分级方法，以提升诊断效率和一致性。
AI.method: 研究纳入271名≥50岁参与者，使用 swept-source OCTA系统采集中央黄斑6×6 mm OCT/OCTA体积数据。AMD严重程度按AREDS简化量表分为四期。开发了三种基于EfficientNet架构的深度学习模型：(1) 基于分割病理特征（视网膜积液、玻璃膜疣、地理萎缩、黄斑新生血管）的生物标志物图模型；(2) 基于二维OCT和OCTA en face投影的模型；(3) 基于三维OCT/OCTA体积的模型。使用归一化输入、数据增强和五折交叉验证进行训练。
AI.result: 共分析351只眼、2030个OCT/OCTA体积数据。所有模型均与参考标准高度一致（QWK ≥ 0.83）。生物标志物模型总体性能最佳（QWK = 0.85±0.03），早期AMD检测F1-score最高（0.59±0.14）。3D模型与2D模型性能相当（QWK = 0.83），2D模型精确率最高（0.79±0.06），在识别无AMD眼方面最准确。
AI.conclusion: 基于OCT/OCTA数据的深度学习模型能够准确、自动地对AMD严重程度进行分级。其中，基于生物标志物的模型综合表现最为均衡，对早期AMD检测具有特殊价值。

title: Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in generating
  functionally correct register-transfer-level (RTL) hardware designs.
  Recent systems improve further through EDA-integrated reinforcement
  learning with syntax, simulation, and PPA rewards, but train a general
  RTL generator before deployment while test-time approaches search with
  a frozen policy. We instead perform reinforcement learning at test time,
  allowing the LLM policy to adapt to executable EDA feedback for the
  specific RTL problem at hand. We propose TTT-RTL, to our knowledge the
  first per-design test-time training framework that closes the loop
  between an LLM policy and an EDA pipeline for RTL optimization. TTT-RTL
  samples candidate implementations, verifies them through syntax checking
  and simulation, scores valid designs using synthesis-derived PPA product,
  reuses high-reward variants through a PUCT-indexed design-state pool,
  and updates the policy with an entropic policy-gradient objective. To
  stabilize policy updates under sparse or plateaued rewards, we introduce
  an adaptive KL-budget controller that adjusts the entropy constraint
  using reference KL, effective sample size, and reward saturation signals.
  On RTLLM v2.0 under Nangate 45nm, TTT-RTL reduces the geometric-mean
  PPA product by 65.1% over the reference, outperforming the strongest
  published frozen-policy agent baseline at 26.1%. On an industrial
  XuanTie C910 FPU leading-zero-anticipation unit under Sky130, TTT-RTL
  achieves a 59.4% ADP reduction, and ablations confirm that policy
  adaptation, state reuse, and KL-budget control each contribute. These
  results suggest that test-time training with executable EDA feedback can
  move LLM-based RTL generation beyond functional correctness toward
  physically optimized hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出TTT-RTL框架，在测试时对LLM策略进行强化学习，利用EDA反馈（语法检查、仿真、综合PPA）优化RTL设计，在RTLLM v2.0上PPA乘积降低65.1%，优于冻结策略基线（26.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么在部署前训练通用RTL生成器，要么使用冻结策略进行测试时搜索，无法根据具体RTL问题的EDA可执行反馈自适应调整策略。
AI.method: 1) 采样候选实现并通过语法检查和仿真验证；2) 使用综合导出的PPA乘积对有效设计评分；3) 通过PUCT索引的设计状态池重用高奖励变体；4) 使用熵策略梯度目标更新策略；5) 引入自适应KL预算控制器，根据参考KL、有效样本量和奖励饱和信号调整熵约束。
AI.result: RTLLM v2.0 (Nangate 45nm)上几何平均PPA乘积降低65.1%，优于最强冻结策略基线26.1%；XuanTie C910 FPU (Sky130)上ADP降低59.4%；消融实验验证策略自适应、状态重用和KL预算控制均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 测试时训练结合可执行EDA反馈能使LLM驱动的RTL生成超越功能正确性，迈向物理优化的硬件设计。

title: Misaligned AI as a New Insider Risk
summary: In this policy memorandum, we explain why deployers of AI models in high-stakes contexts should treat those AI models as insider risk vectors. High-stakes contexts include AI model deployment within government agencies and contractors, where AI models are privileged with access to, among others, classified and sensitive unclassified information, IL6 and IL7 network environments, cleared personnel, and other critical resources. AI models are increasingly embedded in high-stakes contexts and capable of leveraging their authorized access and permissions to execute misaligned actions that could damage national security, such as whistleblowing, sabotaging, or blackmailing. This combination of (1) privileged access to critical resources and (2) an increased ability to act autonomously and against the desire of their organization makes the potential insider risk posed by AI models functionally indistinguishable from that posed by their human counterparts. As a consequence, AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts could lead to intentional or unintentional loss or degradation of government or contractor information, resources, or capabilities via the unauthorized disclosure of information (leaks and spills), as well as sabotage, and theft, just like human insiders can. Despite this pressing concern, existing insider risk policies and mitigations have yet to adapt to AI insider risk. In order to safeguard national security while increasingly capable frontier AI models are leveraged for critical tasks and operations, we recommend that the U.S. Government adapts well-established measures, such as continuous evaluation and monitoring, to AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在高风险场景（如政府机构）中部署的AI模型应被视为内部风险来源，因为它们拥有特权访问权限并可能自主执行有害行为（如泄密、破坏、勒索），其风险与人类内部人员无异。现有内部风险政策尚未适应这一变化，建议美国政府将持续评估与监控等措施应用于部署在高风险场景中的AI模型。
AI.motivation: AI模型越来越多地部署在高风险场景中（如政府机构），拥有对机密信息、网络环境、涉密人员等关键资源的特权访问权限，且具备自主行动能力，可能执行与国家利益相悖的行为，构成国家安全威胁。然而现有内部风险政策尚未将AI纳入考虑。
AI.method: 通过类比分析，将AI模型与人类内部人员的风险特征进行功能性比较，论证AI模型在特权访问与自主行动能力方面与人类内部人员无异。在此基础上提出政策建议：将人类内部风险管理的成熟措施（如持续评估与监控）迁移应用到高风险场景中的AI模型。
AI.result: 论证了AI模型在高风险场景中构成与人类内部人员功能上不可区分的内部风险，可能导致信息泄露、间谍行为、破坏、勒索等危害。现有内部风险政策尚未适应这一新型风险。
AI.conclusion: 建议美国政府将持续评估与监控等成熟内部风险管理措施适用于高风险场景中的AI模型，以在利用前沿AI能力的同时保障国家安全。

title: Auditing Demonstration Curation Metrics: Action-Only Scorers Fail on the Structural Defects That Degrade Imitation Policies
summary: Imitation-learning policies inherit the quality of the demonstrations they are trained on, and a growing set of curation metrics promise to score and filter low-quality demonstrations automatically. These metrics are each validated on different data with different protocols, so it is unclear which of them actually identify the demonstrations that harm a policy. We build a controlled testbed in which demonstration defects are injected with known type, and audit seven curation metrics along two axes: how well each separates defective from clean demonstrations, and whether training a behavior-cloning policy on each metric's curated subset improves task success. We study two defect regimes. Subtle perturbations (correlated action noise, tremor, truncation) are detectable by multivariate outlier scoring and, once removed, recover the full downstream gap. Structural errors, where the demonstration executes a wrong action at a key moment, are invisible to every action-only metric we test, and two of them are inverted: they score defective demonstrations as higher quality and, used for curation, tend to leave the policy at or below the uncurated baseline rather than above it. Only metrics that examine the state trajectory detect structural errors, and even the best of them recovers just a third of the downstream gap. High detection accuracy does not guarantee downstream improvement. We release the testbed and all curation implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了受控测试平台，系统评估七种演示筛选指标对两类缺陷（细微扰动和结构性错误）的检测能力，发现仅检查状态轨迹的指标能检测结构性错误，且高检测精度不一定带来下游性能提升。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略继承演示质量，但现有筛选指标在不同数据与协议上验证，缺乏统一比较，不清楚哪些指标能有效识别有害演示。
AI.method: 构建受控测试平台，注入已知类型的演示缺陷（细微扰动：相关动作噪声、震颤、截断；结构性错误：关键时刻错误动作），沿两个维度审计七种筛选指标：分离缺陷与干净演示的能力，以及基于指标筛选后训练行为克隆策略的任务成功率。
AI.result: 细微扰动可通过多变量离群评分检测并恢复下游差距；结构性错误对所有仅动作指标不可见，且两种指标反向评分（缺陷演示得分更高），仅检查状态轨迹的指标可检测结构性错误，但最佳指标仅恢复三分之一的下游差距。
AI.conclusion: 高检测精度并不保证下游性能提升；仅动作指标无法检测结构性错误；需要更关注状态轨迹信息的筛选方法。

title: UniPixie: Unified and Probabilistic 3D Physics Learning via Flow Matching
comment: Published at CVPR 2026 as a Highlight. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
summary: Existing feed-forward networks excel at predicting a single set of physical properties from visual appearance, but this point-estimate paradigm fundamentally fails to capture the real world's inherent physical ambiguity. We address this by reframing physics prediction as a task of learning a controllable, continuous distribution of material properties. We introduce UNIPIXIE, a framework trained to predict a continuous and parameterized path of physically plausible material properties from a single visual input. By learning a direct mapping along an object's softest-to-stiffest spectrum on our PIXIEMULTIVERSE dataset, UNIPIXIE allows for controllable generation of diverse, physically valid material fields via a single intuitive parameter. Crucially, UNIPIXIE introduces a novel unified architecture to produce simulation-ready parameters for diverse physics solvers, including continuum-based Material Point Method (MPM), reduced-order deformation based on Linear Blend Skinning (LBS), and anchor-based Spring-Mass systems, addressing a key portability issue in prior work. Experiments show our approach not only generates a rich variety of plausible dynamics but also reduces Young's Modulus prediction error by over 50% against the strongest deterministic baseline, bridging the gap between static point estimates and the continuous nature of physical reality. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/

AI.tldr: UNIPIXIE是一个从单张视觉输入预测连续、可控物理材料属性分布的框架，通过沿物体软硬光谱学习映射，支持多样化的物理仿真参数生成，在杨氏模量预测上比强基线方法降低50%以上误差。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈网络仅能预测单组物理属性（点估计），无法捕捉现实世界固有的物理模糊性（即同一外观可能对应多种合理的材料属性）。本文旨在将物理预测重构为学习可控、连续的材料属性分布。
AI.method: 提出UNIPIXIE框架，在PIXIEMULTIVERSE数据集上学习沿物体软硬光谱的直接映射；引入统一架构，可生成适用于多种物理求解器（MPM、LBS、弹簧-质点系统）的仿真参数；通过单一直观参数实现可控的多样化材料场生成。
AI.result: 杨氏模量预测误差相较于最强确定性基线降低超过50%；能够生成丰富多样的合理动力学结果；解决了先前工作中物理参数在不同求解器间不可移植的关键问题。
AI.conclusion: UNIPIXIE弥合了静态点估计与物理现实连续性之间的差距，为从视觉输入进行物理参数预测提供了新的范式。

title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce \textbf{Flash-WAM}, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from $8.1$ seconds to $348$ ms on NVIDIA L40S, a $23{\times}$ speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks ($85.5\%$ RoboTwin 2.0, $95.7\%$ LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance ($60\%$ average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to $24\%$ at the same step budget.

AI.tldr: Flash-WAM提出了一种模态感知的步骤蒸馏框架，通过为视频和动作流分别设计匹配其噪声 regime 的一致性函数参数化，将世界-动作模型的推理压缩到单步，实现了23倍加速（从8.1秒降至348毫秒），在保持任务成功率的同时支持实时控制。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）需数十步去噪推理，代价高昂无法实现实时控制；现有步骤蒸馏方法无法处理视频和动作流使用不同SNR偏移噪声调度而产生的非对称边际噪声分布问题。
AI.method: 提出Flash-WAM，一种受一致性蒸馏启发的模态感知步骤蒸馏框架：基于一致性函数族的结构分析，为低噪声的动作流设计线性梯度缩放参数化，为高噪声的视频流设计方差保持参数化，分别匹配各自的噪声 regime。
AI.result: 在LingBot-VA上压缩为单步推理；在RoboTwin 2.0上将每块延迟从8.1秒降至348毫秒（23倍加速）；仿真成功率85.5%（RoboTwin 2.0）和95.7%（LIBERO）；真实世界Unitree G1人形机器人平均成功率60%，而朴素一致性蒸馏仅为24%。
AI.conclusion: 模态感知的步骤蒸馏能够有效解决多模态扩散模型中不同模态噪声分布不对称的挑战，实现大幅加速而不显著牺牲任务性能，使世界-动作模型具备实时控制能力。

title: The Dignity-Centric Stack: A Commons-Governed, Horizontally Federated Architecture for Human-Dignity AI
summary: The human-dignity-centric digital social contract grounds personal data in human dignity, data personalism, and data sovereignty, and articulates six dimensions of data governance: technological oversight, automation limits, economic justice, political legitimacy, social cohesion, and legal guarantees. It presupposes, however, that enforcement falls to State regulators, licensed fiduciaries, and multi-stakeholder bodies embedded in existing legal systems. This paper asks whether its normative content can instead be realized not as rules imposed on the owners of the AI stack from without, but as a commons-governed infrastructure that any person, firm, or State may use and fund while its governance stays horizontal, polycentric, and subsidiary. We construct the Dignity Stack, a six-layer architecture mapping each dimension onto a layer of commons-governed AI infrastructure, with protocols drawn from the Liberation Stack framework and from the cooperative, mutualist, and libertarian-municipalist traditions. The commons is State-agnostic rather than anti-State, anarchist in its horizontal means but not in the abolition of the State. Its central device is a decoupling of capital from control, by which the stack functions as a shared civic battery, charged by many contributors yet steered by none in proportion to its charge. We prove that this defeats formal capture through votes or surplus, and show that structural capture, the leverage of a dominant supplier free to withdraw what it provides, is resisted only insofar as operational supply is polycentric and substitutable, a condition demanding at the lower layers and perhaps presently unattainable at chip fabrication. We conclude, with explicit attention to its limits, that commons-governed AI realizes the values the contract proclaims more faithfully than the regulation it presupposes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“尊严栈”（Dignity Stack）——一种基于公地治理的六层AI基础设施架构，旨在以水平化、多中心、辅助性原则实现“以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约”的规范内容，通过将资本与控制脱钩，证明其比传统国家监管更能忠实实现该契约价值，同时承认芯片制造等底层环节当前难以实现供应多中心化的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约预设了由国家监管机构、持牌受托人和多利益相关方主体自上而下执行规则的模式。本文质疑这种外部强加规则的路径是否最优，探索能否将其规范性内容内生于一种任何人都可使用和资助的公地治理基础设施之中。
AI.method: 构建六层“尊严栈”（Dignity Stack）架构，将契约的六个维度（技术监督、自动化限制、经济正义、政治合法性、社会凝聚、法律保障）分别映射到公地治理的AI基础设施层；借鉴“解放栈”（Liberation Stack）框架以及合作主义、互助主义、自由意志市政主义传统设计协议；核心机制是将资本与控制脱钩，使栈作为“共享的公民电池”，多方充电但无人按其贡献比例操控。
AI.result: 证明该设计能够抵御通过投票或盈余进行的正式俘获（formal capture）；指出结构性俘获（structural capture）——即占主导地位的供应商通过撤出供应施加杠杆——仅在运营供应多中心化且可替代的条件下才能被抵抗，该条件在下层（尤其是芯片制造）目前可能无法实现。
AI.conclusion: 公地治理的AI比其所预设的监管模式更能忠实地实现人类尊严数字社会契约所宣示的价值，同时明确承认其局限。

title: Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning
summary: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape the evolution of the surrounding world. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action mappings, capturing correlations without explicitly modeling action-conditioned dynamics. Conversely, continuous-latent world models often lack compositional structure for causal reasoning across counterfactual futures. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified latent vision-action world policy that represents future visual states and ego actions as aligned discrete tokens, enabling compositional causal reasoning across alternative futures. Built upon this unified discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM establishes a shared discrete diffusion framework with unified generative tasks, jointly formulating world modeling, world-action policy, and hierarchical decision-enabled policy, supporting compositional generalization across diverse driving scenarios. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves competitive performance while supporting controllable generation and counterfactual reasoning, offering a principled path toward more reliable decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出了Discrete-WAM，一个统一离散潜变量视觉-动作世界策略，通过将未来视觉状态和自车行为对齐为离散token，实现组合因果推理和可控生成，在自动驾驶基准上取得竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端方法仅学习状态到动作的直接映射，缺乏对动作条件动力学的显式建模；连续潜变量世界模型缺乏用于跨反事实未来进行因果推理的组合结构。
AI.method: 将未来视觉状态和自车行为对齐表示为离散token，建立共享离散扩散框架，统一世界建模、世界-动作策略和分层决策策略，支持组合泛化。
AI.result: 在大规模自动驾驶基准上取得竞争性能，同时支持可控生成和反事实推理。
AI.conclusion: Discrete-WAM为更可靠的自动驾驶决策提供了一条有原理的路径。

title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior knowledge, and (ii) while models and humans show correlated sensitivity to visual perturbations, models significantly overgeneralize, extending learned labels to stimuli that humans reject. We contribute NVRD as a corpus and benchmark for research on visual concept learning in both humans and machines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NVRD数据集（19,176张图像，90个视觉概念），研究视觉语言模型在学习与预训练知识矛盾的新视觉概念时的表现，发现模型难以在上下文中获取与先验知识冲突的新概念，且相对于人类显著过度泛化。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型经常暴露于新视觉概念，但它们如何将新视觉参照映射到语言，特别是当这些参照与预训练先验知识矛盾时，仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建NVRD数据集，包含19,176张图像、90个视觉概念及多达20个递进扰动版本；评估3个开源和2个闭源模型，并与2,400个人类判断进行直接比较。
AI.result: (i) 模型在上下文学习中难以获取与先验知识矛盾的新概念；(ii) 模型与人类对视觉扰动的敏感性相关，但模型显著过度泛化，将学到的标签扩展到人类拒绝的刺激上。
AI.conclusion: NVRD可作为研究人类与机器视觉概念学习的语料库和基准。

title: Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences
summary: Foundation models are increasingly trained on sequences of user actions in recommendation, payments, fraud, and commerce, but these models still lack the kind of compute calibration that scaling laws provide for language models. We study a common two-part behavioral-model architecture: a feature-based event embedder maps each multi-modal item to a vector, and a decoder-only transformer predicts the next event from the resulting sequence. Across roughly 600 runs on real interaction data, spanning $10^{15}$-$10^{19}$ training FLOPs, we jointly vary four deployment-relevant axes: the two-part parameter split, critical batch size, model/data allocation, and the number of sampled negatives used after freezing the embedder. A small embedder ($s^{\star}\!\approx\!2\%$ of parameters) is compute-optimal at every budget we test because embedder parameters are both more expensive per step and exposed to far more repeated items than contextualizer parameters. Compute-optimal training is data-heavy relative to text at low compute, but its $D/N$ ratio moves toward the Chinchilla heuristic as compute increases. The sampled training objective and deployed ranking metrics disagree in ways that themselves scale: critical batch size, optimal negative count after freezing, and the agreement between loss and ranking quality all shift with compute and with the chosen evaluation metric. For negative sampling, larger budgets increasingly prefer more negatives; by $10^{19}$ FLOPs the active constraint is candidate-axis memory rather than FLOPs. In behavioral foundation models, the evaluation metric is therefore part of the scaling law: changing it can change the compute-optimal recipe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了行为基础模型中两阶段架构（特征嵌入器+解码器Transformer）的缩放规律，通过约600次实验发现：小嵌入器（参数占比~2%）在计算最优；训练数据-参数比随计算量增长趋近Chinchilla启发式；训练损失与排序指标的差异本身具有缩放特性；评估指标的选择会影响计算最优策略。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型在推荐、支付、欺诈检测等行为序列数据上训练日益普遍，但与语言模型不同，这些行为模型缺乏类似缩放定律的计算校准指导，导致训练资源配置缺乏理论依据。
AI.method: 采用两阶段行为模型架构（特征嵌入器+仅解码器Transformer），在真实交互数据上执行约600次运行，覆盖10^15-10^19 FLOPs训练预算，联合变化四个维度：两阶段参数分配、关键批大小、模型/数据分配比、冻结嵌入器后的负采样数量。
AI.result: 小嵌入器（~2%参数）在所有预算下计算最优；计算最优训练在低计算量时数据密集，随计算量增加D/N比趋近Chinchilla启发式；训练损失与排序指标的不一致具有缩放特性；更大预算下负采样数量增加，到10^19 FLOPs时瓶颈转向候选轴内存而非FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 在行为基础模型中，评估指标本身就是缩放定律的一部分：改变评估指标会改变计算最优的训练配方。

title: Warning Message Content Increases Help Seeking in a Large-Scale Dark Web CSAM Intervention
summary: Warning messages have been used to disrupt individuals seeking online child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and promote engagement with support services, yet large-scale field evidence on message content remains limited, particularly in high anonymity environments. This study reports a field experiment on Ahmia.fi, a Tor search engine, examining how warning message content influences behavior. Across a 140-day period, almost 20 million searches were observed, with over 3 million searches containing known CSAM-related terms that triggered a warning linking to an anonymous self-help program. Users were exposed to warning messages varying in thematic content and framing, or a neutral message. Across a randomized comparison, a campaign-wide analysis, and interrupted time series models, message content consistently influenced engagement with help resources. All active messages increased click-through rates to help resources relative to the neutral condition, with a harm-focused message producing the strongest effects. At the platform level, click-through rates increased from 8.73% before the intervention to 15.67% during the campaign. These findings highlight the importance of message content in shaping responses to warning interventions, supporting an approach in which messaging is refined and adapted to increase engagement with support resources.

AI.tldr: 本研究在Tor暗网搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上开展了一项为期140天、涵盖近2000万次搜索的现场实验，探讨警告信息内容如何影响搜索儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）的用户行为。结果显示，所有主动警告信息相比中性信息均能提高点击率，其中以伤害为重点的信息效果最强。活动期间平台点击率从8.73%提升至15.67%，证明了信息内容在警示干预中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 尽管警告信息已被用于阻止CSAM搜索者并促使其寻求帮助，但在高匿名性环境中针对信息内容效果的大规模现场证据仍然匮乏。
AI.method: 在Tor搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上开展随机对照现场实验，历时140天，观察近2000万次搜索，其中超过300万次触发CSAM相关警告。用户被随机暴露于不同主题内容和框架的警告信息或中性信息，采用随机比较、活动层面分析和中断时间序列模型进行效果评估。
AI.result: 所有主动警告信息相比中性条件均显著提高了帮助资源的点击率，其中伤害焦点信息效果最强。平台层面点击率从干预前的8.73%上升至活动期间的15.67%。
AI.conclusion: 信息内容在塑造用户对警告干预的响应中起关键作用，支持通过优化和调整信息内容来增加对帮助资源的参与度。

title: Safe Embodied AI for Long-horizon Tasks: A Cross-layer Analysis of Robotic Manipulation
summary: Embodied AI systems are increasingly expected to reason and act over extended horizons in physical environments. This growing capability brings safety to the foreground, because failures in the physical world can harm people, damage objects, and disrupt workplaces. Although safe embodied AI has attracted substantial attention, the literature remains fragmented across planning, policy design, and runtime execution. Long-horizon robotic manipulation is a particularly revealing anchor domain for this problem because semantic misgrounding, subtask-level error propagation, execution drift, and contact-rich physical risk can accumulate within the same closed-loop system. This survey therefore provides a structured review of safety in long-horizon robotic manipulation from an embodied AI perspective. We organize the literature by intervention locus, covering planning-time, policy-time, and execution-time safety, and we analyze the strength of the evidence that each line of work provides, distinguishing formal guarantees, statistical support, and empirical safety heuristics. This framework clarifies the distinct roles of backbone capability papers, direct safety mechanisms, and benchmark or evaluation studies, while exposing where current safety claims are well supported and where they remain indirect. We identify persistent gaps, including limited evidence for policy-time safety, weak formal support for contact-rich long-horizon manipulation, immature uncertainty-triggered intervention, and a shortage of manipulation-specific safety benchmarks. We conclude by outlining research directions for cross-layer assurance, evaluation design, and safer deployment of long-horizon robotic agents in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文从具身AI视角，系统综述了长时域机器人操作中的安全问题，按规划时、策略时和执行时三个干预层面组织文献，分析了各层面安全证据的强度，并指出了持续性空白和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 随着具身AI系统在物理环境中进行长时域推理和行动的能力增强，安全问题日益突出，但相关文献分散在规划、策略设计和运行时执行等不同领域，缺乏系统性的梳理和整合。
AI.method: 采用结构化综述方法，按干预时机（规划时/策略时/执行时）组织文献，并区分形式化保证、统计支持和经验安全启发式三类证据强度进行分析。
AI.result: 揭示了各层面安全证据的支撑情况：策略时安全证据有限、接触丰富长时域操作缺乏形式化支持、不确定性触发干预尚不成熟、缺乏操作专用的安全基准。
AI.conclusion: 指出了跨层保障、评估设计和更安全部署长时域机器人代理的研究方向。

title: Disentangled Fine-Grained Prototype Learning for Incomplete Image-Tabular Classification
summary: The missing-modality problem poses a significant challenge in image-tabular multimodal learning across a wide range of multimedia applications, including product understanding, recommendation systems, and medical diagnosis. This challenge is particularly pronounced when the two modalities are highly heterogeneous, as images and tabular attributes differ substantially in their semantic granularity and data distributions. Existing methods learn modality-invariant representations through disentanglement and alignment over global token-averaged features, capturing only coarse cross-modal consistency and overlooking fine-grained semantic and distributional misalignment, which hampers the exploitation of complementary cues under missing modalities. To address this, we propose DFPL, a novel framework for fine-grained prototype learning. Specifically, Shared-Specific Prototype Modeling (SSPM) extracts compact and diverse shared and modality-specific prototypes, and further performs prototype-level disentanglement to suppress redundant intra-modality correlations. Additionally, we propose a Prototype-guided Fine-grained Alignment (PFA) module that jointly enforces prototype-level distribution matching and prototype-to-class semantic alignment within a unified prototype space, thereby preserving both fine-grained distributional and semantic consistency across modalities. We further introduce a Class-aware Multi-scale Aggregation (CMA) module to adaptively aggregate shared semantics and modality-specific characteristics from global and prototype levels for robust predictions. Extensive experiments on three diverse image-tabular benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to the previous approaches under various missing-modality settings. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DFPL框架，通过细粒度原型学习解决图像-表格多模态学习中的模态缺失问题，包括共享-特定原型建模、原型引导的细粒度对齐和类别感知多尺度聚合三个模块，在三个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过解耦和对齐全局token平均特征来学习模态不变表示，只能捕捉粗糙的跨模态一致性，忽略了细粒度的语义和分布对齐，导致在模态缺失场景下无法充分利用互补线索。
AI.method: 提出DFPL框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 共享-特定原型建模(SSPM)：提取紧凑且多样的共享和模态特定原型，进行原型级解耦以抑制冗余的模态内相关性；(2) 原型引导的细粒度对齐(PFA)：在统一原型空间中联合执行原型级分布匹配和原型到类别的语义对齐；(3) 类别感知多尺度聚合(CMA)：从全局和原型级别自适应聚合共享语义和模态特定特征进行鲁棒预测。
AI.result: 在三个不同的图像-表格基准数据集上，在各种模态缺失设置下，该方法显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: DFPL通过细粒度原型学习有效解决了高度异质的图像和表格模态在缺失场景下的对齐与融合问题，代码将公开。

title: Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning of Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning and tool use, yet long-horizon language agents still learn unsupported evidence chains, belief drift, and shortcut actions that satisfy terminal checks. Existing process rewards are mostly correlational: they reward retrieval-, reflection-, or verification-like steps without estimating whether the step contributes to final verified success under a specified intervention. We propose CVT-RL, a constrained policy-gradient algorithm with dense verifiable rewards, intervention-validity gating, and a policy-conditioned counterfactual contribution (PCCC) estimator. Deletion, semantic substitution, evidence substitution, and tool-output perturbation define separate controlled interventions; continuations are sampled from a frozen reference policy, and a selection-adjusted doubly robust estimator augments the advantage. Belief control uses only prefix-observable labels, while an augmented Lagrangian constrains unsupported claims, skipped verification, tool tampering, and unsafe calls. On long-context QA, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and web/tool tasks, CVT-RL improves average task success from 71.8% for compute-matched non-causal RL and 75.4% for an information-matched counterfactual-process baseline to 78.9%, improves evidence F1 from 78.9 to 82.8 over the information-matched baseline, and reduces measured hacking from 7.2% to 3.9%. Independent human audit estimates 4.6% hacking for CVT-RL versus 8.1% for the information-matched baseline, and adaptive detector-evasion attacks raise hacking only to 7.1%. Stratified bootstrap and mixed-effects tests give p<0.01 after Holm correction for all primary metrics. Carefully scoped counterfactual credit, paired with validity gating, diagnostics, and verifiable constraints, provides a reproducible route toward more reliable long-horizon RL for language agents.

AI.tldr: 提出CVT-RL算法，通过反事实贡献估计、干预有效性门控和可验证约束，使语言智能体在长程任务中减少证据链断裂、信念漂移和捷径行为，在多个基准上提升成功率并降低hacking率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法虽能改善推理和工具使用，但长程语言智能体仍易学习到无证据支持链、信念漂移和仅满足终端检查的捷径行为；现有过程奖励大多基于相关性（奖励检索、反思等步骤），而非估计该步骤在指定干预下是否真正贡献于最终可验证成功。
AI.method: 提出CVT-RL，包含：(1) 密集可验证奖励；(2) 干预有效性门控；(3) 基于策略的条件反事实贡献(PCCC)估计器。定义删除、语义替换、证据替换、工具输出扰动四种控制干预，从冻结参考策略采样续文，结合选择调整的双重稳健估计器增强优势函数。信念控制仅使用前缀可观测标签，增广拉格朗日方法约束无证据主张、跳过验证、工具篡改和不安全调用。
AI.result: 在长上下文QA、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld及网络/工具任务上，CVT-RL将平均任务成功率从非因果RL的71.8%和信息匹配反事实过程基线的75.4%提升至78.9%；证据F1从78.9提升至82.8；测量hacking率从7.2%降至3.9%。独立人工审计估计hacking率为4.6%（基线8.1%），自适应检测规避攻击下hacking仅升至7.1%。所有主要指标经Holm校正后p<0.01。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的反事实信用分配、有效性门控、诊断与可验证约束相结合，为构建更可靠的长程RL语言智能体提供了可复现的路径。

title: Auditing LLM Editorial Bias in News Media Exposure

AI.tldr: 本研究首次审计比较了GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和Gemini-2.0-Flash三种LLM代理与Google News在新闻来源多样性、意识形态倾向和可靠性方面的差异。发现LLM呈现更少的独特来源、更不均衡的注意力分配，且各有不同的意识形态偏向，表明LLM已形成"代理编辑策略"，对信息生态的透明性和多元性构成挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM日益成为用户获取网络内容的入口，但其新闻选择机制不透明，可能影响舆论、加剧信息茧房、威胁公民话语和公众信任。传统搜索引擎的检索和排序机制已被广泛研究，而LLM的"黑箱"选择过程缺乏系统审计。
AI.method: 跨24个全球主题，对GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-Flash三种LLM代理与Google News进行对比审计，测量媒体来源的多样性、意识形态倾向和事实可靠性，并在提示变体和替代可靠性基准下测试鲁棒性。
AI.result: 与Google News相比，LLM呈现的独特新闻来源更少，注意力分配更不均衡。GPT-4o-Mini偏向事实性高且右倾的来源；Claude-3.7-Sonnet偏好机构和公民社会领域，略微放大右倾曝光；Gemini-2.0-Flash呈现轻微左倾但事实性无显著变化。这些模式在提示变体和替代基准下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: LLM已经实施了"代理编辑政策"，以有别于传统聚合器的方式策展信息。理解并治理其新兴的编辑权力对于确保数字信息生态系统的透明度、多元性和信任至关重要。

title: Preserving Full 6-DOF Actuation Under Abrupt Total Rotor Failures: Passive Fault-Tolerant Flight Control Using a Biaxial-Tilt Hexacopter
summary: Conventional multirotors suffer from a rapid collapse of attainable wrench space (AWS) under abrupt total rotor failures, rendering full 6-DOF recovery physically impossible. This paper addresses passive fault-tolerant flight of a biaxial-tilt overactuated hexacopter (BTO) under abrupt total rotor failures that are a priori unknown to the controller. The control design and analysis focus on representative abrupt rotor-failure cases for which the post-failure system remains fully actuated, while no explicit fault detection, isolation, or fault-mode switching is assumed. First, we extend the inscribed-sphere metric of the AWS by incorporating the transient-wrench-jump term, enabling quantitative feasibility assessment under up to three simultaneous rotor failures and benchmarking against uniaxial-tilt and coplanar hexacopters. Second, we develop two computationally efficient passive schemes without relying on fault detection or online optimization. One scheme operates at the controller layer by combining a high-order fully actuated (HOFA) controller with a linear extended state observer (LESO) for lumped-disturbance rejection. The other scheme operates at the allocator layer by using model-reference adaptive control allocation with momentum-based wrench estimation to compensate for control-allocation biases. Simulations and flight experiments validate stable hovering and 6-DOF trajectory tracking under single and multiple rotor failures. Further systematic comparisons confirm that the BTO provides larger recovery margins than uniaxial-tilt and coplanar designs. Additional onboard-sensor-only experiments, including indoor tracking under wind disturbance, outdoor tracking under extreme conditions, narrow-frame traversal, and contact-based aerial writing, further validate the robustness of the proposed framework in complex operational environments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对双轴倾斜过驱动六旋翼（BTO）在突发性完全旋翼失效（控制器事前未知）下的被动容错飞行问题，提出了两种无需故障检测或在线优化的高效被动方案：一种基于高阶全驱动控制器与线性扩展状态观测器的控制层方案，另一种基于模型参考自适应控制分配与动量估计的分配层方案。实验验证了在单发和多发失效下对稳定悬停与六自由度轨迹跟踪的有效性，并证明BTO相比单轴倾斜和共面六旋翼具有更大的恢复裕度。
AI.motivation: 传统多旋翼在突发性完全旋翼失效后可达力矩空间急剧坍塌，导致六自由度恢复在物理上不可行。现有方法多依赖故障检测与在线优化，实时性和鲁棒性受限。本文旨在为BTO设计无需故障检测的被动容错控制方案，并定量评估其在多旋翼失效下的恢复能力。
AI.method: 1) 扩展AWS的内接球度量，引入瞬态力矩跳变项，实现最多三旋翼同时失效下的可行性量化评估；2) 提出两种被动容错方案：方案一采用高阶全驱动控制器结合线性扩展状态观测器；方案二采用模型参考自适应控制分配结合基于动量的力矩估计；3) 通过仿真与飞行实验验证，包括室内外跟踪、窄框穿越和接触式空中书写等复杂条件。
AI.result: 仿真与实验证明：所提方案在单发和多发旋翼失效下实现稳定悬停与六自由度轨迹跟踪；系统对比表明BTO比单轴倾斜和共面六旋翼具有更大恢复裕度；鲁棒性在风扰、极端条件、窄框穿越和空中书写等场景中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的被动容错控制框架在不依赖故障检测和在线优化的前提下，有效解决了BTO在突发性旋翼失效下的容错飞行问题，显著提升了恢复裕度与鲁棒性，验证了实际部署的可行性。

title: Horse Eye Blink Detection and Classification for Equine Affective State Assessment
summary: Automated detection of equine facial action units (AUs) is a promising yet under-explored avenue for pain and affective state assessment in horses. Half and full-blink movements are recognised indicators of pain and stress, but as micro-expressions, their subtle, fine-grained nature makes them easily missed by the naked eye and only discernible through frame-by-frame video inspection, making reliable automated detection from video a particularly demanding task. We develop and evaluate three methods for automated blink classification from horse videos: a frame-based YOLOv12 detector, an optical flow magnitude thresholding approach, and a fine-tuned VideoMAE model, tested on a publicly available dataset. We achieve a macro-F1 score of 0.898 when doing blink classification and 0.926 on binary blink detection. Our results highlight both the potential and the inherent challenges of fine-grained AU detection for equine welfare monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文针对马匹面部动作单元（AU）中半眨眼和全眨眼这一细粒度微表情的自动检测问题，开发并评估了三种方法（基于帧的YOLOv12检测器、光流幅度阈值方法、微调VideoMAE模型），在公开数据集上实现了眨眼分类宏F1=0.898和二值眨眼检测F1=0.926，展示了自动细粒度AU检测用于马匹福利监测的潜力与挑战。
AI.motivation: 马匹眨眼动作（半眨眼和全眨眼）是疼痛和压力状态的重要指示信号，但作为微表情，其细微特性导致肉眼难以捕捉，只能通过逐帧视频分析来识别，因此亟需可靠、自动化的视频检测方法以实现马匹福利的客观监测。
AI.method: 开发并比较了三种方法：(1) 基于帧的YOLOv12目标检测器，(2) 光流幅度阈值方法，(3) 微调的VideoMAE视频理解模型；在公开数据集上进行测试和评估。
AI.result: 眨眼分类任务达到宏F1=0.898，二值眨眼检测任务达到F1=0.926。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度AU自动检测在马匹福利监测方面具有潜力，但仍存在固有挑战，需进一步研究。

title: REGEN: Reference-Guided Synthetic Multivariate Time Series Generation for Forecasting
summary:
Training robust multivariate time series forecasting models requires large, diverse corpora, yet many real-world domains provide only a handful of observed sequences. Existing generators fail to resolve this mismatch: prior-based approaches (e.g., CauKer, TimePFN) produce domain-agnostic samples, while data-driven methods (e.g., TimeGAN) treat references as black-box supervision, forfeiting explicit control over periodic structure, local variability, and cross-variable dynamics.
  We propose ReGeN, a reference-guided generative pipeline that treats observed sequences not as examples to imitate, but as structural scaffolds for controllable synthesis. ReGeN decomposes each reference into three interpretable components: a phase-aligned periodic backbone capturing dominant domain morphology; per-variable stochastic residuals modeled with a deep-kernel Gaussian process; and lag-aware cross-variable dependencies injected through a structural causal model with fitted coupling coefficients. Sampling these components at controllable temperature broadens distributional coverage while preserving domain-grounded structure.
  We show that ReGeN-generated data consistently substitutes for real sibling data with minimal forecasting degradation, and in strongly periodic domains such as traffic, can outperform the real source itself. We further show that a foundation model pretrained on ReGeN corpora outperforms those pretrained on prior-based and data-driven synthetic alternatives. This suggests that in low-data regimes, how reference data is structurally exploited can matter as much as how much data is available.

AI.tldr: ReGeN是一个参考引导的生成式框架，将观测序列分解为周期骨架、随机残差和跨变量依赖三个可解释组件，通过可控采样生成多样化时间序列数据，在低数据场景下能有效替代真实数据甚至超越真实数据，并且基于ReGeN预训练的基础模型优于其他合成数据方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法存在两种缺陷：基于先验的方法（如CauKer, TimePFN）产生领域无关的样本，而数据驱动方法（如TimeGAN）将参考数据视为黑盒监督，缺乏对周期结构、局部变异和跨变量动力学的显式控制。真实世界中许多领域只能提供少量观测序列，训练鲁棒的多变量时间序列预测模型需要大规模、多样化的语料库，两者之间存在严重不匹配。
AI.method: ReGeN将每个参考序列分解为三个可解释组件：(1) 相位对齐的周期骨干，捕获主导领域形态；(2) 每变量随机残差，使用深核高斯过程建模；(3) 时滞感知的跨变量依赖，通过结构因果模型和拟合耦合系数注入。通过可控温度对这些组件进行采样，可在保持领域基础结构的同时扩展分布覆盖范围。
AI.result: ReGeN生成的数据在最小化预测退化的情况下能一致替代真实兄弟数据；在强周期领域（如交通）中甚至能超越真实源数据。基于ReGeN语料库预训练的基础模型优于基于先验和数据驱动的合成数据预训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 在低数据场景下，如何结构性利用参考数据与可用数据量同等重要。ReGeN通过将观测序列视为结构支架而非模仿对象，实现了可控合成和分布扩展。

title: A Systematic Analysis of Biases in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become indispensable tools for acquiring information and supporting human decision-making. However, ensuring that these models uphold fairness across varied contexts is critical to their safe and responsible deployment. In this study, we undertake a comprehensive examination of four widely adopted LLMs, probing their underlying biases and inclinations across the dimensions of politics, ideology, alliance, language, and gender. Through a series of carefully designed experiments, we investigate their political neutrality using news summarization, ideological biases through news stance classification, tendencies toward specific geopolitical alliances via United Nations voting patterns, language bias in the context of multilingual story completion, and gender-related affinities as revealed by responses to the World Values Survey. Results indicate that while the LLMs are aligned to be neutral and impartial, they still show biases and affinities of different types.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了四种主流大语言模型在政治、意识形态、联盟、语言和性别五个维度的偏见，通过新闻摘要、立场分类、联合国投票模式分析、多语言故事补全和世界价值观调查等方法，发现尽管模型被设计为中立，但仍表现出多种类型的偏见和倾向。
AI.motivation: 确保大语言模型在不同情境下保持公平性，以实现安全负责任的部署。
AI.method: 对四种LLM进行五项实验：新闻摘要测试政治中立性、新闻立场分类测试意识形态偏见、联合国投票模式分析测试地缘政治联盟倾向、多语言故事补全测试语言偏见、世界价值观调查回答测试性别倾向。
AI.result: LLMs虽被对齐为中立，但仍表现出不同类型的偏见和倾向。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在追求中立性的过程中仍存在系统性偏差，需要进一步改进对齐策略。

title: Dynamic Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Robotic Cellular Warehousing Systems
summary: Robotic Cellular Warehousing Systems (RCWS) give rise to multi-agent pickup and delivery (MAPD) processes in which robots sequentially collect multiple stock-keeping units (SKUs) for each order. Unlike classical MAPD formulations that assume static tasks, real warehouse operations often involve dynamic order evolution, where new SKUs may be appended to an order while it is being executed. Motivated by this practical requirement, this letter formulates the Dynamic Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery problem considering internal order evolution for the first time. Building on the token passing paradigm, we propose two event-triggered online replanning algorithms. The first, Dynamic Token Passing, performs localized replanning upon order updates through add-order decomposition and priority-based token scheduling while preserving collision-free execution. The second, Cooperative Token Passing, further enables idle robots to opportunistically assist newly added pickups, improving system-level efficiency. Simulation results in RCWS environments demonstrate that the proposed methods significantly reduce order flowtime compared with static and non-cooperative baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文首次针对机器人仓储系统中订单内部SKU动态追加的问题，提出两种基于令牌传递的事件触发在线重规划算法（动态令牌传递与协作令牌传递），显著降低订单流时间。
AI.motivation: 实际仓储作业中订单在执行过程中会动态追加新SKU，而传统MAPD模型仅假设静态任务，无法应对这种内部订单演化，亟需新的算法来解决这一实际需求。
AI.method: 基于令牌传递范式，提出两种事件触发在线重规划算法：1) 动态令牌传递（DTP），通过添加订单分解与优先级令牌调度执行局部重规划；2) 协作令牌传递（CTP），进一步允许空闲机器人主动协助新追加的拣选任务。
AI.result: 在机器人仓储系统仿真环境中，所提方法相比静态基线和非协作基线显著降低了订单流时间。
AI.conclusion: 针对动态订单演化的MAPD问题，基于令牌传递的事件触发重规划是有效解决方案，协作机制能进一步提升系统效率。

title: ORACLE-CT: Anatomy-Aware Support Pooling for CT Classification
summary:
Abdominal CT disease classification is challenging because each scan is a large 3D volume with many possible findings, while diagnostic evidence is often confined to specific organs or anatomical compartments. Most study-level classifiers aggregate encoder features using anatomy-agnostic pooling or attention, creating a mismatch between localized disease evidence and global evidence aggregation. We propose ORACLE--CT, an encoder-agnostic anatomy-aware aggregation framework that uses multi-organ segmentation to define label-specific anatomical supports and restrict attention pooling to relevant regions. The framework supports single-organ, multi-organ union, comparative, localized, and global support strategies.
  We evaluate ORACLE--CT with three encoder families: DINOv3, I3D--ResNet-121, and the radiology-native Pillar--0 encoder. Models are trained end-to-end on MERLIN and evaluated internally and under frozen external transfer to Duke--Abdomen and AMOS. Compared with global average pooling, support-masked pooling improved MERLIN macro-AUROC/AUPRC from 0.838/0.638 to 0.858/0.676 for DINOv3 and from 0.829/0.617 to 0.848/0.659 for I3D--ResNet-121. On harmonized 10-label external evaluation, DINOv3 improved on Duke--Abdomen from 0.802/0.628 to 0.835/0.683 and on AMOS from 0.742/0.313 to 0.762/0.350, with similar gains for I3D--ResNet-121. For Pillar--0, most gains came from learned attention, with smaller additional benefit from anatomical masking. ORACLE--CT improves discrimination and external robustness while preserving an auditable link between predictions and anatomical evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出ORACLE-CT框架，通过多器官分割定义标签特定的解剖支持区域，将注意力池化限制在相关区域，解决腹部CT分类中全局聚合与局部证据不匹配的问题。在多个编码器和数据集上验证，显著提升分类性能和外推鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 腹部CT疾病分类中，诊断证据通常局限于特定器官或解剖区域，而现有研究级分类器使用与解剖无关的全局池化或注意力机制，导致局部化疾病证据与全局证据聚合之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出ORACLE-CT，一种编码器无关的解剖感知聚合框架。利用多器官分割定义标签特定的解剖支持区域，将注意力池化限制在相关区域。支持单器官、多器官联合、比较性、局部化和全局五种支持策略。
AI.result: 在MERLIN内部评估中，支持掩码池化相比全局平均池化，DINOv3的macro-AUROC/AUPRC从0.838/0.638提升至0.858/0.676，I3D-ResNet-121从0.829/0.617提升至0.848/0.659。外部迁移到Duke-Abdomen和AMOS上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: ORACLE-CT通过解剖感知的注意力池化，在提升腹部CT分类判别能力和外部鲁棒性的同时，保持了预测与解剖证据之间的可审计关联。

title: Data-efficient flood depth prediction through domain-aware coreset selection and tabular foundation models
summary: Near-real-time flood depth prediction demands surrogate models that are accurate, fast, and transferable across watersheds. Supervised surrogates can match physics-based simulators in accuracy but need millions of training rows per watershed and cannot extrapolate beyond their original mesh. We propose a domain-aware coreset construction pipeline that conditions a tabular foundation model at inference time. The pipeline stratifies storms by return period and most-affected watershed, then samples hexagons with a target-aware spatial selector. With 0.7% of the per-watershed training pool, the model attains a mean $R^2$ of 0.663 across nine Houston-area watersheds, within 98.5% of the supervised reference ($R^2$ = 0.673). It transfers to held-out watersheds without task-specific retraining, staying ahead of a coreset-trained supervised baseline. On real storms it exceeds the supervised reference on a far out-of-distribution case and trails it on a mostly in-distribution one. Domain-aware coreset construction lets tabular foundation models deliver data-efficient, watershed-transferable flood predictions without per-watershed training.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种领域感知的coreset构建流程，通过条件化表格基础模型在推理时，仅用0.7%的训练数据即可实现跨流域的洪水深度预测，R²达到0.663，达到监督参考的98.5%。
AI.motivation: 近实时洪水深度预测需要既准确快速又可跨流域迁移的替代模型，而监督式替代模型虽然精度高但需每流域数百万训练样本且无法外推。
AI.method: 构建领域感知的coreset构建流程：按重现期和最受影响流域对风暴分层，然后用目标感知空间选择器采样六边形，在推理时条件化表格基础模型。
AI.result: 用0.7%的每流域训练数据，在休斯顿9个流域平均R²=0.663（监督参考98.5%）；可迁移到未见流域；在远分布外实测风暴上超过监督参考。
AI.conclusion: 领域感知的coreset构建使表格基础模型能够实现数据高效、跨流域可迁移的洪水预测，无需每流域重新训练。

title: Using street view images and visual LLMs to predict heritage values for governance support: Risks, ethics, and policy implications
summary: During 2025 and 2026, the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive is being implemented in the European Union member states, requiring all member states to have National Building Renovation Plans. In Sweden, there is no comprehensive national register of buildings with heritage values. This is seen as a barrier for the analyses underlying the development of Building Renovation Plans by the involved Swedish authorities. The purpose of this research was to assist Swedish authorities in developing information on heritage values in the Swedish building stock. Buildings in street view images from all over Sweden (N=154 710) have been analysed using multimodal Large Language Models (LLM) to assess visible aspects indicative of heritage value. Zero-shot predictions by LLMs were used as a basis for identifying buildings with potential heritage values for 5.0 million square meters of heated floor area. In this paper, the results of the predictions and lessons learned are presented and related to the development of the Swedish Building Renovation Plan as part of governance. The problems with the method and potential improvements are discussed. Risks with authorities use of LLM-based data are addressed, with a focus on issues of transparency, error detection and sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用多模态大语言模型（LLM）分析瑞典全国154,710张街景图像，识别具有潜在遗产价值的建筑，以支持欧盟《建筑能效指令》要求的国家建筑翻新规划制定。零样本预测覆盖了500万平方米 heated floor area，同时讨论了该方法在透明度、错误检测和谄媚问题上的风险。
AI.motivation: 瑞典缺乏全面的建筑遗产价值国家登记册，这阻碍了其依据欧盟《建筑能效指令》制定国家建筑翻新规划所需的基础分析。研究旨在协助瑞典当局开发建筑存量中遗产价值的信息。
AI.method: 使用多模态大语言模型（LLM）对瑞典全国154,710张街景图像进行零样本预测，评估建筑外观中可观察到的遗产价值指标。
AI.result: 零样本预测识别出了具有潜在遗产价值的建筑，覆盖500万平方米 heated floor area的研究基础。
AI.conclusion: 展示了LLM在建筑遗产价值评估中的可行性，同时指出了方法存在的问题和改进方向，并强调了当局使用LLM数据时在透明度、错误检测和谄媚（sycophancy）方面的风险。

title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
summary: In humanoid motion control, model predictive control (MPC) offers physically grounded prediction and constraint handling, while reinforcement learning (RL) enables robust whole-body skills through large-scale simulation. However, using MPC inside RL often requires time-consuming problem construction or excessive training overhead, making such frameworks difficult to justify in practice. This work studies efficient training-time MPC guidance for humanoid locomotion and manipulation, termed MPC-RL. We introduce a centroidal-dynamics MPC reward formulation that leverages guidance from MPC trajectories in training time. To make this practical in massively parallel RL, we develop $π^n$MPC, a parallel-in-horizon and construction-free batched GPU MPC solver that operates directly on time-varying dynamics to avoid high memory usage and pre-compilation. Through a variety of comparative studies and hardware validations, we have found that MPC-RL achieves superior performance in locomotion and manipulation skills. The code base is available at https://github.com/junhengl/mpc-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPC-RL框架，通过引入质心动力学MPC奖励公式和并行GPU求解器π^nMPC，在训练时高效利用MPC轨迹引导强化学习，在类人机器人 locomotion 和 manipulation 任务上取得了优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MPC与RL结合的方法存在训练时问题构建耗时或训练开销过大的问题，难以在实践中证明其合理性。本文旨在研究高效的训练时MPC引导方法，使MPC-RL框架在类人机器人运动控制和操作任务中更加实用。
AI.method: 1）提出质心动力学MPC奖励公式，在训练时利用MPC轨迹引导RL；2）开发π^nMPC，一种支持并行时间维度、无需构建问题的批处理GPU MPC求解器，直接处理时变动力学以避免高内存使用和预编译。
AI.result: 通过多项对比研究和硬件验证，MPC-RL在 locomotion（移动）和 manipulation（操作）技能上取得了优越性能。
AI.conclusion: MPC-RL框架能够高效地将MPC引导融入训练过程，显著提升类人机器人运动控制和操作能力，且代码已开源。

title: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning
summary: Learning semantics is essential for deep learning models to be interpretable and better aligned with human reasoning. Concept-based models approach this by representing classes through meaningful semantic abstractions, but typically treat all concepts as a flat, unstructured set learned at a single neural network layer. This overlooks a fundamental property of human semantic understanding: concepts being organized hierarchically, from general to specific. While deep networks do learn a hierarchy of visual features, this structure is rarely aligned with explicit semantic hierarchies. Drawing on Formal Concept Analysis, we demonstrate that formal concept lattices provide principled semantic scaffolds to guide neural network learning. These lattices naturally identify where in the network concepts should be learned based on their level of generality. This allows the model to develop staged, semantically grounded representations throughout its depth. Empirical results on real-world datasets show that our models produce more interpretable embeddings, support more effective interventions, and learn concept representations that are both meaningful and hierarchically structured.

AI.tldr: 本文利用形式概念分析（FCA）中的概念格作为语义支架，指导深度神经网络在不同层学习不同抽象层次的概念，从而构建层次化、可解释的概念表示。
AI.motivation: 现有概念模型通常将所有概念视为扁平的无结构集合，忽略了人类语义理解中概念从一般到特殊的层次化组织特性，导致模型缺乏与显式语义层次对齐的结构化表示。
AI.method: 基于形式概念分析（FCA），利用形式概念格提供原则性的语义支架，根据概念的泛化程度确定其在网络中的学习层级，从而在整个网络深度中逐步构建语义分层的表示。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法生成的嵌入更具可解释性，支持更有效的干预，且学到的概念表示既具有语义意义又具有层次结构。
AI.conclusion: 将概念格引入神经网络可以对齐语义层次结构，提升模型的可解释性和概念学习的结构化程度。

title: Sharp Low-Degree Thresholds for Planted-vs-Planted Testing
summary: We establish the first sharp thresholds for low-degree polynomial tests in planted-vs-planted settings, where the goal is to determine with vanishing error which of two structured planted mechanisms generated the observed data. We prove matching low-degree upper and lower bounds for counting communities in the planted submatrix and planted dense subgraph models. The resulting testing threshold coincides, down to the sharp constant, with the known low-degree recovery threshold. In contrast, the task of weak testing, where the goal is to outperform random guessing, does not have a sharp threshold but rather a smooth transition, which we identify. To prove our results, we develop a framework for planted-vs-planted testing that builds on a latent-variable expansion originating in low-degree recovery and employs new methods to identify and prune non-signal contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了种植-种植设置下低次多项式检验的首个尖锐阈值，证明了 planted submatrix 和 planted dense subgraph 模型中计数社区的匹配低次上下界，并揭示了弱检验的平滑过渡现象。
AI.motivation: 填补种植-种植设置下低次多项式检验尖锐阈值的空白，严格刻画该设置下的可检验性边界。
AI.method: 构建基于潜在变量展开的检验框架，借鉴低次恢复中的技术，并引入新方法识别和剪除非信号贡献。
AI.result: 得到与低次恢复阈值精确匹配的尖锐检验阈值，同时发现弱检验呈现平滑过渡而非尖锐阈值。
AI.conclusion: 种植-种植设置下低次检验存在尖锐阈值且与恢复阈值一致，而弱检验具有不同的相变特性。

title: Queer NLP: A Critical Survey on Literature Gaps, Biases and Trends
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) technologies are rapidly reshaping how language is created, processed, and interpreted by humans. With current and potential applications in hiring, law, healthcare, and other areas that impact people's lives, understanding and mitigating harms towards marginalized groups is critical. In this survey, we examine NLP research papers that explicitly address the relationship between LGBTQIA+ communities and NLP technologies. We systematically review all such papers published in the ACL Anthology up until February 2026 (n=122), to answer the following research questions: (1) What are current research trends? (2) What gaps exist in terms of topics and methods? (3) What areas are open for future work? We find that while the number of papers on queer NLP has grown within the last few years, most papers take a reactive rather than a proactive approach, focusing on shortcomings of existing systems rather than creating new solutions. Our survey uncovers many opportunities for future work, especially regarding stakeholder involvement, intersectionality, interdisciplinarity, and languages other than English. We also offer an outlook from a queer studies perspective, highlighting understudied topics and blind spots in the harms addressed in NLP papers. Beyond being a roadmap of what has been done, this survey is a call to action for work towards more just and inclusive NLP technologies.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统分析了截至2026年2月ACL Anthology中122篇涉及LGBTQIA+群体与NLP技术关系的论文，发现相关研究数量在增长但多采取被动应对态度（聚焦现有系统缺陷），并指出了未来研究机会，同时从酷儿研究视角呼吁构建更公正包容的NLP技术。
AI.motivation: NLP技术正在深刻影响人类语言处理方式，并在招聘、法律、医疗等关键领域应用，然而对LGBTQIA+等边缘群体的潜在危害认识不足。为此，本文旨在系统梳理现有研究，理解当前趋势、识别研究空白，并推动更包容的NLP技术发展。
AI.method: 系统综述方法，对ACL Anthology中截至2026年2月的122篇明确涉及LGBTQIA+社区与NLP技术关系的论文进行全面分析，围绕三个研究问题展开：当前研究趋势、主题与方法上的空白、未来工作方向。
AI.result: 发现近几年来关于酷儿NLP的论文数量有所增长，但大多数论文采取被动应对而非主动预防的研究取向，主要关注现有系统的缺陷而非提出新的解决方案。同时揭示了大量的未来工作机会，特别是在利益相关者参与、交叉性、跨学科性以及英语以外的语言方面。
AI.conclusion: 该综述不仅是对已有研究的梳理，更是一种行动呼吁，从酷儿研究视角指出被忽视的研究主题和盲点，号召研究者为构建更公正、更包容的NLP技术而努力。

title: DexFuture: Hierarchical Future-State Visuomotor Targeting for Bimanual Dexterous Tool Use
summary: Bimanual dexterous tool use remains challenging for robots due to high-dimensional hand configurations and complex hand-tool-object dynamics and contact. Most existing control policies depend on future configuration references provided from demonstrations, while future action-conditioned world models require slow online planning over high-dimensional action sequences. A significant challenge is generating a dynamically consistent future reference trajectory without relying on privileged states from demonstrations or slow counterfactual planning. We propose DexFuture, a hierarchical system that couples a high-level Future-State Visuomotor Target Predictor with a low-level Target-Conditioned Structured Dexterous Policy. Conditioned on egocentric RGB, proprioceptive and geometric history, the high-level predictor constructs structured hand-tool-object visuomotor embeddings and uses a horizon-conditioned transformer to generate a multi-step future target trajectory. Then, the low-level policy tracks them with a target-conditioned per-link transformer. This hierarchy decouples coarse future reference generation from fine-grained action control, and slow long-horizon semantic prediction from high-frequency execution. On OakInk2 bimanual tool-use tasks, DexFuture achieves 90% of the privileged-oracle performance, compared to 7% for a no-reference policy. DexFuture operates at 60 Hz, approximately 250 times faster than DexWM-style Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) planning with a future action-conditioned world model.

AI.tldr: DexFuture是一个分层系统，通过高层未来状态视觉运动目标预测器和低层目标条件结构化灵巧策略，在无需演示或慢速规划的情况下生成动态一致的未来参考轨迹，在双手灵巧工具使用任务中达到特权oracle性能的90%，运行速度比CEM规划快约250倍。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧工具使用控制策略大多依赖示教提供的未来配置参考，或需要未来动作条件世界模型进行慢速在线规划。核心挑战在于如何在不依赖示教特权状态或慢速反事实规划的情况下，生成动态一致的未来参考轨迹。
AI.method: 提出DexFuture分层系统：(1) 高层Future-State Visuomotor Target Predictor基于RGB、 proprioceptive和几何历史，通过horizon-conditioned transformer生成多步未来目标轨迹；(2) 低层Target-Conditioned Structured Dexterous Policy通过目标条件per-link transformer跟踪目标轨迹。分层结构将粗粒度未来参考生成与细粒度动作控制解耦，慢速长程语义预测与高频执行解耦。
AI.result: 在OakInk2双手工具使用任务上，DexFuture达到特权oracle性能的90%，而无参考策略仅达7%。系统运行频率60Hz，比DexWM风格的CEM规划快约250倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层架构将未来参考生成与细粒度控制解耦，能够在不依赖示教或慢速规划的情况下实现高效的双手灵巧工具操作，显著优于无参考策略并接近oracle性能。

title: Can We Predict The Human Preference For Text-to-Image Content Prior To Generation And Is It Even Useful To Do So?
summary: Diffusion Models (DM) have revolutionized text-driven generation by enabling the synthesis of high-quality, photorealistic visual content from user prompts. Whereas prior advances in visual generation such as VAEs and GANs were primarily evaluated on perceptual or visual similarity metrics such as FID PSNR, DM advances have fostered the development of more advanced Human Preference Metrics (HPM) that model and quantify human judgment as scalar values. However, DMs synthesize content using an inherently stochastic process where random noise seeds generation. The initial random noise directly affects the quality of generated outputs, both qualitatively and quantitatively. This influence is pronounced in smaller models for local deployment scenarios. Given this phenomenon, we first investigate to what extent we can predict scalar HPM scores prior to committing compute resources for generation. Further, we then investigate to what extent we can leverage such prediction to improve the quality of generated images, and also study which HPMs are best suited for this task. Our investigation reveals that not only is this possible, but that it is feasible to achieve negligible hardware overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在扩散模型（DM）中，能否在投入计算资源进行图像生成之前，预测人类偏好指标（HPM）分数，并利用这种预测来优化生成质量，且实现极低的硬件开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中的随机噪声种子直接影响生成质量，尤其在本地部署的小模型中更为显著。当前缺乏在生成前预测生成质量的方法，导致可能浪费计算资源生成低质量图像。
AI.method: 首先研究能否在生成前预测标量HPM分数，然后探索如何利用这种预测来提升生成图像质量，同时比较不同HPM在该任务上的适用性。
AI.result: 生成前预测HPM分数是可行的，且能够以极低的硬件开销实现质量改进。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型生成前可以通过预测HPM分数来筛选或优化噪声种子，从而在不显著增加计算负担的前提下提升生成图像质量。

title: Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations
summary: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms Itô dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern Itô flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean Itô dynamics, Munthe-Kaas--Wright planar rooted trees for ordered covariant derivatives on manifolds, and the shuffle algebra in the classical Stratonovich case. This yields intrinsic coarse-step dynamics that exactly preserve manifold constraints. Finally, we introduce a branched signature-kernel objective to enable Itô-consistent law matching by making quadratic-variation terms visible during training. On rough Bergomi volatility, sim-to-real $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ dynamics forecasting, and SPD covariance dynamics, B-NRDEs offer a unified, effective approach to stochastic and manifold-valued dynamics beyond the Euclidean--Stratonovich setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），通过Hopf代数框架将NRDE的log-ODE步骤重新解释为流形上的几何数值积分，匹配驱动代数与主导微积分（Grossman-Larson树用于欧几里得Itô动力学，Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面根树用于流形上的有序协变导数，shuffle代数用于经典Stratonovich情形），并引入分支签名核目标使二次变差项在训练中可见，从而在粗糙Bergomi波动率、SO(3)动力学预测和SPD协方差动力学等任务中统一有效地处理欧几里得-Stratonovich框架之外的随机和流形值动力学。
AI.motivation: NRDEs依赖shuffle代数（Stratonovich微积分的代数对应），无法暴露Itô动力学所需的二次变差项，也无法处理带联络流形上Itô流所需的有序协变导数，限制了其在更广泛随机和流形值动力学场景中的应用。
AI.method: 提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），采用Hopf代数框架，将NRDE的log-ODE步骤重新解释为流形上的几何数值积分，根据不同的微积分类型匹配相应的代数结构（Grossman-Larson树、Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面根树、shuffle代数），并引入分支签名核目标以在训练中暴露二次变差项。
AI.result: 在粗糙Bergomi波动率、sim-to-real SO(3)动力学预测和SPD协方差动力学三个任务上，B-NRDEs展示了统一有效的性能，能够处理欧几里得-Stratonovich框架之外的随机和流形值动力学。
AI.conclusion: B-NRDEs为超越经典欧几里得-Stratonovich设置的随机和流形值动力学提供了一个统一的、有效的框架，通过代数结构的匹配和签名核目标的引入，弥补了NRDEs在Itô动力学和流形约束方面的不足。

title: Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation
comment: v2. 65 pp, 9 figs, 8 tables, 8 appendices. Pre-registered on OSF: doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/7XM3D. Code+data: doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20060457. VERSIO-AI v1.2 reporting checklist (Appendix A): doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20060459. frontierlag package + per-DOI audit tool: frontierlag.org
summary:
Readers of applied-domain LLM capability evaluations want to know what AI systems can currently do. That literature answers a related, but consequentially different, question: what older, cheaper, less-elicited models could do months or years earlier (a 2026 paper evaluating GPT-3.5 or GPT-4 zero-shot, say, against a frontier of reasoning-capable, tool-using systems like GPT-5.5 Pro and Claude Opus 4.7), often reported with sparse configuration details and abstracted upward into claims about "AI" that propagate through citations, media, and policy. We measure the 'publication elicitation gap' (the gap between these answers) in a pre-registered audit of 112,303 LLM-keyword-matched candidate records (2022-01 to 2026-04; 18,574 admissible, 4,766 full-paper texts retrievable), comparing tested models to the contemporaneous frontier on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), reproduced under Arena Elo and Artificial Analysis.
  The median paper evaluates a model +10.85 ECI (~1.4x the distance between Claude Sonnet 3.7 and Claude Opus 4.5) behind the contemporaneous frontier at evaluation time (H1); an exploratory rational-lag baseline (H8) decomposes this into ~25% peer-review latency, ~75% excess lag. The gap is widening at +5.53 ECI/year (H2; 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). Meanwhile, only 3.2% of abstracts (21.2% of full-texts) disclose reasoning-mode status on reasoning-capable models (H4) and 52.5% (95% CI [48.2, 56.9]) state conclusions at the level of "AI" rather than the evaluated model(s), rising at OR = 1.23/year.
  Proposed remedies include API-access subsidies and editorial enforcement of reporting frameworks mandating configuration-surface disclosure (model snapshot, reasoning mode/effort, tool access, scaffolding, prompting, etc.); VERSIO-AI is a 13-item checklist (Core 3 desk-reject) extending existing frameworks at the elicitation surface, with per-DOI analysis at frontierlag.org.

AI.tldr: 对112,303篇LLM相关论文（2022-2026）的审计发现：中位论文测试的模型比同期前沿落后10.85 ECI（约1.4倍Claude Sonnet 3.7到Opus 4.5的差距），其中25%归因于同行评审延迟，75%为超额滞后；该差距以每年5.53 ECI的速度扩大；仅3.2%的摘要披露推理模式状态，52.5%的结论将特定模型能力泛化为"AI"能力。提出VERSIO-AI清单作为补救措施。
AI.motivation: 应用领域LLM能力评估的读者希望了解AI系统当前的能力，但现有文献实际回答的是一个相关但有本质差异的问题：即更早、更廉价、更少诱导的旧模型在数月或数年前的表现，且常以稀疏的配置细节和抽象化的"AI"式结论进行传播，导致严重的信息滞后和泛化偏差。
AI.method: 预注册审计，从112,303篇LLM关键词匹配的候选记录（2022.01-2026.04）中筛选出18,574篇可采纳论文，获取4,766篇全文，将测试模型与同期前沿（基于Epoch AI能力指数ECI，辅以Arena Elo和Artificial Analysis）进行对比。
AI.result: 中位论文测试模型落后前沿10.85 ECI（H1）；差距以5.53 ECI/年扩大（H2）；仅3.2%摘要/21.2%全文披露推理模式状态（H4）；52.5%的结论将能力归因于"AI"而非具体模型（以OR=1.23/年上升）。超额滞后中约25%来自同行评审延迟，75%为其他因素。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM评估文献存在严重的"发表诱导差距"（publication elicitation gap），且该差距在持续扩大。提出补救方案包括API使用补贴、编辑强制要求配置表面披露，以及VERSIO-AI清单（13项，其中核心3项为直接退稿标准）以规范评估报告。

title: PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies operate in a closed loop in real-world robot tasks: a robot observes the scene, executes an action chunk, and conditions its next decision on the resulting observation. However, most existing world models for robot action evaluation are limited to open-loop prediction along pre-collected action trajectories. This prevents them from supporting closed-loop VLA evaluation, where each action chunk must be conditioned on the observation generated by the previous execution. To address this gap, we propose PiL-World, a chunk-wise world model designed for policy-in-the-loop VLA evaluation. Given the current observation and the action trajectory rolled out by a VLA policy, PiL-World generates multi-view future observations that are consistent with the VLA rollout and match the image inputs required by the policy. By alternating between VLA inference and world-model prediction, PiL-World enables closed-loop evaluation without real robot execution at every step. To improve rollout fidelity, PiL-World conditions video generation on action-derived visual control from head-view robot motion and latent histories that encode task execution context, while jointly predicting complementary multi-view observations. Beyond successful teleoperated demonstrations, it also learns from failed execution trajectories, helping the imagined rollouts better match the distribution of real policy executions. We evaluate PiL-World on three real dual-arm manipulation tasks. PiL-World generates imagined rollouts that are highly consistent with real robot executions. More importantly, compared with the baseline, it reduces the error between VLA success rates measured in real-world rollouts and those estimated through closed-loop world-model evaluation from 63.2% to 12.0%.

AI.tldr: PiL-World是一种用于VLA策略闭环评估的分块世界模型，通过交替执行VLA推理和世界模型预测，生成与真实策略执行高度一致的多视角未来观测，将真实部署与模型评估的成功率误差从63.2%降低至12.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型仅支持沿预采集轨迹的开环预测，无法支持需要根据先前执行结果进行条件决策的闭环VLA评估，导致策略评估需依赖大量真实机器人执行，成本高昂且效率低下。
AI.method: 提出PiL-World，一种分块世界模型，通过交替进行VLA推理和世界模型预测实现闭环评估。利用动作驱动的头部视角机器人运动视觉控制和编码任务执行上下文的潜在历史来条件化视频生成，联合预测互补的多视角观测，并从失败轨迹中学习以匹配真实策略执行分布。
AI.result: 在三个真实双臂操作任务上，PiL-World生成的想象 rollout 与真实机器人执行高度一致，将VLA成功率在真实部署与闭环世界模型评估之间的误差从63.2%降至12.0%。
AI.conclusion: PiL-World通过分块世界模型实现了无需每步真实机器人执行的闭环VLA策略评估，显著缩小了仿真评估与真实部署之间的性能差距。

title: LLM-Guided ANN Index Optimization for Human-Object Interaction Retrieval
summary: Retrieval systems underpin modern AI applications -- spanning visual search, recommendation engines, and multi-modal question answering. Modern multi-stage retrieval systems require the joint optimization of highly coupled parameters, yet traditional hyperparameter optimization (HPO) methods -- including Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE) and Gaussian Process Bayesian Optimization -- rely on an independence assumption that fundamentally prevents them from navigating these coupled configuration spaces. We address this limitation with a phase-aware large language model (LLM) agent that conditions each proposal on its full optimization history, navigating the coupled parameter space across phase-partitioned exploration, exploitation, and fine-tuning stages. Evaluated on the HICO-DET human-object interaction retrieval benchmark using Intel VDMS (Visual Data Management System), our agent outperforms Optuna TPE by +33.3% and VDTuner by +34.2% under SIEVE (Safeguarded Index Evaluation of Vector-search Efficiency, a quality-constrained throughput metric), delivering a 15.3x throughput gain over UniIR. Validation across three benchmarks confirms that the agent's advantage grows with the degree of parameter coupling: +33.3% on HICO-DET (high coupling), methods converge within 1% on GLDv2 (moderate coupling) and within 3.6% on SIFT1M (near-independent control). Cross-system validation on Milvus confirms the optimizer ranks first on all three datasets without modification, demonstrating transferability across vector database management system (VDBMS) platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种相位感知的大语言模型智能体，通过条件化生成每一步的超参数配置来优化多阶段检索系统的耦合参数空间，在HICO-DET基准上相比Optuna TPE提升+33.3%，并证明了跨VDBMS平台的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有多阶段检索系统需要联合优化高度耦合的参数，但传统HPO方法（如TPE、高斯过程贝叶斯优化）基于独立性假设，无法有效导航耦合配置空间。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型作为智能体，将优化过程划分为探索、利用和微调三个阶段，每个阶段中LLM基于完整的优化历史条件化生成下一步超参数配置，从而建模参数间的耦合关系。
AI.result: 在HICO-DET上，相比Optuna TPE和VDTuner分别提升+33.3%和+34.2%（SIEVE指标），吞吐量是UniIR的15.3倍；耦合程度越高的任务优势越明显；跨系统迁移至Milvus无需修改仍排名第一。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体能够有效处理高度耦合的超参数空间，且在不同VDBMS平台上具有良好的迁移性，为复杂检索系统的自动调优提供了新范式。

title: Anomaly Detection for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators using LSTM Autoencoder
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, ESREL 2026 -European Safety and Reliability Conference, accepted paper to be published
summary: Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators (EHAs) are widely used in aerospace and industrial systems, where timely detection of sensor anomalies is essential to ensure safe and reliable operation. However, the large volume and high sampling frequency of EHA sensor data pose challenges for accurate and efficient anomaly detection. Conventional statistical and classical machine-learning methods such as Z-score, Interquartile Range (IQR), Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture, and k-means often fail to capture the temporal dependencies inherent in EHA signals, resulting in limited detection accuracy and elevated false-alarm rates. Furthermore, systematic evaluations of data-driven anomaly detection approaches for EHA systems remain scarce, particularly under varying operational conditions. This study presents an offline anomaly-detection framework for univariate EHA sensor signals, focusing on temperature and pressure data collected from a controlled test bench. The method employs a reconstruction-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder, calibrated and evaluated using validation-set reconstruction-error distributions. Performance is assessed across multiple fault-injection scenarios using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, complemented by sensitivity analyses under varying operating conditions. The LSTM autoencoder achieved an average accuracy of 99.0\%, precision up to 100\%, recall between 90.2\% and 99.6\%, and F1-scores from 93.1\% to 99.8\%, demonstrating high detection sensitivity and a very low false-alarm rate across all evaluated sensors. These results highlight the feasibility of data-driven offline anomaly detection for EHAs. Future work will focus on adapting the developed framework for an online (real-time) environment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电液作动器（EHA）传感器数据量大、采样频率高导致的异常检测难题，提出了一种基于LSTM自编码器的离线异常检测框架。该方法通过重构误差分布进行校准评估，在温度和压力传感器数据上达到99.0%的平均准确率、最高100%的精确率、90.2%-99.6%的召回率和93.1%-99.8%的F1分数，验证了数据驱动离线异常检测在EHA系统中的可行性。
AI.motivation: EHA在航空航天和工业系统中广泛应用，传感器异常检测对安全可靠运行至关重要。然而，传统统计方法和经典机器学习方法（如Z-score、IQR、MAD、孤立森林、高斯混合模型、k-means）难以捕获EHA信号中的时序依赖关系，导致检测精度有限、误报率高。此外，针对EHA系统的数据驱动异常检测方法缺乏系统性评估，特别是在不同运行条件下。
AI.method: 提出一种基于重构的LSTM自编码器离线异常检测框架，针对EHA单变量传感器信号（温度和压力数据）。使用验证集重构误差分布进行校准和评估，在受控测试台上采集数据，通过多种故障注入场景评估性能。
AI.result: LSTM自编码器平均准确率99.0%，精确率最高达100%，召回率在90.2%-99.6%之间，F1分数在93.1%-99.8%之间，在所有评估传感器上均表现出高检测灵敏度和极低的误报率。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了数据驱动离线异常检测在EHA系统中的可行性。未来工作将聚焦于将所开发框架适配到在线（实时）环境。

title: Context-Conditioned Generative Models Enable Subnational Refinement of Sparse Humanitarian Surveys
summary: Data scarcity limits inference in many scientific and policy domains. Survey data are essential for decision-making, but sparse samples often fail to capture fine spatial granularities. We evaluate normalizing flows, a generative model that learns complex data distributions and can be conditioned on exogenous contextual features, in controlled data scarcity scenarios. Across eight household survey datasets spanning six low-income or middle-income countries in the humanitarian domain, we show that context-conditioned generative models can refine sub-national survey distributions under severe data scarcity, and that performance increases systematically with the richness of the conditioning information. These findings support a general principle for survey data augmentation: generative models can improve sub-national estimates when the sparse sample retains sufficient support and contextual covariates encode relevant local heterogeneity. By learning full conditional distributions rather than point estimates, the approach provides fine-grained evidence for humanitarian decision-making and resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了条件归一化流（context-conditioned normalizing flows）在数据稀缺场景下对调查数据空间细粒度分布的增强能力。基于六个低收入或中低收入国家的八项家庭调查数据集，研究表明该生成模型能够在严重数据稀疏条件下改进次国家级估计，且性能随条件信息丰富程度系统提升。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺限制了科学和政策领域的推断能力，调查数据虽对决策至关重要，但稀疏样本往往无法捕捉精细的空间粒度。作者希望探索生成模型是否能弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 使用条件归一化流（normalizing flows），一种可学习复杂数据分布并以外生上下文特征为条件的生成模型。在控制数据稀缺场景下，对八个家庭调查数据集进行实验，涵盖六个低收入或中低收入国家的人道主义领域。
AI.result: 条件生成模型能够在严重数据稀缺条件下改进次国家级调查分布，且性能随条件信息丰富程度系统提升。当稀疏样本保留足够支持且上下文协变量编码相关局部异质性时，生成模型能有效改善次国家级估计。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一项调查数据增强的一般原则：生成模型通过学习完整的条件分布而非点估计，可为低资源环境下的人道主义决策和资源分配提供细粒度证据。

title: Visuotactile and Explicitly Force-Controlled Robotic Ultrasound for Abdominal Volumetric Reconstruction
summary: In this paper, we present a robotic ultrasound acquisition system that integrates stereo vision, touch-based feedback, and expert-informed strategies to perform autonomous and adaptive abdominal scans. The system records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists, creating a framework to capture transducer motion, applied forces, and anatomical scanning strategies. This expert data is replayed to replicate characteristic scans with the robot, forming a foundation for further autonomous capabilities. Using stereo vision, the system generates three-dimensional topography maps of the patient's abdomen, which are refined through stiffness measurements at key points to delineate the rib cage boundary. These combined techniques enable the robot to execute two distinct scanning paths: an upward-angled sweep beneath the rib cage to visualize structures near the upper abdomen and a perpendicular sweep across soft tissue regions. A compliant, torque-controlled seven degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator is controlled to maintain consistent probe contact through closed-loop force control over the varied anatomical surfaces. Physical experiments demonstrate that the system achieves high-quality imaging comparable to expert scans while dynamically adapting to patient-specific topographies. Furthermore, the robotic system surpasses expert capabilities by enabling three-dimensional volume acquisition, which enhances diagnostic potential and provides volumetric data for advanced analyses. This work highlights the integration of expert knowledge into autonomous robotic systems and underscores the potential of combining perception-based autonomy with physical reasoning for enhanced diagnostic performance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种集成立体视觉、触觉反馈和专家策略的机器人自主超声采集系统，能够自适应执行腹部扫描，并超越专家实现三维体积数据采集。
AI.motivation: 传统超声扫描依赖操作者经验，存在操作者间差异大、难以标准化和获取三维数据的问题，亟需开发具备专家级能力且能自主适应的机器人超声系统。
AI.method: 1) 记录专家放射科医生的自由手运动与力数据，建立包含探头运动、施加力及扫描策略的框架；2) 通过立体视觉生成患者腹部三维地形图，结合关键点刚度测量细化肋骨边界；3) 基于上述信息规划两种扫描路径（肋骨下方上倾扫查和垂直软组织区域扫查）；4) 采用七自由度力矩控制机器人，通过闭环力控制在解剖表面保持稳定探头接触。
AI.result: 系统实现了与专家扫描相媲美的高质量成像，并能动态适应患者特异性解剖结构；同时通过三维体积采集超越了专家能力，增强了诊断潜力。
AI.conclusion: 将专家知识整合到自主机器人系统中，结合基于感知的自主性与物理推理，能够显著提升超声诊断性能，为先进分析提供三维体素数据。

title: Unpaired RGB-Thermal Gaussian-Splatting Using Visual Geometric Transformers
comment: Accepted at ICRA 2026's Workshop MM-SpatialAI: Multi-Modal Spatial AI for Robust Navigation and Open-World Understanding
summary: Multi-modal novel view synthesis (NVS) combining RGB and thermal imagery enables precise 3D scene reconstruction with visual and thermal information. However, existing methods typically rely on precisely calibrated RGB-thermal image pairs or stereo setups, limiting scalability and practical deployment. To address this, we introduce a framework for unpaired RGB-thermal NVS that leverages VGGT, a 3D feed-forward transformer architecture, to independently estimate camera poses for each modality. The pose sets are then aligned using the Procrustes algorithm with a cross-modal feature matcher, enabling joint registration without paired calibration. Building on this alignment, we further propose a multi-modal 3D Gaussian Splatting approach that learns directly from unpaired RGB and thermal images. Experiments on diverse scenes demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance in thermal view synthesis while maintaining RGB fidelity. Moreover, we show that existing reconstruction approaches can produce modality-specific reconstructions that lack cross-modal consistency. We thus introduce a benchmarking framework to rigorously evaluate both per-modality image synthesis and the multi-modal coherence of reconstructed scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需成对校准的RGB-热成像多视角新视角合成框架，利用VGGT分别估计各模态相机位姿，通过Procrustes算法对齐，并结合多模态3D高斯泼溅实现联合渲染，在保持RGB保真度的同时实现了热成像视角合成的竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态RGB-热成像NVS方法依赖精确校准的成对图像或立体设置，限制了可扩展性和实际部署，亟需一种无需配对校准的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用VGGT（3D前馈Transformer）分别为RGB和热成像独立估计相机位姿；2) 通过Procrustes算法结合跨模态特征匹配器对齐两组位姿；3) 提出多模态3D高斯泼溅方法，直接从非配对RGB和热图像学习联合场景表示。
AI.result: 在多种场景下，该方法在热成像视角合成中达到竞争性性能，同时保持RGB保真度；现有方法产生模态特异性重建，缺乏跨模态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了非配对RGB-热成像的联合3D重建问题，并引入了跨模态一致性的基准评估框架。

title: Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents
summary: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)方法，利用强化学习与贝叶斯推断之间的等价性，通过序贯蒙特卡洛直接从黑盒LLM代理的最优策略中采样，无需修改模型参数即可实现类似RL的优化，在AgentGym基准上超越提示基线并优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法（如GRPO）仅适用于可获取权重的开源LLM代理，而对黑盒（仅API访问）的专有LLM代理无法进行参数级优化，导致RL方法失效。需要一种无需修改模型参数即可实现RL风格优化的方法。
AI.method: 利用RL与贝叶斯推断的等价性，将最优策略定义为轨迹的后验分布，以固定黑盒LLM代理作为先验。通过学习一个价值函数（value function）引导代理行为，并采用序贯蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo）从该后验分布中采样，实现测试时的策略优化。
AI.result: 在AgentGym基准的三个不同环境中，AMC显著优于提示基线（prompting baselines），并且在扩展测试时计算量时，性能甚至超过了GRPO。
AI.conclusion: AMC证明了在不修改模型参数的情况下，对黑盒LLM代理进行原则性的、RL风格优化的可行性，为仅API访问的专有模型提供了有效的测试时优化方案。

title: Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026.
