Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出五阶段AI素养连续体（从“未参与”到“改进”），用于诊断和指导高等教育中学生的AI素养发展，并通过北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者）验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI素养框架虽定义了能力维度，但缺乏对学习者起点及发展路径的诊断和教学指导，学生要么因恐惧、不信任而回避AI，要么不加批判地依赖AI。
AI.method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体（0-4阶段），采用基于设计的研究方法，在学分课程和密集工作坊中实施，涉及330余名参与者（2024秋-2026春），采用观察性和基于实践的发现方式。
AI.result: 参与者表现出从非参与或非批判使用向知情参与的行为转变；持续性、学科嵌入式体验产生了更强的批判性评估和改进导向实践的证据。
AI.conclusion: AI素养应被视为一种发展性能力，而非单纯的工具采纳；所提连续体为教育者提供了与UNESCO/OECD框架对齐的实用诊断和教学路径。

title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
summary: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present \textbf{LadderMan}, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints. Video results are available at https://ladderman-robot.github.io .

AI.tldr: 本文提出LadderMan系统，通过两阶段学习管道和视觉基础模型，使人形机器人能够鲁棒地攀爬各种梯子并在梯子上进行操作。
AI.motivation: 梯子攀爬因稀疏的抓握点、复杂的全身协调以及对感知和控制误差的高度敏感性，是人形机器人最具挑战性的任务之一，现有方法难以应对。
AI.method: 采用可扩展的两阶段学习管道：首先通过混合运动跟踪从单个参考运动学习多个攀爬专家，然后通过混合模仿学习和强化学习将这些专家蒸馏为统一的基于深度图像的视觉运动攀爬策略；利用视觉基础模型弥合深度感知的仿真到现实差距；针对操作任务采用双智能体公式训练独立策略，通过遥操作实现梯上操作。
AI.result: LadderMan在多种几何形状的梯子上实现了鲁棒的攀爬，零样本迁移到真实硬件，并支持在梯子约束下的多种操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 证明了所提系统在人形机器人梯子攀爬和梯上操作任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Robust Scene Transfer for PointGoal Navigation via Privileged Sensor Guided Contrastive Learning
summary:
We propose a sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning framework for visual representation learning in PointGoal navigation. During training, privileged LiDAR sensing guides the contrastive objective through a geometry-aware similarity metric and adaptive temperature scaling, encouraging visual embeddings to capture navigation-relevant structure rather than scene-specific appearance. The resulting encoder is pretrained independently, frozen, and used as the perceptual backbone for reinforcement learning, decoupling representation learning from policy optimization. We further introduce a cross-stage domain mismatch between representation pretraining and policy learning to suppress environment-specific shortcuts and promote reliance on task-relevant features.
  Extensive experiments in high-fidelity simulation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves policy-level scene transfer across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. At deployment, the agent relies only on monocular RGB observations together with standard task-related inputs such as goal position and proprioceptive signals, without access to LiDAR or other privileged sensors. Our method outperforms large pretrained vision models and standard contrastive baselines under severe appearance and semantic shifts. We also release a multimodal dataset to support future research on privileged-guided visual representation learning for navigation. The code is available at:

AI.tldr: 提出了一种传感器引导的自适应对比学习框架，利用LiDAR特权信息引导视觉表征学习，使编码器捕获导航相关结构而非场景外观，并在PointGoal导航任务中实现了跨场景的优越迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉表征学习方法容易捕捉场景特定的外观信息而非导航相关的几何结构，导致策略在新环境中的泛化能力受限。作者希望解耦表征学习与策略优化，并抑制环境特定捷径，提升跨场景迁移能力。
AI.method: 1) 利用特权LiDAR传感信号，通过几何感知相似度度量和自适应温度缩放构建对比学习目标；2) 独立预训练视觉编码器后冻结，作为强化学习的感知骨干；3) 引入跨阶段域不匹配（表征预训练与策略学习之间的域差异），抑制环境特定捷径。
AI.result: 在高质量仿真实验中，该方法在室内外多种环境下的策略级场景迁移显著提升。仅依靠单目RGB和标准任务输入（目标位置、本体感知），无需LiDAR，性能优于大模型预训练视觉模型和标准对比学习基线，尤其在严重外观和语义偏移下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 特权引导的对比学习能有效学习导航相关的视觉表征，提升跨场景泛化能力；同时发布了多模态数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Statistically Reliable LLM-Based Ranking Evaluation via Prediction-Powered Inference
summary: With PRECISE, we extended Prediction-Powered Inference to produce bias-corrected estimates of ranking evaluation metrics by combining a small human-labeled set with a large LLM-judged set. PPI is provably unbiased regardless of the LLM judge's error profile. We make it applicable to hierarchical metrics like Precision@K, where annotations are per-document but the metric is per-query, by reducing the output-space computation from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K). On the ESCI benchmark, augmenting 30 human annotations with Claude 3 Sonnet judgments reduces the standard error of Precision@4 estimates from 4.45 to 3.50 (a 21% relative reduction). In a production system, our framework correctly identified the best of three system variants from 100 human labels and 2 hours of domain-expert annotation; A/B testing confirmed this ranking with +407 bps in daily sales.

AI.tldr: PRECISE 将 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 扩展至排序评估指标的无偏估计，利用少量人工标注和大量 LLM 判断，在 ESCI 基准上使 Precision@4 标准误差降低 21%，并在生产系统中通过 100 个人工标注正确识别最佳系统变体，经 A/B 测试验证销售额提升 407 个基点。
AI.motivation: 传统评估排序系统需要大量人工标注，成本高昂；LLM 作为评判者虽可扩展但存在偏差。希望结合少量人工标注与大量 LLM 判断，实现无偏且高效的指标估计。
AI.method: 在 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 框架基础上，将输出空间计算复杂度从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K)，使其适用于 Precision@K 等层级指标（标注在文档级，指标在查询级）。
AI.result: ESCI 基准上，30 个人工标注结合 Claude 3 Sonnet 判断，使 Precision@4 标准误差从 4.45 降至 3.50（相对降低 21%）。生产系统中，用 100 个人工标注和 2 小时领域专家标注正确识别三个系统变体中的最优者，A/B 测试确认排名，日销售额提升 407 个基点。
AI.conclusion: PRECISE 能够以极少量人工标注实现排序评估指标的无偏估计，显著降低方差，并在实际生产系统中有效指导系统选型，带来可观的业务收益。

title: The Fair Lending Model: How the Longest-Running Algorithmic Fairness Programs Work in Practice
comment: To be published at FAccT 2026. Emily Black, Miranda Bogen, and Logan Koepke contributed equally
summary: U.S. financial institutions subject to fair lending laws have been running algorithmic fairness programs for decades. Despite this long history, remarkably little is known about how these requirements operate in practice. In this paper, we offer the first empirical account of how financial institutions test for and mitigate algorithmic discrimination on the ground. In doing so, we shed light on how the regulatory design of fair lending law and regulation have shaped the policies, processes, and practices of fair lending programs. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with participants across the fair lending ecosystem, we find that while financial institutions have a floor of fairness practices aimed at preventing discrimination in lending largely absent in other domains, the specifics of how firms test for discrimination and search for less discriminatory algorithms varies widely. We also find that regulatory supervision via fair lending examinations has been the key driver of compliance work, but that the practical impact of fair lending programs often depends on how well they can navigate competing business incentives, perceived legal tensions, and regulatory uncertainty. Ultimately, our findings highlight the unique role that supervisory authority has played in successfully fostering fair lending practices -- a regulatory design feature that is distinct from other areas of civil rights law and almost completely absent from recent policy proposals for dealing with algorithmic discrimination.

AI.tldr: 通过对35位公平借贷生态参与者的半结构化访谈，首次实证揭示了美国金融机构在公平借贷法律监管下如何实际测试和缓解算法歧视，发现机构虽具备基础合规实践，但具体方法差异显著，监管审查是关键驱动力，而商业激励、法律矛盾与监管不确定性影响实际效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管美国金融机构受公平借贷法约束已数十年，但学术界对这些要求在实际中如何运作知之甚少，缺乏实证研究。
AI.method: 基于对公平借贷生态系统中35位参与者进行的半结构化访谈。
AI.result: 金融机构具备防止借贷歧视的最低公平实践标准（这在其他领域缺失），但具体测试歧视和寻找较少歧视性算法的方法差异很大；监管审查是合规工作的关键驱动力，但实际效果取决于机构如何应对商业激励、法律冲突和监管不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 监管监督权在成功促进公平借贷实践方面发挥了独特作用，这一监管设计特征区别于民权法的其他领域，且几乎完全缺失于当前应对算法歧视的政策提案中。

title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

AI.tldr: 提出TAGA框架，通过主动注视机制学习地形感知，使仿人机器人能够在多样化复杂地形上实现鲁棒且泛化的运动，包括1.2米跨距的世界纪录。
AI.motivation: 敏捷的仿人运动需要同时具备广域感知覆盖和精确局部几何理解，而现有方法在机载计算资源受限条件下难以兼顾二者。
AI.method: TAGA框架融合视觉、本体感知和运动指令，通过学习主动注视行为选择性关注高度扫描图中的特定区域，自适应提高观测信息密度，并通过强化学习自然涌现这种注视行为。
AI.result: 在仿真和硬件上实现了鲁棒且泛化的运动，包括地形感知落脚点选择、高台穿越、稀疏落脚点穿越，以及1.2米跨距（感知仿人运动系统报道最大）。
AI.conclusion: 主动注视机制可通过强化学习自然涌现，无需额外监督，显著提升训练效率和运动性能，在机载计算受限条件下实现精细的感知运动。

title: BRepCLIP: Contrastive Multimodal Pretraining on BRep Primitives for CAD Understanding
summary: Learning representations of CAD models is a largely open problem. While 3D representation learning has flourished around point clouds and meshes, the native format of CAD - boundary representations BReps, which encodes exact parametric surfaces, curves, and their topology, has received little attention as a representation learning substrate. We introduce BRepCLIP, the first framework to align BRep geometry with language and image embeddings through contrastive pretraining. We model each CAD object as a sequence of face and edge tokens with separate discrete vocabularies for surface and curve geometry, augmented with spatial and semantic descriptors that capture surface types (e.g., cylindrical, torus, NURBS) and curve primitives (e.g., line, arc, B-spline). A transformer encoder aggregates these tokens into a global BRep embedding, aligned with CLIP's text and image encoders via a joint contrastive objective. BRepCLIP generates more discriminative and semantically grounded embeddings than existing point-based alternatives, improving Top-1 retrieval over OpenShape by 40.4%, 22.0%, and 23.9% on ABC, CADParser, and Automate, respectively, and improving zero-shot classification on FabWave by 15% in Top-1 score. We further demonstrate its utility as a CAD-aware similarity metric for evaluating text and image-conditioned CAD generation, establishing the importance of structure-aware pretraining for multimodal CAD understanding. Project page is available at https://muhammadusama100.github.io/BrepClip2026/

AI.tldr: BRepCLIP首次将边界表示(BRep)的CAD模型几何与CLIP文本/图像嵌入通过对比预训练对齐，在检索和零样本分类任务上显著优于现有基于点云的方法。
AI.motivation: CAD模型的表示学习是一个尚未充分解决的问题。虽然3D表示学习在点云和网格领域蓬勃发展，但CAD的原生格式——边界表示(BRep)，其编码了精确的参数化曲面、曲线及其拓扑结构，作为表示学习的基础却很少受到关注。
AI.method: 将每个CAD对象建模为面令牌和边令牌序列，为曲面和曲线几何使用分离的离散词汇表，并补充空间和语义描述符以捕获曲面类型和曲线基元。使用Transformer编码器将这些令牌聚合为全局BRep嵌入，通过联合对比目标与CLIP的文本和图像编码器对齐。
AI.result: 在ABC、CADParser和Automate数据集上，Top-1检索比OpenShape分别提升40.4%、22.0%和23.9%；在FabWave上零样本分类Top-1提升15%。
AI.conclusion: BRepCLIP生成的嵌入比现有基于点云的替代方案更具区分性和语义基础，同时可作为CAD感知的相似度指标用于评估文本和图像条件下的CAD生成，证明了结构感知预训练对多模态CAD理解的重要性。

title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and a 27 page appendix. Accepted to the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
summary: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency of OT-potential FM (OTP-FM) on diverse single-cell RNA sequencing, oceanographic, and meteorological datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bexorg-Inc/OTP-FM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OTP-FM方法，通过将动态最优传输中的势项引入条件流匹配学习目标，实现了利用中间观测边际约束来引导端点之间流的多边际流匹配框架，在单细胞RNA测序、海洋学和气象学数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配方法主要关注两个端点分布之间的传输映射，而很少利用中间观测到的边际分布来约束流。在许多科学领域（如单细胞RNA测序、海洋学、气象学）中，可以采样到连续的时序分布，但缺乏能够在多边际设定下有效利用这些中间分布信息的框架。
AI.method: 利用流匹配与动态最优传输之间的联系，在动态最优传输作用量中引入势项来柔和地将流导向中间边际分布。通过扩展条件流匹配的学习目标以纳入这些势项，推导出一种高效、免模拟的多边际流匹配算法（OTP-FM）。
AI.result: 在单细胞RNA测序、海洋学和气象学等多个多样化数据集上，OTP-FM实现了最先进的性能和训练效率。
AI.conclusion: OTP-FM通过引入势项的多边际流匹配方法，在灵活建模时空动态流的同时保持了训练效率，为处理具有中间观测边际的科学数据动力学建模提供了有效工具。

title: The Stability of Online Algorithms in Performative Prediction
summary: The use of algorithmic predictions in decision-making leads to a feedback loop where the models we deploy actively influence the data distributions we see, and later use to retrain on. This dynamic was formalized by Perdomo et al. 2020 in their work on performative prediction. Our main result is an unconditional reduction showing that any no-regret algorithm deployed in performative settings converges to a (mixed) performatively stable equilibrium: a solution in which models actively shape data distributions in ways that their own predictions look optimal in hindsight. Prior to our work, all positive results in this area imposed strong restrictions on how models influenced distributions. By using a martingale argument and allowing randomization, we avoid any assumption on how populations respond to predictions and sidestep recent hardness results showing that deterministic stable models are in general PPAD-hard to compute. Lastly, on a more conceptual note, our connection sheds light on why common algorithms, like gradient descent, are naturally stabilizing and prevent runaway feedback loops. We hope our work enables future technical transfer of ideas between online optimization and performativity.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在表演性预测（performative prediction）环境中，任何无遗憾（no-regret）算法都会收敛到（混合）表演性稳定均衡，且该结论不依赖对人群响应模型的强假设，通过允许随机化和使用鞅论证，避开了确定性稳定模型计算复杂性的障碍。
AI.motivation: 在决策中使用算法预测会导致反馈循环：模型影响数据分布，而分布又用于重新训练模型。Perdomo等人2020年形式化了这一动态（表演性预测），但先前所有正面结果都对模型如何影响分布施加了强限制。本文旨在无需这些假设的情况下建立通用收敛性结果。
AI.method: 采用鞅论证并允许算法随机化，避免了任何关于人群如何响应预测的假设，从而绕过了近期关于确定性稳定模型PPAD-hard的困难结果。
AI.result: 任何无遗憾算法在表演性环境中都会收敛到（混合）表演性稳定均衡，即模型主动塑造数据分布，使得自身预测在事后看来最优。
AI.conclusion: 该结果表明，像梯度下降这类常见算法天然具有稳定性，能够防止失控的反馈循环。这为在线优化与表演性之间的技术迁移奠定了基础。

title: A Novel Method with Encoder-Decoder for Cross-Sensor Adaptation in Surface Shape Sensing with Sparse Strain Sensors
summary: Performance variations in sensor arrays, caused by intrinsic differences or installation conditions, can lead to inconsistent results during shape sensing. To obtain accurate results, a large amount of data is usually required, and a separate model must be retrained for each sensor array, thereby increasing the cost and time of data acquisition, transmission, and computation. To address this issue, this work proposes an encoder-decoder architecture for surface shape sensing based on sparse strain sensors and further incorporates meta-learning and few-shot adaptation strategies to enable adaptation across different groups of sensor arrays. Experimental results demonstrate that, after the cross-sensor adaptation, a newly deployed sensor array achieves a sensing error of approximately 4.0 mm relying on less than 5.0% newly labeled data and requiring an adaptation time of under 1 second, which represents a substantial improvement from 23.0 mm error without adaptation and 20-minute data collection time required to train a new model. Moreover, the number of points with errors below 5.0 mm increased by more than 65.0%. These results indicate that the proposed method can substantially reduce the cost and training burden of surface shape sensing, and it has broad potential applications in soft robotics and wearable devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于编码器-解码器架构结合元学习与少样本自适应策略的表面形状感知方法，使不同传感器阵列间能够快速迁移。实验表明，新部署的传感器阵列仅需不到5.0%的新标注数据和不到1秒的适应时间，误差从23.0mm降至约4.0mm，误差低于5.0mm的点数增加超过65.0%，显著降低了数据采集与训练成本。
AI.motivation: 传感器阵列因固有差异或安装条件导致性能变化，传统方法需要大量数据和为每个阵列单独训练模型，成本高、耗时长。作者旨在解决跨传感器阵列的适应问题，减少数据采集、传输和计算的开销。
AI.method: 提出编码器-解码器架构用于基于稀疏应变传感器的表面形状感知，并整合元学习（meta-learning）与少样本自适应（few-shot adaptation）策略，使模型能够快速适应不同传感器阵列组。
AI.result: 经过跨传感器适应后，新部署的传感器阵列仅需不到5.0%的新标注数据和不到1秒的适应时间，误差从无适应时的23.0mm降至约4.0mm；误差低于5.0mm的点数增加超过65.0%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法显著降低了表面形状感知的数据采集成本和模型训练负担，在软体机器人和可穿戴设备领域具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: Almieyar-Oryx-BloomBench: A Bilingual Multimodal Benchmark for Cognitively Informed Evaluation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the rapid progress of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the field lacks benchmarks that rigorously diagnose their true reasoning abilities and chart meaningful progress toward human-like multimodal intelligence. Most existing evaluations focus on piecemeal or disconnected tasks, obscuring critical cognitive weaknesses and providing little insight for targeted improvement. To address this gap, we introduce BloomBench, part of the Almieyar benchmarking series, the first cognitively human-grounded, bilingual (English-Arabic) multimodal benchmark for VLMs. Grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy, BloomBench systematically evaluates six levels of cognition (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create) through carefully designed image-question-answer tasks. Built with a semi-automated pipeline and validated through a stratified hybrid quality assurance protocol, it ensures scalability, cultural inclusivity, and linguistic fidelity. Leveraging this framework, we conduct a comprehensive study of state-of-the-art VLMs to diagnose their cognitive profiles. Our analysis reveals a sharp cognitive asymmetry: while state-of-the-art models achieve strong performance ceilings in semantic understanding, they struggle substantially with factual recall and creative synthesis. This demonstrates that current general multimodal proficiency masks deeper limitations in specific cognitive layers. Furthermore, our study highlights a critical performance gap between Arabic and English, exposing limitations in current cross-lingual multimodal reasoning. These findings establish a foundation for developing more cognitively aligned and inclusive VLMs. The benchmark framework and dataset is available at: https://github.com/qcri/Almieyar-Oryx-BloomBench.

AI.tldr: BloomBench是一个基于Bloom认知分类学的双语（英-阿）多模态推理基准，系统评估VLM在六个认知层次的表现，发现当前模型在语义理解上表现优异但在事实回忆和创意合成上严重不足，且存在显著的跨语言性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评估缺乏对真实推理能力的严格诊断，多采用碎片化任务，掩盖了关键认知缺陷，无法为针对性改进提供指导。
AI.method: 基于Bloom认知分类学构建六个认知层次（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评价、创造）的多模态基准BloomBench，采用半自动流水线构建数据集，并通过分层混合质量保证协议进行验证，支持英语和阿拉伯语双语评估。
AI.result: SOTA模型在语义理解层表现优异，但在事实回忆和创意合成层表现严重不足；模型在阿拉伯语和英语之间存在显著的跨语言推理性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前通用多模态能力掩盖了特定认知层的深层缺陷，需开发更贴合认知机制和更具包容性的VLM。

title: A prism hierarchy of learning regimes in large linear autoencoders
summary: Theoretical studies of machine learning models commonly consider different limiting regimes in which the learning dynamics of gradient descent becomes theoretically tractable. It is, however, desirable to have a systematically obtained picture of all qualitatively different extreme learning regimes for a particular type of models. In this paper we propose such a picture for large weight-tied linear autoencoders characterized by input and latent dimensions, initialization magnitude, and training set size. This model is nonlinear in the weights and its gradient flow does not have a general theoretical solution. We show that at the level of the formal loss-expansion hierarchy, its extreme regimes are naturally associated with faces of a triangular prism. In particular, there are five basic extreme regimes associated with the 2-faces of the prism: (1) large-data, (2) small-data, (3) mean-field, (4) narrow-latent, and (5) free. For regimes (1,2,3,4), we derive explicit expressions for both train and population limiting loss evolutions under gradient flow, obtaining very good agreement with experimental results.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地提出了大权重共享线性自编码器中五种极端学习机制（大数据、小数据、平均场、窄潜变量和自由机制），这些机制与三角棱柱的面自然对应，并在前四种机制下推导出了梯度流训练损失和总体损失的显式表达式，与实验结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型的理论研究通常考虑不同的极限机制以使梯度下降的学习动力学可解，但缺乏对不同极端学习机制的系统性分类。本文旨在为特定模型（大权重共享线性自编码器）提出一个关于所有定性不同极端学习机制的系统性图景。
AI.method: 通过形式损失展开层次结构，将极端机制与三角棱柱的面自然关联。具体识别出与棱柱2-面相关的五种基本极端机制：（1）大数据、（2）小数据、（3）平均场、（4）窄潜变量和（5）自由机制。对前四种机制推导了梯度流下训练损失和总体损失演化的显式表达式。
AI.result: 成功识别出五种极端学习机制，并在（1-4）机制下获得了训练损失和总体损失演化的显式解析表达式，且与实验结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文为非线性权重模型（大权重共享线性自编码器）建立了系统性的极端学习机制分类框架，揭示了不同机制之间的几何关联，并为前四种机制提供了可验证的理论预测。

title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that require nuanced ethical reasoning, yet existing bias evaluations treat model outputs as simply "biased" or "unbiased." This binary framing misses the gradual, context-sensitive way bias actually emerges. We address this gap in two stages: behavioral profiling and mechanistic validation. In the behavioral stage, we introduce the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), a metric that quantifies the probability of biased output across a graduated, seven-tier stress test ranging from abstract numerical problems to scenarios rooted in historical and socioeconomic injustice. Evaluating four leading models (Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5), we identify distinct behavioral signatures shaped by alignment design: for instance, Gemini 1.5 reaches 72.7% MSI by Tier 5 under socioeconomic framing, while Claude exhibits sharp suppression consistent with identity-based safety training. We then verify these behavioral patterns mechanistically. We select criminal-bias scenarios, which produced the highest MSI scores across models, as probes and apply logit lens, attention analysis, activation patching, and semantic probing to a controlled set of six models spanning three capability tiers: small language models (SLMs), instruction-tuned base models, and reasoning-distilled variants. Circuit-level analysis reveals a U-curve of bias: SLMs exhibit strong criminal bias; scaling to instruction-tuned models eliminates it; reasoning distillation reintroduces bias to SLM-like levels despite identical parameter counts, suggesting distillation compresses reasoning traces in ways that reactivate shallow statistical associations. Critically, the socially loaded cues that drive high MSI scores activate the same bias-driving circuits identified mechanistically, providing cross-stage validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出道德敏感性指数(MSI)，通过七级压力测试量化LLM的偏见输出概率，并借助电路级分析揭示偏见产生的U形曲线：小模型偏见严重，指令微调消除偏见，推理蒸馏虽参数不变却重新引入偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM偏见评估仅采用"有偏见/无偏见"的二元分类，忽略了偏见在现实场景中逐渐、依赖上下文的涌现方式。需要更细粒度的量化指标和机制验证。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：行为层面提出七级MSI压力测试（从抽象数值到历史社会不公场景），评估四个模型；机制层面选取刑事偏见场景，对三类能力层级六个模型进行logit透镜、注意力分析、激活修补和语义探针分析。
AI.result: Gemini 1.5在社会经济框架下达72.7% MSI；发现偏见U形曲线：SLM偏见强，指令微调消除，推理蒸馏重新引入至SLM水平；社会性线索同时激活行为偏见和机制电路中相同路径。
AI.conclusion: LLM偏见是渐进涌现的，受对齐设计和推理方式影响；推理蒸馏可能在压缩过程中重新激活浅层统计关联，需在设计层面关注。

title: Learning of Robot Safety Policies via Adversarial Synthetic Scenarios
summary: In this work, we propose an agentic gamification framework for hazard-informed learning of robot safety policies through synthetic scenarios. We model scenario generation as an adversarial game between two agents: a Red Team that explores the space of potential failures by constructing hazardous situations, and a Blue Team that incrementally refines safety policies to prevent them. This iterative process enables efficient discovery of high-risk edge cases that are unlikely to be captured through random simulation or manual enumeration. By combining classical risk modeling with adversarial scenario generation and modern learning paradigms, this work provides a scalable pathway for embedding safety into Physical AI systems operating in complex real-world environments. The paper describes ongoing work. The contribution is a problem formulation and a proposed solution architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于智能体博弈的合成场景框架，通过红蓝两队对抗生成危险场景，迭代学习机器人安全策略，高效发现高风险边缘案例，为物理AI系统提供可扩展的安全嵌入路径。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（随机仿真或手动枚举）难以有效捕获高风险边缘案例，需要一种可扩展的自动化方式来学习机器人安全策略。
AI.method: 将场景生成建模为红蓝两队对抗博弈：红队探索潜在失效空间并构建危险情境，蓝队增量式优化安全策略以防止失效。
AI.result: 当前为进行中工作，尚未给出实验验证结果，主要贡献在于问题形式化与方案架构设计。
AI.conclusion: 结合经典风险建模、对抗场景生成与现代学习范式，为复杂真实环境中物理AI系统的安全性嵌入提供了可扩展路径。

title: Noise-Aware Visual Representation Learning for Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: Medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) has strong potential for clinical decision support by enabling AI models to interpret medical images and answer clinically relevant queries. Recent approaches typically connect off-the-shelf vision encoders with large language models (LLMs) through lightweight mapping networks to reduce computational cost. However, these methods often overlook the importance of handling noise and small irrelevant changes in visual representations. To address these challenges, we propose a noise-aware Med-VQA framework that incorporates a denoising autoencoder before visual embeddings are mapped into the input space of an LLM. The denoising autoencoder is pretrained to reconstruct clean visual embeddings from corrupted inputs, encouraging the model to learn robust visual representations that are less sensitive to noise. The resulting embeddings are then projected into the language model embedding space using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP), forming visual prefix tokens that provide image information to the LLM. To enable efficient adaptation without full retraining, we employ parameter-efficient fine-tuning using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The proposed method is evaluated on the SLAKE and PathVQA benchmarks. Experimental results show improved robustness to noisy input embeddings while maintaining competitive clean performance across multiple evaluation criteria. These findings suggest that learning more robust visual representations can enhance Med-VQA performance and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种噪声感知的医学视觉问答框架，通过在视觉嵌入映射到LLM之前引入去噪自编码器来学习鲁棒的视觉表示，并采用LoRA参数高效微调，在SLAKE和PathVQA基准上提升了模型对噪声的鲁棒性并保持了良好的干净性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Med-VQA方法通常将现成的视觉编码器与LLM通过轻量映射网络连接，但忽视了视觉表示中噪声和小幅无关变化的影响，导致模型鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 在视觉嵌入映射到LLM输入空间之前，引入预训练的去噪自编码器重构干净的视觉嵌入，学习对噪声不敏感的鲁棒视觉表示；随后通过MLP将嵌入投影为视觉前缀token；采用LoRA进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: 在SLAKE和PathVQA基准上，该方法对噪声输入嵌入表现出更强的鲁棒性，同时在干净数据上保持了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 学习更鲁棒的视觉表示能够有效提升Med-VQA的性能和鲁棒性，为临床决策支持提供了更可靠的AI方案。

title: PJ-RoPE: A Fourier-Jet-Affine Position Space for Relative Attention
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ybzhang-nxu/Poincare_Rope
summary:
We unify RoPE's Fourier phase, Jordan-RoPE's finite jets, and ALiBi's affine recency into a single learnable relative-position space, and study which regions of this space are selected by different tasks. PJ-RoPE is a Fourier-Jet-Affine formulation for relative attention, with an optional Poincare-type reading as the affine completion of a homogeneous Fourier-jet positional representation. Algebraically, the same primitives form a finite constant-coefficient difference module: simple roots of the lag-shift operator give Fourier/RoPE characters, repeated nonzero roots give Jordan/Fourier jets, and the repeated unit root gives ALiBi-like affine recency.
  The framework separates scalar PJ-bias kernels from exact PJ-rotary feature transforms, introduces adaptive sector diagnostics, and uses LC/rapidity coordinates to stabilize high-order jets. Controlled probes verify sector containment and selection; small language runs expose an affine/recency boundary; music-token streams provide the clearest case where LC/affine variants remain strong while carrying measurable high-order corrections; and LC diagnostics show a scale-stability gain coupled to phase-resolution loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PJ-RoPE框架，将RoPE、Jordan-RoPE和ALiBi统一到一个可学习的相对位置空间中，并通过傅里叶-喷流-仿射公式实现相对注意力。实验验证了不同任务会选择该空间的不同区域。
AI.motivation: 现有的相对位置编码方法（RoPE、Jordan-RoPE、ALiBi）各自独立，缺乏统一的数学框架来理解其内在联系以及不同任务如何选择不同的位置表征空间。
AI.method: 提出PJ-RoPE框架，将RoPE的傅里叶相位、Jordan-Rope的有限喷流（jet）和ALiBi的仿射近因性统一为可学习的相对位置空间。从代数上建立有限常系数差分模块：滞后移位算子的单根对应傅里叶/RoPE字符，非零重根对应Jordan/傅里叶喷流，单位重根对应ALiBi仿射近因性。引入标量PJ偏置核与精确PJ旋转特征变换的分离、自适应扇区诊断、以及LC/快度坐标稳定高阶喷流。
AI.result: 受控探针验证了扇区包含与选择性；小规模语言实验揭示了仿射/近因边界；音乐token流中LC/仿射变体保持强性能同时携带可测量的高阶修正；LC诊断显示尺度稳定性提升伴随相位分辨率损失。
AI.conclusion: PJ-RoPE提供了一个统一的数学框架来理解和选择不同任务所需的相对位置表征，不同任务会选择该统一空间中的不同区域，为自适应位置编码设计提供了理论基础。

title: Federating Governance: How Community Rules Scale with Mastodon Instances
comment: Accepted to CSCW 2026 at Salt Lake City, Utah, USA
summary: The rise of decentralized social media platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky highlights the challenge of scaling self-governance and moderation. As communities grow, they face new issues that demand increasingly complex governance structures. However, as moderation is mainly volunteer-driven, there is limited formal guidance on how community rules and moderation practices should evolve with growth. This study investigates how moderation scale with Mastodon instances by analyzing community rules across servers of varying sizes. We categorize these rules to identify key governance priorities and find that these priorities are remarkably consistent across instance sizes: rules addressing problematic content, such as harassment, hate speech, and illegal content, dominate regardless of scale. While smaller communities focus on narrower sets of topics, larger servers maintain a more balanced coverage of a broad range of topics. Our analysis of rule formalization reveals that community size strongly predicts rule development. As instances grow, their rules become more extensive and topically diverse, but also exhibit lower readability and linguistic diversity. In contrast, external federation interactions have a limited role, mainly associated with a broader scope of rules without substantially affecting their diversity or form. These findings highlight the relative influence of internal versus external factors, suggesting that local scaling pressures outweigh network-level dynamics in decentralized social media governance. The scaling pattern observed on Mastodon resemble those previously identified on centralized platforms such as Reddit, suggesting that community size imposes fundamental constraints on self-governance that transcend platform architectures

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析Mastodon实例的社区规则，发现去中心化社交媒体的自我治理中，社区规模是规则发展的首要驱动力：规模越大，规则越广泛、主题越多样，但可读性和语言多样性下降；而外部联邦交互影响有限。这一规模化模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似，表明社区规模对自我治理的约束超越了平台架构。
AI.motivation: 去中心化社交平台（如Mastodon、Bluesky）的兴起带来了自我治理与内容审核的规模化挑战。随着社区增长，治理结构日趋复杂，但审核主要由志愿者驱动，缺乏关于社区规则与审核实践如何随规模演进的正式指导。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 分析Mastodon实例中不同规模服务器的社区规则，对规则进行分类以识别关键治理优先级，并研究规则形式化程度与社区规模、外部联邦交互的关系。
AI.result: 1) 治理优先级在不同规模实例中高度一致，针对骚扰、仇恨言论、非法内容等问题的规则占主导；2) 较小社区关注的主题范围较窄，较大服务器覆盖的主题更广且更均衡；3) 社区规模强预测规则发展：规模越大，规则越广泛、主题越多样，但可读性和语言多样性降低；4) 外部联邦交互影响有限，仅与规则范围更广相关，对多样性和形式化影响不大。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化社交媒体治理中，内部因素（社区规模带来的本地扩展压力）的影响远大于外部因素（网络层面的联邦交互）。这种规模化模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似，表明社区规模对自我治理施加了超越平台架构的根本性约束。

title: Towards a Data Flywheel for Embodied Intelligence in Logistics
summary: Embodied intelligence is moving from laboratory demonstrations toward industrial deployment, with the logistics industry serving as a key application scenario. Learning-based policies offer a promising path beyond traditional perception-planning-control pipelines, but their scalability depends on how embodied data can be collected, organized, and reused. This research studies a data-centric framework for industrial embodied intelligence by constructing a logistics data flywheel. Our framework converts daily operations into reusable data assets, uses World Models to generate reliable supervision for long-tail parcel manipulation, and feeds deployment feedback back into policy improvement. As an initial result, \textit{WM-DAgger} introduces a World-Model-based data aggregation framework that synthesizes out-of-distribution recovery data for robust imitation learning. Building on this result, ongoing work explores how large-scale in-the-wild multimodal data, including labeled human demonstrations, unlabeled operational videos, and system-level robot logs, can be aligned for policy learning and transformed into feedback for continual system improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向工业具身智能的数据中心化框架，通过构建物流数据飞轮将日常操作转化为可复用数据资产，利用世界模型生成长尾包裹操作监督信号，并将部署反馈循环用于策略持续改进。作为初步成果，WM-DAgger框架通过世界模型生成分布外恢复数据实现鲁棒模仿学习；当前工作正在探索如何对齐大规模多模态野外数据（包括人工标注演示、未标注操作视频和系统级机器人日志）以支持策略学习并转化为持续系统改进的反馈。
AI.motivation: 具身智能正从实验室走向工业部署，但基于学习的策略可扩展性受限于具身数据的采集、组织和复用方式，亟需一种数据中心化的解决方案来打通从数据收集到策略改进的闭环。
AI.method: 提出了一个物流数据飞轮框架：1) 将日常操作转化为可复用数据资产；2) 利用世界模型为长尾包裹操作生成可靠监督信号；3) 将部署反馈输入策略改进循环。具体实现包括WM-DAgger（基于世界模型的数据聚合框架）和多模态数据对齐技术。
AI.result: WM-DAgger能够合成分布外恢复数据用于鲁棒模仿学习；正在探索大规模野外多模态数据（人工演示、未标注视频、系统日志）对齐用于策略学习并转化为持续改进反馈。
AI.conclusion: 工业物流场景为具身智能提供了从数据到部署再到持续改进的完整闭环验证平台，数据中心化方法有望解决长尾分布和分布外泛化等关键挑战。

title: Dual Feature Decoupling for Fine-Grained OOD Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution detection (OOD) is an indispensable technique when applying machine learning models to real-world scenarios. Most existing OOD detection methods have been developed under the idealized assumption of large inter-class distributional differences, while largely overlooking fine-grained tasks characterized by subtle variations, such as medical image classification and vehicle recognition. The high visual similarity among fine-grained subcategories, together with the interference of background factors, makes OOD detection extremely challenging. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel Dual Feature Decoupling Network (DFDNet), which addresses fine-grained OOD detection from the perspective of feature disentanglement. The proposed DFDNet comprises two key components: a spatial-frequency decoupling module and a reconstruction-guided decoupling module. The spatial-frequency decoupling module is designed to preserve content features that are discriminative for classification while suppressing task-irrelevant style information. On the other hand, the reconstruction-guided decoupling module introduces a novel pixel-level adversarial reconstruction task to further remove low-level, non-discriminative information and enhance category-specific high-level semantic representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance improvements on multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对细粒度分类场景下的分布外检测（OOD）难题，提出了一种双特征解耦网络（DFDNet），通过空间-频率解耦与重建引导解耦两个模块，分离判别性内容特征与任务无关的风格/低级信息，在多个数据集上取得了竞争性性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法大多假设类间分布差异较大，忽略了医学图像分类、车辆识别等细粒度任务中类别间差异微小、背景因素干扰严重的问题，亟需专门针对细粒度OOD检测的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出Dual Feature Decoupling Network (DFDNet)，包含两个核心模块：(1) 空间-频率解耦模块，保留对分类有判别力的内容特征，抑制任务无关的风格信息；(2) 重建引导解耦模块，通过像素级对抗重建任务进一步去除低级非判别性信息，增强类别特定的高级语义表示。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了竞争性的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 从特征解耦的角度出发，通过分离判别性内容特征与干扰性特征，能够有效提升细粒度OOD检测的性能。

title: Mamba-Assisted Non-Markovian Closure for Reduced-Order Modeling
comment: Code will be released upon acceptance
summary: Reduced-order modeling of high-dimensional dynamical systems is often hindered by the non-Markovian closure term that represents the effect of unresolved variables on the resolved dynamics. Inspired by the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, in which the closure takes the form of a memory functional of the resolved trajectory, we recast closure modeling as a sequence modeling problem and propose the Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC) framework: a Mamba-based sequence model, trained to predict the closure from the resolved trajectory, is coupled with the reduced-order governing equations through a numerical integrator to advance the resolved variables in time. A key feature of the framework is its exploitation of the dual representation of state-space models -- the model is trained in a sequence-to-sequence fashion via the convolutional form, and deployed for step-by-step autoregressive rollout via the recurrent form, yielding both efficient long-trajectory training and constant per-step inference cost. On the viscous Burgers' equation and the chaotic two-scale Lorenz '96 system, the MAC model substantially outperforms the Markovian reduced-order model, the GRU-based sequence model, and the Wilks method in predictive accuracy and long-time rollout stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC)框架，利用Mamba序列模型对高维动力系统的非马尔可夫闭包项进行建模，在粘性Burgers方程和混沌Lorenz '96系统上显著优于传统降阶模型、GRU序列模型和Wilks方法。
AI.motivation: 高维动力系统降阶建模中，未解析变量对解析变量的影响表现为非马尔可夫闭包项，传统马尔可夫假设无法准确捕捉这一记忆效应，限制了降阶模型的精度和稳定性。
AI.method: 基于Mori-Zwanzig形式论，将闭包建模转化为序列建模问题，提出MAC框架：用Mamba序列模型从解析变量轨迹中预测闭包项，再通过数值积分器与降阶控制方程耦合进行时间推进。利用状态空间模型的双重表示——卷积形式进行高效序列到序列训练，循环形式进行自回归推理，实现恒定单步推理成本。
AI.result: 在粘性Burgers方程和混沌两尺度Lorenz '96系统上，MAC模型在预测精度和长时间卷积极稳定性上显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、GRU序列模型和Wilks方法。
AI.conclusion: MAC框架有效解决了降阶建模中非马尔可夫闭包的序列建模问题，兼具训练效率和推理效率，为高维动力系统降阶提供了一种高精度、高稳定性的新范式。

title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
summary: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the \emph{world modeling interface} to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the \emph{language reasoning} capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an \emph{autoregressive (AR)} Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the \emph{next state}, comprising the \emph{semantic-level} textual intention and complementary \emph{fine-grained} physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction \emph{implicitly} impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from \emph{cross-embodiment robot videos} without action annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型，一种结合世界建模与语言推理能力的具身基础模型。通过自回归Transformer预测下一状态（包含语义级文本意图与细粒度物理动态），在2B参数下实现SOTA多任务与长时域任务性能（如RoboTwin2.0 Clean上92.94%成功率），并支持跨本体机器人视频的无动作标注学习。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）缺乏语言推理能力，难以解决复杂长时域任务；而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽具备语言推理能力，但无法像WAM那样利用大规模第一人称视频进行世界建模。WLA旨在融合两者优势，同时实现语义级语言推理与细粒度物理动态建模。
AI.method: 1) 采用自回归（AR）Transformer骨干（而非WAM中的双向扩散Transformer）预测下一状态，包含语义级文本意图与细粒度物理动态；2) 物理动态通过World Expert的世界建模目标监督，并用于简化Action Expert的状态-动作关联建模；3) 使用meta-query使世界预测隐式影响动作生成，且推理时可禁用世界预测以提升效率；4) 世界预测可在推理时激活，实现test-time scaling以改进控制。
AI.result: WLA-0（2B激活参数）在RTX 5090上达到40ms/次推理。在RoboTwin2.0 Clean上达到92.94%成功率，在RMBench上达到56.5%成功率，均达到SOTA。支持从跨本体机器人视频中直接学习新任务，无需动作标注。
AI.conclusion: WLA模型成功融合了WAM的世界建模能力和VLA的语言推理能力，在具身智能的多任务与长时域任务上实现SOTA性能，并具备从无标注跨本体视频中学习的能力，为具身基础模型提供了新范式。

title: UltraVR: A Diagnostic Ultra-Resolution Image-VQA Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel on visual question answering and multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Yet their capability on ultra-resolution images - where critical evidence is tiny, subtle, spatially distant, or distributed - remains unclear. Existing evaluations largely report final-answer accuracy, offering limited insight into whether models acquire and integrate the necessary visual evidence. We introduce UltraVR, a diagnostic benchmark for evidence-grounded visual reasoning over ultra-resolution images. UltraVR spans four high-value scenarios: CCTV surveillance, remote sensing (RS), whole-slide image (WSI) pathology, and industrial anomaly detection (AD). These domains pose complementary challenges: fine-grained object grounding in crowded CCTV scenes, long-range spatial comparison in RS, multi-scale evidence navigation in WSI, and subtle irregularity detection in repetitive industrial layouts. Beyond standard QA triples, each instance includes a structured ground-truth chain of thought with step-level questions, intermediate answers, and reasoning labels. These labels decompose reasoning into evidence grounding, local perception, quantification, evidence integration, and decision inference, enabling process-level diagnosis over black-box scoring. Using UltraVR, we evaluate frontier VLMs and show that current models remain far from reliable on ultra-resolution reasoning. Importantly, the structured annotations allow us to localize failures across the visual-to-decision pipeline: errors concentrate in evidence grounding and local perception, while downstream inference often recovers when intermediate visual facts are supplied. These findings demonstrate UltraVR as a diagnostic testbed for measuring not only whether VLMs answer correctly, but where their ultra-resolution reasoning process breaks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UltraVR基准，用于诊断VLM在超分辨率图像上的证据基础视觉推理能力，涵盖监控、遥感、病理和工业检测四个高价值场景。通过结构化推理链标注，揭示当前模型在证据定位和局部感知环节存在主要失败，而下游推理在获得中间视觉事实后常能恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评估多关注最终答案准确率，无法揭示模型在超分辨率图像中是否真正获取并整合了关键视觉证据（微小、细微、空间分散或分布式线索），缺乏对推理过程的细粒度诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建UltraVR基准，包含四个高价值场景（CCTV监控、遥感、全切片病理、工业异常检测），每个实例提供结构化真实推理链，包含分步问题、中间答案和推理标签（证据定位、局部感知、量化、证据整合、决策推理），实现过程级诊断。
AI.result: 当前前沿VLM在超分辨率推理上远未达到可靠水平；错误主要集中在证据定位和局部感知环节，但下游推理在获得中间视觉事实后常能恢复。
AI.conclusion: UltraVR可作为诊断测试平台，不仅能衡量VLM是否回答正确，还能定位其超分辨率推理过程在何处断裂，为改进模型提供方向性指导。

title: Evidence-Guided Neural Architecture Selection under Uncertainty for Subject-Specific Blood Glucose Forecasting
summary: Reliable neural architecture selection is an open challenge in time-series forecasting under limited, noisy, and heterogeneous data, where standard heuristic architecture design and validation approaches fail to ensure accurate and reliable prediction and generalization. We propose EVIDENT (EVidence-based IDEntification of Neural archiTectures), a framework for architecture selection that integrates Bayesian training, evidence-based ranking, and task-specific validation under uncertainty. The framework explores the candidate architecture pool and identifies the lowest-capacity model that satisfies a prescribed validation criterion. We demonstrate this method using temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for individualized blood glucose forecasting in type 1 diabetes patients. The results show that EVIDENT systematically rejects both under- and over-parameterized TCN architectures on population-level diabetes data, while identifying models that generalize reliably to unseen patients. When multiple architectures are competitive, the framework further supports plausibility-weighted ensemble predictions that enhance predictive performance. Compared with a random-search baseline, EVIDENT identified smaller architectures with more consistent forecasting performance on unseen patients. These findings establish EVIDENT as a strategy to neural architecture discovery, enabling reliable model selection for high-consequence forecasting in data-limited and heterogeneous settings.

AI.tldr: 提出EVIDENT框架，通过贝叶斯训练、证据排序和不确定性下验证，在有限、噪声和异质数据中为时间序列预测选择最简可靠神经架构，在1型糖尿病血糖预测中验证其优于随机搜索基线。
AI.motivation: 在有限、噪声和异质数据的时间序列预测中，标准启发式架构设计和验证方法无法确保准确可靠的预测和泛化，神经架构选择仍是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出EVIDENT框架，集成贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排名和不确定性下的任务特定验证，探索候选架构池并识别满足规定验证标准的最低容量模型，同时支持集成预测。
AI.result: 在1型糖尿病血糖预测中，EVIDENT系统性地拒绝了欠参数化和过参数化的TCN架构，识别出能可靠泛化到未见过患者的模型；当存在多个竞争架构时，加权集成进一步提升预测性能；与随机搜索基线相比，EVIDENT识别出更小的架构并具有更一致的预测表现。
AI.conclusion: EVIDENT建立了一种可靠的神经架构发现策略，能够在数据有限和异质的高风险预测场景中实现可信的模型选择。

title: Merging model-based control with multi-agent reinforcement learning for multi-agent cooperative teaming strategies
summary: In this work, we propose a framework that combines multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) with model-based control to achieve safe, dynamically feasible actions in cooperative multi-agent tasks. Multi-agent reinforcement learning provides the advantage of learning cooperative policies for multi-agent teams from discrete non-differentiable rewards in a long planning horizon. Model-predictive control is robust and offers safe, dynamically feasible actions in a fast replanning framework for short horizons. We propose an algorithm that extends actor-critic model predictive control for MARL which we refer to as multi-agent actor-critic model predictive control (MA-AC-MPC). We demonstrate the capabilities of this algorithm by applying it to a multi-agent pursuit-evasion scenario. Specifically, we compare the evader team's strategy using the MA-AC-MPC model and a multi-layer perceptron model (MA-AC-MLP). The pursuer team uses augmented proportional navigation as it is accepted as an advanced adversarial control law. We also provide an example with a heterogeneous environment where a drone and omni-wheeled rover cooperate to achieve repeatable and successful landing with 100% success rate in hardware for MA-AC-MPC compared to 60% for MA-AC-MLP. We demonstrate the robustness of the proposed MA-AC-MPC algorithm in hardware for both environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多智能体强化学习（MARL）与模型预测控制（MPC）的框架（MA-AC-MPC），在合作多智能体任务中实现安全、动态可行的动作。通过在多智能体追逃场景和异构环境（无人机与全向轮式机器人协同降落）中的仿真与硬件实验，验证了该方法在成功率与鲁棒性上优于传统多层感知机模型（MA-AC-MLP）。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习擅长长时域规划中从非可微奖励中学习合作策略，但难以保证短期动作的安全性与动态可行性；模型预测控制虽具备鲁棒性和短时域快速重规划的安全优势，但缺乏长期学习能力。为结合两者优势，提出MA-AC-MPC框架。
AI.method: 将Actor-Critic模型预测控制（AC-MPC）扩展到多智能体场景，提出多智能体Actor-Critic模型预测控制（MA-AC-MPC）算法。在追逃场景中，逃避者团队分别使用MA-AC-MPC和MA-AC-MLP策略，追捕者采用增强比例导引律；在异构环境中，无人机与全向轮式机器人协同完成降落任务。
AI.result: 在异构硬件实验中，MA-AC-MPC实现了100%的成功降落率，而MA-AC-MLP仅为60%。在多智能体追逃场景中也验证了MA-AC-MPC的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MA-AC-MPC成功融合了MARL的长期合作学习能力与MPC的短期安全动态可行性，在合作多智能体任务中展现出更高的成功率和更强的鲁棒性，具有在真实硬件环境中部署的潜力。

title: BMCR: Adaptive Backbone Module Composition via Reinforcement Learning for Remote Sensing Object Detection
summary: In remote sensing object detection, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) excel at capturing local details while Vision Transformers (ViTs) are better at global context modeling. However, existing detectors typically rely on a single fixed backbone or a manually designed hybrid architecture, and thus fail to adaptively exploit these complementary strengths across inputs of diverse complexity. To address this limitation, we propose Backbone Module Composition via Reinforcement Learning (BMCR). BMCR dynamically assembles input-adaptive inference paths from reusable modules decomposed from off-the-shelf CNN and ViT backbones. To enable such cross-family composition, we first construct an extensible module toolbox. Specifically, we decompose representative CNN and ViT backbones into reusable functional modules and encapsulate each module with explicit structural, semantic, and computational metadata for compatibility-aware assembly. To bridge the gap between grid-based CNN features and token-based ViT representations, we design a lightweight Optimal Transport (OT) based transition interface that ensures distribution-aware alignment while respecting spatial consistency. The backbone composition process is then formulated as a sequential decision problem, in which a policy network progressively selects task-relevant modules according to intermediate multi-scale observations. To stabilize the joint optimization of reusable modules and the routing policy, we further develop an Adaptive Module Cooperative Optimization (AMCO) strategy that coordinates module updating, routing exploration, and reward assignment during training. On DOTA-v1.0, DOTA-v1.5 and DIOR-R, BMCR achieves 79.31\%, 73.41\% and 71.86\% mAP, respectively, surpassing strong static and dynamic baselines by up to 2.5 points while maintaining competitive efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BMCR方法，通过强化学习动态组合CNN和ViT骨干模块，实现遥感目标检测中自适应推理路径构建，在多个基准数据集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感目标检测器通常依赖单一固定骨干网络或人工设计的混合架构，无法根据输入样本的复杂度自适应地利用CNN（擅长局部细节）和ViT（擅长全局建模）的互补优势。
AI.method: 1) 构建可扩展模块工具箱，将CNN和ViT骨干分解为可复用的功能模块并封装元数据；2) 设计基于最优传输的轻量级过渡接口，实现网格特征与Token表示的对齐；3) 将骨干组合建模为序列决策问题，策略网络根据中间多尺度观测逐步选择模块；4) 提出自适应模块协作优化策略，协调模块更新、路由探索与奖励分配。
AI.result: 在DOTA-v1.0、DOTA-v1.5和DIOR-R数据集上分别达到79.31%、73.41%和71.86% mAP，超越强静态和动态基线最多2.5个百分点，同时保持具有竞争力的效率。
AI.conclusion: BMCR通过强化学习实现了跨CNN/ViT家族的动态骨干模块组合，有效应对遥感图像多样复杂性，验证了输入自适应推理路径在目标检测中的潜力。

title: SHALA-LLM: Smartly Handling Ambiguous Labels in Aligning LLMs
summary: Many human-centered tasks, including natural language inference (NLI) and emotion recognition (ER), have multiple plausible interpretations, leading to label ambiguity and challenging disagreements across human annotators. As LLMs are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, faithfully modeling such ambiguity is essential to identify contested inputs, preserve variability in ambiguous cases, and capture the full distribution of human judgments. Yet, existing LLM alignment approaches have predominantly assumed a single correct label, excluding annotator disagreement during optimization. Instead of treating this ambiguity as noise, we show how to treat it as information that improves model behavior through a new algorithm called SMARTLY HANDLING AMBIGUOUS LABELS IN ALIGNING LLMS (SHALA-LLM). This reinforcement learning framework provides a new way for LLMs to learn directly from annotator distributions while dynamically prioritizing highly ambiguous samples during optimization. Experiments on ambiguity-sensitive NLI and ER benchmarks, including ChaosNLI, GoEmotions, and MSP-Podcast, demonstrate that SHALA-LLM improves agreement with annotator label distributions, e.g. on ChaosNLI, it reduces Jensen-Shannon Distance by up to 62.1%. At the same time, SHALA-LLM improves F1 by up to 16.7%, showing that modeling annotator disagreement can also strengthen classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHALA-LLM算法，一种通过强化学习框架让LLM直接从标注者分布中学习并动态优先处理高歧义样本的对齐方法，在歧义敏感的NLI和ER基准上，将Jensen-Shannon距离降低最高62.1%，同时F1提升最高16.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法默认单一正确标签，忽略标注者间的分歧；但许多人类任务存在多解释歧义，需要模型能够忠实建模这种歧义以识别争议输入、保留歧义案例的变异性并捕捉完整的人类判断分布。
AI.method: 提出SHALA-LLM算法，一种新型强化学习框架，允许LLM直接从标注者分布中学习，并在优化过程中动态优先处理高歧义样本。
AI.result: 在ChaosNLI、GoEmotions和MSP-Podcast等歧义敏感的NLI和ER基准上，SHALA-LLM将Jensen-Shannon距离降低最高62.1%，F1提升最高16.7%。
AI.conclusion: 建模标注者分歧不仅能更好对齐人类判断分布，还能同时增强分类性能，表明标注歧义可被作为信息而非噪声加以利用。

title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

AI.tldr: RealDexUMI是一种基于可穿戴通用操作接口的灵巧操作数据收集与部署系统，通过共享末端执行器模块（轻量级灵巧手、手内视觉、指尖触觉）和掌侧同构遥操作手套，实现零重定向、直观精确的双手控制，在8项真实机器人任务中实现88.75%的平均成功率，并支持跨三种本体的策略迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧操作数据收集方法存在两类问题：要么通过重定向或具身转换丢失可部署的灵巧性，要么依赖机器人特定遥操作，成本高昂、难以规模化且缺乏直观的接触感知控制能力。目标是在保持精细手-物交互的同时，实现既可用于数据收集又可直接部署的灵巧操作方案。
AI.method: 提出RealDexUMI框架，核心是共享灵巧末端执行器模块（轻量级灵巧手、手内视觉、指尖触觉传感）与掌侧同构遥操作手套。手套将人类手指输入直接映射为机器人手关节命令，实现实时、无重定向的精确手部控制。共享模块确保收集与部署阶段的手内观测、触觉信号、接触状态和手部动作完全一致，实现零间隙数据。
AI.result: 在8项真实机器人任务（涵盖精细操作、接触密集型、长时序和双臂操作）上，基于RealDexUMI数据训练的策略平均成功率达88.75%，能够泛化到未见过的初始位姿，并成功跨三种不同机器人本体迁移。
AI.conclusion: RealDexUMI通过同构遥操作手套与共享末端执行器模块的设计，有效弥合了灵巧操作数据收集与策略部署之间的鸿沟，在保持数据保真度的同时实现了高成功率、泛化能力和跨本体迁移能力，为灵巧操作提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: HDST-GNN: Heterogeneous Dynamic Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks for Multi-Object Tracking in UAV Aerial Imagery
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) from UAV imagery presents unique challenges: altitude varies across sequences, objects are small and densely packed, and frequent occlusion causes identity switches. Existing graph-based trackers assume fixed spatial context and treat all objects uniformly, ignoring the heterogeneous lifecycle states of detections, active tracklets, and lost targets. We propose HDST-GNN, a Heterogeneous Dynamic Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network with three novel contributions. First, Altitude-Adaptive Edge Construction estimates a camera-altitude proxy from mean object area and adjusts the graph connectivity radius accordingly. Second, Heterogeneous Node Representation models detections (Type-D), confirmed tracklets (Type-T), and lost tracklets (Type-L) as distinct node types with dedicated projections and typed edge relations. Third, Occlusion-Gated Temporal Aggregation gates each node's attention contribution by its occlusion confidence, preventing occluded nodes from corrupting neighbour embeddings. HDST-GNN is trained end-to-end with a differentiable Sinkhorn head using joint cross-entropy and triplet loss. On VisDrone2019-MOT with oracle detections, HDST-GNN achieves 94.51% MOTA and 97.24% IDF1, outperforming SORT by +5.0 MOTA points and reducing identity switches by 81%. With real YOLOv8n detections, HDST-GNN reduces identity switches by 49% vs. SORT. Ablation studies confirm the independent contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出HDST-GNN，一种异构动态时空图神经网络，用于解决无人机视角下多目标跟踪中因高度变化、目标小且密集、频繁遮挡导致的身份切换问题。通过高度自适应边构建、异构节点表示和遮挡门控时序聚合三大创新，在VisDrone2019-MOT上显著超越SORT，MOTA达94.51%，身份切换减少81%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的跟踪器假设固定空间上下文且对所有对象统一处理，忽略了检测、活跃轨迹、丢失轨迹等异构生命周期状态，无法有效应对无人机视角下高度变化、目标密集和频繁遮挡带来的挑战。
AI.method: (1) 高度自适应边构建：通过目标平均面积估计相机高度代理，动态调整图连接半径；(2) 异构节点表示：将检测、确认轨迹、丢失轨迹建模为三种独立节点类型，各自配备专用投影和类型边关系；(3) 遮挡门控时序聚合：根据遮挡置信度对节点注意力贡献进行门控，防止遮挡节点污染邻居嵌入。使用可微Sinkhorn头部和联合交叉熵-三元组损失进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 在VisDrone2019-MOT上，使用oracle检测时MOTA达94.51%、IDF1达97.24%，比SORT提升+5.0 MOTA，身份切换减少81%；使用YOLOv8n真实检测时身份切换比SORT减少49%。消融实验验证了各模块的独立贡献。
AI.conclusion: HDST-GNN通过引入异构节点建模和高度自适应机制，有效解决了无人机多目标跟踪中因高度变化和遮挡导致的身份切换问题，显著优于传统统一处理方法。

title: Pattern Selectivity is Not Task-Causal Structure: A Cross-Architecture Mechanistic Study of Composed-Task Circuits in 1B-Class Language Models
summary:
We test whether a single screen-and-ablate recipe -- identify attention-head circuits by task-pattern selectivity, then verify by causal ablation against a matched-random null -- produces consistent mechanistic claims across model families. The recipe ports across pipelines; the specific circuit it identifies does not. Across four composed tasks (indirect-object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, variable binding) and three 1B-class language models from distinct training pipelines (Pythia 1B / Pile / dense; OLMo 1B / DCLM / dense; OLMoE 1B-7B / DCLM / mixture-of-experts), we run a unified protocol with the matched-random null sampled across ten seeds per cell. The resulting 12 (task, model) cells contain no two that share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size: the same task, with the same behavioral capability, is implemented through different attention-pattern types across models.
  We introduce a five-category screen-outcome taxonomy -- primary cause, secondary cause, correlate, interferer, null -- with quantitative thresholds, and show that all five outcomes appear in the panel. We propose a falsifiable hypothesis: the MoE model in our panel builds composed-task circuits on top of a foundational previous-token positional substrate (the prev-token-circuit ablation is the strongest causal screen on 3 of 4 tasks for OLMoE 1B-7B), with the IOI exception consistent with IOI being a final-position name-copying task whose structure directly probes a different pattern. The hypothesis comes with explicit predictions for other MoE language models.
  We frame the methodology honestly: the spectral participation-ratio signal from the companion methodology paper is a general indicator of specialized computation; what makes a finding task-specific is the task-pattern screen plus a per-model causal verification.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了一种"筛查-消融"方法（通过任务模式选择性识别注意力头电路，然后用因果消融与匹配随机零假设对比验证）在不同模型家族中是否产生一致的机制性结论。结果发现，该方法流程可移植，但具体识别的电路不可移植。在四种组合任务（间接宾语识别、大于、后继序列、变量绑定）和三个1B级语言模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B）上，12个（任务, 模型）组合中没有两个共享相同的主要因果筛查结果，即便任务和行为能力相同，不同模型也通过不同的注意力模式类型实现。本文引入了五类筛查结果分类法（主因、次因、相关物、干扰物、零），并提出一个可证伪假设：MoE模型在基础的前一个token位置基座上构建组合任务电路。
AI.motivation: 检验一个通用的"筛查-消融"方法能否在不同模型家族中产生一致的机制解释，揭示模型间电路实现的差异性和共性。
AI.method: 在4种组合任务和3个1B级语言模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B）上运行统一实验协议，采用任务模式选择性筛查注意力头电路，再通过因果消融与匹配随机零假设（每单元10个种子）对比验证。引入五类筛查结果分类法，并提出可证伪假设。
AI.result: 12个（任务, 模型）组合中没有两个共享相同的主要因果筛查结果；相同任务和行为在不同模型中通过不同的注意力模式类型实现；五类结果（主因、次因、相关物、干扰物、零）均出现在面板中；MoE模型在3/4任务上的最强因果筛查是前一个token位置电路消融。
AI.conclusion: 方法流程可移植，但识别的具体电路不可移植；谱参与比信号是专用计算的通用指标，但任务特异性发现需要任务模式筛查加逐模型因果验证；提出MoE模型构建组合任务电路的前token位置基座假设。

title: Gotta Grow Fast: Design and Benchmarking of a Tip Mount for High-Speed Vine Robots
comment: Accepted to IEEE Robotics & Automation Letters
summary: Soft, growing vine robots extend through tip eversion, a mechanism that enables navigation through cluttered environments. However, integrating cameras and other sensors at the tip is uniquely challenging because the material forming the tip is constantly renewed as the robot grows. This continual material turnover, combined with friction between internal layers, added tip weight, and fabric constriction, complicates sensor and tool mounting. These limitations hinder the deployment of vine robots for inspection and search tasks, where rapid growth while carrying tip-mounted sensors is essential. In this work, we present a triangular roller tip mount that reduces internal resistance during growth by rolling rather than sliding against the robot body. The design was refined through iterative failure analysis, enabling, for the first time, consistent eversion on a TPU-coated ripstop nylon vine robot. To quantitatively evaluate mount performance, we introduce a custom testbed that isolates tip mounting effects by measuring tail tension during eversion. Comparative experiments across multiple mount variants, including prior designs, show that our triangular roller mount achieves the lowest tail tension and most repeatable growth performance. These results establish both a validated tip mount design and a repeatable benchmarking framework for advancing sensor and tool integration in soft growing robots. CAD for the mount and testbed is available at: https://sprout-mitll.github.io/tip_mounts/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三角滚轮式尖端安装座，通过滚动代替滑动减少生长阻力，首次实现了在TPU涂层防撕裂尼龙材质 vine robot 上的一致外翻，并建立了可重复的基准测试框架。
AI.motivation: 藤蔓机器人在顶端集成摄像头和传感器面临独特挑战：顶端材料不断更新、内部层间摩擦、顶端重量增加及织物收缩导致传感器和工具安装困难，阻碍了其在检测和搜索任务中的应用。
AI.method: 设计三角滚轮尖端安装座，通过滚动而非滑动减少生长时的内部阻力；通过迭代故障分析优化设计；搭建专用测试台通过测量尾部张力来隔离评估尖端安装效果。
AI.result: 与包括先前设计在内的多种安装变体相比，三角滚轮安装座实现了最低的尾部张力和最可重复的生长性能。
AI.conclusion: 建立了经过验证的尖端安装座设计和可重复的基准测试框架，推动软体生长机器人中传感器和工具的集成。

title: What's Under the Skin? Estimating Swine Body Condition
summary: Sow body condition is an important indicator for growers as it has a large impact on lactation performance and piglet survival. However, body condition measures used during production, such as visual scoring and calipers, correlate poorly with underlying tissue composition. Ultrasound scans can provide direct measurements of subcutaneous backfat thickness and loin muscle depth, but their operation is labor intensive and not scalable for production. We present PigFormer, an end-to-end two-stage system that takes raw depth frames from a ceiling-mounted RGB-D camera and predicts subcutaneous backfat thickness, loin muscle depth, and total tissue thickness at the last rib. Stage 1 is a geometric front-end that converts raw depth into a standardized height map via SAM3-to-MaskDINO segmentation distillation, ground-plane removal, and orientation normalization. Stage 2 is a Slice Attention Encoder that treats each height map as a sequence of cross-sectional slices and captures spatial relationships along the full dorsal surface. On a multi-site dataset of 319 sow and gilt instances from two facilities, PigFormer achieves 2.43 mm backfat MAE and 3.87 mm overall MAE. It outperforms strong single-stage ResNet-18 and ViT-small baselines. PigFormer offers a practical path toward continuous, automated, non-contact body condition monitoring in commercial swine production. Code is available at https://github.com/iambashar/Pigformer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PigFormer，一种端到端两阶段系统，利用天花板安装的RGB-D摄像头原始深度帧，预测猪皮下背膘厚度、腰肌深度和总组织厚度。第一阶段通过SAM3-to-MaskDINO分割蒸馏、地面移除和方向归一化将原始深度转换为标准化高度图；第二阶段采用切片注意力编码器，将高度图视为横截面切片序列并捕获沿整个背部的空间关系。在两个设施319头母猪和小母猪数据集上，PigFormer达到了2.43 mm背膘MAE和3.87 mm整体MAE，优于ResNet-18和ViT-small基线。
AI.motivation: 母猪体况是影响泌乳性能和仔猪存活的重要指标，但生产中使用的视觉评分和卡尺等体况测量方法与底层组织成分相关性差。超声扫描可提供皮下背膘厚度和腰肌深度的直接测量，但操作劳动密集且难以规模化生产。
AI.method: PigFormer是一个端到端两阶段系统。第一阶段为几何前端，通过SAM3-to-MaskDINO分割蒸馏、地面移除和方向归一化将原始深度转换为标准化高度图。第二阶段为切片注意力编码器（Slice Attention Encoder），将高度图视为横截面切片序列，沿整个背部表面捕获空间关系。
AI.result: 在两个设施319头母猪和小母猪的多位点数据集上，PigFormer实现2.43 mm背膘MAE和3.87 mm整体MAE，优于强单阶段ResNet-18和ViT-small基线。
AI.conclusion: PigFormer为商业养猪生产中实现连续、自动化、非接触式体况监测提供了一条实用路径。

title: Generalized TV--$\ell_p$ Structured Priors for Bayesian $T_1$ Mapping
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:015
summary: We propose an extended family of structured spatial priors that incorporates the total variation (TV) function with $\ell_p$ norms. The prior is proven to be proper and incorporated into a Bayesian regression framework to enable uncertainty quantification in $T_1$ mapping, with posterior inference performed using the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS). This TV--$\ell_p$ construction is proven to constitute a well-defined family of prior distributions, and it naturally enforces spatial consistency and smooth variations in the estimated parameter maps. The method was evaluated in comparison to maximum-likelihood estimation and several Bayesian alternative priors based on the uniform, Gamma, and bounded TV priors. The evaluation includes experiments on synthetic brain and cardiac $T_1$ mapping datasets, as well as a real in-vivo breast $T_1$ mapping dataset. The results show that the TV--$\ell_p$ prior yields more concentrated posterior densities, indicating reduced uncertainty. It also consistently achieves lower variance and smaller (negative) bias, leading to more reliable estimates. Overall, embedding a TV-based structured penalty along with $\ell_p$ norms in a prior in a Bayesian model improves spatial coherence in $T_1$ maps and enhances uncertainty quantification, offering a robust approach for $T_1$ mapping with uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合总变分（TV）与ℓ_p范数的扩展结构空间先验族，用于贝叶斯回归框架下的T₁映射不确定性量化。该先验被证明是适定的，通过No-U-Turn采样器进行后验推断，在合成和真实T₁数据集上相比多种贝叶斯先验及最大似然估计，能获得更集中的后验密度、更低的方差和更小的负偏倚，从而提升空间一致性和不确定性量化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有T₁映射方法在参数估计中缺乏有效的空间先验约束和不确定性量化机制，导致估计结果空间一致性差、方差较大。作者希望引入一种兼具TV结构化惩罚和ℓ_p范数灵活性的贝叶斯先验，在保证先验适定性的同时，提升T₁参数图的空问平滑性和估计可靠性。
AI.method: 提出TV-ℓ_p先验族，证明其作为先验分布的适定性；将该先验嵌入贝叶斯回归框架，使用No-U-Turn采样器（NUTS）进行后验推断；在合成脑/心脏T₁数据和真实乳腺T₁数据上，与最大似然估计、均匀先验、Gamma先验、有界TV先验等基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: TV-ℓ_p先验相比基线方法能得到更集中的后验密度（不确定性降低）、更低的方差和更小的负偏倚；在合成和真实数据上均表现出更优的空间一致性和估计可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将基于TV的结构化惩罚与ℓ_p范数结合嵌入贝叶斯模型的先验中，能够显著改善T₁参数图的空问连贯性并增强不确定性量化，为带不确定性的T₁映射提供了一种鲁棒的贝叶斯方法。

title: Sample-efficient Low-level Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulation Tasks via Zero-shot Transfer Learning
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN) 2026 conference accepted
summary: As robotic systems become more sophisticated, the growing complexity of their motion planning models and the longer training times pose substantial challenges. Evolutionary algorithms such as the Sample-efficient Cross-Entropy Method (iCEM) have recently demonstrated promising potential for low-level real-time planning by leveraging efficient knowledge reuse strategies to improve performance. Although effective in many control tasks, iCEM's performance can be constrained in more complex scenarios, particularly those requiring stacking, sliding, and shelf placement. In this work, we propose a novel iCEM+TL framework that explicitly leverages Transfer Learning (TL), where key iCEM parameters are transferred from simpler upstream tasks to guide more complex downstream tasks. Additionally, we applied Reward Redesign (RR) through task decomposition for stacking objects and shelf placement to optimize task-specific performance. Results from the simulation show that our framework achieves success rate improvements of up to 23%. The framework is further validated on a real Franka Emika robot in a stacking task, demonstrating its practical feasibility for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iCEM+TL框架，通过迁移学习将iCEM参数从简单任务迁移到复杂任务，并结合奖励重塑（任务分解）进行优化，在仿真中成功率提升达23%，并在真实Franka Emika机器人上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 机器人运动规划模型日益复杂且训练时间长，iCEM在复杂场景（如堆叠、滑动、货架放置）中性能受限，需要更高效的参数知识迁移策略来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出iCEM+TL框架，利用迁移学习将上游简单任务的iCEM关键参数迁移到下游复杂任务；同时采用奖励重塑（Reward Redesign），通过任务分解优化堆叠和货架放置等特定任务的性能。
AI.result: 仿真实验中成功率提升高达23%，并在真实Franka Emika机器人堆叠任务中验证了实际部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: iCEM+TL框架通过迁移学习和奖励重塑有效提升了复杂机器人运动规划任务的性能，具备实际部署潜力。

title: KV-Control: Parameter-Efficient K/V Injection for Trajectory-Controlled Text-to-Motion
summary: Text-conditioned 3D human motion models now synthesize plausible motions from prompts, but practical animation and embodied-agent workflows rarely stop at text: a character may need to follow a sketched root path, hit an end-effector target, or satisfy a multi-joint trajectory while still preserving the gait, style, and intent described by language. This exposes a control trade-off. A trajectory controller should be precise without overwriting the pretrained text-conditioned motion prior, yet existing solutions either duplicate large portions of the generator to regain per-layer control access or move much of the cost to test-time optimization. We introduce KV-Control, a compact attention-side control interface for frozen masked text-to-motion transformers. The key idea is to make geometric constraints available as memory inside self-attention rather than injecting them through a global pose token or enforcing them only at the output side. To support this interface, we co-design a part-tokenized motion substrate and controller: \textbf{PartVQ} learns anatomy-aligned part codebooks, T-Concat exposes each frame--part token as an attention-addressable site, and KV-Control injects control-conditioned key/value memories at every self-attention layer while preserving the pretrained query stream, text cross-attention, FFN, and all backbone weights. The resulting adapter adds only trainable injection parameters atop a shared trajectory encoder, yet tracks root and multi-joint constraints with sub-centimeter accuracy under the inherited refinement protocol while retaining text-conditioned motion quality. KV-Control reframes trajectory conditioning as lightweight memory retrieval, providing a small, precise, and transparent control interface for text-to-motion generation.

AI.tldr: KV-Control提出了一种轻量级注意力侧控制接口，通过在自注意力层注入控制条件的键/值记忆，实现在冻结的遮罩文本到运动变换器上进行精确的轨迹控制，而无需修改预训练骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的3D人体运动模型虽能生成合理动作，但实际应用（如动画、具身智能体）需要满足根路径、末端效应器目标等多关节轨迹约束，同时保留语言描述的步态、风格和意图。现有方法要么复制生成器以获取逐层控制权限，要么将大量计算转移到测试时优化，存在精度与效率的权衡。
AI.method: 提出KV-Control，核心思想是将几何约束作为记忆存入自注意力机制内部。为此协同设计了三个组件：PartVQ学习解剖对齐的部分码本；T-Concat将每帧-部分token暴露为注意力可寻址位点；KV-Control在每层自注意力中注入控制条件的键/值记忆，同时保持预训练的查询流、文本交叉注意力、FFN和所有骨干网络权重不变。适配器仅在共享轨迹编码器上添加可训练注入参数。
AI.result: 在保持文本条件运动质量的同时，KV-Control在继承的细化协议下实现了亚厘米级的根轨迹和多关节约束追踪精度。
AI.conclusion: KV-Control将轨迹条件化重新定义为轻量级记忆检索，为文本到运动生成提供了一个小体积、精确且透明的控制接口。

title: Trust, but Don't Verify: Epistemic Blind Spots in LLM Source Evaluation
summary: Language models increasingly act as epistemic proxies, synthesizing evidence from multiple sources to inform decisions. Whether they evaluate the quality of that evidence, or merely aggregate it based on surface presentation, remains poorly understood. We show that models possess the capability to detect fabricated statistics (correct identification rates of 0.76-1.00 for methodology in isolation) but do not recruit this capability during multi-source synthesis, producing similar numeric estimates whether the statistics are fabricated or valid. Specifically, source influence is governed by a methodology-register gate that responds to the distributional register of analytical text but not to numeric validity: for example, statistically impossible confidence intervals receive the same weight as valid ones. The behavioral dissociation replicates across five models from three families (Claude, Qwen, OLMo) and three professional domains. Mechanistic analyses, including causal tracing, linear probes, and component-level attribution, converge on the same account: the model encodes and causally uses a methodology-register representation that transfers across domains (probe AUC 0.83-0.92), while numeric-validity signals, decodable in isolation, are suppressed to chance during multi-source synthesis. Prompting-based mitigations, even an oracle checklist naming the exact statistical checks, produce blanket skepticism rather than selective discernment, and the post-training pipelines we examine reinforce the stylistic shortcut without building numeric verification. Unlike sycophancy, which tracks user preference, this failure tracks whether a source presents as analytically credible, not whether its claims are internally consistent. We term this epistemic alignment: like preference and safety alignment, the question is not capability but deployment.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在作为认知代理时，虽然具备识别虚假统计数据的能力（正确率0.76-1.00），但在多源证据合成过程中不会调用该能力，而是通过“方法论-语域门控”机制（methodology-register gate）基于文本的分析性语域而非数值有效性来分配权重。这种“认知对齐”（epistemic alignment）问题在多个模型族、专业领域和机制分析中均得到验证，且现有提示策略和后训练流程无法解决。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型作为认知代理（epistemic proxy）时，是否真的能评估证据质量，还是仅仅基于表面呈现方式进行聚合。具体关注模型在拥有检测虚假统计能力的情况下，是否能在多源合成中实际使用这一能力。
AI.method: 实验设计：对比模型在孤立条件下检测虚假统计的能力与在多源合成任务中整合证据时的表现。行为实验跨5个模型（Claude、Qwen、OLMo三个家族）和3个专业领域。机制分析采用因果追踪（causal tracing）、线性探针（linear probes）和组件级归因（component-level attribution）。
AI.result: 模型在孤立条件下能高精度识别虚假统计（0.76-1.00），但在多源合成中无法区分虚假与有效统计，产生相似数值估计。虚假置信区间获得与有效区间相同的权重。探针分析显示方法论-语域表征可解码（AUC 0.83-0.92）并因果使用，而数值有效性信号在多源合成中被抑制至随机水平。提示策略导致全面怀疑而非选择性辨别。
AI.conclusion: 模型存在“认知对齐”问题：不是缺乏检测虚假信息的能力，而是在实际部署中未能使用该能力。模型基于来源是否呈现为“分析性可信”（方法论-语域）而非内部一致性来分配权重。这一问题区别于谄媚（sycophancy），本质上属于部署层面的对齐问题。

title: L-SDPPO: Policy Optimization of Spiking Diffusion Policy for Intra-vehicular Robotic Manipulation
summary: Intra-vehicular robots in spacecraft help reduce astronaut workload and improve mission efficiency. Recent research focuses on using deep learning methods to achieve the acute control required for operations in these complex environments. However, objects exhibit unpredictable, unconstrained drift without gravitational damping. These factors demand robustness against complex multimodal action distributions. Diffusion policies (DP) can model these complex actions, but their iterative sampling process consumes too much energy for the limited power budgets of spacecraft. We therefore propose a low-energy intra-vehicular robotic manipulation framework, L-SDPPO, in which the Spiking Diffusion Policy (SDP) is optimized with a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm. Furthermore, to address the insufficient perception of dynamic spatiotemporal features in microgravity, we propose the statedependent latency injection (SDLI) mechanism, which mimics biological neural delays to dynamically regulate the timing of input information. Evaluation on five representative intra-vehicular daily tasks (e.g., hatch opening and precision container capping) shows that our method consistently achieves higher success rates and lower energy consumption, compared to the state-of-the-art robotic manipulation methods. These results demonstrate our method is a viable intra-vehicular robotic manipulation method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于脉冲扩散策略和强化学习的低能耗航天器舱内机器人操控框架L-SDPPO，并引入状态依赖延迟注入机制以增强微重力下的动态时空特征感知，在五项典型任务中实现了更高的成功率和更低的能耗。
AI.motivation: 航天器舱内机器人需在微重力下处理物体不可预测的无阻尼漂移，现有深度学习方法（包括扩散策略）虽能建模复杂多模态动作分布，但其迭代采样过程能耗过高，难以适应航天器有限的电力预算。
AI.method: 提出L-SDPPO框架：将脉冲扩散策略（SDP）与强化学习（RL）联合优化以降低能耗；提出状态依赖延迟注入（SDLI）机制，模拟生物神经延迟动态调节输入信息时序，增强微重力下动态时空特征感知能力。
AI.result: 在舱门开启、精密容器封盖等五项代表性舱内日常任务中，L-SDPPO相比现有最先进机器人操控方法实现了更高的成功率和更低的能量消耗。
AI.conclusion: L-SDPPO是一种可行的低能耗航天器舱内机器人操控方法。

title: ShotCrop$^3$: Cropping Human-Centric Images into Cinematic Triple-Shot Compositions
summary: Prior work on aesthetic composition typically produces a single aesthetically pleasing crop, overlooking the narrative value of composing multiple shots from one scene. In practice, multi-shot composition is critical for downstream creative workflows: commercial posters often require multiple crops with different emphases (e.g., context, subject, and emotion/product details) to present key story beats. Therefore, we propose \textbf{Triple-Shot Compositions (TSC)}, a composition task that generates a three-shot set -- establishing, medium, and close-up -- from a single human-centric image, each paired with a brief shot description to support visual narration. To learn TSC with limited expert annotations, we introduce \textbf{ShotCrop} which undergoes a three-stage training process: it first applies Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning to establish basic reasoning and aesthetic shot-cropping skills, then performs semi-supervised fine-tuning with high-confidence pseudo labels to further enhance aesthetic capability, and is finally optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization for \textbf{ShotCrop} (GRPO-S) using a composite reward tailored for it. Specifically, our pseudo-labeling strategy combines MLLM-based scoring, aesthetic assessment, and CLIP similarity to retain high-confidence training signals. In addition, we present TSC-Bench, a benchmark of 1.2k expert-annotated test cases. Notably, ShotCrop achieves an average improvement of \textbf{2.82} times over GPT-5 in shot localization accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Triple-Shot Compositions (TSC)任务，从单张人物图像生成包含远景、中景、特写三张裁切及对应文字描述的三镜头集。为此设计ShotCrop模型，采用三阶段训练（CoT监督微调、半监督微调、GRPO-S强化学习）及伪标签策略。构建TSC-Bench基准，ShotCrop在镜头定位精度上平均比GPT-5提升2.82倍。
AI.motivation: 现有美学构图方法通常只生成单一裁切，忽略了从同一场景中组合多个镜头对下游创意工作流（如商业海报需要不同重点的多个裁切来呈现关键故事节拍）的叙事价值。
AI.method: 提出TSC任务与ShotCrop模型：三阶段训练（CoT监督微调建立基础推理与裁切技能→半监督微调用高置信伪标签增强美学能力→GRPO-S优化）；伪标签策略融合MLLM评分、美学评估和CLIP相似度；构建TSC-Bench基准。
AI.result: ShotCrop在镜头定位精度上平均比GPT-5提升2.82倍，在1.2k专家标注测试集上验证。
AI.conclusion: 多镜头构图任务TSC及ShotCrop方法有效支持视觉叙事需求，半监督与强化学习结合的框架在有限标注下取得显著提升。

title: CausalPOI: Spatio-Temporal Graph-Based Causal Modeling for Cold-Start POI Check-in Forecasting
summary: As urban environments continue to evolve rapidly, accurately modeling the dynamic behaviour of Points of Interest is essential for supporting data-driven urban planning and commercial decision-making. While recent advancements in spatio-temporal graph learning have improved POI forecasting, most methods rely on proximity-based graphs and correlation-driven modeling, which overlook the functional dependencies between POIs and fail to capture the causal effects of urban interventions. In this paper, we introduce a novel research problem -- cold-start POI check-in forecasting, which aims to predict the future check-in pattern of a newly introduced POI, by modeling its temporal evolution and functional interactions with nearby POIs in a structured urban spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose CausalPOI, a spatio-temporal graph-based causal representation learning framework. CausalPOI leverages Spatio-Temporal Functional Interaction Graph to model semantic and spatial relationships between POIs, and constructs structurally aligned treatment and control graphs to simulate factual and counterfactual scenarios. Extensive experiments on real-world SafeGraph datasets demonstrate that CausalPOI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across the board, validating its effectiveness in spatio-temporal forecasting, semantic interaction modeling, and causal effect estimation, providing a more interpretable and actionable foundation for urban intervention analysis. Source code is available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalPOI框架，通过时空图因果表征学习解决冷启动POI签到预测问题，在真实数据集上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有POI预测方法依赖基于距离的图和相关驱动建模，忽视了POI之间的功能依赖关系及城市干预的因果效应，无法有效预测新引入POI的签到模式。
AI.method: 提出CausalPOI框架，构建时空功能交互图建模POI间的语义和空间关系，并构造结构对齐的处理图和控制图来模拟事实与反事实场景，实现因果表征学习。
AI.result: 在真实SafeGraph数据集上的大量实验表明，CausalPOI在时空预测、语义交互建模和因果效应估计方面全面显著优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CausalPOI为冷启动POI签到预测提供了更可解释和可操作的城市干预分析基础，验证了因果表征学习在时空图建模中的有效性。

title: A Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation with Distributed Generative AI models
comment: Accepted to the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026). The final published version will appear under the title "A Distributed Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation Using Local LLMs and VLMs"
