summary: This paper presents a distributed conversational framework for human-robot collaborative manipulation that integrates local language and vision-language models (VLMs) with a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2)-based execution stack. Language understanding, visual grounding, orchestration, and motion execution run as separate ROS 2 nodes, enabling flexible deployment across distributed hardware while maintaining a responsive control loop. From free-form user commands, the system generates structured action requests for pick, place, and handover. It uses a VLM to return image-space targets, which are converted into metric robot-frame goals using depth and calibration. A web dashboard exposes intermediate intent and grounding overlays (pixel, depth, and robot-frame) and requires explicit operator confirmation before any motion is executed. Experiments on a Franka FR3 platform evaluate end-to-end task reliability and latency under increasing working table scene ambiguity and compare alternative LLM/VLM configurations in the same pipeline. Code and full documentation are available at [github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm](https://github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于ROS 2的分布式人机协同操作对话框架，集成语言与视觉-语言模型，实现从自由形式用户指令到机械臂抓取、放置和交接任务的端到端执行，并在Franka FR3平台上验证了系统在不同场景模糊度下的可靠性与延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机协同操作系统中，语言理解、视觉定位与运动执行通常紧密耦合，难以灵活部署在分布式硬件上；同时，自由形式用户指令到结构化动作的映射缺乏鲁棒性，且缺乏显式的操作员确认机制来确保安全。
AI.method: 将语言理解、视觉定位、任务编排和运动执行为四个独立的ROS 2节点，支持分布式部署；利用VLM从自由形式指令中提取图像空间目标，再结合深度数据与标定转换为机器人框架下的度量坐标；通过网页仪表盘展示中间意图与定位信息，并要求操作员显式确认后才能执行运动。
AI.result: 在Franka FR3平台上进行了端到端任务可靠性实验，对比了不同LLM/VLM配置在同一流水线中的表现，并评估了工作台场景模糊度增加对系统性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分布式对话框架能够有效整合大语言模型与视觉-语言模型，实现从自然语言指令到物理操作的闭环，且通过ROS 2的模块化设计保证了灵活性与响应性；操作员确认机制增强了系统安全性。

title: Multi-Task Crack Foundation Model for Engineering-Reliable Crack Representation and Topology Preservation in Civil Infrastructure
summary: Reliable crack assessment requires not only accurate pixel-level masks but also connected crack geometry and confidence estimates that remain stable under domain shift. However, existing segmentation models can achieve high overlap scores while fragmenting cracks, missing fine branches, and providing no calibrated uncertainty. To address this gap, this paper proposes CrackGeoFM, a multi-task framework that combines a frozen visual foundation backbone with crack-specific adaptation for mask prediction, skeleton reconstruction, and uncertainty estimation. The framework integrates a Frequency-Guided Crack Enhancement Module (FCEM) to enhance high-frequency crack cues, a Crack-Domain Feature Adaptation Module (CFAM) to adapt frozen backbone features to crack-domain patterns, and a Structure-Aware Multi-Task Decoder (SMTD) to jointly decode masks, skeletons, and uncertainty. Across 20 crack datasets, CrackGeoFM achieves state-of-the-art segmentation, improved topology preservation, calibrated uncertainty, and effective few-shot adaptation with only five labeled images. These results support reliable, generalizable, and engineering-oriented crack analysis for infrastructure assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrackGeoFM，一个多任务框架，结合冻结的视觉基础骨干网络与裂缝专用适配模块，同时进行裂缝掩膜预测、骨架重建和不确定性估计，在20个裂缝数据集上实现最先进的分割性能、拓扑保持和校准的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有裂缝分割模型虽能达到较高的重叠分数，但存在裂缝碎片化、遗漏细枝裂缝、缺乏校准的不确定性问题，且无法在域偏移下保持稳定。
AI.method: 提出CrackGeoFM多任务框架，包含三个核心模块：频率引导的裂缝增强模块（FCEM）增强高频裂缝线索、裂缝域特征适配模块（CFAM）将冻结骨干特征适配到裂缝域模式、结构感知多任务解码器（SMTD）联合解码掩膜、骨架和不确定性。
AI.result: 在20个裂缝数据集上实现最先进的分割性能，改进的拓扑保持，校准的不确定性，以及仅需5张标注图像即可实现有效的少样本适配。
AI.conclusion: CrackGeoFM支持可靠、可泛化、面向工程的裂缝分析，适用于基础设施评估。

title: Selective-Advantage Entropy-Adaptive Horizon GRPO: Asymmetric Token-Level Discounting for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) has emerged as an effective reinforcement-learning algorithm for aligning language models on reasoning tasks, but it treats every token position and every sampled rollout symmetrically. We introduce two complementary extensions: (i) Adaptive-Horizon GRPO (AH-GRPO), which weights each token's policy gradient using a cumulative entropy-based discount that reduces the effective horizon when the model is uncertain, and (ii) Selective-Advantage AH-GRPO (SA-AH-GRPO), which applies this discounting only to negative-advantage rollouts, leaving positive-advantage, successful trajectories unattenuated. We evaluate standard GRPO with alpha = 0, AH-GRPO with alpha = 0.5, and SA-AH-GRPO with alpha = 0.5 on the GSM8K mathematical reasoning benchmark using both Qwen 2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen 2.5-3B-Instruct fine-tuned with LoRA. On the 3B model, SA-AH-GRPO achieves Pass@1 = 0.858 at its peak at step 30 and maintains 0.846 at 180 steps, with training variance reduced to 0.0246, a 3.6 times reduction relative to GRPO while matching its peak accuracy. On the 1.5B model, SA-AH-GRPO achieves a peak Pass@1 of 0.686, improving over the zero-shot baseline of 0.637. Our analysis shows that asymmetric discounting preserves the full gradient signal on correct solutions, prevents entropy collapse, and substantially stabilises training, suggesting a principled inductive bias for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on structured generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种GRPO扩展：AH-GRPO（基于累积熵的自适应折扣）和SA-AH-GRPO（仅对负优势轨迹进行折扣），在GSM8K推理任务上使用Qwen 2.5模型进行验证。SA-AH-GRPO在3B模型上达到Pass@1=0.858，训练方差降低3.6倍，在1.5B模型上达到0.686，优于零样本基线0.637。非对称折扣保留了正确解的梯度信号，防止熵坍缩，显著稳定了训练过程。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO对所有token位置和采样轨迹对称处理，忽视了模型在不同token位置的不确定性差异，导致训练不稳定和效率低下。
AI.method: (i) AH-GRPO：基于累积熵的折扣因子，在模型不确定时缩短有效视界；(ii) SA-AH-GRPO：仅对负优势（失败）轨迹施加折扣，保留正优势（成功）轨迹的完整梯度信号。在GSM8K上使用Qwen 2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Qwen 2.5-3B-Instruct进行LoRA微调评估。
AI.result: 3B模型上SA-AH-GRPO峰值Pass@1=0.858（第30步），180步保持0.846，训练方差降至0.0246（相对GRPO降低3.6倍）；1.5B模型上峰值Pass@1=0.686，优于零样本基线0.637。
AI.conclusion: 非对称折扣保留了正确解的完整梯度信号，防止熵坍缩，显著稳定训练过程，为具有可验证奖励的结构化生成任务提供了一种原则性的归纳偏置。

title: 3D Underwater Path Planning via Generative Flow Field Surrogates
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) launch and recovery (LAR) into the hull of an advancing host platform requires traversal of a complex, three-dimensional propeller wake whose hydrodynamic structure cannot be characterised by a uniform current model. High-fidelity Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations resolve this structure with sufficient accuracy for path planning, but their computational cost renders them impractical for onboard use. We address this gap by integrating two conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) architectures -- a regularised PatchGAN and a 2D3DGAN with self-attention -- as drop-in replacements for RANS CFD data within a three-dimensional, energy-weighted A* path planning framework. Both generators are driven by a hierarchical pipeline that synthesises full $128^3$ voxel flow field volumes from scalar operating condition inputs alone, with end-to-end inference times of approximately 28-146 $μ$s, compared to hours for a single RANS computation. We benchmark all four environmental knowledge levels: uniform current, ground-truth CFD, PatchGAN, and 2D3DGAN~SA across 19,800 independently generated trajectories spanning 550 distinct flow conditions. Full CFD wake knowledge reduces energy expenditure by 5.7-12.5% and high-velocity wake-core encounters by up to 77.8% relative to uniform-current planning, with both benefits scaling with operating severity. The cGAN surrogates recover approximately 45-60% of the CFD energy benefit and high-velocity cell avoidance benefit while operating at inference speeds compatible with edge device use. These results provide the first systematic quantification of the downstream path planning value of cGAN-predicted hydrodynamic fields in a three-dimensional maritime robotics application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）替代高计算成本的RANS CFD仿真，在三维能量加权A*路径规划框架中生成自主水下航行器（AUV）在推进器尾流中的流场数据，实现了28-146 μs的端到端推理速度，相比单次RANS计算数小时大幅加速。在19800条独立轨迹上的基准测试表明，完整CFD尾流知识相比均匀流模型可降低5.7-12.5%能量消耗并减少高达77.8%的高速尾流核心遭遇，cGAN代理可恢复约45-60%的CFD收益，且推理速度支持边缘设备部署。
AI.motivation: AUV在母船船体回收过程中需穿越复杂三维螺旋桨尾流，传统的均匀流模型无法描述尾流的水动力学结构，而高保真RANS CFD仿真虽能精确解析但计算成本过高无法用于机载实时路径规划。因此需要一种既能保持足够精度又具有实时推理能力的代理模型。
AI.method: 集成两种cGAN架构（正则化PatchGAN和带自注意力的2D3DGAN）作为RANS CFD数据的即插即用替代品，通过分层流水线从标量工况输入合成完整128³体素流场体积，并在三维能量加权A*路径规划框架中进行评估。在550种不同流动条件下的19800条轨迹上对四种环境知识水平（均匀流、真实CFD、PatchGAN、2D3DGAN-SA）进行系统基准测试。
AI.result: 完整CFD尾流知识相比均匀流模型降低5.7-12.5%能量消耗，高速尾流核心遭遇减少高达77.8%，收益随工况严重程度增加。cGAN代理恢复约45-60%的CFD能量收益和高速尾流规避收益。推理速度28-146 μs，支持边缘设备使用。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统量化了cGAN预测水动力场在三维海洋机器人路径规划中的下游价值，证明cGAN代理可在显著降低计算成本的同时保留CFD尾流知识的大部分实用收益，为AUV实时机载回收路径规划提供了可行的技术方案。

title: CoFi-UCGen: Coarse-to-Fine Unsupervised Conditional Generation without Label Priors
summary: Unsupervised conditional image generation (UCGen) aims to control generation without relying on manually annotated labels, yet remains challenging due to unstructured semantic representations across granularities. To address this, we propose a novel coarse-to-fine UCGen framework (CoFi-UCGen) that explicitly disentangles global semantics from fine-grained variations, which to the best of our knowledge, sets out the first successful attempt for both coarse- and fine-grained conditional generation without any labels. More specifically, we first propose the adversarial semantic reciprocal learning theory to ensure the semantic consistency and completeness between images and latent spaces. Based on the consistency, we propose the bit-codes to learn a structured coarse-grained latent space, and further prove distinct global semantics inherent from our bit-codes while preserving independent noise sampling for generation. Building upon these bit-codes, we establish a fine-grained semantic basis and introduce a hierarchical modulation mechanism in diffusion models, by enabling layer-wise injection from coarse conditions to progressively control fine-grained attributes during generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that without any label priors or pre-trained feature extractors, our CoFi-UCGen consistently outperforms existing UCGen methods in terms of image quality, semantic consistency, and control accuracy, verifying the effectiveness of explicit coarse-to-fine semantic decomposition for the challenging UCGen task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoFi-UCGen，一种无监督条件图像生成框架，通过粗到细的语义解耦方法，首次在不依赖任何标注标签的情况下同时实现粗粒度和细粒度条件生成，在图像质量、语义一致性和控制精度上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 无监督条件图像生成面临语义表示无结构、跨粒度难以控制的挑战，现有方法无法在不依赖人工标注的情况下同时实现粗粒度和细粒度的条件生成。
AI.method: 提出对抗语义互惠学习理论保证图像与隐空间之间的语义一致性和完整性；提出bit-codes学习结构化粗粒度隐空间，证明其蕴含不同全局语义且保留独立噪声采样；基于bit-codes构建细粒度语义基，在扩散模型中引入层次化调制机制，实现从粗条件到逐层注入以逐步控制细粒度属性。
AI.result: 在无需任何标签先验或预训练特征提取器的情况下，CoFi-UCGen在图像质量、语义一致性和控制精度上一致优于现有无监督条件生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的粗到细语义解耦策略对于无监督条件图像生成任务有效，验证了结构化语义表示在无标签条件下的可行性。

title: DP-MacAdam: Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum
summary: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) has become the standard framework for privacy-preserving machine learning, yet its reliance on a fixed gradient clipping threshold to limit sensitivity remains a significant practical limitation. Adaptive clipping algorithms such as AdaClip shift and scale the gradient prior to clipping and adding noise so that the clipped gradient yields a more informative descent direction. The shift and scaling parameters are selected adaptively based on the empirical mean and variance. However, in existing adaptive clipping algorithms, these empirical estimates have not been also used for momentum to accelerate training itself. On the other hand, DP-Adam is an algorithm that exploits Adam-like momentum updates based on the gradient mean and variance to accelerate training, but does not exploit these estimates for adaptive clipping. In this work, we propose Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum (DP-MacAdam), a novel algorithm that combines these two approaches so as to use the same mean and variance estimates for both clipping and momentum. We perform an analysis showing that DP-MacAdam estimates the gradient variances in a bias-free manner. In addition, we empirically evaluate the privacy and accuracy of DP-MacAdam, demonstrating that it achieves improved model utility compared to DP-SGD, AdaClip, and DP-Adam baselines, without requiring manual tuning of the clipping threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-MacAdam算法，统一了差分隐私中的自适应梯度裁剪和自适应动量机制，使用相同的均值和方差估计同时实现裁剪和Adam-like动量更新，在无需手动调整裁剪阈值的情况下，相比DP-SGD、AdaClip和DP-Adam提升了模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有DP-SGD依赖固定裁剪阈值，限制了实用性；自适应裁剪算法（如AdaClip）使用均值和方差估计来调整裁剪参数，但未将这些估计用于动量加速训练；而DP-Adam利用Adam动量加速训练，却未将这些估计用于自适应裁剪。两者未能协同利用梯度统计信息。
AI.method: 提出DP-MacAdam算法，将自适应裁剪（shift和scale参数基于经验均值和方差动态调整）与Adam-like自适应动量更新融合，使相同的梯度均值和方差估计同时服务于裁剪和动量计算，并设计了无偏的梯度方差估计方法。
AI.result: 理论分析表明DP-MacAdam实现了梯度方差的无偏估计；实验评估显示，在隐私和精度方面，DP-MacAdam相比DP-SGD、AdaClip和DP-Adam基线取得了更好的模型效用，且无需手动调节裁剪阈值。
AI.conclusion: 统一裁剪和动量的梯度统计估计是一种有效的隐私保护训练策略，DP-MacAdam同时解决了固定裁剪阈值的局限性和动量加速的需求，为差分隐私深度学习提供了更实用的方案。

title: Towards Realistic 3D Sonar Simulation
summary: As underwater robotics research increasingly addresses complex 3D perception and autonomous navigation, the fidelity of sonar simulation has become a key factor in algorithm development. Current simulation frameworks typically rely on geometry-driven rendering, approximating 3D sonar as an underwater equivalent to LiDAR, which fails to account for fundamental acoustic phenomena such as refraction, multi-path interference, and phase-dependent signal formation. This paper proposes a modular architecture for realistic 3D sonar simulation that integrates GPU-accelerated graphics engines with physically grounded acoustic propagation principles. We implement a volumetric 3D sonar model within the NVIDIA Isaac Sim environment, modeled after the Water Linked 3D-15 sensor, and integrate it into a comprehensive underwater simulation framework. The system is validated through a hardware-in-the-loop configuration, where a modified FastLIO2 SLAM pipeline, executed on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, performs sensor fusion using synthetic 3D sonar, DVL, IMU, and pressure data. Finally, a qualitative comparison between simulated outputs and real-world data from harbor sheet-pile inspections is provided, characterizing the remaining sim-to-real gap and establishing a roadmap toward fully acoustics-driven volumetric sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化架构，将GPU加速图形引擎与物理声学传播原理相结合，在NVIDIA Isaac Sim环境中实现了高保真3D声纳仿真，并通过硬件在环配置验证了其在SLAM中的应用，最后与真实港口数据进行了定性比较。
AI.motivation: 当前声纳仿真框架主要依赖几何驱动渲染，将3D声纳近似为水下LiDAR，无法模拟折射、多径干扰和相位相关信号形成等基本声学现象，导致仿真保真度不足。
AI.method: 提出模块化架构，在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中集成GPU加速图形引擎与物理声学传播原理，实现体素级3D声纳模型（模拟Water Linked 3D-15传感器），并融入完整水下仿真框架；通过硬件在环配置（NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano运行改进FastLIO2 SLAM）融合合成3D声纳、DVL、IMU和压力数据进行验证。
AI.result: 在硬件在环配置中成功验证了合成3D声纳在多传感器融合SLAM中的应用，并提供了模拟输出与真实港口钢板桩检测数据的定性比较，表征了当前的仿真到现实差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了向完全声学驱动体素感知的发展路线图，明确了当前模拟与真实数据之间的差距及改进方向。

title: V2V-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Video-to-Video Generation Evaluation
summary: Video-to-video (V2V) generation is difficult to evaluate because outputs must both follow editing instructions and preserve frame-level correspondence with the source video, which existing T2V and I2V metrics do not capture. We introduce V2V-Bench, a 11-dimension benchmark organized into five categories: temporal alignment, structural fidelity, transformation quality, video quality, and semantic alignment. V2V-Bench pairs diverse source videos with challenging editing tasks and evaluates two commercial models, Grok Imagine and Gemini Veo3, and one open-source model, Open Sora 2. Results show complementary model strengths: Grok performs better on editing fidelity, while Veo3 achieves stronger visual quality. On six V2V-specific dimensions, V2V-Bench reaches a Spearman correlation of 0.905 with human judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出了V2V-Bench，一个11维度的视频到视频生成评估基准，涵盖时间对齐、结构保真度、变换质量、视频质量和语义对齐五大类，并对比了Grok Imagine、Gemini Veo3和Open Sora 2三个模型，在V2V特有维度上与人类判断的Spearman相关系数达0.905。
AI.motivation: 现有的T2V和I2V指标无法捕捉V2V生成中既要遵循编辑指令又要保持源视频帧级对应关系的评估需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含11个维度、分为五大类别（时间对齐、结构保真度、变换质量、视频质量、语义对齐）的评估基准V2V-Bench，使用多样化的源视频和具有挑战性的编辑任务，评估两个商业模型（Grok Imagine、Gemini Veo3）和一个开源模型（Open Sora 2）。
AI.result: Grok在编辑保真度上表现更好，Veo3在视觉质量上更强；在6个V2V特有维度上，V2V-Bench与人类判断的Spearman相关系数达到0.905。
AI.conclusion: V2V-Bench能够有效评估V2V生成质量，揭示了不同模型各有优势互补的特性。

title: Sharp First-Order Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of finding \(ε\)-stationary points in smooth nonconvex optimization when the objective satisfies higher-order smoothness assumptions. While the classical \(ε^{-2}\) rate is optimal under only Lipschitz gradients, higher-order smoothness leads to accelerated first-order upper bounds, most notably the \(ε^{-7/4}\) rate under Lipschitz Hessians and the \(ε^{-5/3}\) rate under Lipschitz third derivatives. The matching lower bounds, however, have remained open. We resolve this gap by proving a new dimension-free first-order lower bound for higher-order smooth nonconvex functions, valid for every finite smoothness order. In particular, our construction gives a matching \(Ω(ε^{-7/4})\) lower bound in the Hessian-Lipschitz case and a matching \(Ω(ε^{-5/3})\) lower bound in the third-order-smooth regime. The hard instance is based on a \emph{block-chain} mechanism that enforces blockwise oracle revelation while preserving the smoothness structure needed for the scalar hard instance. The lower-bound construction was discovered with the assistance of ChatGPT 5.5 Pro and subsequently verified by the authors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了光滑非凸优化中，目标函数满足高阶光滑性假设时的确定性一阶黑箱复杂度，证明了与已知上界匹配的维度无关下界：Hessian Lipschitz下Ω(ε^{-7/4})，三阶导数Lipschitz下Ω(ε^{-5/3})，填补了理论空白。硬实例基于“块链”机制，并在ChatGPT 5.5 Pro辅助下发现。
AI.motivation: 在光滑非凸优化中，高阶光滑性（如Lipschitz Hessian、Lipschitz三阶导数）能加速一阶方法的收敛上界，但这些上界的匹配下界一直缺失，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 提出一种“块链”（block-chain）机制构造硬实例，在保持标量硬实例所需光滑性结构的同时，强制黑箱按块序逐渐揭示信息，从而建立维度无关的下界。
AI.result: 证明了Hessian Lipschitz情形下Ω(ε^{-7/4})的下界，以及三阶导数Lipschitz情形下Ω(ε^{-5/3})的下界，二者均与已知最优上界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 完全解决了高阶光滑非凸优化中一阶黑箱复杂度上下界匹配的问题，且下界对任意有限光滑阶均成立。ChatGPT 5.5 Pro协助发现了该构造。

title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences of interactions with an efficient sequential kinodynamic trajectory optimizer and pruning strategy, enabling the rapid discovery of novel skills. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that our LLM-guided search discovers successful whole-body trajectories across several challenging long-horizon tasks. Finally, by training reinforcement learning tracking policies on the discovered trajectories, we transfer the motions to a real humanoid robot. This is the first work to discover and deploy long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation skills entirely through automated evolutionary search. Supplementary videos of the experiments are available at: https://youtu.be/DHiVz34QYlw.

AI.tldr: MotionDisco 是一个无需人类演示或遥操作，通过大语言模型引导的进化搜索与序列运动动力学优化相结合，自动发现复杂长时域人形机器人全身操控运动（包括接触丰富的移动操控技能）的框架，并在真实机器人上通过强化学习跟踪策略成功部署。
AI.motivation: 现有的人形机器人全身操控运动生成主要依赖遥操作或人类演示的运动重定向，缺乏从零自动发现长时域、接触丰富的移动操控运动的方法。由于接触交互空间随任务时长和物体数量呈组合爆炸式增长，这一任务极具挑战性。
AI.method: 将大语言模型（LLM）引导的进化搜索与序列运动动力学轨迹优化器及剪枝策略相结合。LLM 引导搜索在交互序列空间中进行高效探索，动力学优化器生成可行轨迹，剪枝策略剔除无效分支，最终通过强化学习训练跟踪策略将运动迁移到真实机器人上。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性长时域任务上成功发现了全身轨迹；消融实验验证了 LLM 引导搜索的有效性；在真实人形机器人上成功部署了学习的操控技能。
AI.conclusion: 首次完全通过自动化进化搜索发现并部署了长时域人形机器人全身移动操控技能，证明了大语言模型引导搜索在机器人运动规划中的潜力。

title: LongSpace: Exploring Long-Horizon Spatial Memory from Perception to Recall in Video
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced image and video understanding and can increasingly handle longer visual inputs. Long-horizon tasks such as autonomous driving and robotic navigation require more than recognizing the current view, as models must remember and retrieve previously observed spatial layouts, routes, viewpoint changes, and object states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce LongSpace-Bench, a room-tour video benchmark for long-horizon spatial memory, covering scene perception, spatial relations, and spatial memory. In this work, we further propose LongSpace, a memory framework for long-video spatial reasoning. LongSpace models long videos as sequential chunks, incorporates 3D structural cues into early decoder layers, and constructs layer-aware memory for question-guided retrieval. Experiments on multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks show that LongSpace improves long-video spatial understanding, further demonstrating explicit spatial memory as a key capability for long-horizon video MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongSpace-Bench基准和LongSpace框架，用于评估和提升多模态大模型在长视频空间记忆与推理上的能力，通过3D结构感知和层级记忆机制显著改善长程空间理解。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在处理长视频时缺乏对空间布局、路径、视角变化及对象状态的长期记忆与检索能力，而自动驾驶、机器人导航等长程任务恰恰依赖此能力，因此需要专门的评估基准和解决方案。
AI.method: LongSpace将长视频建模为连续块序列，在早期解码器层注入3D结构线索，并构建层级感知记忆用于问题引导的检索，从而增强模型对长视频的空间推理能力。
AI.result: 在多个空间推理基准上，LongSpace显著提升了长视频空间理解性能，表明显式空间记忆是长程视频MLLMs的关键能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式空间记忆是提升长视频多模态大模型空间推理能力的核心要素，LongSpace框架有效弥补了现有模型在长程空间记忆上的不足。

title: GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Code and resources are available at: GitHub: https://github.com/zadid6pretam/GOTabPFN; PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/gotabpfn/; Project webpage: https://www.zadidhabib.com/gotabpfn.html; Hugging Face Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/zadid6pretam/GOTabPFN and https://zadid6pretam-GOTabPFN.hf.space
summary: We investigate how to make small tabular foundation models effective for High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) tabular prediction without retraining large backbones. We introduce Graph-guided Ordering with Local Refinement (GO-LR), show its equivalence to weighted Minimum Linear Arrangement, and interpret the practical solver as a TSP-path-style surrogate. We propose GOTabPFN,which builds on GO-LR, and a Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC) unit to pool locally adjacent ordered features into meta-features, yielding a compact representation that makes TabPFN-style prediction practical in HDLSS regimes. Across tabular benchmarks, GOTabPFN improves stability and accuracy under tight token budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GO-LR（图引导排序与局部精炼）方法，将高维低样本量表格数据的有序特征压缩为元特征，使小型表格基础模型（如TabPFN）在HDLSS场景下高效可用。GOTabPFN在严格token预算下提升了稳定性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 使小型表格基础模型能够有效处理高维低样本量（HDLSS）表格预测任务，而无需重新训练大型骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出GO-LR（图引导排序与局部精炼），证明其等价于加权最小线性排列问题，并将其解释为TSP路径替代方案；在此基础上构建GOTabPFN，并引入神经启发子单元压缩（NSC）模块，将局部相邻有序特征池化为元特征。
AI.result: 在多个表格基准测试中，GOTabPFN在严格的token预算下提升了稳定性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: GO-LR方法结合NSC压缩机制，使TabPFN风格模型在HDLSS高维小样本场景下变得实用，兼顾了稳定性和预测精度。

title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
comment: Preprint. Code and project page are available. Code: https://github.com/Skywalker-yqz/AffordanceVLA Project page: https://skywalker-yqz.github.io/AffordanceVLA/
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception--action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{AffordanceVLA}, a unified framework that introduces structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception--action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components: 1) \textbf{Which2Act} for object-centric grounding via visual latent prediction to suppress distractions; 2) \textbf{Where2Act} for 2D interaction localization via affordance map estimation; and 3) \textbf{How2Act} for 3D geometric reasoning to guide manipulation policies. These affordance cues provide spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with specialized experts and train the model using a three-stage training strategy with a progressive data curriculum. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA achieves strong performance across diverse manipulation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出AffordanceVLA框架，通过结构化的 affordance 预测作为任务导向的中间表示，建立更精确的感知-动作映射，在模拟和真实世界中实现鲁棒的机器人操作。
AI.motivation: VLA模型利用预训练VLM的世界知识进行指令跟随机器人操作，但VLM语义空间与具身控制策略之间存在结构不匹配，阻碍了精确的感知-动作映射学习。
AI.method: 提出AffordanceVLA框架，包含三个互补组件：Which2Act（视觉潜在预测进行对象级定位）、Where2Act（affordance图估计进行2D交互定位）、How2Act（3D几何推理指导操作策略）。采用Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT)架构和专门专家模块，使用三阶段训练策略和渐进式数据课程，并开发了自动数据增强流水线。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界实验中，AffordanceVLA在多种操作场景下展现出强大的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的affordance预测作为任务导向的中间表示，有效地弥合了视觉、语言和动作之间的鸿沟，建立了更精确和鲁棒的感知-动作映射。

title: T-SAR-JEPA: Self-Supervised Temporal Anomaly Detection in SAR Amplitude Stacks via Latent Prediction
comment: Won IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest 2026; to appear in IGARSS 2026 proceedings
summary: We present T-SAR-JEPA, a self-supervised framework for temporal anomaly detection in SAR amplitude stacks via latent prediction. A ViT-Base/16 encoder from SAR-JEPA is domain-adapted on 39,300 Capella patches using local masked reconstruction with gradient feature prediction. A temporal transformer with sinusoidal time encoding forecasts future latent states from K=7 acquisitions, with progressive unfreezing substantially reducing validation loss. The model operates on amplitude alone; InSAR coherence serves exclusively as independent pseudo-ground-truth. On the DFC 2026 dataset (300 time-series, three AOIs), T-SAR-JEPA achieves ROC-AUC of 77.0% on the Hawaii eruption window, outperforming RX, PaDiM, Linear AR, and LSTM baselines (~50%). Spatial coherence of 99.9% (p < 0.001, permutation test) confirms structured detections. Code: https://github.com/TerraLatent/t-sar-jepa

AI.tldr: 提出了T-SAR-JEPA，一个基于自监督学习的SAR振幅时序异常检测框架，通过潜在状态预测在DFC 2026数据集上达到77.0% ROC-AUC，显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: SAR时序数据中的异常检测具有重要应用价值（如火山喷发监测），但现有方法（如RX、PaDiM、线性AR、LSTM）性能有限，且对InSAR相干性等辅助数据的依赖限制了实用性。
AI.method: 1) 使用SAR-JEPA的ViT-Base/16编码器，在39,300个Capella patches上进行局部掩码重建和梯度特征预测的域自适应；2) 引入时序Transformer，结合正弦时间编码，从K=7次获取中预测未来潜在状态；3) 采用渐进解冻策略降低验证损失；4) 仅使用振幅数据，InSAR相干性仅作为独立伪标签。
AI.result: 在DFC 2026数据集（300条时间序列，3个AOI）上，T-SAR-JEPA在夏威夷喷发窗口达到77.0% ROC-AUC，显著优于RX、PaDiM、线性AR和LSTM基线（约50%）。空间一致性达99.9%（p<0.001，置换检验）。
AI.conclusion: T-SAR-JEPA基于自监督潜在预测的范式在SAR时序异常检测中有效，仅使用振幅数据即可获得显著优于传统方法和基线模型的表现，具备高空间一致性的结构化检测能力。

title: Towards Unified and Data-Efficient Prognostics and Health Management with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Data-driven Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) uses time-varying condition-monitoring data to diagnose system states and estimate remaining useful life in engineered assets. These tasks are central to maintenance planning, but industrial PHM data are often fragmented, partially observed, and poorly labeled, which hinders supervised learning. Foundation models offer a route toward reusable predictive systems, yet most time-series foundation models are designed for forecasting and assume long, coherent, regularly sampled sequences. To address this gap, we propose a framework for applying Tabular Foundation Models to industrial time series using in-context learning, and we evaluate them on a variety of PHM tasks. By converting raw unit-level signals into tabular rows, we show that these models perform well across multiple tasks - including prognostics, and diagnostics - and are highly data efficient. We compare them directly with sequence models, transformer baselines, and gradient-boosted trees under a common evaluation protocol. The results indicate that tabular foundation models achieve the best average ranks across prognostic and diagnostic tasks. Our findings further show that PFN-based models are competitive in low-data regimes, that temporal context can be preserved in the tabular representation, and that performance depends on representative context construction under subsampling. These results demonstrate that tabular foundation models provide a practical and general interface for heterogeneous PHM problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models）通过上下文学习（In-Context Learning）处理工业时间序列PHM任务的方法。通过将单元级信号转换为表格行，该方法在诊断和预后任务上表现优异，尤其在低数据场景下竞争力强，平均排名优于序列模型和梯度提升树等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 工业PHM数据通常碎片化、部分观测且标签质量差，难以进行监督学习。现有时间序列基础模型大多针对长、规则采样的序列预测任务设计，不适用于PHM中常见的异构、不完整数据场景。因此需要一种能复用预训练模型、适应工业时间序列数据特点的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出将原始单元级时间序列信号转换为表格行（tabular rows）的表示方法，利用表格基础模型通过上下文学习（in-context learning）进行PHM任务（预后和诊断）的推理。在统一的评测协议下，与序列模型、Transformer基线以及梯度提升树进行直接对比。
AI.result: 表格基础模型在预后和诊断任务上取得了最佳平均排名；PFN-based模型在低数据场景下具有竞争力；表格表示能够保留时间上下文信息；性能依赖于子采样下代表性上下文样本的构建方式。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型为异构PHM问题提供了实用且通用的接口，能够有效处理工业时间序列中的碎片化和标注不足问题，具有良好的数据效率和跨任务泛化能力。

title: ActiveMimic: Egocentric Video Pretraining with Active Perception
summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable alternative to robot data for pretraining, yet models pretrained on such video consistently underperform those pretrained on robot data. We attribute this gap to a missing signal, the active perception behavior in egocentric videos, where humans continuously reposition their viewpoint during manipulation, inducing camera motion that standard pipelines treat as noise. To address this, we present ActiveMimic, a pretraining framework that recovers synchronized camera and wrist trajectories from a single body-worn RGB camera, models camera motion as a viewpoint action, and jointly learns active perception and manipulation from in-the-wild egocentric human video before adapting to a target robot. Empirically, real-world experiments across tasks with diverse active perception demands show that ActiveMimic consistently surpasses baselines pretrained on human video and matches state-of-the-art models pretrained on robot data. Further analysis provides evidence that active perception capability originates from egocentric human video pretraining rather than robot-specific fine-tuning, confirming active perception as the key to unlocking egocentric human video for robot pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出ActiveMimic框架，通过在自我中心人类视频中恢复并建模主动感知行为（相机运动作为视角动作），联合学习主动感知与操作，使预训练模型性能从远逊于机器人数据提升至与之持平。
AI.motivation: 自我中心人类视频预训练的模型始终不如机器人数据预训练的模型，作者认为差距在于自我中心视频中缺失的"主动感知行为"信号——人类在操作时不断调整视角引起的相机运动被标准流水线当作噪声丢弃。
AI.method: (1) 从单台身体佩戴RGB相机恢复同步的相机和手腕轨迹；(2) 将相机运动建模为"视角动作"；(3) 在野外自我中心人类视频上联合学习主动感知与操作；(4) 迁移到目标机器人。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，ActiveMimic一致超越基于人类视频预训练的基线，并匹配基于机器人数据预训练的最先进模型；主动感知能力源自人类视频预训练而非机器人微调。
AI.conclusion: 主动感知是解锁自我中心人类视频用于机器人预训练的关键信号，弥补了与机器人预训练数据之间的差距。

title: Parallel Jacobi Decoding for Fast Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated remarkable performance in generating high-fidelity images. However, their inherently sequential next-token prediction leads to significantly slower inference. Recent studies have introduced Jacobi-style decoding to accelerate autoregressive image generation. Extending the draft sequence initially improves efficiency, yet the acceleration quickly saturates as error propagation in the one-dimensional sequence hinders convergence. Observing that images exhibit strong local spatial correlations, we propose Parallel Jacobi Decoding (PJD), a training-free decoding approach that expands draft tokens in the two-dimensional spatial domain to enable efficient spatially parallel refinement. PJD adjusts the attention mask to mitigate error accumulation and improve convergence stability. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets show that PJD achieves 4.8x-6.4x acceleration across multiple autoregressive image generation models while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Parallel Jacobi Decoding (PJD)，一种无需训练的解码方法，通过在二维空间域扩展草稿token实现空间并行精炼，将自回归图像生成加速4.8-6.4倍。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成模型虽性能优异，但顺序逐token预测导致推理极慢；现有Jacobi解码加速方法因一维序列中的误差传播而很快饱和。
AI.method: PJD利用图像强局部空间相关性，在二维空间域扩展草稿token以支持高效的空间并行精炼，并调整注意力掩码减少误差累积、提升收敛稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个自回归图像生成模型上，PJD实现4.8x-6.4x加速，同时保持可比的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: PJD是一种训练无关、高效且质量保持的并行解码方法，解决了自回归图像生成中顺序预测导致的推理瓶颈。

title: Learned Subspace Compression for Communication-Efficient Pipeline Parallelism
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Connecting Low-rank Representations in AI, ICML 2026
summary: Pipeline parallelism enables training of large language models that exceed single-device memory, yet inter-stage activation communication becomes the dominant bottleneck when trained on low-bandwidth networks. Recent work in this area has proposed using fixed orthogonal projections to compress activations. However, this still results in a significant performance degradation and requires a number of non-standard adaptations to constrain the optimization. A natural alternative is to learn a low rank projection for each pipeline stage, however maintaining the necessary orthogonality of these projectors during training remains a challenge. We present Manifold Aware Projection Learning (MAPL), a method that treats inter-stage compression as a learnable orthogonal projection under explicit Stiefel manifold (orthogonal matrices) constraints. Rather than prescribing a fixed global subspace, MAPL lets each pipeline stage discover and continuously adapt its own task-optimal compression subspace via manifold-constrained steepest descent. To recover token-specific signals at stage boundaries, we introduce per-stage factorized anchor embeddings that allow for full-rank activation reconstruction with negligible communication overhead. We further show that we can incorporate residual vector quantization after projection with a streaming codebook synchronization protocol that amortizes dictionary communication. Across LLaMA models from 150M to 1B parameters we show that MAPL can be easily applied to the existing pipeline and can achieve high compression with neglibile performance degradation with a drastically improved tradeoffs in performance vs. compression compared to Subspace Networks.

AI.tldr: MAPL是一种通过显式施蒂费尔流形约束学习可微正交投影的方法，用于流水线并行训练中激活值的低开销压缩，在LLaMA 150M到1B模型上实现了比子空间网络更优的性能-压缩权衡，并引入了分段因子化锚点嵌入和残差向量量化机制以进一步减少通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有流水线并行训练中，跨阶段激活通信成为低带宽网络下的主要瓶颈。虽然已有工作采用固定正交投影压缩激活值，但导致显著性能下降且需要非标准约束；而直接学习低秩投影又难以维持正交性。因此需要一种既能学习可微正交投影、又能保持流形约束的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将跨阶段压缩建模为施蒂费尔流形约束下的可学习正交投影，通过流形约束最速下降实现每个流水线阶段自主发现并自适应压缩子空间；2) 引入分段因子化锚点嵌入，实现全秩激活重建且通信开销可忽略；3) 在投影后集成残差向量量化，配合流式码本同步协议分摊字典通信成本。
AI.result: 在LLaMA 150M到1B参数模型上，MAPL可轻松应用于现有流水线，实现高压缩比且性能下降可忽略，在性能与压缩的权衡上显著优于子空间网络。
AI.conclusion: MAPL通过流形约束的端到端学习正交投影，有效解决了流水线并行中激活压缩的性能损失问题，为低带宽网络下的大模型训练提供了一种实用的通信优化方案。

title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
summary: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. It includes a history encoder that embeds proprioceptive history into a latent state and a torque adaptor that computes residual torque corrections. Because TAM depends only on proprioceptive history and not on policy observations, or the action space, the same TAM weights can be reused to adapt policies with different action spaces (joint targets, end-effector targets, or direct torques). The policies themselves do not need to be trained with domain randomization of robot parameters. Instead, we offload the need for domain randomization to TAM by training it entirely in randomized simulation, using multi-robot pretraining followed by a robot-specific fine-tuning step that still requires no real-robot data. We evaluate TAM zero-shot on a real Franka Panda robot across dynamic manipulation tasks that include a vision-based box pushing policy (from RL), a flip policy (from BC), and an MPC ball-on-plate balancing. Our experiments show that TAM improves zero-shot real-robot execution compared to online system identification and RMA baselines and enables robust dynamic manipulation performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Torque Adaptation Module (TAM)，通过学习调整扭矩命令来弥合不同机器人之间的动力学差异，在不依赖领域随机化或系统辨识的情况下实现零样本跨机器人迁移。
AI.motivation: 同一策略在不同机器人实例间因动力学差异（如sim-to-real差距、未知负载等）表现不一致，尤其在接触丰富、动态操作中，微小运动偏差会导致接触时序和模式紊乱，最终任务失败。现有方法如领域随机化产生过于保守的策略，系统辨识需为每个机器人重新收集数据。
AI.method: TAM位于底层控制器与机器人扭矩接口之间，包含历史编码器（将本体感知历史嵌入隐状态）和扭矩适配器（计算残差扭矩修正）。仅依赖本体感知历史，不依赖策略观测或动作空间，因此同一TAM权重可复用于不同动作空间的策略。训练策略：多机器人预训练（随机化仿真）→ 机器人特定微调（无需真实数据）。
AI.result: 在真实Franka Panda机器人上，对基于RL的视觉推盒子策略、基于BC的翻转策略和MPC的球平衡三项动态操作任务进行零样本测试，TAM优于在线系统辨识和RMA基线方法，实现了鲁棒的动态操作性能。
AI.conclusion: TAM通过轻量级残差扭矩修正模块，有效地将机器人间动力学差异的适配任务从策略训练中解耦，无需领域随机化或真实数据即可实现跨机器人策略迁移，是一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Real-Time Threat Detection from Surveillance Cameras using Machine Learning
summary: Ensuring public safety in densely populated urban environments remains a critical challenge, necessitating the deployment of intelligent and automated video surveillance systems. Traditional surveillance approaches rely heavily on manual monitoring, which is inefficient and susceptible to human fatigue, delayed response, and observational errors. To overcome these limitations, this work presents a real-time object detection-based surveillance framework. The proposed system focuses on detecting guns, knives, and region-specific blunt objects commonly involved in violent activities in Indian surveillance scenarios. A key contribution of this work is the use of a custom-created dataset collected using a mobile camera, consisting of 336 labeled images of blunt objects such as iron rods, wooden sticks, and plastic rods. This dataset is combined with a publicly available dataset of 7,623 images of guns and knives, forming a consolidated dataset of 7,959 images across three classes: gun, knife, and blunt object. The combined dataset is used to train a YOLOv8-based object detection model for real-time performance. Experimental evaluation shows that increasing the training duration significantly improves recall and average precision for the blunt object class without signs of overfitting. Overall, the proposed framework achieves an effective balance between accuracy and efficiency, making it suitable for deployment in real-world surveillance environments such as campuses, public spaces, and transportation areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于YOLOv8的实时目标检测监控框架，用于检测城市环境中的枪支、刀具和钝器（如铁棒、木棍、塑料棒），在包含7,959张图像的自建数据集上训练，实现了准确性与效率的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 传统人工监控存在效率低下、人员疲劳、响应延迟和观察误差等问题，难以满足密集城市环境中的公共安全需求，亟需智能自动化视频监控系统。
AI.method: 使用手机相机采集336张钝器图像（铁棒、木棍、塑料棒），与公开的7,623张枪支和刀具图像合并为7,959张图像的数据集（三类：枪、刀、钝器），基于YOLOv8目标检测模型进行训练，实现实时检测。
AI.result: 增加训练时长显著提升了钝器类别的召回率和平均精度，且未出现过拟合；整体框架在准确性与效率之间取得了有效平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于校园、公共场所和交通区域等真实监控场景的部署，具备实时性和可靠性。

title: LEVANTE-bench: Multi-Scale Comparison of VLMs to Children Using Cognitive Tasks (or, "Is Your VLM Smarter Than a 5th Grader?")
summary: Given the inherently multimodal nature of human experience, vision-language models (VLMs) hold substantial promise for modeling human cognition as it grows and develops with experience. Realizing their potential requires tools for comparing VLMs with human cognitive development across tasks, ages, and populations. We present LEVANTE-bench, a benchmark based on tasks and data from the Learning Variability Network (LEVANTE), which distributes open-source tasks and data measuring children's cognition across languages and cultures. In LEVANTE-bench, we systematically assess VLMs on six tasks, comparing their alignment with children aged 5-12 ($N$ = 1547) across three countries. We compare models at multiple scales, assessing their overall accuracy, their task- and item-level alignment with children, and how well they match children's trial-level error distributions. Alignment was heterogeneous across scales: at the level of tasks and items, more capable models aligned better with humans. However, match to human error distributions varied widely across tasks, and for several tasks, smaller models matched younger children's errors better. In addition, even the best-performing VLMs struggled on matrix reasoning and mental rotation tasks. Thus, current VLM architectures align only partially with the cognitive abilities of children.

AI.tldr: LEVANTE-bench是一个基于跨文化儿童认知数据（5-12岁，1547名儿童，3个国家）的基准测试，用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）与人类认知发展的对齐程度。研究发现，VLM在任务和项目层面与儿童对齐较好，但在错误分布匹配上表现异质，小模型在某些任务上更匹配低龄儿童的错误模式，且所有模型在矩阵推理和心理旋转任务上表现较差，表明当前VLM架构仅部分对齐儿童认知能力。
AI.motivation: 人类体验本质上是多模态的，因此视觉-语言模型（VLM）在建模人类认知发展方面具有潜力。然而，缺乏系统性的工具来比较VLM与不同任务、年龄和人群的儿童认知发展。
AI.method: 基于LEVANTE网络的开源任务和数据，构建LEVANTE-bench基准，在6项认知任务上系统评估VLM与1547名5-12岁儿童（来自3个国家）的对齐程度，从整体准确率、任务/项目级对齐、试次级错误分布匹配等多个尺度进行比较。
AI.result: 对齐具异质性：在任务和项目层面，更强模型与人类对齐更好；但错误分布匹配在不同任务间差异大，部分任务上小模型更匹配低龄儿童错误模式；即使最优VLM在矩阵推理和心理旋转任务上表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM架构仅与儿童认知能力部分对齐，在多项认知任务上仍存在显著差距。

title: CLEAR: Cognition and Latent Evaluation for Adaptive Routing in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models often struggle to balance multi-modal maneuver generation with real-time inference constraints. While diffusion models successfully capture diverse driving behaviors, their iterative denoising process incurs unacceptable latency for safety-critical deployment. To address this, we propose CLEAR (Cognition and Latent Evaluation for Adaptive Routing), a framework that combines ultra-fast generative planning with deep semantic reasoning. CLEAR employs Drive-JEPA as the visual encoder and replaces the multi-step denoising chain with a single-step conditional drift in a VAE latent space, introducing a conditioning coefficient to balance diversity and expert precision. Meanwhile, we fully fine-tune Qwen~3.5~0.8B on driving QA pairs to extract scene-aware hidden states. These states guide both an Adaptive Scheduler, which selects the conditioning coefficient $α$ and sample count $N$ from a discrete set of predefined schemes, and a cross-attention scorer that selects the optimal trajectory from candidates. On the NAVSIM v1 benchmark, CLEAR achieves a state-of-the-art PDMS of 93.7. Our results demonstrate that high-fidelity, multi-modal planning can be executed efficiently without dense geometric annotations or iterative sampling.

AI.tldr: CLEAR框架通过单步VAE潜空间条件漂移替代扩散模型的多步去噪，结合Drive-JEPA视觉编码器和Qwen 3.5-0.8B的语义推理，在NAVSIM v1上达到93.7 PDMS，实现高效且多样化的端到端自动驾驶规划。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶模型难以兼顾多模态机动生成与实时推理约束，扩散模型虽能捕捉多样驾驶行为但其迭代去噪过程导致安全关键部署中不可接受的延迟。
AI.method: CLEAR采用Drive-JEPA作为视觉编码器，用VAE潜空间中的单步条件漂移替代多步去噪链，引入调节系数平衡多样性与专家精度；全微调Qwen 3.5-0.8B提取场景感知隐状态，指导自适应调度器选择调节系数α和样本数N，以及交叉注意力评分器选择最优轨迹。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1基准上，CLEAR取得了93.7 PDMS的最新最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 高保真、多模态规划可以在无需密集几何标注或迭代采样的条件下高效执行。

title: ViCuR: Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by training a student on trajectories sampled from its own policy under supervision from a teacher. In multimodal reasoning, a common extension is to use a privileged teacher that observes training-time-only signals such as reference answers or rationales. However, such answer-side privilege creates a train-test mismatch: the teacher's supervision may depend on signals unavailable to the student, encouraging shortcut imitation rather than visually grounded reasoning. We propose ViCuR, a visually grounded privileged-teacher distillation framework that replaces answer-side privilege with visual cues (query-related evidence in the input). Because these cues are derived from the same visual input available at inference, their evidence is recoverable by the student. To support this, ViCuR introduces a lightweight cue recovery module that uses dedicated sink-token cross-attention during prefill to aggregate task-relevant visual evidence into an internal representation, without changing the inference interface or requiring auxiliary cue-generation losses. Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3-VL-2B and 8B students, ViCuR consistently improves over answer-based on-policy self-distillation by +1.19 and +1.24 on overall average performance. It also extends naturally to stronger-teacher OPD, surpassing OPD baselines by +0.64 and +1.08, with consistent out-of-domain gains at the 8B scale. These results show that, in multimodal on-policy distillation, the design of teacher privilege is as important as teacher strength.

AI.tldr: ViCuR提出了一种基于视觉线索的特权教师蒸馏框架，通过在输入中引入查询相关的视觉证据（而非答案侧特权）来改善多模态推理中的师生不匹配问题，在七个基准上一致优于基于答案的同类方法。
AI.motivation: 在多模态推理中，传统的基于答案侧特权的教师蒸馏方法存在训练-测试不匹配：教师依赖学生推理时不可见的信号（如参考答案），导致学生学会捷径模仿而非基于视觉的推理。
AI.method: ViCuR用输入中的视觉线索（查询相关的视觉证据）替代答案侧特权；引入轻量级的线索恢复模块，通过专用的sink-token交叉注意力在预填充阶段聚合任务相关的视觉证据到内部表示中，不改变推理接口或需要额外的线索生成损失。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-2B和8B学生模型上，ViCuR在七个基准上相比基于答案的同策略自蒸馏平均提升+1.19和+1.24；在更强教师的同策略蒸馏中超过OPD基线+0.64和+1.08，8B规模上在域外任务上也有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 在多模态同策略蒸馏中，教师特权的设计（即提供何种信息）与教师强度同等重要。

title: Dominant-Layer ZO: A Single Layer Dominates Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) using only forward passes, but it remains unclear how useful adaptation is distributed across layers. In this work, we reveal a surprising phenomenon: ZO fine-tuning is sharply dominated by a single decoding layer. Across multiple LLM families and downstream tasks, fine-tuning this dominant layer alone consistently matches or even exceeds full-model ZO fine-tuning. We further show that the dominant layer is task-agnostic but model-specific, and can be identified before training through a simple inference-only analysis of activation outliers. Specifically, the dominant layer consistently aligns with the first activation-outlier layer in the pre-trained model. To explain this phenomenon, we analyze how perturbation effects propagate under ZO optimization. We find that the dominant layer combines two key properties: high perturbation sensitivity and early placement in the residual stream, allowing perturbation-induced effects to propagate and accumulate through remaining subsequent decoding layers. As a result, this layer produces disproportionately strong and stable optimization signals under forward-only updates. Extensive experiments on LLaMA2-7B and Qwen3-8B across nine benchmarks show that dominant-layer ZO fine-tuning improves average performance over full-model MeZO and LoRA-based ZO fine-tuning while achieving up to 4.52$\times$ training speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文发现零阶优化微调大语言模型时，性能主要由单个解码层主导。该主导层是任务无关但模型特定的，可通过推理时的激活值异常点提前识别。仅微调该层即可匹配甚至超越全模型零阶微调效果，同时提升平均性能并实现最高4.52倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化虽然能实现内存高效的大模型微调，但各层对适配效果的贡献分布尚不明确，需要深入探究以提升效率。
AI.method: 通过实验揭示零阶微调由单个解码层主导的现象；利用激活值异常点分析在训练前识别该主导层；从扰动传播角度分析该层为何具备高扰动敏感性和早期残差流位置，从而产生强且稳定的优化信号。
AI.result: 在LLaMA2-7B和Qwen3-8B上跨9个基准的实验表明，主导层零阶微调在平均性能上超越全模型MeZO和基于LoRA的零阶微调，同时实现最高4.52倍训练加速。
AI.conclusion: 零阶微调中解码层的贡献高度集中，识别并仅微调主导层可在保持甚至提升性能的同时大幅提升训练效率。

title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remain brittle in long-horizon and high-uncertainty control, where one-pass action decoding provides limited inference-time deliberation. Explicit chain-of-thought can increase reasoning depth, but introduces token latency and an indirect text-to-action interface. We propose MPCoT, a reward-guided multi-path latent reasoning framework that initializes $M$ hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and softly aggregates them before action decoding. A training-only path-preference objective evaluates candidate action branches with expert-action consistency, world-model/VLM-based progress, and success feedback to align the latent path scorer with downstream execution quality. MPCoT preserves the original 8-step action interface, generates zero reasoning tokens, and exposes configurable inference controls (K,M). Under matched protocols on LIBERO and CALVIN, MPCoT improves long-horizon performance, with ablations confirming depth-width effects, confidence-weighted aggregation, and reward-guided path supervision.

AI.tldr: MPCoT是一种奖励引导的多路径潜在推理框架，在不生成显式推理token的情况下，通过多假设初始化、权重共享迭代优化和软聚合机制提升VLA策略在长时域和高不确定性控制任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在长时域和高不确定性控制场景中表现脆弱，单次动作解码缺乏推理时 deliberative 能力；显式思维链虽能提升推理深度，但引入token延迟和间接的文本到动作接口。
AI.method: 提出MPCoT框架：初始化M个假设，经过K步权重共享迭代优化，在动作解码前进行软聚合。设计训练时的路径偏好目标，利用专家动作一致性、世界模型/VLM进度和成功反馈来评估候选动作分支，使潜在路径评分器与下游执行质量对齐。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和CALVIN基准测试的标准协议下，MPCoT提升了长时域性能。消融实验验证了深度-宽度效应、置信度加权聚合和奖励引导路径监督的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MPCoT保持了原有的8步动作接口，不产生额外推理token，并暴露可配置的推理控制参数(K,M)，在推理效率与推理深度之间取得平衡。

title: TextWand: A Unified Framework for Scene Text Editing
summary: We propose TextWand, a general-purpose framework that unifies scene text removal, generation, and replacement into a single model. By decomposing complex editing tasks into the atomic primitives of rendering and erasure, TextWand achieves precise control over both text appearance and background integrity. Specifically, we introduce a novel design, Overlay-Reference Positional Encoding (ORPE), to enforce pixel-level layout fidelity and exemplar-driven style control, alongside a new strategy, Region-Adaptive Suppression (RAS), to ensure clean text erasure. To address the absence of a comprehensive benchmark for general-purpose scene text editing among existing single-task datasets, we construct TextWand-Bench. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TextWand outperforms existing leading open-source and closed-source models by delivering superior text content accuracy, layout and style consistency, and overall image quality across scene text removal, generation and replacement tasks.

AI.tldr: TextWand是一个统一场景文本移除、生成和替换的通用框架，通过渲染和擦除的原子操作分解，结合ORPE和RAS两种新设计，在TextWand-Bench基准上超越现有开源和闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常针对场景文本的移除、生成或替换等单一任务分别设计，缺乏能够统一处理这些任务的通用框架。此外，缺乏一个综合性的基准来评估通用场景文本编辑性能。
AI.method: 将复杂编辑任务分解为渲染和擦除两种原子操作；提出Overlay-Reference Positional Encoding (ORPE)实现像素级布局保真度和示例驱动的风格控制；提出Region-Adaptive Suppression (RAS)策略确保干净的文本擦除；构建TextWand-Bench综合基准。
AI.result: 在场景文本移除、生成和替换任务上，TextWand在文本内容准确性、布局与风格一致性以及整体图像质量方面均优于现有领先的开源和闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: TextWand通过统一的框架设计，有效解决了场景文本编辑中的多个子任务，证明了原子操作分解与新颖模块设计的有效性。

title: What Objects Enable, Not What They Are: Functional Latent Spaces for Affordance Reasoning
comment: Code, videos, and data available at: https://A4Dance-reasoning.github.io
summary: Existing robot planning systems rely on appearance-based reasoning, where visual observations are encoded into latent spaces organized around object appearances (e.g., recognizing a "cart" based on how it looks). However, planning requires reasoning about task-relevant functionalities of objects (e.g., whether an object is "movable"), which appearance-based latent spaces do not capture. As a result, existing approaches struggle to generalize to novel robot-object interactions. We address this limited generalizability through affordance reasoning, enabling planning based on task-relevant object functionalities instead of appearance alone. We introduce A4D, which maps visual observations into a shared latent space structured around affordances (e.g., "movable"). By projecting visual observations into this functional latent space and measuring their proximity to affordances, A4D infers functionalities relevant to the observed object. Furthermore, we introduce an affordance discovery mechanism that expands the latent space to handle unseen scenarios where existing affordances are insufficient. A4D uses proximity in the functional latent space to quantify uncertainty in affordance inference and selectively triggers affordance discovery. We evaluate A4D across several planning tasks involving diverse and unseen affordances. A4D achieves 94% inference accuracy on existing affordances outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by over 15% points, improves new-affordance inference accuracy from 70% to over 90% with fewer than 10% of the original training data, and enables 100x faster inference. Code, videos, and data available at: https://A4Dance-reasoning.github.io.

AI.tldr: A4D通过将观测映射到基于功能（affordance）的共享潜在空间，利用功能推理替代外观推理进行机器人规划，显著提升了泛化能力，在新颖物体交互任务中准确率提升15%以上，新功能推理准确率从70%提升至90%+，推理速度提升100倍。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人规划系统依赖基于外观的推理，将视觉观测编码到围绕物体外观组织的潜在空间中，无法捕捉与任务相关的物体功能属性（如"可移动性"），导致难以泛化到新颖的机器人-物体交互场景。
AI.method: 提出A4D框架：1）构建基于功能（affordance）的共享潜在空间，将视觉观测投影到该空间；2）通过观测在功能潜在空间中的邻近性推断物体功能；3）引入功能发现机制，当现有功能不足以解释观测时，基于不确定性量化选择性触发新功能扩展。
AI.result: 在多种涉及多样化和未见功能的规划任务中，A4D在现有功能推理上达到94%准确率（超出SOTA 15%+），新功能推理准确率从70%提升至90%+，且仅需不到原始数据10%的训练样本，推理速度提升100倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于功能推理的潜在空间显著优于传统外观推理方法，能有效泛化到新颖物体交互场景，且具有高效的数据利用率和推理速度。

title: Breaking Time: A Fully Gaussian Framework for Distributed and Continuous-Time SLAM
comment: To be published in RA-L. Open-source implementation is released at https://github.com/rvp-group/gsolver
summary: Continuous-time SLAM provides a principled framework for fusing heterogeneous sensors while estimating smooth trajectories, and is particularly well-suited for handling heterogeneous, asynchronous sensor streams with non-uniform readout patterns, such as rolling shutter cameras, LiDAR scanners, radar sweeps, or event-based sensors. In this work, we introduce G-solver, a fully Gaussian and distributed framework that combines Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) with Gaussian Process (GP) motion priors for continuous-time trajectory estimation. Our GP model provides a probabilistic representation of the trajectory, enabling consistent interpolation and the use of data-driven hyperparameters, while GBP offers a scalable message-passing formulation well-suited for decentralized settings. The resulting solver naturally extends to multi-camera scenarios without specialized synchronization or engineering effort. We evaluate the approach on synthetic and real data, including rolling shutter and distributed multi-camera optimization, demonstrating accurate and stable estimation with runtimes comparable to existing continuous-time methods. An open-source implementation is released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G-solver，一种结合高斯信念传播（GBP）和高斯过程（GP）运动先验的全高斯分布式连续时间SLAM框架，支持异构异步传感器融合，并天然扩展至多相机场景。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间SLAM方法在处理异构、异步传感器（如卷帘快门相机、激光雷达、雷达、事件相机）时存在框架复杂、同步工程量大等问题，缺乏统一的概率化分布式求解方案。
AI.method: 将高斯过程（GP）运动先验作为轨迹的概率化表示，实现一致性插值和数据驱动超参数；采用高斯信念传播（GBP）进行可扩展的消息传递式分布式求解，形成全高斯框架。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据（包括卷帘快门相机和分布式多相机优化）上验证，展现出准确稳定的估计性能，运行时间与现有连续时间方法相当。
AI.conclusion: G-solver实现了无需专门同步或工程化努力即可自然扩展到多相机场景的连续时间SLAM，并已开源。

title: VTI-CoT: Visual-Textual Interleaved Chain of Thought for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning aims to understand complex temporal events and causal relationships within videos. Recently, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has been introduced to this field to enhance reasoning accuracy. However, existing CoT-based video reasoning methods primarily rely on text-only information for logical deduction, overlooking critical visual information during the inference process. Inspired by the human cognitive mechanism of reviewing visual segments during inference, we propose VTI-CoT, a Visual-Textual Interleaved CoT framework. VTI-CoT integrates textual reasoning steps with corresponding visual frames. Given the scarcity of visual-textual interleaved CoT in existing datasets, we develop an automated annotation pipeline to construct high-quality multimodal CoT data. Further, reasoning over long-form videos entails increasingly long CoT token sequences, which severely hinders training convergence and efficiency. To address this, we employ Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-based compression techniques to compress CoT supervision signals into a single canvas. Experimental results demonstrate that VTI-CoT achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of the same parameter scale while significantly improving training efficiency.

AI.tldr: VTI-CoT提出了一种视觉-文本交错推理框架，通过结合视觉帧与文本推理步骤，并采用OCR压缩技术提升训练效率，在视频推理任务上达到同参数规模最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CoT的视频推理方法仅依赖文本信息进行逻辑推理，忽略了推理过程中关键的视觉信息，导致推理准确性受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出VTI-CoT框架，将文本推理步骤与对应视觉帧交错融合；2) 开发自动化标注流程构建高质量多模态CoT数据；3) 采用OCR压缩技术将CoT监督信号压缩至单一画布，解决长视频推理中CoT序列过长导致的训练收敛和效率问题。
AI.result: 在同参数规模模型中达到最先进性能，同时显著提升训练效率。
AI.conclusion: VTI-CoT通过视觉-文本交错推理和OCR压缩策略，有效弥补了现有方法忽视视觉信息的缺陷，兼顾了推理准确性与训练效率。

title: Less is MoE: Trimming Experts in Domain-Specialist Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models achieve strong performance through conditional computation, but their large parameter footprint poses deployment challenges. Prior MoE compression approaches catastrophically fail when evaluated on general-purpose benchmarks beyond commonsense reasoning. We trace this failure to the granularity of compression: important capabilities are distributed across experts but concentrated in FFN sparse intermediate dimensions. To identify these dimensions, we use Fisher importance which outperforms activation-, router-score-, and magnitude-based alternatives, and identifies tiny sets of task-critical dimensions: in Qwen1.5-MoE, removing as few as 12 of 1.35M routed-FFN intermediate dimensions collapses GSM8K accuracy while largely preserving factual-knowledge performance. Building on this, we propose Fisher-MoE, which operates within FFN to remove intermediate dimensions ranked by Fisher importance. At the same 50% MoE compression ratio, Fisher-MoE preserves model capability, while reducing weight memory by ~45% and improving inference throughput by 21%. These findings suggest intermediate dimension granularity is an effective unit for both compression and ranking where capability concentrates in MoE models.

AI.tldr: 本文发现MoE模型的关键能力集中在FFN稀疏中间维度，基于Fisher重要性的Fisher-MoE方法通过移除低重要性维度，在50%压缩率下保持模型能力，减少45%权重内存并提升21%推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE压缩方法在通用基准测试上表现失败，原因是压缩粒度不当——重要能力分布在专家之间但集中在FFN稀疏中间维度上。
AI.method: 使用Fisher重要性识别任务关键维度，提出Fisher-MoE方法，在FFN内部按Fisher重要性排序移除中间维度进行压缩。
AI.result: 在Qwen1.5-MoE上，移除仅12个中间维度即导致GSM8K准确率崩溃；50%压缩率下，Fisher-MoE保持模型能力，减少~45%权重内存，提升21%推理吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 中间维度粒度是MoE模型压缩和重要性排序的有效单元，关键能力在此集中。

title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning
summary: Point clouds are a primary sensory representation for robotic perception, underpinning LiDAR-based autonomous driving, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and navigation. Within these pipelines, Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) is the most well-known downsampling operator, as its uniform coverage preserves the geometric structure on which downstream perception relies. However, the large time complexity of classical FPS scales poorly with the million-point-per-second rates of modern 3D sensors, making it a dominant latency bottleneck that conflicts with the real-time and limited onboard compute budgets of robotic systems. Therefore, we propose RadiusFPS, an FPS acceleration framework based on spherical voxel pruning that preserves the standard FPS update rule under the same initialization and tie-breaking policy. By indexing the point cloud with spherical voxels, RadiusFPS derives a conservative geometric bound that prunes redundant distance computations in each iteration, complemented by a coordinate-wise point-skip test that removes residual updates. We further introduce RadiusFPS-G, a warp-level GPU implementation that fuses voxel selection, pruning, and distance update into memory-coalesced kernels, eliminating costly global-memory round-trips. On indoor (S3DIS, ScanNet) and outdoor LiDAR (SemanticKITTI) benchmarks, RadiusFPS-G attains up to 2.5x speedup over GPU-based FPS and matches or exceeds QuickFPS among the evaluated methods while using roughly half its GPU memory, with comparable segmentation accuracy. When coupled with the learning-based FastPoint sampler, the resulting pipeline achieves the fastest End-to-End inference among all evaluated configurations. These properties make high-quality FPS-style sampling practical for latency- and memory-constrained robotic vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RadiusFPS，一种基于球形体素剪枝的FPS加速框架，通过保守几何边界剪枝冗余距离计算和坐标级点跳过测试，以及GPU实现RadiusFPS-G，在多个基准上实现高达2.5倍加速，同时内存减半，适用于延迟和内存受限的机器人视觉场景。
AI.motivation: 经典FPS算法时间复杂度高，难以满足现代3D传感器每秒百万点级别的实时处理需求，成为机器人系统中延迟瓶颈，亟需加速方案。
AI.method: 提出RadiusFPS框架：基于球形体素索引点云，推导保守几何边界剪枝冗余距离计算；设计坐标级点跳过测试消除剩余更新。进一步提出RadiusFPS-G，实现warp级别的GPU核融合，将体素选择、剪枝和距离更新融合为内存合并的核函数，避免全局内存往返。
AI.result: 在S3DIS、ScanNet和SemanticKITTI基准上，RadiusFPS-G相比GPU版FPS最高加速2.5倍，与QuickFPS相当或更优，GPU内存减半，分割精度相当。与FastPoint采样器结合时达到最快端到端推理速度。
AI.conclusion: RadiusFPS使高质量FPS风格采样在延迟和内存受限的机器人视觉系统中变得实用，兼顾速度、内存效率和采样质量。

title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising. We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We keep standard velocity prediction and add no teacher model, distillation stage, or auxiliary objective; in our main recipe, we simply bias the training time distribution toward high-noise states. We first isolate the effect in a controlled MNIST grid-to-sequence task, then test it with extensive robot-policy experiments. Across standard LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe, and on standard LIBERO can exceed ten-step policies trained with a uniform time distribution. A real-robot bimanual YAM RSS evaluation gives a small-sample cross-architecture check of the same sampler trend. On a 1.4B VLM model with a 30M action head, one-step decoding reaches 95.6\% on LIBERO-Long. These results show that strong one-step VLA action generation can emerge from standard diffusion training, without importing the full few-step diffusion machinery developed for image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散VLA模型的动作生成与图像生成具有不同的条件-目标结构，通过简单地在训练时偏向高噪声状态，即可实现与十步解码相当的单步动作生成性能，无需引入教师模型、蒸馏或辅助目标等复杂技术。
AI.motivation: 扩散VLA模型继承了图像生成中的迭代去噪范式，但作者认为VLA动作生成的条件-目标结构不同：策略条件是高维的（观测、语言、状态），而预测目标仅是低维动作块。这种非对称性意味着图像生成领域开发的高级单步方法在VLA中并非必要，因此探索能否通过更简单的方式实现强单步动作生成。
AI.method: 保持标准的速度预测（velocity prediction），不引入教师模型、蒸馏阶段或辅助目标。主要方法是在训练时间分布上偏向高噪声状态（high-noise biased schedules），即在训练中更频繁地采样高噪声时间步。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO-Pro基准上，高噪声偏置训练的单步策略与十步解码性能相当；在标准LIBERO上甚至超越均匀时间分布训练的十步策略。在1.4B VLM模型上，单步解码在LIBERO-Long上达到95.6%。真实机器人YAM RSS双机械臂实验也验证了相同趋势。
AI.conclusion: 强单步VLA动作生成可以通过标准扩散训练结合高噪声偏置调度实现，无需引入图像生成领域的复杂少步扩散机制。

title: Balancing Image Compression and Generation with Bootstrapped Tokenization
summary: Despite progress in image tokenization, standard methods encode redundant information by mixing all granularities within each token, thus redundancy persists between tokens. The mix of information of different granularity also complicates the training of generators. This paper introduces SelfBootTok, a method that resolves this by cleanly decomposing information into global and local token groups. Through self-bootstrapped learning, the model predicts local details exclusively from global tokens, shifting the burden of visual details from the generator to the tokenizer. Consequently, our generator is far more efficient, requiring only global tokens and reducing computation by approximately 40%, while delivering superior reconstruction and generation. Moreover, this paradigm scales elegantly: by leveraging more data or parameters to self-supervise local representation learning, SelfBootTok achieves a new state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.56 using only 64 tokens.

AI.tldr: SelfBootTok 通过自引导学习将图像信息分解为全局和局部令牌组，使生成器仅需全局令牌即可高效工作，在减少约40%计算量的同时实现了更优的重建和生成性能，以仅64个令牌达到了1.56的gFID新纪录。
AI.motivation: 现有图像令牌化方法将不同粒度信息混合在同一个令牌中，导致令牌间存在冗余信息，且不同粒度的信息混合增加了生成器的训练难度。
AI.method: 提出SelfBootTok方法，通过自引导学习将信息干净地分解为全局和局部令牌组，模型仅从全局令牌预测局部细节，从而将视觉细节的负担从生成器转移到令牌化器。
AI.result: 生成器仅需全局令牌，计算量减少约40%，同时实现了更优的重建和生成性能；通过增加数据或参数进行自监督局部表示学习，以64个令牌达到了1.56的gFID分数，实现了新最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: SelfBootTok通过信息分解策略有效提升了图像令牌化的效率和质量，且该方法具有良好的可扩展性，能够随数据或参数规模的增加而进一步提升性能。

title: Multi-Resolution Tactile Imitation Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Touch sensing is beneficial for solving a wide variety of manipulation tasks. While there exists a wide range of tactile sensors with different properties, exploiting the fusion of multiple heterogeneous tactile sensors to improve manipulation learning remains underexplored. We present Multi-Resolution Tactile Sensing (MiTaS), a representation framework that leverages multiple tactile sensors operating at different temporal resolutions in order to solve complex contact-rich manipulation tasks. We propose a novel architecture using modality-specific convolutional stems and transformer-based fusion that effectively fuses information from an RGB camera stream, a vision-based GelSight Mini sensor and a high-frequency event-based Evetac sensor. This multi-sensor representation then conditions a flow-matching policy for solving downstream tasks. Experimental results across five contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-resolution tactile features in imitation learning. MiTaS achieves an average success rate of 80 %, while vision-only (31 %) and visual-tactile (54 %) baselines cannot solve the task reliably. Co-training a visuo-tactile model with multi-tactile data boosts performance by over 10 \% in certain tasks, without having access to the Evetac sensor during policy evaluation. A detailed sensor-reading and attention analysis reveals the importance of different sensors throughout task execution, validating our multi-resolution tactile sensing approach. Project Page: http://mitas-touch.github.io.

AI.tldr: MiTaS提出一种多分辨率触觉感知框架，融合RGB相机、GelSight Mini（低频视觉触觉）和Evetac（高频事件触觉）三种传感器，通过模态特定卷积主干和基于Transformer的融合架构，为流匹配策略提供条件，在5种接触密集操作任务中实现80%的平均成功率，显著优于纯视觉（31%）和视觉-触觉（54%）基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管存在多种不同性质的触觉传感器，但利用异构触觉传感器的融合来改进操作学习仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出MiTaS框架，使用模态特定卷积主干提取特征，基于Transformer融合RGB、GelSight Mini和Evetac三种传感器信息，融合后的多分辨率触觉表征作为流匹配策略的条件进行模仿学习。
AI.result: 在5种接触密集操作任务中，MiTaS平均成功率80%，显著优于纯视觉（31%）和视觉-触觉（54%）基线；联合训练视觉-触觉模型与多触觉数据可在某些任务中提升10%以上性能，且无需Evetac传感器参与策略评估。
AI.conclusion: 多分辨率触觉感知框架有效融合异构触觉传感器，在接触密集操作任务中显著优于纯视觉和单一触觉方法，并具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Cosine Misleads: Auxiliary Losses Reshape Vision Language Models, Not Their Latents
summary: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) inserts supervised latent tokens between perception and answer generation in vision-language models (VLMs). The field uses alignment between these latents and their visual targets, i.e., cosine similarity or mean squared error (MSE), as both the training loss and the quality metric, assuming that better alignment yields a better answer. We test this with a designed matrix of five LVR variants and find the assumption inverted: cosine alignment is negatively correlated with accuracy across all five (r=-0.94). To explain this, we introduce PRISM, a pair of inference-time diagnostics: a linear probe that asks where the answer is decodable, and a corruption test that asks whether the latent is load-bearing. The supervised latents are largely bypassed. Corrupting them shifts accuracy by at most four points. The answer is decodable downstream of the latent but not at it, and the size of this decodability gap predicts how much each variant relies on its latent under perturbation. Consistent with an Information Bottleneck reading of the loss, the auxiliary objective reshapes the language model via shared parameters rather than via the latent variable it nominally optimizes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型中潜在视觉推理（LVR）的监督潜变量与准确率呈负相关（r=-0.94），并通过PRISM诊断工具揭示这些潜变量在实践中被绕过，辅助目标实际上通过共享参数而非潜变量本身重塑语言模型。
AI.motivation: 验证LVR领域中一个核心假设：潜变量与视觉目标的对齐程度越好（如余弦相似度或MSE），最终答案质量越高。
AI.method: 设计五种LVR变体的对照矩阵，引入PRISM诊断工具（线性探针+破坏测试），并结合信息瓶颈理论分析。
AI.result: 余弦对齐与准确率呈强负相关（r=-0.94）；破坏潜变量最多仅影响4个百分点的准确率；答案在潜变量下游可解码，但在潜变量本身位置不可解码。
AI.conclusion: LVR的辅助目标实际上通过共享参数而非潜变量本身影响语言模型，潜变量在实践中被绕过，原有对齐假设不成立。

title: Representation Learning Enables Scalable Multitask Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Scaling reinforcement learning (RL) to diverse multitask settings remains a central challenge. While recent advances in model-based RL achieve strong performance, they rely on planning and complex training pipelines, making it unclear which components are essential for scalability. We revisit this question and argue that the primary driver of scalable multitask RL is not model-based control, but \emph{representation learning}. In particular, we show that combining predictive, model-based representations with high-capacity value function approximation is sufficient to achieve strong performance, even without planning. We evaluate a simple model-free algorithm, MR.Q, coupled with auxiliary predictive objectives into a scalable actor-critic architecture. This approach outperforms a recent world-model-based method and a range of deep RL baselines across a diverse suite of multitask continuous control tasks, while significantly reducing computational overhead and improving wall-clock efficiency. We observe consistent improvements with increased model capacity and show through ablations that predictive representation learning is critical for performance.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在多任务强化学习中，可扩展性的主要驱动力并非基于模型的规划，而是表征学习。提出的MR.Q算法结合预测性表征学习与高容量价值函数近似，无需规划即可超越基于世界模型的方法，显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 模型基RL在多任务场景中表现优异，但其依赖规划和复杂训练流程，各组件对可扩展性的贡献不明确，亟需厘清关键因素。
AI.method: 提出MR.Q算法：一种简单无模型演员-评论家架构，结合辅助预测性目标（模型基表征学习）与高容量价值函数近似，完全摒弃规划模块。
AI.result: 在多任务连续控制套件中，MR.Q超越基于世界模型的方法及多种深度RL基线，显著降低计算开销并提升墙钟效率；增大模型容量带来一致收益。
AI.conclusion: 多任务RL可扩展性的核心在于预测性表征学习与高容量函数近似的结合，而非模型基控制或规划；简单无模型方法足以媲美甚至超越复杂模型基方法。

title: Attitude-Aided Linear Calibration of Triaxial Accelerometers
summary: Triaxial MEMS accelerometers are widely used for inertial sensing, navigation, and sensor fusion, but existing calibration methods often rely on costly reference setups or nonlinear iterative optimization, limiting their efficiency and applicability to low-cost or self-calibrating systems. We present attitude-aided linear accelerometer calibration (ALAC), a method that operates on any platform providing orientation information, such as turntables, robotic arms, or inertial measurement units. ALAC constructs a combined error matrix (CEM) to represent sensor errors in a unified calibration model and enables linear least-squares estimation. The bias and gravity vector are jointly estimated, implicitly accounting for platform misalignment, and matrix decomposition of the CEM recovers scale, non-orthogonality, and alignment rotation parameters. Under static gravity, calibration is formulated as a constrained homogeneous least-squares (CHLS) problem and solved in closed form using standard linear algebra. Only five arbitrarily oriented measurements are required, and a recursive extension supports online or in-field calibration. Experiments on a stationary robot-mounted accelerometer and a quasi-static public IMU trajectory show that ALAC, in both offline and online modes, outperforms reference-based and online baselines in accuracy and robustness to sensor noise. On the same dataset, it matches iterative self-calibration under filtered conditions and surpasses all evaluated baselines on raw measurements. These results demonstrate a robust and practical calibration scheme for MEMS-based inertial platforms, especially low-cost IMUs and online calibration scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ALAC（姿态辅助线性加速度计校准）的方法，利用平台提供的姿态信息，通过构建组合误差矩阵(CEM)将校准问题转化为线性最小二乘估计，仅需5个任意方向测量即可实现MEMS加速度计的高效标定，在离线和在线模式下均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的三轴MEMS加速度计校准方法要么依赖昂贵的参考设备，要么使用非线性迭代优化，效率低且不适用于低成本或自校准系统。
AI.method: ALAC方法利用任何提供姿态信息的平台（转台、机械臂、IMU等），构建组合误差矩阵(CEM)统一表示传感器误差，将校准建模为约束齐次最小二乘(CHLS)问题，通过线性代数闭式求解，联合估计偏置和重力矢量，并通过矩阵分解恢复尺度、非正交性和对准旋转参数。
AI.result: 在机器人安装的加速度计和公共IMU轨迹数据集上，ALAC在离线和在线模式下均优于基于参考的基线和在线基线方法，在滤波条件下与迭代自校准方法相当，在原始测量上超越所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ALAC提供了一种鲁棒且实用的MEMS惯性平台校准方案，特别适用于低成本IMU和在线校准场景，仅需5个任意方向测量，支持递归扩展实现在线/现场校准。

title: DRIFT: A Residual Flow Adapter for Decoding Continuous Outputs in Vision-Language Models
summary: Many modern vision-language models (VLMs) build on autoregressive decoding of discrete tokens. While text-based output interfaces enable scalable pretraining and strong zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks, they are poorly suited for problems that require precise continuous outputs, such as localizing temporal boundaries of events or generating robotic control actions. To address this challenge, we propose DRIFT, a general framework for adapting pretrained VLMs to continuous decoding tasks. DRIFT combines a base predictor, which provides a coarse estimate of the target output, with a generative refinement module based on flow matching that iteratively improves the prediction. This residual formulation transforms the generative modeling problem from learning a global output distribution to modeling a localized residual distribution around a strong prior, substantially simplifying optimization. We evaluate DRIFT on both perception and planning tasks, including visual grounding and robotic control. Across multiple tasks and architectures spanning MLLMs, VLAs, and WAMs, DRIFT consistently outperforms a strong set of regression- and generative-based solutions.

AI.tldr: DRIFT是一个通用框架，通过结合基础预测器与基于流匹配的生成式精化模块，将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配到连续解码任务（如时间定位、机器人控制），在多项感知与规划任务上优于回归和生成式基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM基于离散token的自回归解码，在需要精确连续输出的任务（如事件时间边界定位、机器人控制动作生成）中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出DRIFT框架，包含基础预测器（提供粗略估计）和基于流匹配的生成式精化模块（迭代改进预测）。采用残差公式，将生成建模从学习全局输出分布转化为围绕强先验建模局部残差分布。
AI.result: 在视觉定位和机器人控制等多个感知与规划任务上，涵盖MLLM、VLA、WAM等多种架构，DRIFT consistently优于强回归和生成式基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DRIFT框架有效弥合了离散token解码VLM与连续输出任务之间的鸿沟，为VLM在连续空间中的应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: Field Validation of a Multi-Resolution ConvLSTM Framework for Retaining Wall Deformation Prediction
summary: This study presents a comprehensive field validation of a multi-resolution Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) framework for predicting retaining wall deformation during staged excavation. The framework is trained on Gaussian noise-augmented numerical simulations and integrates ConvLSTM models operating at different temporal resolutions through a stacking ensemble strategy. The proposed framework is validated using field monitoring data from 34 inclinometers across 11 excavation sites in South Korea. Site-wise prediction performance is systematically evaluated using multiple evaluation metrics, with analyses of the influence of temporal deformation irregularity and spatiotemporal prediction characteristics on model performance. The results demonstrate that the framework predicts retaining wall deformation associated with up to 5.0 m of additional excavation with an average mean absolute error of 1.4 mm and a coefficient of determination of 0.93 across the excavation sites. These results indicate that the framework, although trained exclusively on numerically simulated and augmented database, can be effectively applied to diverse field excavation conditions and achieve a reliable level of prediction accuracy in practical retaining wall deformation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种多分辨率卷积长短期记忆网络（ConvLSTM）框架，用于预测基坑分阶段开挖期间的挡土墙变形。该框架基于高斯噪声增强的数值模拟训练，通过堆叠集成策略融合不同时间分辨率的ConvLSTM模型，并在韩国11个开挖场地的34个测斜仪实测数据上进行了系统验证，取得了平均绝对误差1.4 mm、决定系数0.93的优异预测性能。
AI.motivation: 基坑开挖过程中挡土墙变形的准确预测对工程安全至关重要，但现有方法在跨场地泛化能力和多时间尺度特征捕捉方面存在不足，亟需一种能够基于数值模拟数据训练并有效迁移至实际工程条件的预测框架。
AI.method: 采用高斯噪声增强的数值模拟生成训练数据；构建多分辨率ConvLSTM模型分别捕捉不同时间尺度的变形特征；通过堆叠集成策略融合多分支预测结果；利用34个测斜仪实测数据（11个场地）进行现场验证，并系统评估时间变形不规则性和时空预测特性的影响。
AI.result: 框架能够预测多达5.0米额外开挖深度的挡土墙变形，平均绝对误差1.4 mm，决定系数0.93，表明基于数值模拟训练的模型可有效迁移至实际工程条件。
AI.conclusion: 该多分辨率ConvLSTM框架在挡土墙变形预测中达到了可靠的精度水平，即使仅使用数值模拟及增强数据进行训练，也能成功泛化至多样化的现场开挖条件，具有良好的工程实用价值。

title: Meridian: Metric-Semantic Primitive Matching for Cross-View Geo-Localization Beyond Urban Environments
summary: Successful robot automation requires accurate global localization to support repeatability, task planning, goal specification, and safe operation. However, reliable localization in GNSS-denied environments remains an open problem. Overhead aerial imagery offers a promising solution, but existing approaches primarily target structured urban environments and have been rarely demonstrated in unstructured natural terrain. Limitations of the state-of-the-art include a reliance on models trained for specific environments, as well as difficulty handling repetitive geometries and featureless landscapes commonly found in natural outdoor areas. To overcome these challenges, we present Meridian, a method for matching high-level metric-semantic primitives across aerial images and ground robot RGB-D camera data that achieves accurate global localization and generalizes well across diverse environments, all without any training or algorithmic fine-tuning on area-specific data. We formulate novel consistency metrics to estimate a distribution over robot submap poses and to reject outlier hypotheses in a robust pose graph optimization step for accurate robot trajectory estimation. We demonstrate that our algorithm can localize a ground robot across a wide variety of environments, including an autonomous driving dataset, a park and campus area, and a wilderness camp, with an average optimized trajectory error of 2.4 m over 19 km of ground traversal.

AI.tldr: Meridian是一种利用高空航拍图像与地面机器人RGB-D数据匹配高层度量-语义基元的方法，无需针对特定环境训练或微调即可实现跨多样化环境的全局定位，在19公里地面遍历中平均优化轨迹误差为2.4米。
AI.motivation: 现有GNSS拒止环境下的全局定位方法过度依赖特定环境训练模型，难以处理自然户外场景常见的重复几何结构和无特征地形，缺少通用且无需区域特定数据适配的定位方案。
AI.method: 提出Meridian方法，通过匹配航拍图像与地面RGB-D数据中的高层度量-语义基元，设计新颖的一致性度量来估计子图位姿分布，并在鲁棒位姿图优化中剔除离群假设以估计机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶数据集、公园校园区域和野外营地等多种环境中验证，19公里地面遍历的平均优化轨迹误差为2.4米。
AI.conclusion: Meridian无需训练或算法微调即可在不同环境间良好泛化，为GNSS拒止环境下的可靠全局定位提供了有效的通用解决方案。

title: Physics-Guided Deep Unfolding for Blind Cross-Sensor Spectral Super-Resolution via Learning the Spectral Transformation Function
summary: Hyperspectral imaging provides rich spectral information for quantitative remote sensing, yet hyperspectral sensors remain costly and thus unavailable in many UAV deployments. Spectral super-resolution (SSR) seeks to reconstruct hyperspectral images (HSIs) from multispectral images (MSIs). Most existing SSR methods assume a fixed and known spectral response function (SRF) and are therefore limited to single-sensor settings. In practical cross-sensor scenarios, the spectral degradation from HSI to MSI is unknown and varies with sensor characteristics and scene content, which renders HSI reconstruction ill-posed. This paper proposes a physics-guided deep unfolding network, termed PGU-Net, to address blind cross-sensor SSR by jointly estimating the HSI and a learnable spectral transformation function (STF). PGU-Net unrolls an alternating optimization procedure into an end-to-end trainable architecture with stages, where each stage sequentially updates the HSI and the STF.
