As Text-to-Image (T2I) models become increasingly capable, researchers have started to use them for scientific illustration generation. However, existing benchmarks often assess outputs at a holistic level, overlooking fine-grained elements, while scientific reasoning ability and output conciseness remain under-quantified. We introduce FEPBench, a benchmark built from carefully selected high-quality scientific illustrations across multiple disciplines and layout types. With the assistance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and human experts, we provide fine-grained atom set annotations and systematically evaluate T2I models along three dimensions: instruction faithfulness, reasoning enrichment, and semantic precision. Our evaluation further decomposes model performance across visual, textual, relation, and layout elements. Results show that even state-of-the-art (SOTA) closed-source models, such as GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, still suffer from text-rendering bottlenecks, limited reasoning enrichment, and difficulty balancing generation richness with precision. These findings provide practical guidance for improving and deploying T2I models in scientific illustration generation. Benchmark data, atom set annotations, and evaluation code will be released by us.

AI.tldr: FEPBench是一个面向科学插图生成的细粒度评估基准，通过原子集标注从指令忠实度、推理丰富性和语义精度三个维度系统评估文生图模型，发现即使SOTA闭源模型在文本渲染、推理丰富性及生成丰富度与精度平衡方面仍存在明显瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有科学插图生成评估基准多停留于整体层面，忽略细粒度元素，且对模型的科学推理能力和输出简洁性缺乏量化评估。
AI.method: 基于跨学科高质量科学插图构建FEPBench基准，借助多模态大语言模型和人类专家提供细粒度原子集标注，从指令忠实度、推理丰富性和语义精度三个维度，进一步分解为视觉、文本、关系和布局元素进行系统性评估。
AI.result: SOTA闭源模型（如GPT Image 2和Nano Banana Pro）在文本渲染、推理丰富性及生成丰富度与精度之间的平衡方面仍存在显著瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: FEPBench为改进和部署科学插图生成中的T2I模型提供了实用指导，相关数据和代码将开源。

title: Beyond Soft Masks: Hard-Perturbation Mixup Explainer for Robust GNN Explainability
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a range of applications involving graph-structured data, particularly in high-stakes domains. However, the opaque nature of their decision-making processes limits their trustworthiness and broader adoption. Existing post-hoc explanation methods aim to improve explainability by identifying subgraphs that influence GNN predictions and adopt mixup strategies to alleviate the out-of-distribution (OOD) issue caused by using subgraphs for prediction. Yet, these approaches typically rely on soft masks, which are inherently unable to fully eliminate label-irrelevant information, allowing redundant structures to leak into the mixup process and hindering the resolution of the OOD problem, thereby degrading explanation fidelity. In this work, we propose HPME, a Hard-Perturbation Mixup Explanation framework grounded in a generalized Graph Information Bottleneck, which leverages graph pooling to extract discrete explanatory subgraphs and to yield an information-capacity bound to thoroughly compress label-irrelevant components. Furthermore, we introduce a novel mixup strategy built upon structure-level replacement, generating in-distribution explanations to effectively mitigate the distribution shift. Extensive experiments on diverse tasks demonstrate that HPME achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating robust and interpretable explanations across both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出HPME框架，通过硬扰动混合解释和广义图信息瓶颈，解决GNN解释中软掩码无法完全消除标签无关信息导致的分布外问题，提升解释保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN事后解释方法使用软掩码无法彻底消除标签无关信息，导致冗余结构泄漏到混合过程中，加剧分布外问题，降低解释保真度，限制了GNN在高风险领域的可信应用。
AI.method: 提出HPME框架：1）基于广义图信息瓶颈，利用图池化提取离散解释子图并产生信息容量界以压缩标签无关成分；2）采用结构级替换的混合策略，生成分布内解释以缓解分布偏移。
AI.result: 在多种任务上的大量实验表明，HPME在合成和真实数据集上均实现了最先进的鲁棒且可解释的解释生成性能。
AI.conclusion: HPME通过硬扰动和结构级混合策略有效解决了软掩码的固有限制，提升了GNN解释的保真度和鲁棒性，为图神经网络的可解释性提供了新的范式。

title: EVE: A Generator-Verifier System for Generative Policies
summary: Visuomotor policies based on generative such as diffusion and flow-matching have shown strong performance for robotics applications but degrade under distribution shifts, demonstrating limited recovery capabilities without costly finetuning. In the language modeling domain, test-time compute scaling has revolutionized the reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs by enabling candidate solution refinement. These methods typically leverage foundation models as verification modules in a zero-shot manner to score candidate solutions. We hypothesize that generative policies can similarly benefit from additional inference-time compute that employs zero-shot VLM-based verifiers in a generation-verification framework. To this end, we introduce EVE: a modular, generator-verifier interaction framework that boosts the performance of pretrained generative policies at test time, with no additional training. EVE wraps a frozen base policy with multiple zero-shot, VLM-based verifier agents. Each verifier proposes action refinements to the base policy candidate actions, while an action incorporator uses classifier guidance to fuse aggregated verifier feedback into action denoising. We study design choices for generator-verifier information interfacing across a system of verifiers with distinct capabilities. Across diverse simulated and real robotic tasks and embodiments, EVE consistently improves success rates without additional policy or verifier training. Through extensive ablations, we isolate the contribution of verifier capabilities and action incorporator strategies, offering practical guidelines to build scalable, modular generator-verifier systems for embodied control.

AI.tldr: EVE是一个无需额外训练的模块化生成器-验证器交互框架，通过在测试时引入零样本VLM验证器对预训练生成式策略的动作进行评分和精炼，显著提升了机器人策略在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和成功率。
AI.motivation: 生成式视觉运动策略在机器人应用中表现优异，但在分布偏移下性能退化严重，且微调成本高昂。受语言模型中测试时计算扩展（如使用基础模型作为验证模块进行零样本候选解评分）的启发，作者假设生成式策略也能通过引入推理时计算和零样本VLM验证器在生成-验证框架中获益。
AI.method: 提出EVE框架，包含：(1) 冻结的基础生成式策略作为动作生成器；(2) 多个零样本VLM验证器代理对候选动作进行评分和精炼；(3) 动作整合器（Action Incorporator）使用分类器引导（classifier guidance）融合聚合后的验证器反馈，指导动作去噪过程。研究不同验证器能力组合和信息交互方式的设计选择。
AI.result: 在多个模拟和真实机器人任务及不同机器人形态上，EVE在无需额外训练策略或验证器的情况下，持续提升了任务成功率。消融实验验证了验证器能力和动作整合器策略的贡献。
AI.conclusion: EVE证明了零样本VLM验证器可以有效增强预训练生成式策略的测试时性能，为构建可扩展、模块化的生成器-验证器具身控制系统提供了实用指南。

title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models with Hybrid Post-Processing: Achieving Cost-Efficient, Low-Latency Multi-Label Structured Prediction via LoRA Fine-Tuning on Scarce Data
summary:
Deploying frontier large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific structured evaluation tasks often incurs substantial latency, cost, and data privacy overhead. We present a hybrid framework that combines a fine-tuned small language model (LLaMA 3.1 8B, with only 2.05% trainable parameters via LoRA) and a deterministic rule-based post-processing layer. Trained on just 219 curated examples, the system is applied to multi-label compliance evaluation of conversational transcripts spanning 18 heterogeneous output fields. In blind evaluation on 53 previously unseen production transcripts, it achieves 100% JSON structural validity, 83.0% human-validated overall accuracy, and 100% accuracy on the most critical classification field. The proposed approach formalizes a hybrid neural-symbolic decomposition and introduces targeted hard-negative augmentation to improve performance on critical decision boundaries. Running on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, inference completes in approximately 2 seconds, which is 2-5x faster than frontier-model APIs. The system costs only $0.013 per evaluation compared with $0.025-$0.055 for proprietary alternatives, resulting in 46-76% cost savings. These results demonstrate that domain-adapted small language models, when combined with deterministic post-processing, can match frontier-model accuracy for structured compliance evaluation while substantially reducing operational cost, latency, and privacy risk.
  Keywords: small language models, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, LoRA, domain adaptation, hybrid inference, compliance evaluation, structured output.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合框架，将LoRA微调的小语言模型（LLaMA 3.1 8B，仅2.05%可训练参数）与确定性规则后处理层结合，在仅219个样本训练下，实现多标签合规评估任务中83%准确率、100% JSON结构有效性和关键字段100%准确率，同时推理速度比前沿模型API快2-5倍，成本降低46-76%。
AI.motivation: 部署前沿大语言模型进行领域特定的结构化评估任务时，常面临高延迟、高成本和数据隐私问题。本文旨在探索小语言模型结合规则后处理是否能以更低代价达到与前沿模型相当的准确性。
AI.method: 采用混合神经-符号分解框架：1) 使用LoRA对LLaMA 3.1 8B进行参数高效微调（仅2.05%可训练参数）；2) 引入确定性规则后处理层保证结构化输出有效性；3) 提出针对性硬负样本增强以改善关键决策边界性能。训练仅用219个精选样本。
AI.result: 在53个未见过的生产级对话转录本上进行盲评：JSON结构有效性100%，总体准确率83.0%，最关键分类字段准确率100%。推理时间约2秒（比前沿模型API快2-5倍），单次评估成本$0.013（比专有方案$0.025-$0.055降低46-76%）。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的小语言模型结合确定性后处理，能够在结构化合规评估任务中达到与前沿模型相当的准确性，同时大幅降低运营成本、延迟和隐私风险，为实际生产部署提供了一种高效可行的替代方案。

title: EgoHumanoid: Unlocking In-the-Wild Loco-Manipulation with Robot-Free Egocentric Demonstration
summary: Human demonstrations offer rich environmental diversity and scale naturally, making them an appealing alternative to robot teleoperation. While this paradigm has advanced robot-arm manipulation, its potential for the more challenging, data-hungry problem of humanoid loco-manipulation remains largely unexplored. We present EgoHumanoid, the first framework to co-train a vision-language-action policy using abundant egocentric human demonstrations together with a limited amount of robot data, enabling humanoids to perform loco-manipulation across diverse real-world environments. To bridge the embodiment gap between humans and robots, including discrepancies in physical morphology and viewpoint, we introduce a systematic alignment pipeline spanning from hardware design to data processing. A portable system for scalable human data collection is developed, and we establish practical collection protocols to improve transferability. At the core of our human-to-humanoid alignment pipeline lies two key components. The view alignment reduces visual domain discrepancies caused by camera height and perspective variation. The action alignment maps human motions into a unified, kinematically feasible action space for humanoid control. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that incorporating robot-free egocentric data significantly outperforms robot-only baselines by 51\%, particularly in unseen environments. Our analysis further reveals which behaviors transfer effectively and the potential for scaling human data.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoHumanoid框架，首次利用丰富的人类自我中心演示与有限机器人数据联合训练视觉-语言-动作策略，并设计人-人形机器人对齐管线，使双足人形机器人能够在多样真实环境中实现全身操作。
AI.motivation: 人类演示数据丰富且易于规模化，但现有双足人形机器人的全身操作研究主要依赖遥操作数据，数据成本高、扩展性差。作者希望探索如何利用低成本的人类自我中心演示数据来缓解人形机器人数据匮乏问题。
AI.method: 提出EgoHumanoid框架，包含：(1) 从硬件到数据处理的人-人形对齐管线，含视角对齐（减少视觉域差异）和动作对齐（将人类动作映射到统一运动学可行空间）；(2) 便携式人类数据采集系统及实用采集协议；(3) 联合训练视觉-语言-动作策略。
AI.result: 在未见环境中，融入无机器人自我中心数据相比纯机器人基线性能提升51%。实验验证了哪些行为可有效迁移及人类数据的规模化潜力。
AI.conclusion: 人类自我中心数据能显著提升人形机器人在未见环境中的全身操作性能，验证了从人到人形机器人的行为迁移可行性，并揭示了数据规模化扩展的前景。

title: Video-Rate Streaming Stylization on a Vision-Aware MLLM-Conditioned Edit Diffusion: Asymmetric Batched Inference on a Distilled UNet + MLLM Text Encoder
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology. Code, evaluation harness, and the released v3 Temporal LLLite adapter weights are at https://github.com/otanl/dreamlite-stream (also mirrored to Hugging Face and Zenodo)
summary: Aggressive distillation of the diffusion U-Net inverts the per-frame bottleneck of real-time text-to-image pipelines: once the denoiser is a 4-step or 1-step distilled student, the text encoder becomes the critical path. This inversion is most acute in vision-aware edit diffusion, where the encoder is a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We study the case of a 0.39B distilled edit U-Net paired with a 2.13B MLLM text encoder (Qwen3-VL) and present a streaming pipeline targeted at this regime built around three engineering mechanisms: asymmetric side-stream / main-stream CUDA pipelining with batched text-encoder amortisation (and optional static-prompt caching), a compile-friendly ControlNet-LLLite reformulation that folds the entire U-Net + adapter stack into a single fused graph, and a periodic conditioning-refresh schedule with a hook subset that amortises the per-frame conditioning cost. On a single consumer RTX 3090 Ti at 512x512 the pipeline sustains 27.4 fps over a 480-frame run at batch size B=8 and 29.6 fps at B=16, with end-to-end p50 latency of approximately 0.5 and 1.0 seconds respectively; the same operating point measures 54.9 fps on RTX 4090 and 74.1 fps on RTX 5090. We report video-rate streaming throughput rather than interactive low latency, and locate our numbers against same-stack StreamDiffusion re-runs as systems context, not as a benchmark superiority claim. For the trained oil-painting style, the released temporal adapter generalises within in-clip noise to 19 unused DAVIS-2017 sequences and 15 non-DAVIS clips from seven sources; prompt-level generalisation to unseen style families is bounded and reported separately.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散U-Net蒸馏后文本编码器成为瓶颈的问题，提出了一套流式管线：非对称侧流/主流CUDA流水线（批处理文本编码器摊销+静态提示缓存）、编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite融合图、以及周期性条件刷新调度。在RTX 3090 Ti上512x512分辨率以B=8达到27.4 fps，B=16达到29.6 fps，RTX 5090可达74.1 fps。
AI.motivation: 扩散U-Net蒸馏至4步或1步后，去噪器不再是瓶颈，文本编码器（尤其是MLLM）成为关键路径，导致视觉感知编辑扩散中每帧条件计算开销巨大，亟需针对此非对称计算特征设计高效流式管线。
AI.method: 1) 非对称侧流/主流CUDA流水线，支持批处理文本编码器摊销和可选的静态提示缓存；2) 编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重表述，将整个U-Net+适配器堆栈融合为单一计算图；3) 周期性条件刷新调度，通过钩子子集摊销每帧条件计算成本。
AI.result: 单卡RTX 3090 Ti上512x512分辨率480帧测试：B=8时27.4 fps，B=16时29.6 fps；p50端到端延迟分别约0.5秒和1.0秒。RTX 4090达54.9 fps，RTX 5090达74.1 fps。风格迁移泛化方面，在DAVIS-2017的19个未见序列和15个非DAVIS片段上验证了时序适配器的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过工程机制有效解决了蒸馏U-Net+大MLLM编码器的非对称瓶颈，实现了视频级流式吞吐，但提示级风格泛化仍有限制，需进一步研究。

title: Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks for Counterfactual Outcome Prediction
summary: Longitudinal treatment decisions require predicting potential outcomes under future treatment sequences in the presence of time-varying confounding, heterogeneous patient dynamics, and limited domain-specific data. Existing longitudinal causal estimators typically train a new model for each cohort or simulator. We introduce Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks (CausalLongPFN), a prior-fitted in-context predictor for longitudinal causal prediction. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic episodes sampled from a broad prior over temporal structural causal models, exposing it to treatment-confounder feedback, latent heterogeneity, nonlinear state evolution, delayed effects, and cumulative treatment responses. At test time, CausalLongPFN is frozen: it conditions on support trajectories, a query history, and a proposed future treatment sequence, and returns a predictive distribution over future outcomes without gradient updates or propensity-model fitting. Multi-step predictions are obtained by recursively applying the one-step predictor under the specified treatment sequence. We evaluate on branchable cancer, HIV, and warfarin benchmarks with ground-truth counterfactual labels, and on factual-only rolling-origin prediction in MIMIC-III ICU trajectories. CausalLongPFN is competitive with domain-trained longitudinal baselines on counterfactual benchmarks and performs strongly on factual MIMIC-III prediction, suggesting that broad synthetic causal pretraining can provide a useful frozen alternative when repeated domain-specific training is costly or impractical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalLongPFN，一种基于先验拟合的上下文预测器，通过合成因果模型预训练实现免微调的纵向因果预测，在癌症、HIV、华法林及MIMIC-III数据集上达到与领域训练基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有纵向因果估计方法对每个队列或模拟器都需要重新训练模型，成本高昂且不实用，亟需一种无需梯度更新或倾向性模型拟合的通用预测方法。
AI.method: 在涵盖治疗-混淆反馈、潜在异质性、非线性状态演化、延迟效应和累积治疗反应的广泛先验分布上，通过合成时间结构因果模型进行预训练；测试时冻结模型，通过上下文支持轨迹和查询历史直接输出未来结果预测分布，并通过递归单步预测实现多步预测。
AI.result: 在分支癌症、HIV、华法林的反事实基准和MIMIC-III的事实预测上，CausalLongPFN与领域训练的纵向基线方法竞争力相当，且在MIMIC-III事实预测上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的合成因果预训练可以提供一种有用的冻结替代方案，适用于领域特定训练成本高昂或不可行的情况。

title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models
summary: Simulation offers a scalable and low-cost way to enrich vision-language-action (VLA) training, reducing reliance on expensive real-robot demonstrations. However, most sim-real co-training methods rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which treats simulation as a static source of demonstrations and does not exploit large-scale closed-loop interaction. Consequently, real-world gains and generalization are often limited. In this paper, we propose an RL-based sim-real Co-training (RL-Co) framework that leverages interactive simulation while preserving real-world capabilities. Our method follows a generic two-stage design: we first warm-start the policy with SFT on a mixture of real and simulated demonstrations, then fine-tune it with reinforcement learning in simulation while adding an auxiliary supervised loss on real-world data to anchor the policy and mitigate catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate our framework on four real-world tabletop manipulation tasks using two representative VLA architectures, OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$, and observe consistent improvements over real-only fine-tuning and SFT-based co-training, including +24% real-world success on OpenVLA and +20% on $π_{0.5}$. Beyond higher success rates, RL co-training yields stronger generalization to unseen task variations and substantially improved real-world data efficiency, providing a practical and scalable pathway for leveraging simulation to enhance real-robot deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出基于强化学习的仿真-真实协同训练框架（RL-Co），通过两阶段方法（先SFT联合训练再RL微调+真实数据辅助损失）解决VLA策略的仿真到真实迁移问题，在多个操作任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真-真实协同训练方法依赖监督微调（SFT），将仿真视为静态演示源，未能利用大规模闭环交互，导致真实场景收益和泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段一用真实+仿真混合数据进行SFT热启策略；阶段二在仿真环境中用强化学习微调，同时添加真实数据的辅助监督损失以缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA和π_{0.5}两种架构、四项真实桌面操作任务上，相比真实数据微调和SFT协同训练，成功率分别提升24%和20%，且泛化能力和数据效率显著提高。
AI.conclusion: RL-Co提供了一种实用可扩展的仿真利用路径，通过强化学习闭环交互显著提升真实机器人部署性能，优于现有SFT范式。

title: Multimodal Sexism Identification and Characterization using Large Language Models and Gradient Boosting
summary: We present the AILS-NTUA submission to the EXIST 2026 Lab at CLEF, addressing multimodal sexism identification and characterization in memes (Task 2) and short-form videos (Task 3). Our system follows a feature-engineered late-fusion pipeline built around gradient-boosted regression models and hierarchical post-processing. For memes, we combine visual, textual, demographic, biometric, and LLM-derived semantic indicators designed to capture high-level cues such as stereotyping, objectification, irony, and misogyny. For videos, we investigate the effect of feature selection, frame-based visual representations, OCR-based textual features, acoustic descriptors, and sensor-derived metadata. Development results show that focused LLM-derived semantic cues improve meme sexism identification, while video performance is highly sensitive to feature dimensionality and cross-modal noise. For videos, development results favor compact feature selection, but official test results show that this conclusion does not fully transfer to unseen data, where the unfiltered representation generalizes better. Overall, our findings highlight the usefulness of targeted semantic feature engineering for static memes and the need for more robust temporal modeling in noisy short-form video settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AILS-NTUA系统，参与EXIST 2026评测的模因（Task 2）和短视频（Task 3）多模态性别歧视识别任务。系统采用基于梯度提升回归模型的特征工程后融合管道。在模因任务中，结合视觉、文本、人口统计、生物特征和LLM语义指标；在视频任务中，探究特征选择、帧级视觉、OCR文本、声学描述符和传感器元数据的影响。实验表明，LLM语义线索对模因性别歧视识别有效，而视频性能对特征维度和跨模态噪声高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体中性别歧视内容以模因和短视频等形式广泛传播，现有方法缺乏对多模态、异质性内容的有效识别与刻画，亟需设计能够融合多种模态信息并进行性别歧视检测与特征化的系统。
AI.method: 采用特征工程驱动的后融合管道，以梯度提升回归模型为核心，结合层次化后处理。模因任务融合视觉特征、文本特征、人口统计特征、生物特征及LLM衍生的语义指标（如刻板印象、物化、反讽、厌女等线索）；视频任务探索特征选择策略、帧级视觉表征、OCR文本特征、声学描述符及传感器元数据的组合效果。
AI.result: 开发集上，聚焦的LLM语义线索提升了模因性别歧视识别性能；视频任务的性能对特征维度和跨模态噪声高度敏感，开发集显示紧凑特征选择更优，但官方测试结果表明未过滤的完整特征集在未见数据上泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 有针对性的语义特征工程对静态模因的性别歧视识别有效，而嘈杂的短视频场景需要更鲁棒的时序建模方法。

title: CaliDist: Calibrating Large Language Models via Behavioral Robustness to Distraction
summary: Existing calibration methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) often overlook a critical dimension of trustworthiness: a model's {\em behavioral robustness} to irrelevant or misleading information. In this paper, we argue that a model's true confidence should reflect its stability under cognitive pressure. We introduce \textsc{CaliDist}, a novel post-hoc calibration approach that directly measures and penalizes a model's susceptibility to distraction. \textsc{CaliDist} quantifies how an LLM's predictions and uncertainty change when its input prompt is perturbed with semantic \textit{distractors}. This stability (or lack thereof) signal is then used to adaptively scale the model's initial confidence score. Our extensive experiments on seven Natural Language Understanding classification benchmarks using six distinct LLMs show that \textsc{CaliDist} consistently achieves lower Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier Score compared with strong baselines. Remarkably, our method reduces the ECE from 23\% to 7\% on average--a relative improvement of 70\%--demonstrating that behavioral stability is a powerful signal for calibration. We make our code and datasets available at github.com/m-anas-j/CaliDist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaliDist，一种通过衡量LLM对语义干扰的稳定性来进行后验校准的新方法，将平均ECE从23%降至7%（相对提升70%）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM校准方法忽略了对无关或误导信息的"行为鲁棒性"这一关键信任维度，模型真实置信度应反映其在认知压力下的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出CaliDist后验校准方法，通过向输入添加语义干扰（distractors）来量化LLM预测和不确定性的变化，利用该稳定性信号自适应缩放模型初始置信度得分。
AI.result: 在7个NLU分类基准上使用6种不同LLM进行实验，CaliDist在ECE和Brier Score上均优于强基线，平均ECE从23%降至7%，相对提升70%。
AI.conclusion: 行为稳定性是LLM校准的有效信号，代码和数据集已开源。

title: HERO: Learning Humanoid End-Effector Control for Visual Whole-Body Open-Vocabulary Object Grasping
summary: Visual loco-manipulation of arbitrary in-the-wild objects requires accurate end-effector (EE) control and a generalizable understanding of the scene from visual inputs (eg, RGB-D images). Existing imitation and sim2real methods jointly learn both these aspects via monolithic end-to-end learning and are thus hard to scale. In this work, we bring to bear the best tools for each of these problems -- large vision models for generalizable scene understanding and simulated training for accurate EE control -- leading to an overall modular loco-manipulation system that exhibits strong generalization. Our core technical innovation is HERO, an accurate residual-aware EE tracking policy made possible by combining classical robotics with machine learning. It uses a) inverse kinematics to convert residual end-effector targets into reference trajectories, b) a learned neural forward model for accurate forward kinematics, and c) goal adjustment and replanning. Together, these innovations reduce the end-effector tracking error to 2.44cm, outperforming the strongest prior method by 5.5x. Our overall system operates in diverse real-world environments, from offices to coffee shops, where the robot reliably grasps various everyday objects (eg, mugs, apples, toys) on surfaces ranging from 43cm to 92cm in height. Systematic modular and end-to-end tests demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed design. We believe our advances open up new ways of training humanoids to interact with daily objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERO系统，通过结合经典机器人学与机器学习，实现视觉引导的任意物体灵巧操控。核心创新包括逆运动学残差跟踪、神经正向运动学模型和重规划机制，将末端执行器跟踪误差降至2.44cm（比先前方法提升5.5倍），在多样化真实环境中（办公室、咖啡店等）成功抓取各种日常物体（杯子、苹果、玩具等），证明了模块化设计的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习和sim2real方法通过端到端学习联合处理末端执行器控制与场景理解，难以规模化和泛化。作者希望将大型视觉模型（用于场景理解）与模拟训练（用于精确EE控制）相结合，构建一个模块化、可泛化的灵巧操控系统。
AI.method: 提出HERO（残差感知EE跟踪策略）：1) 逆运动学将残差末端执行器目标转换为参考轨迹；2) 学习的神经正向模型实现精确正向运动学；3) 目标调整与重规划机制。整体采用模块化架构，分离视觉感知（大视觉模型）与底层控制（模拟训练），而非端到端学习。
AI.result: 末端执行器跟踪误差降至2.44cm，比最强先方法提升5.5倍。在多样化真实环境（办公室、咖啡店）中，机器人能可靠抓取各种日常物体（杯子、苹果、玩具），表面高度范围43cm-92cm。
AI.conclusion: 模块化设计比端到端学习更有效，HERO为训练人形机器人交互日常物体开辟了新途径。通过系统性模块化和端到端测试验证了设计的有效性。

title: Deep Learning-based 3D Oral Cavity Reconstruction Using 2D Intraoral Images
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. English version of a paper presented at the Korea Multimedia Society Conference, November 2025
summary: Oral 3D modelling is one of the most essential stages in dentistry, and many different approaches, such as impression taking and intraoral scanning, are commonly used for this phase, each with notable limitations. Impression taking, which involves placing alginate or silicone material in a tray and inserting it into the patient's oral cavity to form a negative mold, suffers from significant patient discomfort, material deformation errors, and difficulties in storage and transportation. Intraoral scanners, which directly scan oral structures in real time using structured light or laser technology, produce state-of-the-art results but are associated with substantially high equipment costs. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a software-based approach that reconstructs a 3D oral model using only ten 2D intraoral images captured from different angles, requiring no dedicated hardware devices. The proposed method reduces cost, eliminates the need for physical scanning equipment, minimises patient discomfort, and enables automated 3D reconstruction. The model is trained on the publicly available Dental3DS dataset, comprising 950 upper jaw samples, and employs MobileNetV2 as the image encoder combined with Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 77.49%, measured by nearest-neighbor matching with a distance threshold of 0.035. However, predicted vertices tend to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, resulting in uneven point distribution across the reconstructed model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于软件的3D口腔重建方法，仅用10张2D口腔图像即可生成3D模型，无需专用硬件设备，在Dental3DS数据集上达到77.49%的准确率，但存在预测顶点分布不均的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统口腔取模存在患者不适、材料变形、存储困难等问题；口内扫描仪成本高昂。为解决这些硬件依赖和患者体验差的局限性，提出一种低成本的纯软件3D重建方案。
AI.method: 使用MobileNetV2作为图像编码器提取特征，结合多头注意力机制进行多视角特征融合，仅需10张不同角度的2D口内图像，在Dental3DS数据集（950个上颌样本）上训练。
AI.result: 最近邻匹配（距离阈值0.035）下准确率为77.49%，但预测顶点倾向于集中在真实数据的高密度区域，导致重建模型点分布不均匀。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效降低了成本和患者不适，实现了自动化3D重建，但点云分布不均匀的问题仍需后续改进。

title: SALT: When More Rollouts Don't Help in Group-Based Policy Optimization and How to Make Them Matter
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often adopts GRPO-style group-relative updates, sampling multiple rollouts per prompt to construct normalized learning signals. However, merely increasing the number of rollouts does not reliably strengthen learning: under GRPO-style group normalization, per-rollout policy-gradient features can concentrate into a low-rank, signed geometry, causing substantial cancellation during aggregation and weakening the effective update. We address this failure mode with SALT, a Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT that uses sample-wise gradient geometry to reweight the coefficients of group-relative updates. SALT estimates a dominant shared subspace from the mini-batch Gram geometry, decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels, and adaptively amplifies the residual channel when signed cancellation is severe. Across diverse reasoning-oriented RLVR benchmarks and model scales, SALT improves effective update geometry and performance without modifying the reward model or the rollout sampling procedure

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALT方法，通过估计梯度子空间并自适应重加权组相对更新系数，解决了GRPO-style RLVR中因符号抵消导致的梯度低秩问题，提升了强化学习训练效果。
AI.motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，GRPO风格的组相对更新虽然通过采样多个rollout来构建归一化学习信号，但单纯增加rollout数量并不能可靠地增强学习效果：组归一化会导致每个rollout的策略梯度特征集中到低秩、有符号的几何结构中，在聚合时发生大量符号抵消，削弱有效更新。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT），利用样本梯度的几何结构对组相对更新的系数进行重加权。具体地，从mini-batch Gram矩阵中估计主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享通道和残差通道，当符号抵消严重时自适应放大残差通道。
AI.result: 在多种面向推理的RLVR基准测试和不同模型规模上，SALT在不修改奖励模型或rollout采样过程的情况下，改善了有效更新几何结构并提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: SALT通过自适应调整组相对更新中的梯度几何结构，有效缓解了GRPO-style RLVR中因符号抵消导致的梯度退化问题，是一种轻量级且有效的即插即用改进组件。

title: ContactExplorer: Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration for General-Purpose Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in domains such as Atari games, navigation, and locomotion, where exploration can often be guided by novelty over states or dynamics. In contrast, dexterous manipulation requires rich physical hand--object interactions, but existing methods often suffer from unstable contact-based novelty signals, inefficient distance novelty signals, or reliance on task-specific priors. We propose ContactExplorer, a general exploration method for dexterous manipulation tasks. ContactExplorer represents contact as the intersection between object surface points and hand keypoints, encouraging dexterous hands to discover diverse and novel contact patterns, namely which fingers contact which object regions. It maintains a contact counter conditioned on discretized object states obtained via learned hash codes, capturing how frequently each finger interacts with different object regions. This counter is leveraged in two complementary ways: (1) to assign a count-based contact coverage reward that promotes exploration of novel contact patterns, and (2) an energy-based reaching reward that guides the agent toward under-explored contact regions. We evaluate ContactExplorer on a diverse set of dexterous manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that ContactExplorer substantially improves sample efficiency and success rates over existing exploration methods, and that the contact patterns learned with ContactExplorer transfer robustly to the real world. Project page is https://contact-explorer.github.io.

AI.tldr: ContactExplorer 提出了一种基于接触模式探索的通用强化学习方法，通过维护接触计数器来奖励新颖的接触模式并引导智能体探索未充分接触的区域，在灵巧操作任务上显著提升了样本效率和成功率，并成功迁移到真实世界。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在灵巧操作任务中面临挑战：基于状态的 novelty 信号不稳定，基于距离的 novelty 效率低，或依赖任务特定的先验知识。需要一种通用的探索方法来解决灵巧手与物体之间丰富的物理交互问题。
AI.method: ContactExplorer 将接触表示为物体表面点与手部关键点的交集，维护一个基于离散化物体状态（通过学习到的哈希码）的接触计数器。该计数器用于两种奖励：基于计数的接触覆盖率奖励（鼓励探索新接触模式）和基于能量的到达奖励（引导智能体前往未充分探索的接触区域）。
AI.result: 在多种灵巧操作任务上，ContactExplorer 相比现有探索方法显著提高了样本效率和成功率，并且学习的接触模式能够鲁棒地迁移到真实世界。
AI.conclusion: ContactExplorer 是一种通用且有效的灵巧操作探索方法，通过面向接触模式的探索机制解决了灵巧操作中的关键瓶颈，具有良好的真实世界迁移能力。

title: ATT-CR: Adaptive Triangular Transformer for Cloud Removal
summary: Cloud removal aims to accurately reconstruct the ground objects obscured by clouds in remote sensing images. Existing Transformer-based methods utilizing self-attention have shown impressive results by effectively modeling long-range dependencies in cloudy images. However, they suffer from the following issues: 1) the high computational complexity of self-attention limits scalability; 2) treating both cloudy and clean pixels as valid within the attention computation brings disturbances in subsequent layers, leading to suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Triangular Transformer for Cloud Removal (ATT-CR), a model that effectively reduces computational costs and mitigates interference from cloudy pixels. Specifically, it consists of two core components: Triangular Attention (TAN) and Feature Selected Gating Module (FSGM). TAN employs lower and upper triangular matrices to approximate Softmax attention with O(N) computational complexity, significantly reducing the computational costs. The FSGM, on the other hand, integrates with TAN to adaptively distinguish between cloudy and clean features, which minimizes the introduction of invalid information into subsequent layers. Extensive experiments on cloud removal benchmarks demonstrate that ATT-CR delivers superior performance compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 针对现有基于Transformer的云去除方法中自注意力计算复杂度高以及云像素干扰导致次优性能的问题，本文提出自适应三角Transformer（ATT-CR），通过三角注意力（TAN）实现O(N)计算复杂度，并利用特征选择门控模块（FSGM）自适应区分云与干净特征，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的云去除方法存在两个关键问题：1) 自注意力的高计算复杂度限制了模型的可扩展性；2) 在注意力计算中将云像素与干净像素同等对待，导致后续层产生干扰，性能次优。
AI.method: 提出自适应三角Transformer（ATT-CR），包含两个核心组件：1) 三角注意力（TAN），利用下三角和上三角矩阵近似Softmax注意力，实现O(N)计算复杂度，大幅降低计算成本；2) 特征选择门控模块（FSGM），与TAN协同工作，自适应区分云特征与干净特征，减少无效信息传入后续层。
AI.result: 在多个云去除基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ATT-CR相比现有方法取得了更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: ATT-CR通过三角注意力降低了计算复杂度，并通过特征选择门控模块有效减少了云像素的干扰，为遥感图像云去除任务提供了一种高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: Robust and sparse support vector machine via hybrid truncated loss for supervised classification
summary: The support vector machine (SVM) is a widely used classifier, but choosing an appropriate loss function remains difficult. Convex losses such as the hinge loss and least-squares loss are sensitive to outliers, while bounded non-convex losses often lead to high computational cost. To address this, we propose a hybrid truncated loss function ($L_{\mathrm{ht}}$) that is both sparse and bounded, and build the $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM model for single-view classification. We introduce the P-stationary point and use it to establish the first-order necessary and sufficient optimality conditions. Based on these conditions, we design an alternating direction method of multipliers with a working-set strategy that reduces computational cost and achieves global convergence. We further extend $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM to multi-view learning by adding structural information and view weights, resulting in Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM, which follows both the consensus and complementarity principles. Experiments on synthetic, real-world, and image datasets show that $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM achieves higher accuracy with fewer support vectors and better noise robustness than five single-view methods, while Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM outperforms six multi-view methods in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合截断损失函数 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$，构建了 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM 单视图分类模型及其多视图扩展 Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM，通过P-驻点理论和带工作集策略的交替方向乘子法实现高效求解，实验表明在准确率、稀疏性和鲁棒性上优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 现有SVM的凸损失函数（如合页损失、最小二乘损失）对异常值敏感，而有界非凸损失函数计算成本高，亟需一种既稀疏有界又计算高效的损失函数。
AI.method: 提出混合截断损失 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$（稀疏且有界），构建 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM；引入P-驻点概念并建立一阶最优性的充要条件；设计带工作集策略的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）实现全局收敛；将模型扩展为多视图版本 Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM，融入结构信息和视图权重，遵循共识与互补原则。
AI.result: 在合成、真实和图像数据集上，$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM相比5种单视图方法准确率更高、支持向量更少、噪声鲁棒性更强；Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM在准确率、精确率、召回率和F1-score上优于6种多视图方法。
AI.conclusion: $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$ 损失函数有效兼顾了稀疏性、有界性和计算效率，所提模型在单视图和多视图分类任务中均表现出优越性能。

title: Enhancing Multi-Robot Exploration Using Probabilistic Frontier Prioritization with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixtures
comment: Accepted: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-agent autonomous exploration is essential for applications such as environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and industrial-scale surveillance. However, effective coordination under communication constraints remains a significant challenge. Frontier exploration algorithms analyze the boundary between the known and unknown regions to determine the next-best view that maximizes exploratory gain. This article proposes an enhancement to existing frontier-based exploration algorithms by introducing a probabilistic approach to frontier prioritization. By leveraging Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model (DP-GMM) and a probabilistic formulation of information gain, the method improves the quality of frontier prioritization. The proposed enhancement, integrated into two state-of-the-art multi-agent exploration algorithms, consistently improves performance across environments of varying clutter, communication constraints, and team sizes. Simulations showcase an average gain of $10\%$ and $14\%$ for the two algorithms across all combinations. Successful deployment in real-world experiments with a dual-drone system further corroborates these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（DP-GMM）和信息增益概率公式的前沿优先级增强方法，用于提升多智能体自主探索在多障碍、通信受限等复杂环境下的效率。该方法集成到两种现有算法中，仿真平均提升10%和14%，并在双无人机真实实验中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 多智能体自主探索在环境监测、搜救和工业监控等应用中至关重要，但通信约束下的有效协调仍是一大挑战。现有前沿探索算法在前沿优先级排序上存在不足，需要更鲁棒的优先级机制来提升探索效率。
AI.method: 提出一种概率化的前沿优先级增强方法：利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（DP-GMM）对前沿区域进行聚类与建模，并结合信息增益的概率公式来量化每个前沿的探索价值，从而改进优先级排序。该方法作为增强模块集成到两种现有的多智能体探索算法中。
AI.result: 在多种环境（不同障碍密度、通信约束、团队规模）下的仿真中，两种算法分别平均提升10%和14%的探索性能；在双无人机系统的真实实验中成功验证了效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的概率化前沿优先级增强方法能够有效提升多智能体在复杂环境下的探索效率，尤其适用于通信受限场景，且具有较好的泛化性和实际部署可行性。

title: Global-Local Monte Carlo Tree Search in Vision-Language Models for Text-to-3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved significant reasoning performance in various tasks.However, there are few studies on text-to-3D indoor scene generation with LVLMs. The main challenge is that prevailing LVLM-based methods employ chain-of-thought sequential decision mechanisms that cannot revise earlier decisions, causing error propagation.In this paper, we consider the task as a planning problem constrained by spatial and layout commonsense.To solve this problem, we model it as a tree search problem with global and local trees, which differs from existing sequential decision-making approaches.In the global tree, we place each object iteratively and explore multiple attempts like humans furnishing a room, where the problem space is represented as a tree.To effectively search the tree, we propose a hierarchical scene representation and a PRM-guided MCTS method.The hierarchical representation abstracts a scene into room level, region level, floor object level, and supported object level.The PRM-guided MCTS method uses the PRM to prune unnecessary branches and the MCTS algorithm to balance exploration and exploitation to get an optimal solution with fewer attempts.In the local tree, it further decomposes the placement of each object into finer sub-steps, including the specific placement parameters.To make the whole appearance of the scene consistent, we leverage pre-trained diffusion image generative models to predict textures for all the objects in the scene.As existing benchmarks for text-to-3D indoor scene generation remain limited in scale and diversity, we collect a new large-scale diverse dataset that contains 65 scene types and 3,250 instructions with diverse sizes, layouts, and styles, named 3DTindo-bench, to better assess the capability of the state-of-the-art models. Our experiments show that our method generates more realistic 3D scenes than state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于PRM引导的MCTS树搜索方法解决文本到3D室内场景生成中的错误传播问题，通过全局树（层次化场景表示+PRM-MCTS）和局部树（细粒度放置参数）的双层搜索架构，并构建了包含65种场景类型、3250条指令的大规模数据集3DTindo-bench，实验证明该方法优于现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LVLM的方法采用链式思维顺序决策机制，无法修正早期决策，导致错误传播。文本到3D室内场景生成需要满足空间和布局常识约束，而现有方法缺乏回溯修正能力。
AI.method: 1) 将任务建模为全局树和局部树的双层树搜索问题；2) 全局树中使用层次化场景表示（房间→区域→地面物体→支撑物体）和PRM引导的MCTS方法（PRM剪枝无关分支，MCTS平衡探索与利用）；3) 局部树将每个物体的放置进一步分解为细粒度子步骤；4) 使用预训练扩散模型预测场景中所有物体的纹理以保持外观一致性；5) 构建大规模多样化数据集3DTindo-bench。
AI.result: 在自建数据集3DTindo-bench上的实验表明，该方法相比现有SOTA方法生成了更真实的3D场景。
AI.conclusion: 树搜索框架结合PRM-MCTS能有效解决顺序决策中的错误传播问题，为文本到3D室内场景生成提供了新范式。

title: Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack
summary: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona in-context learning attacks, adversarial frustration, prefill attacks, and conditional misalignment. Across several models and threat settings, we find that consistency training reduces misalignment well beyond the sycophancy and jailbreak settings studied in prior work. We also find cases of cross-threat generalization, where training against one failure mode improves robustness to another, and identify a shared residual-stream mechanism underlying ACT, MLPCT, and AttCT, while distinguishing BCT as mechanistically distinct. Our results suggest that consistency training is a flexible and extensible framework for alignment, capable of unifying defenses against a broader class of model pathologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究扩展了一致性训练的范围，引入MLP一致性训练（MLPCT）和注意力一致性训练（AttCT）两种新目标，并将其应用于四种新的安全威胁。实验表明一致性训练能有效减少多种错配问题，并展现出跨威胁泛化能力，验证了该方法作为灵活对齐框架的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有的一致性训练仅针对少数错配场景（如谄媚和越狱），尚未探索其在更广泛安全威胁下的有效性，且缺乏对模型内部表征一致性目标的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出两种新的一致性训练目标：MLPCT（匹配MLP层后激活状态）和AttCT（匹配每头注意力分布）；将一致性训练扩展到四种新威胁场景：人设上下文学习攻击、对抗性挫败、预填充攻击和条件性错配。
AI.result: 一致性训练在多种模型和威胁设置下均有效减少错配行为，并观察到跨威胁泛化现象；ACT、MLPCT和AttCT共享残差流机制，而BCT机制上有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 一致性训练是一种灵活且可扩展的对齐框架，能够统一防御更广泛类别的模型病理现象。

title: Simulation of Adaptive Running with Flexible Sports Prosthesis using Reinforcement Learning of Hybrid-link System
summary: This study proposes a reinforcement learning-based framework for adaptive running motion simulation in a unilateral transtibial amputee using a hybrid-link system that incorporates the flexibility of a leaf-spring-type sports prosthesis. The design and selection of sports prostheses typically rely on trial and error. A comprehensive whole-body dynamics analysis that accounts for interactions between human motion and prosthetic deformation can provide valuable insights for user-specific design and selection. The proposed hybrid-link system enables such analysis by integrating a Piece-wise Constant Strain (PCS) model to represent prosthetic flexibility. Based on this system, the simulation methodology generates whole-body dynamic motions of a unilateral transtibial amputee using a reinforcement learning approach. This framework integrates imitation learning based on motion capture data with accurate computation of prosthetic dynamics. Running motions are simulated under multiple virtual prosthetic stiffness conditions, and the corresponding metabolic cost of transport (COT) obtained from these simulations is analyzed. The results suggest that variations in prosthetic stiffness influence running dynamics and performance, and that COT is consistent with values reported in prior study. Our findings demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach for simulation and analysis under virtual conditions that differ from real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，利用混合连杆系统（结合了片弹簧式运动假肢的柔性）对单侧小腿截肢者的自适应跑步运动进行仿真。通过将分段常应变(PCS)模型集成到系统中以表示假肢柔性，结合模仿学习和假肢动力学精确计算，在不同虚拟假肢刚度条件下模拟跑步运动并分析代谢能量消耗(COT)，结果表明假肢刚度影响跑步动力学和性能，COT与文献报道一致。
AI.motivation: 运动假肢的设计和选择通常依赖试错法，缺乏能够全面考虑人体运动与假肢变形之间相互作用的全身动力学分析工具，这限制了对用户特定假肢设计的能力。
AI.method: 提出一种混合连杆系统，集成分段常应变(PCS)模型表征假肢柔性；基于该系统，采用强化学习方法结合运动捕捉数据的模仿学习以及假肢动力学的精确计算，生成单侧小腿截肢者的全身动态跑步运动；在多种虚拟假肢刚度条件下进行仿真。
AI.result: 假肢刚度的变化影响跑步动力学和性能；仿真得到的代谢能量消耗(COT)与先前研究报道的数值一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能够在不同于真实条件的虚拟条件下进行有效的仿真和分析，为假肢的用户特定设计和选择提供了潜在的实用工具。

title: ReSAGE-PAR: Representational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
comment: Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
summary: To address the limited diversity and data scarcity in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR), we explore image synthesis using diffusion models guided by attribute-based prompts. While this enables the controlled generation of pedestrian images, it faces two critical challenges: (i) the domain gap between high-quality pre-training data and low-resolution, non-standard surveillance crops, and (ii) the need for reliable attribute verification to prevent generative hallucinations. In this paper, we introduce a robust generate-score-autolabel pipeline called ReSAGE-PAR (REpresentational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in PAR) that bridges this domain gap and enables scalable, high-fidelity dataset expansion. First, we adapt pre-trained diffusion models to native PAR resolutions using a tailored LoRA-based Image-to-Image approach. Second, we extract vision-language alignment scores between the generated images and their conditioning prompts, utilizing a comprehensive prompting strategy that includes label-consistent and inconsistent complements. Finally, we formulate a Bayesian classifier that converts these continuous scores into reliable binary pseudo-labels. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of ReSAGE-PAR in preserving spatial priors and verifying attributes. When integrated into PAR training, ReSAGE-PAR consistently yields significant improvements-achieving gains of up to 8.7% on standard backbones and pushing state-of-the-art frameworks to new performance levels. This proves its value as an architecture-agnostic solution for scalable PAR enhancement. The complete codebase for ReSAGE-PAR is publicly available at http://www-vpu.eps.uam.es/publications/ReSAGE-PAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReSAGE-PAR，一种基于扩散模型、LoRA图像生成和视觉-语言对齐评分贝叶斯分类的生成-评分-自动标注流水线，用于解决行人属性识别中的数据稀缺和多样性不足问题，在标准骨干网络上提升达8.7%。
AI.motivation: 行人属性识别（PAR）面临数据多样性有限和标注数据稀缺的问题，现有方法难以获取高质量、多样化的训练样本。
AI.method: 采用扩散模型实现基于属性提示的图像合成；利用LoRA微调策略将预训练扩散模型适配到低分辨率监控场景；提取生成图像与条件提示之间的视觉-语言对齐分数；设计包含标签一致与不一致补全的综合性提示策略；构建贝叶斯分类器将对齐分数转化为可靠的二值伪标签。
AI.result: 在标准骨干网络上取得最高8.7%的性能提升，推动现有最先进框架达到新性能水平，且方法具有架构无关性。
AI.conclusion: ReSAGE-PAR通过生成-评分-自动标注流水线有效弥合了域差距，实现了可扩展、高保真的数据集扩充，是一种适用于PAR增强的架构无关解决方案。

title: GenAutoML: An Agentic Framework for Dynamic Architecture Generation and Optimization in Time-Series Analysis
summary: Designing neural architectures for time-series forecasting and anomaly detection remains a resource-intensive task that often requires substantial domain expertise. Traditional Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) systems typically rely on static, predefined search spaces, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse data characteristics. We present GenAutoML, an agentic framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as neural architects to bridge natural-language requirements and executable PyTorch implementations. The framework incorporates a Sandboxed Reflection Loop for autonomous code refinement and a Signature-Aware Runtime that enforces architectural consistency and execution safety. To improve robustness under non-stationary conditions, we further introduce a Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN) wrapper. Experiments on the ETTh1, ETTm1, and Weather benchmarks demonstrate that GenAutoML can dynamically generate task-specific neural architectures tailored to dataset characteristics. Among the generated models, WaveInterferenceNet achieves inference latency below 0.01 ms per sample while maintaining competitive predictive performance. By emphasizing computational efficiency, architectural adaptability, and stable optimization behavior, GenAutoML enables the creation of ultra-lightweight neural networks suitable for resource-constrained and latency-sensitive Edge AI deployments.

AI.tldr: GenAutoML 是一个基于大语言模型的智能框架，能根据自然语言需求自动生成轻量级、任务特化的时序预测与异常检测神经网络架构，通过沙盒反射循环和动态可逆实例归一化等技术，在 ETTh1、ETTm1 和 Weather 基准上生成的 WaveInterferenceNet 实现了每样本低于 0.01ms 的推理延迟，适用于资源受限的边缘 AI 部署。
AI.motivation: 传统的神经网络架构设计依赖大量领域知识且资源消耗大，现有的 AutoML 系统使用静态预定义搜索空间，难以适应多样化的数据特征，因此需要一种能动态生成任务特化架构的方法。
AI.method: 提出 GenAutoML 框架，利用 LLM 作为神经架构师将自然语言需求转化为可执行的 PyTorch 代码；引入沙盒反射循环实现自主代码精炼；设计签名感知运行时确保架构一致性与执行安全；提出动态可逆实例归一化（Dyn-RevIN）包装器以增强非平稳条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 ETTh1、ETTm1 和 Weather 基准上验证了 GenAutoML 能根据数据集特征动态生成任务特化架构；其中 WaveInterferenceNet 实现了每样本低于 0.01ms 的推理延迟，同时保持了具有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: GenAutoML 通过强调计算效率、架构适应性和稳定优化行为，能够创建超轻量级神经网络，适用于资源受限和延迟敏感的 Edge AI 部署场景。

title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution
summary: In many robotic tasks, agents must traverse a sequence of spatial regions to complete a mission. Such problems are inherently mixed discrete-continuous: a high-level action sequence and a physically feasible continuous trajectory. The resulting trajectory and action sequence must also satisfy problem constraints such as deadlines, time windows, and velocity or acceleration limits. While hybrid temporal planners attempt to address this challenge, they typically model motion using linear (first-order) dynamics, which cannot guarantee that the resulting plan respects the robot's true physical constraints. Consequently, even when the high-level action sequence is fixed, producing a dynamically feasible trajectory becomes a bi-level optimization problem. We address this problem via reinforcement learning in continuous space. We define a Markov Decision Process that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner. Our results show that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过连续空间强化学习来修正混合规划器生成的一阶运动规划，使其满足二阶动力学约束，从而弥合规划与真实执行之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 混合时序规划器通常使用线性（一阶）动力学建模运动，无法保证规划结果满足机器人真实的物理约束（如速度、加速度限制、时间窗口等），即使固定了高层动作序列，生成动力学可行的轨迹仍是一个双层优化问题。
AI.method: 定义了一个显式融入二阶解析约束的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），在连续空间中通过强化学习对混合规划器生成的一阶规划进行细化，使其满足二阶动力学约束。
AI.result: 该方法能够可靠地恢复物理可行性，有效弥合规划器初始一阶轨迹与实际执行所需动力学之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 连续空间强化学习可以作为一种有效的后处理手段，将混合规划器生成的不满足真实物理约束的一阶轨迹转化为动力学可行的轨迹，解决了离散-连续混合规划中的可行性鸿沟问题。

title: Texture-preserving implicit neural representation for Cone beam CT truncated reconstruction
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) frequently suffers from data truncation, which introduces severe artifacts and limits the effective field of view (FOV). Existing deep learning methods for truncated cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) reconstruction suffer from serious limitations, including a strict reliance on supervised ground truth and a failure to account for continuous 3D spatial truncation variations. To address these challenges, we introduce a self-supervised 3D reconstruction framework based on neural scene representations. By directly mapping spatial coordinates to radiodensity under projection supervision, our approach inherently bypasses traditional filtering and backprojection operations, thereby fundamentally eliminating truncation-induced ring artifacts while enabling robust continuous 3D data extrapolation. However, coordinate networks are susceptible to an inherent spectral bias, which leads to a severe loss of clinically vital high-frequency textures. To resolve this bottleneck, we further incorporate a physics-based iterative refinement module into the neural scene representation architecture. Leveraging the artifact-free, extrapolated volume from the coordinate network as an optimal initialization, this module progressively re-extracts and injects high-frequency structural information from the original projections back into the volume. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method successfully unifies the exceptional artifact suppression and extrapolation capabilities of neural networks with the high-fidelity detail preservation of iterative algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于神经场景表示的自监督3D重建框架，通过坐标映射直接预测辐射密度，从根本上消除截断伪影，并结合基于物理的迭代细化模块恢复高频纹理信息，在模拟和真实数据集上实现了优异的重建效果。
AI.motivation: CBCT常因数据截断产生严重伪影并限制有效FOV，现有深度学习方法依赖监督真值且无法处理连续的3D空间截断变化，亟需一种无需监督、能处理连续截变并保持高频细节的自监督重建方法。
AI.method: 采用神经场景表示实现从空间坐标到辐射密度的直接映射，在投影监督下自监督训练，绕过传统滤波反投影操作；再引入基于物理的迭代细化模块，以坐标网络输出的无伪影外推体素为初始值，从原始投影中逐步提取并注入高频结构信息。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，该方法统一了神经网络的伪影抑制与外推能力与迭代算法的高保真细节保持，实现了无截断伪影且富含高频纹理的3D重建。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功解决了CBCT截断重建中伪影去除与高频细节保持的矛盾，为临床CBCT成像提供了一种无需监督、能处理连续截变的高质量重建方案。

title: Deciphering Two Training Clocks in Grokking via Deep Linear Network Theory with Conditional ReLU Reduction
summary: Grokking suggests that fitting the training data and learning a simple underlying rule may occur on different time scales. We formalize this phenomenon by separating the fast decay of the classification loss from the slower simplification of the learned representation, and we call the resulting pair of stopping times two training clocks. For deep linear networks, we show that a post-margin gap-growth or one-step tail-contraction condition reduces the cross-entropy loss to level epsilon on a logarithmic time scale. In contrast, when layerwise weight decay is present, the induced regularization on the end-to-end map can be expressed as a Schatten-type penalty; under a sharp late-time Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz tail, this structural energy closes on a polynomial time scale. The two clocks, therefore, separate fitting from representation simplification. We then explain how the same mechanism can appear in ReLU MLPs. In regions where the activation patterns on the training set remain fixed, the network reduces to a linear model in the active coordinates. In a two-layer ReLU embedding model, chain-rule estimates further show that the classifier head can receive larger effective gradients than the embedding block under controlled downstream norms. This supports a two-stage mechanism in which the classifier fits first, while the representation continues to simplify later. We use modular addition as the main experimental setting. The deep linear theory provides the rigorous core of the analysis. But the ReLU results are formulated as conditional reductions that account for empirical behavior without claiming a global proof for nonlinear training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"双训练时钟"概念，形式化描述了分类损失快速下降与表征简化慢速发生之间的分离现象。在深度线性网络中，交叉熵损失在对数时间尺度上降低到ε水平，而结构能量在多项式时间尺度上衰减。在ReLU网络中，当激活模式固定时，网络退化为线性模型，支持"分类器先拟合，表征后简化"的两阶段机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究观察到"Grokking"现象，即模型先记忆训练数据，后泛化到简单规则，但缺乏对这一过程中不同时间尺度分离的形式化理论解释。
AI.method: 1) 定义"双训练时钟"形式化框架；2) 对深度线性网络，提出post-margin gap-growth或one-step tail-contraction条件，证明交叉熵损失在对数时间尺度收敛，引入层间权重衰减后结构能量在多项式时间尺度衰减；3) 对ReLU MLP，利用激活模式固定时退化为线性模型的性质；4) 对两层ReLU嵌入模型，通过链式法则分析分类头与嵌入层的梯度差异。
AI.result: 深度线性网络中，分类损失在对数时间尺度上降低到ε，表征简化（结构能量）在多项式时间尺度上完成。ReLU网络中，分类头接收到的有效梯度大于嵌入块，支持"分类器先拟合，表征后简化"的两阶段机制。
AI.conclusion: "双训练时钟"框架成功形式化了Grokking现象中拟合与泛化在不同时间尺度上分离的本质，深度线性网络提供了严格的理论核心，ReLU结果为实验现象提供了条件性解释。

title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 50 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Open-H-Embodiment，这是目前最大的开放医疗机器人视频与同步运动学数据集，涵盖50多家机构、多种手术机器人平台。基于该数据集，作者训练了两个基础模型：GR00T-H（首个开放视觉-语言-动作基础模型）和Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（首个多机构手术模拟世界模型），实验表明这些模型在缝合任务和手术模拟上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗机器人数据集规模小、单机构、开放程度低，限制了基础模型的发展，阻碍了自主医疗机器人的进步。
AI.method: 1) 构建Open-H-Embodiment大型开放数据集，包含50+机构、多种机器人平台（CMR Versius、da Vinci、dVRK等）的手术视频与同步运动学数据；2) 训练GR00T-H视觉-语言-动作模型；3) 训练Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator动作条件世界模型，支持多机构手术模拟。
AI.result: GR00T-H是唯一在结构化缝合基准中实现完整端到端任务完成的模型（25%试验成功率，其他模型均为0%），在29步离体缝合序列中平均成功率达64%。Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator首次实现从单一检查点支持9种机器人平台的多机构手术模拟。
AI.conclusion: 开放、大规模医疗机器人数据收集可作为关键基础设施，推动机器人学习和世界建模等领域的研究进展。

title: LoomVideo: Unifying Multimodal Inputs into Video Generation and Editing
summary: Developing unified video generation and editing models capable of interpreting interleaved multimodal inputs is a promising yet challenging frontier field. Existing unified frameworks predominantly rely on massive models (typically 13B parameters or more) and incorporate source video conditions for editing by concatenating sequence tokens. This concatenation inevitably doubles the sequence length, quadrupling the computational complexity of the self-attention mechanism and introducing prohibitive overhead. To address these bottlenecks, we present LoomVideo, a highly efficient 5B-parameter unified architecture for both video generation and editing. LoomVideo replaces the standard text encoder with a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) and employs Deepstack injection mechanism to align multi-layer MLLM features with the Diffusion Transformer (DiT). Crucially, we introduce a zero-overhead Scale-and-Add conditioning approach for video editing. By scaling and directly adding the clean source video latent to the noised target latent, this elegant design eliminates the need for token concatenation, drastically reducing computational cost while maintaining robust capabilities for complex, non-rigid edits. Furthermore, a Negative Temporal RoPE strategy is seamlessly integrated to handle multiple reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our compact 5B model achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance across comprehensive benchmarks, exhibiting exceptional superiority in e-commerce and fashion generation scenarios. Benefiting from the zero-overhead conditioning mechanism, LoomVideo achieves at least a 5.41x acceleration in inference speed compared to models of similar capabilities, paving the way for highly practical and efficient video foundation models.

AI.tldr: LoomVideo是一个5B参数的高效统一视频生成与编辑框架，通过MLLM和Deepstack注入机制对齐多模态特征，提出零开销的Scale-and-Add条件方法替代传统token拼接，并集成Negative Temporal RoPE处理多参考图像，在降低计算复杂度的同时达到SOTA性能，推理速度提升至少5.41倍。
AI.motivation: 现有统一视频生成与编辑框架依赖大规模模型（13B+），通过拼接token引入源视频条件，导致序列长度翻倍、自注意力计算复杂度呈四次方增长，带来难以承受的计算开销。亟需一种高效架构在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.method: 1) 用MLLM替换标准文本编码器，采用Deepstack注入机制对齐多层MLLM特征与DiT；2) 提出零开销的Scale-and-Add条件方法，直接对干净源视频隐变量进行缩放并加到噪声目标隐变量上，避免token拼接；3) 集成Negative Temporal RoPE策略处理多张参考图像。
AI.result: 5B参数模型在全面基准上达到SOTA或极具竞争力的性能，在电商和时尚生成场景中表现出色；受益于零开销条件机制，推理速度相比同类能力模型提升至少5.41倍。
AI.conclusion: LoomVideo以紧凑的5B参数规模实现了高效统一的视频生成与编辑，Scale-and-Add方法在零额外开销下保持了复杂非刚性编辑能力，为实用高效的视频基础模型铺平了道路。

title: TS-ICL: A Flexible Time-Indexed Foundation Model for Time Series via In-Context Learning
summary: Foundation models mark a profound paradigm shift in time series modeling, with task-specific models being superseded by general-purpose zero-shot models. Yet, current approaches primarily focus on forecasting, while real-world time series are often irregularly and partially observed, requiring models that can jointly forecast, impute missing values, and handle degraded sampling conditions. To address these challenges, we introduce TS-ICL, a novel probabilistic In-Context Learning encoder--regressor Transformer that unifies forecasting and imputation. TS-ICL formulates time series tasks as timestamp-aligned regression and naturally incorporates covariates by training on synthetic dependency structures generated from a novel causal data prior. Empirically, TS-ICL achieves a new state-of-the-art in imputation, while remaining competitive with leading forecasting foundation models across both univariate and covariate-aware benchmarks. It shows particularly strong performance in forecasting with partially observed look-back windows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TS-ICL，一种基于概率上下文学习的编码器-回归器Transformer，统一了时间序列的预测与填补任务，在填补任务上达到SOTA，在预测任务上与前沿基础模型竞争力相当，尤其擅长处理部分观测的回看窗口。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型主要聚焦于预测任务，而真实世界的时间序列常呈不规则、部分缺失状态，需要模型能够同时进行预测、填补缺失值并处理退化采样条件。
AI.method: 提出TS-ICL，一种概率型上下文学习编码器-回归器Transformer。将时间序列任务建模为时间戳对齐的回归问题，通过从新颖的因果数据先验生成的合成依赖结构来自然融入协变量。
AI.result: 在填补任务上达到新的最先进水平；在单变量和协变量感知的基准测试中与领先的预测基础模型保持竞争力；在部分观测回看窗口的预测中表现尤为出色。
AI.conclusion: TS-ICL成功统一了时间序列的预测与填补任务，证明了基础模型可以超越纯预测范式，处理更真实世界的不规则采样场景。

title: Do We Really Need Immediate Resets? Rethinking Collision Handling for Efficient Robot Navigation
summary: Should a single collision necessarily terminate an entire navigation episode? In most deep reinforcement learning (DRL) frameworks for robot navigation, this remains the standard practice: every collision immediately triggers a global environment reset and is penalized as a complete task failure. While a collision during deployment naturally indicates task failure, applying the same treatment during training prevents the agent from exploring challenging obstacle configurations, which slows learning progress in the early training phase. In this work, we challenge this convention and propose a Multi-Collision reset Budget (MCB) framework that decouples local collision termination from global environment resets, allowing the agent to retry difficult configurations within the same episode. Simulation experiments show that MCB improves early-stage learning efficiency by reaching target success-rate levels with fewer interactions, with small collision budgets producing the most consistent gains. Real-world experiments on heterogeneous robot platforms further validate the deployability of the learned policies in cluttered environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多碰撞重置预算（MCB）框架，允许机器人在导航训练中遭遇碰撞后继续重试而非立即全局重置，从而提升早期学习效率并保持策略的可部署性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度强化学习导航框架中，每次碰撞都触发全局环境重置并视为任务失败，这阻碍了智能体在训练早期探索复杂障碍物配置，拖慢学习进度。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Collision reset Budget (MCB)框架，将局部碰撞终止与全局环境重置解耦，允许智能体在同一回合内对困难配置进行重试。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明MCB能以更少交互次数达到目标成功率水平，小碰撞预算带来最一致的增益；在异构机器人平台上的真实实验验证了学得策略在杂乱环境中的可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 单次碰撞不应终止整个导航回合，MCB通过解耦碰撞终止与全局重置，有效提升了训练早期学习效率，且学得策略可迁移到真实机器人上。

title: LLM-Conditioned Synthesis of Pathological Gaits via Structured Gait-Language Representations
comment: Accepted at CVPR MOMA Workshop 2026 and selected for spotlight presentation at the workshop
summary: Pathological gait datasets remain scarce due to privacy, recruitment, cost, and movement variability. Our work presents a multimodal LLM-guided framework for pathology-aware 3D gait data synthesis from structured textual descriptions. The proposed method generates fixed-length synthetic skeleton-based gait sequences for pathological gait classification tasks. The framework combines motion tokenisation, pathology-aware language conditioning, LLM-based semantic augmentation, and language-to-gait generation. A key contribution is the proposed pathological tokeniser, which is designed to preserve pathology-specific motion characteristics during discrete representation learning. Experiments suggest that the proposed synthetic sequences improve downstream classification for recurrent classifiers when combined with real data. The best result is obtained using a GRU classifier trained with real and synthetic samples, achieving 92.77\% accuracy under a leave-one-subject-out protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态大语言模型引导的框架，用于从结构化文本描述生成病理感知的3D步态数据，通过病理标记器保留病理特征，结合真实数据训练GRU分类器达到92.77%准确率。
AI.motivation: 病理步态数据集因隐私、招募、成本和运动变异性等问题而非常稀缺，现有数据不足以支撑有效的病理步态分类研究。
AI.method: 提出多模态LLM引导框架，包含运动标记化、病理感知语言条件化、LLM语义增强和语言到步态生成四个组件。核心创新是病理标记器，在离散表示学习过程中保留病理特定的运动特征，生成固定长度的合成骨架步态序列。
AI.result: 合成数据与真实数据结合训练GRU分类器，在留一受试者交叉验证协议下达到92.77%的分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的合成序列能够有效提升循环分类器的下游分类性能，验证了LLM引导的病理步态数据合成方法的有效性。

title: When Denser Credit Is Not Enough: Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Training
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Recent group-based methods such as GiGPO improve over GRPO by constructing step-level advantages at repeated anchor states. However, we show that such dense credit can be statistically unreliable: under limited rollouts, rare but lucky actions may receive overly large advantages, producing divergent anchor bias and late-stage training oscillation. We propose Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ECPO), a critic-free policy optimization algorithm that calibrates step-level credit before policy updates. ECPO combines Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage, which groups rollouts by canonical actions and shrinks low-count estimates, with Variance-Gated Credit Weighting, which suppresses anchor states dominated by within-action noise. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that ECPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving GiGPO by +5.2/+7.3 success points on ALFWorld/WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B while adding only 0.1% additional advantage-computation overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECPO算法，通过证据校准的动作优势（ECAA）和方差门控信用加权（VGCW）机制，在无需批评模型的情况下为LLM智能体提供更可靠的步骤级信用分配，在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上显著优于GRPO/GiGPO等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组的强化学习方法（如GiGPO）在稀疏延迟奖励下通过锚点状态构建步骤级优势，但有限采样下罕见但幸运的动作可能获得过大优势，导致锚点偏差和训练后期振荡。
AI.method: ECPO包含两个核心组件：1) 证据校准的动作优势（ECAA）：按规范动作对rollout分组，对低计数估计进行收缩；2) 方差门控信用加权（VGCW）：抑制被组内噪声主导的锚点状态。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B评估，ECPO一致优于强基线；在ALFWorld/WebShop上相比GiGPO分别提高+5.2/+7.3个成功点，且额外优势计算开销仅0.1%。
AI.conclusion: ECPO通过校准步骤级信用分配有效解决了组基方法的锚点偏差问题，是一种高效且轻量的免批评策略优化算法。

title: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception
summary: Recent advances in robot imitation learning have produced powerful visuomotor policies that manipulate diverse objects from visual inputs. However, monocular observations lack depth information, which is critical for precise manipulation in cluttered or geometrically complex scenes. Explicit depth maps and point clouds are often noisy and fragile in real-world manipulation. We introduce StereoPolicy, a visuomotor policy learning framework that directly leverages synchronized stereo image pairs to improve geometric reasoning without constructing explicit 3D representations. StereoPolicy processes each image with pretrained 2D vision encoders and fuses left-right features through a cross-attention-based Stereo Transformer, capturing spatial correspondence and disparity cues implicitly. The framework integrates with diffusion-based and pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, delivering consistent improvements over RGB, RGB-D, point cloud, and multi-view baselines across three simulation benchmarks and seven real-robot tabletop and bimanual mobile manipulation tasks. Our results show that stereo vision bridges 2D pretrained representations and 3D geometric understanding for robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: StereoPolicy 是一种基于立体视觉的机器人模仿学习框架，通过直接处理同步立体图像对（而非显式3D表示）来提升几何推理能力，在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中优于RGB、RGB-D、点云和多视角基线方法。
AI.motivation: 单目观测缺乏深度信息，在杂乱或几何复杂场景中难以实现精确操作；显式深度图和点云在真实操作中往往噪声大且脆弱。需要一种能有效利用立体信息但避免显式3D重建的方法。
AI.method: 使用预训练2D视觉编码器分别处理左右图像，通过基于交叉注意力的 Stereo Transformer 融合左右特征，隐式捕获空间对应和视差线索。该框架可集成到扩散策略和预训练VLA策略中。
AI.result: 在三个模拟基准和七项真实机器人桌面及双臂移动操作任务中，StereoPolicy 一致优于RGB、RGB-D、点云和多视角基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 立体视觉能够弥合2D预训练表示与3D几何理解之间的鸿沟，为机器人操作提供有效的几何推理能力。

title: ReCache: Learning Budget-Aware Caching Schedules for Diffusion Models via REINFORCE
summary: Modern diffusion models generate high-quality images and videos, but their iterative denoising process makes inference expensive. Feature caching accelerates sampling by reusing or predicting intermediate activations across neighboring denoising steps, exploiting the redundancy of computations along the reverse trajectory. In this work, we focus on the caching schedule: selecting which denoising steps should be fully recomputed. Existing schedules are either fixed (e.g. uniform) or chosen adaptively from per-step error heuristics; in both cases, the actual compute cost is a side-effect of hand-tuned thresholds rather than a quantity the user can specify. We propose ReCache, which inverts this: given a target budget k, it learns the recomputation schedule that maximizes generation quality, turning compute into a directly controllable input. ReCache trains via policy gradients, sidestepping backpropagation through full diffusion inference, and uses no labelled data. Generations from uncached inference serve as matching targets, paired with a reward for generation quality. ReCache is compatible with any caching mechanism, including feature reuse and feature forecasting; for each mechanism, a single trained policy adapts across computational budgets at inference time. ReCache consistently outperforms scheduling baselines: under a $\times5.04$ FLOPs reduction on FLUX, it reduces LPIPS by 31% (from 0.456 to 0.316) compared to DiCache; on Wan 2.1 at a $\sim \times2.6$ speedup, it drops LPIPS by 65% (from 0.480 to 0.169) and boosts the VBench score by 7% (5.6 points, from 70.4 to 76.0) over uniform HiCache. Code is available at https://github.com/thecrazymage/ReCache.

AI.tldr: ReCache通过策略梯度学习最优重计算调度，将计算预算作为直接可控输入，在给定FLOPs或速度目标下最大化生成质量，兼容多种缓存机制，显著优于现有调度基线。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型特征缓存的调度策略要么是固定的（如均匀采样），要么基于逐步骤误差启发式自适应选择，实际计算开销是手工调参的副产品，用户无法直接指定计算预算。本文旨在反转这一范式，让用户直接控制计算成本，学习在给定预算下最大化生成质量的调度策略。
AI.method: 提出ReCache，使用策略梯度训练一个重计算调度策略，以目标计算预算k为输入，输出哪些去噪步骤应完全重计算。训练时以无缓存的完整推理生成结果作为匹配目标，结合生成质量的奖励信号，无需任何标注数据，且避免通过完整扩散推理反向传播。该方法兼容特征复用和特征预测等多种缓存机制。
AI.result: 在FLUX上实现5.04倍FLOPs降低，LPIPS相比DiCache降低31%（从0.456到0.316）；在Wan 2.1上实现约2.6倍加速，LPIPS相比均匀HiCache降低65%（从0.480到0.169），VBench分数提升7%（5.6分，从70.4到76.0）。
AI.conclusion: ReCache首次将扩散模型推理的计算预算转化为直接可控的输入，通过强化学习学习最优调度策略，在多种缓存机制和多种计算预算下均优于现有调度基线，为扩散模型的高效推理提供了新的可控计算范式。

title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
summary: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit predictions for test errors and representation alignment. Our analysis shows that the impact of pre-training on LoRA is summarized by an effective noise term, from which we derive prescriptions for the optimal pre-training procedure. We also demonstrate a regime with a mismatch between the value of the test error and representation quality, and propose an application of our theory to active fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了注意力模型中低秩适配（LoRA）的高维统计理论，解析了预训练与微调之间的相互作用。通过构建单头注意力层的可解框架，先进行大规模数据预训练，再基于有限数据进行秩一LoRA更新。在高维极限下，两阶段可用有限序参数集精确刻画，得到测试误差和表示对齐的显式预测。分析表明预训练对LoRA的影响可归结为有效噪声项，由此推导出最优预训练策略。还发现了测试误差与表示质量不匹配的机制，并提出了主动微调的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA研究缺乏严格的理论分析，尤其是预训练与微调之间相互作用的统计机制尚不明确。作者旨在建立高维统计理论框架，从理论上理解LoRA在注意力模型中的行为，并为最优预训练策略提供指导。
AI.method: 采用高维统计物理方法，构建单头注意力层的可解模型：先在大数据上预训练，再在小数据上进行秩一LoRA微调。在高维极限下利用随机矩阵理论和消息传递技术，将两阶段动力学简化为有限序参数集的封闭方程，实现测试误差和表示质量的精确刻画。
AI.result: 预训练对LoRA的影响可视为一个有效噪声项；基于该发现推导出最优预训练过程的显式条件；发现了测试误差与表示质量（表示对齐）之间存在不匹配的相变区域；提出了基于该理论的主动微调策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了注意力模型中LoRA的高维统计理论，揭示了预训练作为有效噪声影响微调的内在机制，为实际应用中的预训练设计和主动微调策略提供了理论依据。

title: SEDualVLN: A Spatially-Enhanced Dual-System for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) approaches have currently followed two primary paradigms: the end-to-end Vision-Language Model (VLM) policy fine-tuned on navigation trajectories to directly predict actions, and the zero-shot modular pipeline integrating pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for training-free generalization to unseen environments. However, end-to-end methods struggle with long-horizon navigation and lack dynamic reasoning, whereas zero-shot methods are constrained by limited spatial grounding for reliable planning and also require substantial reasoning time. To bridge this gap, we introduce SEDualVLN, a spatially-enhanced dual-system VLN framework. System 1 is a VLM model enhanced with both global and local spatial awareness, used for action generation. System 2 integrates a general MLLM with a mapping module, wherein the MLLM plans waypoints by leveraging top-down views of the real-time 3D map alongside streams of rendered path images. Both systems leverage different forms of spatial enhancement to cultivate the agent's sense of direction in VLN tasks. Ultimately, they cooperate to complete the navigation task through a fast-slow coordinated approach. SEDualVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on VLN-CE benchmarks, and further ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of each system and module.

AI.tldr: 提出SEDualVLN，一种空间增强的双系统VLN框架，结合快速VLM系统（系统1）和慢速MLLM系统（系统2），通过快慢协调实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端VLN方法缺乏动态推理且难以处理长程导航，零样本模块化方法空间定位能力有限且推理耗时长，两者各有局限。
AI.method: 双系统框架：系统1为增强全局与局部空间感知的VLM，用于动作生成；系统2集成通用MLLM与地图模块，利用实时3D地图俯视图和路径图像规划路点，通过快慢协同完成导航。
AI.result: 在VLN-CE基准上达到SOTA性能，消融实验验证了各系统和模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 空间增强的双系统协同方法有效弥补了端到端与零样本范式各自的不足，提升了VLN任务中的方向感知与导航表现。

title: FontFusion: Enhancing Generative Text in Diffusion Models with Typographic Conditioning
summary: Typography generation in diffusion models faces a persistent trade-off: enabling precise font control typically degrades text legibility, while maintaining readability often sacrifices typographic fidelity. We present FontFusion, a plug-and-play conditioning framework for Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures that resolves this dilemma through three core innovations: (1) a hierarchical token representation establishing explicit text-font relationships at multiple granularities, (2) position-aware embeddings creating spatial bindings between typography and image content, and (3) a multi-level token dropping strategy improving both computational efficiency and generalization to unseen fonts. Our systematic evaluation of font embedding spaces reveals that a dual encoder combining DeepFont and DINOv2 outperforms any single encoder for typography tasks. FontFusion demonstrates 76% relative improvement on challenging decorative fonts over single-encoder baselines and font consistency gains exceeding approximately 68-76% over unconditioned models, while integrating into existing DiT architectures without retraining.

AI.tldr: FontFusion是一个即插即用的条件框架，通过层次化token表示、位置感知嵌入和多级token丢弃策略，解决了扩散模型中字体控制与文本可读性之间的权衡问题，在DiT架构上实现了76%的装饰性字体性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中的字体生成面临持久性权衡：精确的字体控制通常会降低文本可读性，而保持可读性又往往牺牲字体保真度。现有方法难以同时兼顾这两个方面。
AI.method: 提出FontFusion框架，包含三个核心创新：(1) 层次化token表示，建立多粒度的显式文本-字体关系；(2) 位置感知嵌入，创建版式与图像内容之间的空间绑定；(3) 多级token丢弃策略，提升计算效率和未见字体的泛化能力。此外，系统评估发现DeepFont和DINOv2双编码器组合优于单一编码器。
AI.result: 在装饰性字体上相比单编码器基线提升76%，字体一致性相比无条件模型提升约68-76%，无需重新训练即可集成到现有DiT架构。
AI.conclusion: FontFusion有效解决了字体控制与文本可读性之间的权衡问题，为扩散模型中的版式生成提供了即插即用的解决方案，且具有良好的泛化能力和计算效率。

title: Addressing Imbalance in Multi-Label Data via Label-Specific Distance-based Oversampling
summary: The complex imbalanced label distribution poses a crucial challenge to multi-label classification, as most classifiers are biased towards the majority class and high-frequent labels. Oversampling is an efficient and flexible solution that augments instances to provide a more balanced training dataset for multi-label classifiers. Most existing oversampling methods create synthetic instances in a heuristic way that essentially relies on neighborhood information retrieved using Euclidean distance within the entire feature space. However, they fail to consider the varying semantic relevance of features to different labels, leading to label inconsistency among proximate neighbors and further introducing label confusion and overfitting to synthetic instances. To overcome the above issue, we propose a novel sampling approach called Label-Specific Distance-based Multi-Label Oversampling (LSDMLO) that creates more useful and well-labeled synthetic instances to address the imbalance in multi-label datasets. LSDMLO derives the label-specific distance to identify label-consistent neighbors based on the weighted pertinent feature space, which facilitates selecting seed instances that express more label correlations in boundary areas and generating synthetic instances aligned with the label distribution of original data. The comprehensive experiments verify that the proposed LSDMLO outperforms the state-of-the-art multi-label sampling approaches under various base classifiers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为LSDMLO的多标签过采样方法，通过标签特定距离在加权特征空间中识别标签一致的近邻，从而生成更有用且标签一致的合成实例，有效解决了多标签分类中因特征语义相关性差异导致的标签不一致问题，在多个基分类器上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于欧氏距离的过采样方法忽视了特征对不同标签的语义相关性差异，导致近邻标签不一致，引入标签混淆和过拟合问题。
AI.method: 提出LSDMLO方法，通过标签特定距离在加权的相关特征空间中识别标签一致的近邻，选择表达更多标签相关性的边界区域种子实例，生成与原始数据标签分布一致的合成实例。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，LSDMLO在多种基分类器下均优于当前最先进的多标签采样方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用标签特定距离替代全局欧氏距离进行近邻选择，能有效提升合成实例的质量和标签一致性，从而更好地处理多标签不平衡问题。

title: Safety-Critical Adaptive Impedance Control via Nonsmooth Control Barrier Functions under State and Input Constraints
summary: Safe physical interaction is critical for deploying robotic manipulators in human-robot interaction and contact-rich tasks, where uncertainty, external forces, and actuator limitations can compromise both performance and safety. We propose an online adaptive impedance control framework that enforces joint-state safety while achieving compliant interaction under uncertain dynamics. The approach combines a quadratic-program-based safety filter with a novel composed position-velocity non-smooth control barrier function (NCBF), enabling joint position and velocity constraints to be enforced through a unified relative-degree-one barrier. Unknown dynamics are compensated online using an interval type-2 fuzzy logic system, while actuator torque limits are handled through soft constraints with exact penalty recovery of feasible solutions. A disturbance-observer-enhanced safety mechanism improves robustness against modelling errors and external interaction forces. Using composite Lyapunov analysis, we prove forward invariance of the safe set and the uniform ultimately boundedness of the impedance-tracking error. Simulations on a 7-DOF manipulator with severe parametric uncertainty and external interaction wrenches demonstrate safe constraint satisfaction and robust impedance tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种在线自适应阻抗控制框架，结合基于二次规划的安全滤波器与新颖的复合位置-速度非光滑控制障碍函数（NCBF），通过区间二型模糊逻辑系统补偿未知动力学，并利用扰动观测器增强鲁棒性，在7自由度机械臂仿真中验证了安全约束满足与鲁棒阻抗跟踪。
AI.motivation: 在机器人与人交互及接触密集任务中，不确定性、外部力和执行器限制会同时影响性能与安全性，亟需一种既能实现柔顺交互又能保障关节状态安全的方法。
AI.method: 将基于二次规划的安全滤波器与复合位置-速度非光滑控制障碍函数结合，实现统一相对度一的约束；使用区间二型模糊逻辑系统在线补偿未知动力学；通过软约束与精确罚函数恢复处理执行器力矩限制；引入扰动观测器增强对建模误差和外部力的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在7自由度机械臂仿真中，面对严重参数不确定性和外部交互力/力矩，该方法成功实现了安全约束满足与鲁棒阻抗跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 通过复合Lyapunov分析证明了安全集的前向不变性与阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界性，验证了所提框架在不确定动态下兼顾安全与柔顺交互的有效性。

title: VZCrash: A Large-Scale IMU Dataset of Ego-Vehicle Crashes
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). VZCrash is publicly available at this URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vzc-research-chapter/VZCrash
summary: We introduce VZCrash, the largest publicly available dataset of real-world vehicle collision data featuring Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) telemetry. The dataset contains more than 31,000 validated crashes and 158,000 negative samples, including hard cases and distractors. Each sample includes acceleration and angular velocity at 100 Hz, and GPS speed at 1 Hz. Events in VZCrash were captured by devices installed on a fleet of 73,010 commercial vehicles of different sizes driving in the United States over the span of several years. We also present an extensive experimental study enabled by the volume of the dataset. We first benchmark several different approaches, from a simple threshold-based heuristic to state-of-the-art deep learning models. Then, we present an experiment demonstrating the importance of scaling data to train high-quality crash detection models, and we show that scale is especially important when these models need to be deployed into a real-world environment.

AI.tldr: VZCrash是最大的公开真实车辆碰撞数据集，包含超过31,000个已验证的碰撞事件和158,000个负样本（含困难样本和干扰项），每个样本包含100Hz的加速度/角速度和1Hz的GPS速度数据，来自73,010辆不同尺寸商用车辆多年行驶记录。论文还进行了广泛实验，从简单阈值方法到SOTA深度学习模型，并证明了数据规模对于训练高质量碰撞检测模型的关键作用，尤其是在实际部署场景中。
AI.motivation: 现有真实世界车辆碰撞数据严重缺乏，尤其是包含IMU遥测数据的大规模公开数据集，限制了碰撞检测算法的发展与评估。
