AI.method: 构建了包含31,000+碰撞事件和158,000负样本的大规模IMU数据集VZCrash，并在该数据集上对多种方法（从阈值启发式到SOTA深度学习模型）进行系统基准测试，同时设计了数据规模缩放实验。
AI.result: VZCrash是目前最大的公开真实车辆碰撞数据集；实验表明数据规模对训练高质量碰撞检测模型至关重要，尤其在实际部署场景中。
AI.conclusion: VZCrash数据集可有效支持碰撞检测研究，且数据规模是提升模型实际部署性能的关键因素。

title: Short paper: Models in the dark -- Rectification and erasure under GDPR in ML supply chains
comment: accepted for presentation at Annual Privacy Forum 2026
summary: The rights to rectification and erasure, as established under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), are central to protecting individuals' privacy. However, their effective enforcement in machine learning (ML) systems remains challenging. Existing work has largely addressed these rights from either a legal or a technical perspective in isolation and disregards the fact that models are produced in complex supply chains involving multiple actors across development, distribution, and deployment. This paper presents a holistic survey of challenges in implementing the rights to rectification and erasure in ML models. Drawing on academic literature and guidance from data protection authorities, we find that many GDPR requirements cannot yet be technically met in practice. Our findings further suggest that issues arising in ML supply chains are insufficiently addressed in research. To tackle this gap, we introduce the notion of models in the dark -- derived models created further downstream in an ML chain without sufficient transparency or traceability -- and analyse the urgent challenges posed by this phenomenon. By adopting an interdisciplinary perspective, this work contributes to bridging the gap between legal requirements and the technical implementation of data subject rights in ML, ultimately supporting the development of trustworthy artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文全面调研了机器学习模型中实现GDPR纠正权和删除权的挑战，发现许多法律要求在实践中尚无法从技术上实现，并提出了"暗箱模型"这一概念来指代ML供应链中缺乏透明度和可追溯性的衍生模型。
AI.motivation: GDPR规定的纠正权和删除权对保护个人隐私至关重要，但现有工作仅从法律或技术孤立视角处理这些问题，忽视了ML模型在复杂供应链中涉及多个参与者的实际情况。
AI.method: 基于学术文献和数据保护机构的指导进行综合调研，采用跨学科视角分析法律要求与技术实现之间的差距。
AI.result: 许多GDPR要求在技术上尚无法实现；ML供应链中的问题在研究中也未得到充分关注；"暗箱模型"现象带来了紧迫挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过跨学科视角弥合了ML中数据主体权利的法律要求与技术实现之间的差距，支持可信人工智能的发展。

title: Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory
summary: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）的门控机制，用于机器人长期记忆的选择性存储。该方法利用V-JEPA-2的语义丰富潜空间计算惊讶值，选择高用处的记忆进行存储。结合门控情节记忆与4D场景图空间记忆，在机器人问答任务中比先前方法提升≥12%，并在事件分割任务中以无监督因果方法超越监督和非因果方法。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人面临长期记忆存储受限的问题，无法存储所有过往事件，需要一种选择性记忆机制来保留对未来任务有用的信息。然而未来任务通常是未知的，因此需要一种不依赖具体任务先验的通用记忆选择方法。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）作为记忆形成的门控机制；在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富、部署无关的潜空间中计算惊讶值；将门控情节记忆（gated episodic memory）与4D场景图空间记忆（4D scene graph-based spatial memory）相结合。
AI.result: 在机器人问答基准测试中，该方法在时间、空间和二元问题上均比先前机器人记忆方法提升≥12%；在事件分割任务中，使用无监督因果方法超越了监督和非因果方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯惊讶作为一种无监督、不依赖任务先验的记忆选择机制，能有效提升通用机器人在下游任务中的表现，尤其在长时间跨度的语义理解和事件分割方面具有显著优势。

title: Knowledge Distillation for Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generation models are highly expressive but computationally intensive, motivating effective model compression. Knowledge distillation (KD) is a natural approach for model compression and has been widely studied in language modeling, yet its behavior in visual AR generation remains underexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of distillation strategies for AR image models. Our analysis shows that while standard distillation can yield meaningful gains, recent methods developed for language do not directly transfer to images: long decoding horizons and visual token ambiguity make teacher supervision unreliable especially under student-conditioned contexts. To address this, we propose VarKD, a distillation framework for visual autoregressive models that distills on student samples while selectively applying teacher supervision and reducing token-level ambiguity. Experiments on ImageNet across multiple AR backbones show that VarKD consistently outperforms prior distillation baselines, narrowing the gap to large-scale models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究视觉自回归图像生成模型的知识蒸馏策略，发现语言模型的蒸馏方法不能直接迁移到视觉AR任务，并提出VarKD框架——在学生样本上进行蒸馏，同时选择性应用教师监督并减少token级歧义，在ImageNet上多个AR骨干网络中一致优于现有蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成模型计算量巨大，需要有效的模型压缩。知识蒸馏在语言建模中已被广泛研究，但其在视觉AR生成任务中的行为尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出VarKD蒸馏框架，核心是在学生自身生成的样本上进行蒸馏，同时选择性应用教师监督（避免学生-conditioned上下文下教师监督不可靠的问题），并减少token级别的歧义性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上多个AR骨干网络（多种backbone）上，VarKD一致优于先前的蒸馏基线，缩小了与大模型之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型上的蒸馏方法不能直接迁移到视觉AR生成任务，原因是长解码视野和视觉token歧义导致教师监督在student-conditioned上下文中不可靠；VarKD通过针对这些问题的设计，有效实现了视觉AR模型的知识蒸馏。

title: Dead Directions: Geometric Singular Learning
summary: Singular learning theory and information geometry have studied the same parameter spaces in mostly separate vocabularies: the former computes Bayesian invariants in resolved coordinates, the latter works in original coordinates under a non-degeneracy assumption that overparameterised models routinely violate. We bridge them through one primitive, the dead direction: a unit vector along which the Fisher metric degenerates, equivalently a tangent to the analytic singular set with a definite KL order, set by how fast the KL divergence vanishes. The two readings name the same vector; our central move shows its KL order is recoverable as the decay rate of the directional Fisher curvature approaching the singularity, in original parameter coordinates and without a Hironaka resolution. A selection rule on smooth fibres translates this rate into Watanabe's single-direction contribution to the real log canonical threshold, and we extend the recovery to multi-component crossings, multiplicity $m$, the singular fluctuation $ν$ (universal in the KL order for 1D directions), prior-RLCT shifts, and tempered posteriors. We then lift this rate to a deep network: a multi-layer K-FAC factorisation writes each Fisher block as a product of activation- and gradient-side rates with a duality between them, instantiated at modern-network primitives (residual streams, layer normalisation, attention). A quotient theorem carries the rate to the gauge quotient $Θ/G$ under gradient flow on a $G$-invariant metric; SGD qualifies, standard Adam does not, and we construct a $G$-equivariant Adam-family preconditioner (DDCAdam) that does. The bridge yields a parameter-coordinate handle on singular geometry, closed-form per-architecture predictions, and a trajectory-rate readout of Watanabe's triple $(λ, m, ν)$ from one checkpoint's forward and backward passes, without posterior sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过“死方向”这一原始概念，将奇异学习理论与信息几何统一起来：在原始参数坐标下，Fisher度量的退化方向携带KL阶信息，该信息可转化为Watanabe实对数规范阈值的单方向贡献，并进一步推广到多分量交叉、多重性、奇异涨落等情形。作者将此方法扩展到深度网络，利用K-FAC分解将Fisher块分解为激活侧与梯度侧率的乘积，并提出DDCAdam优化器以保留几何结构。最终，该方法可从单一检查点的前向与后向传播中直接读出Watanabe三元组(λ, m, ν)，无需后验采样。
AI.motivation: 奇异学习理论与信息几何分别用不同的词汇研究同一参数空间：前者在解析坐标下计算贝叶斯不变量，后者在原始坐标下工作但依赖非退化假设，而过参数化模型经常违反这一假设。本文旨在搭建两者之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 定义死方向为Fisher度量的退化方向，同时是解析奇异集的切方向且具有确定的KL阶。证明其KL阶可通过原始坐标下趋近奇异点的方向Fisher曲率衰减率恢复。通过平滑纤维上的选择规则，将此率转化为Watanabe的单方向实对数规范阈值贡献，并扩展到多分量交叉、多重性m、奇异涨落ν、先验-RLCT偏移及温度后验。在深度网络中，利用K-FAC分解将Fisher块分解为激活侧与梯度侧率的乘积，提出DDCAdam优化器。
AI.result: 建立了原始参数坐标下奇异几何的可操作框架，实现了每架构的闭式预测，以及从单一检查点的前向与后向传播中直接读出Watanabe三元组(λ, m, ν)，无需后验采样。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功桥接了奇异学习理论与信息几何，为深度网络的奇异几何提供了原始坐标下的可操作工具，使贝叶斯不变量的计算无需解析奇点解析或后验采样，并设计了可保留几何结构的优化器。

title: AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticRL框架，利用多模态GPT智能体自动设计奖励函数、优化策略并实现无人机导航任务的策略选择与部署，经闭环迭代提升策略性能71%，真实世界成功率达91%。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在自主导航中依赖人工设计奖励函数和反复手动调参，耗时长且难以保证任务成功率，亟需提升奖励设计与策略优化的自动化程度。
AI.method: 使用多模态GPT智能体解析任务信息与视觉场景，生成奖励函数，基于PPO训练策略；智能体作为评审者评估策略并生成诊断反馈，闭环迭代优化奖励函数；推理阶段利用真实图像与自然语言任务信息自动识别场景并选择对应策略。
AI.result: 闭环优化使策略性能提升71%；真实世界成功率为91%，sim-to-real准确率为94%。
AI.conclusion: AgenticRL有效提升了无人机导航任务中奖励设计的自主性与策略鲁棒性，实现了从仿真到真实环境的高效迁移。

title: HyperVis: Continuous Latent Visual Relational Graphs on the Lorentz Hyperboloid for Compositional Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with compositional reasoning that requires understanding inter-object relationships. A natural remedy is to inject explicit scene graph triplets $\langle s, p, o \rangle$ from an off-the-shelf scene graph generator (SGG), but we show this backfires: discrete text labels collide with the continuous visual modality, degrading GQA accuracy from 60.38\% to 58.86\%. We propose \textbf{HyperVis}, which bypasses the SGG semantic bottleneck entirely. From $N$ class-agnostic region proposals, we compute a dense $O(N^2)$ visual relation tensor via spatially-biased cross-attention, project it onto a Lorentz hyperboloid, and enforce hierarchy through spatial physics, namely IoA-driven entailment cones and exterior-angle repulsion. We discover that HyperVis contributes in two complementary ways: (1) as a \emph{training-time regularizer}, the hyperbolic relational losses shape LoRA representations that improve generative VQA (GQA 61.03\% vs.\ 57.21\% for LoRA fine-tuning without relational losses, recovering and surpassing the baseline); and (2) as an \emph{inference-time relational encoder}, hyperbolic prefix tokens boost discriminative compositional scoring (SugarCrepe 79.94\%, $+$6.25pp over baseline). The learned curvature stabilises at $κ{=}4.0$, an order of magnitude above prior hyperbolic VLMs where $κ$ typically collapses toward zero, indicating that continuous visual features genuinely require the exponential volume of strongly curved space. A controlled Euclidean ablation confirms this decomposition: the relational pipeline regularises LoRA comparably in flat space (GQA 60.81\%), but the compositionality gain is specifically hyperbolic (SugarCrepe $+$4.58pp over Euclidean), with entailment loss ${\sim}6{\times}$ higher in Euclidean training. Codes are available at TBA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperVis，通过将视觉关系建模为双曲空间中的张量，避免了场景图生成器的语义瓶颈，在训练时作为正则化器提升LoRA微调性能，在推理时作为关系编码器提升组合性推理能力，并发现强曲率空间对连续视觉特征至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM难以理解对象间的组合关系；直接注入场景图三元组会导致离散文本标签与连续视觉模态的语义冲突，反而降低性能。
AI.method: 从N个类无关区域提议出发，通过空间偏置交叉注意力计算密集的O(N²)视觉关系张量，将其投影到洛伦兹双曲面，并通过IoA驱动的包含锥（entailment cones）和外角排斥（exterior-angle repulsion）实施空间物理层次约束。
AI.result: 作为训练时正则化器：GQA 61.03% vs LoRA微调基线57.21%；作为推理时关系编码器：SugarCrepe 79.94%，比基线高6.25个百分点。学习曲率稳定在κ=4.0，比先前双曲VLM高一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉特征需要强曲率双曲空间的指数级体积；关系管线的正则化效果在欧氏空间中可复现，但组合性增益是双曲空间特有的。

title: Steering Vectors are an Adversarial Attack Surface
summary: Activation steering has become a popular way to control Large Language Model (LLM) behavior without fine-tuning. Since the technique is plug-and-play, users share datasets and precomputed vectors to steer model activations. However, we show that a \emph{stealth data poisoning attack} silently compromises this pipeline. By substituting $4{-}6\%$ of tokens in the steering dataset, an attacker can silently align the resulting vector with an anti-refusal direction. This jailbreaks the target model while preserving the intended steering effect on benign prompts. Under this threat model, a malicious actor can distribute an apparently safe bundle containing texts, vectors, and weights, alongside an equivalence certificate that the end-user can verify. We test the attack on two open-weight model families and eight model-attribute combinations, observing that poisoned vectors reach an absolute attack success rate (ASR) of $20{-}55\%$, $+19\%$ to $+51\%$ over a clean reference. Finally, we find that a refusal-direction orthogonalization defense can recover ${\approx}82\%$ of the ASR gap without harming benign behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种针对激活导向管道的隐秘数据投毒攻击：攻击者只需替换导向数据集中4-6%的token，就能使生成的导向向量与拒绝方向对齐，从而破解目标模型，同时保留对良性提示的预期导向效果。在多个模型上，投毒向量的攻击成功率（ASR）达到20-55%，比干净参考高出19-51%。一种拒绝方向正交化防御可以恢复约82%的ASR差距。
AI.motivation: 激活导向技术因无需微调即可控制LLM行为而流行，用户共享数据集和预计算向量。但这种即插即用的流水线存在安全隐患——攻击者可以通过投毒数据来暗中破坏模型的拒绝安全机制。
AI.method: 攻击者通过替换导向数据集中4-6%的token来投毒，使得生成的导向向量与抗拒绝方向对齐；同时提供等价性证书让用户验证，但证书无法检测投毒。防御方法采用拒绝方向正交化。
AI.result: 在两种开源模型家族、8个模型-属性组合上，投毒向量达到20-55%的绝对攻击成功率，比干净参考高出19-51%。正交化防御可恢复约82%的ASR差距且不影响良性行为。
AI.conclusion: 激活导向管道存在隐秘的数据投毒攻击风险，恶意攻击者可分发看似安全的捆绑包（文本、向量、权重及等价性证书），实际却包含后门。正交化防御能部分缓解但无法完全消除威胁。

title: OSCAR: Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics
summary: We present OSCAR, a precise action-conditioned video world model that generalizes across different robot embodiments and enables robot policy evaluation. Existing video world models face three main challenges for real-world robot evaluation: limited scenario diversity in current robot training datasets, imprecise action following, and poor generalization across embodiments for broad adoption. We tackle these challenges from two perspectives. At its core is a large-scale standardized data pipeline that curates, filters, and deduplicates broad robotics and egocentric human datasets, yielding a clean joint-training dataset that spans diverse tasks, scenarios, actions, and robot embodiments. To condition the video model, we adopt 2D kinematic skeleton rendering as a unified conditioning representation that generalizes across different robot arms or even human hands. We finetune the Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model on a single GH200 GPU. Our model achieves significant improvement on action following, appearance quality, and motion consistency, compared to existing baselines, which either have a much larger model size or require more GPUs. We further deploy OSCAR to evaluate robot policies from RoboArena. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significant correlation between our virtual policy evaluation in OSCAR and real-world evaluation, paving the way for the future where robot policies can be purely evaluated in virtual generated worlds.

AI.tldr: OSCAR是一个精准的动作条件视频世界模型，通过大规模标准化数据流水线和2D骨骼渲染统一条件表示，实现了跨不同机器人本体的泛化，并支持机器人策略的虚拟评估，与真实世界评估高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型在真实机器人评估中面临三大挑战：训练数据场景多样性有限、动作跟随不精确、跨本体泛化能力差，难以广泛采用。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模标准化数据流水线，对机器人和人类数据集进行整理、过滤和去重，形成覆盖多样化任务、场景、动作和本体的联合训练数据集；2) 采用2D运动学骨骼渲染作为统一的条件表示，跨不同机器人臂甚至人类手部进行泛化；3) 在单张GH200 GPU上微调Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型。
AI.result: 相比现有基线（更大模型或更多GPU），OSCAR在动作跟随、外观质量和运动一致性上均有显著提升。在RoboArena上的实验表明，OSCAR中的虚拟策略评估与真实世界评估之间存在显著相关性。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR为未来在虚拟生成世界中纯评估机器人策略铺平了道路，验证了虚拟评估与真实评估的高度相关性。

title: MS-DKC: A Dataset Knowledge Card Framework for Designing and Adapting Medical Image Segmentation Models
summary:
Medical image segmentation is often framed as a search for stronger architectures, but this can obscure a more fundamental question: what does the dataset require from the model? In medical imaging, this requirement is shaped by foreground occupancy, morphology, boundary ambiguity, topology sensitivity, annotation quality, acquisition variation, and operating point.
  This paper introduces the Medical Segmentation Dataset Knowledge Card (MS-DKC), a framework for making these factors explicit. MS-DKC records dataset evidence through image/acquisition, morphology, supervision, context-dependence, and deployment-risk descriptors. These descriptors are mapped to failure modes, design priors, and risk-aligned criteria, making segmentation design more traceable than architecture-first comparison.
  We evaluate MS-DKC on DRIVE, ISIC2018, and ACDC, representing distinct regimes. DRIVE contains sparse, thin, branching vessels, favoring detail-preserving models, sensitivity-aware optimization, threshold analysis, and topology-aware metrics. DKC-TNet-v2 achieved Dice 0.8044 and IoU 0.6730 with 35103 parameters, while SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef reached Dice 0.8141, IoU 0.6865, sensitivity 0.8265, specificity 0.9804, and AUC 0.9853. ISIC2018 involves compact but appearance-variable lesions; validation-constrained score-function selection on Att-Next-Topo/ATTNext produced MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug with Dice 0.8872, IoU 0.8214, precision 0.9173, Boundary F1 0.4878, and ASSD 4.13, while plausible additions failed to improve the risk-aligned profile. ACDC provides a multi-class cardiac case, where MS-DKC recommends four-class softmax segmentation, class-balanced Dice/CE supervision, and class-wise surface evaluation. Overall, the results support dataset-conditioned design: different datasets require different priors, operating points, and evidence before a model can be judged appropriate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出医学分割数据集知识卡（MS-DKC）框架，通过显式描述数据集的前景占据、形态、边界模糊性、拓扑敏感性、标注质量、采集变化和操作点等特征，将数据集需求映射到模型设计选择上，实现可追溯的分割设计而非传统架构优先比较。在DRIVE、ISIC2018和ACDC三个不同数据集上的实验验证了数据集条件化设计的有效性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割研究中过度关注架构搜索，忽略了数据集本身对模型的需求。不同的医学数据集在前景占比、形态结构、边界清晰度、拓扑敏感性、标注质量、采集变化和操作点等方面存在显著差异，但这些因素在传统方法中未被显式建模，导致模型设计缺乏可追溯性。
AI.method: MS-DKC框架通过图像/采集描述子、形态描述子、监督描述子、上下文依赖描述子和部署风险描述子五个维度记录数据集特征，并将这些描述子映射到对应的失效模式、设计先验和风险对齐准则上。该方法将数据集需求与模型设计决策显式关联，替代传统架构优先的比较范式。
AI.result: 在DRIVE上，DKC-TNet-v2达到Dice 0.8044、IoU 0.6730（35103参数），SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef达Dice 0.8141、IoU 0.6865、灵敏度0.8265、特异度0.9804、AUC 0.9853。ISIC2018上MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug达Dice 0.8872、IoU 0.8214、精度0.9173、Boundary F1 0.4878、ASSD 4.13。ACDC推荐四类softmax分割、类别平衡Dice/CE监督和逐类表面评估。
AI.conclusion: 不同数据集需要不同的设计先验、操作点和证据标准才能判断模型是否合适。数据集条件化设计比架构优先比较更有效，MS-DKC框架能够使分割设计决策更加可追溯和可解释。

title: LLM Explainability with Counterfactual Chains and Causal Graphs
summary: Causal graphs provide a high-level language for making mechanisms transparent. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to recover causal graphs of external-world processes. Instead, in this paper, we use causal graphs to model LLM inference itself, providing stakeholders with a transparent view of how the model perceives and organizes high-level concepts to produce a prediction. We propose a four-phase method for constructing such graphs. Given a target LLM and a set of textual examples, our method discovers class-discriminative, human-interpretable concepts and maps each input to LLM-perceived concept states. We then introduce an MCMC-inspired counterfactual augmentation procedure that expands the sparse observational data through chains of counterfactuals. This enables stable causal discovery with $σ$-CG, yielding informative, interpretable graphs. We apply our method to three LLMs across disease diagnosis, sentiment analysis, and LLM-as-a-judge classification tasks. We evaluate the learned graphs for predictive fidelity and structural stability, and the MCMC-inspired augmentation for convergence and downstream utility. Our results show that the discovered causal graphs capture meaningful dependencies consistent with LLMs' reasoning. Together, this paper provides a foundation for concept-level explainability of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用因果图对LLM推理过程本身进行建模，通过四阶段方法发现可解释的概念状态，并采用MCMC启发的反事实增强技术实现稳定因果发现，从而为LLM提供概念层面的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作使用LLM恢复外部世界的因果图，但缺乏对LLM内部推理过程透明化的方法。本文旨在利用因果图建模LLM自身的推理机制，让利益相关者了解模型如何感知和组织高层概念以产生预测。
AI.method: 提出四阶段方法：(1) 发现类别判别性、人类可解释的概念；(2) 将每个输入映射到LLM感知的概念状态；(3) 引入MCMC启发的反事实增强过程，通过反事实链扩展稀疏观测数据；(4) 使用σ-CG进行稳定因果发现，生成信息丰富且可解释的因果图。
AI.result: 在疾病诊断、情感分析和LLM-as-a-judge分类任务上对三个LLM进行实验，评估了学习到的因果图的预测保真度和结构稳定性，以及MCMC启发增强的收敛性和下游效用。结果显示发现的因果图捕获了与LLM推理一致的有意义依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 本文为LLM的概念级可解释性提供了基础，证明因果图能够有效揭示LLM内部概念的因果依赖关系，且与模型推理行为一致。

title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
summary: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.

AI.tldr: 提出了VISTA框架，通过UMI-VQA数据集、物理验证管道和两阶段协同训练，解决了UMI数据与VLA模型之间的视觉域差异和物理可行性不匹配问题，在仿真和真实任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: UMI数据用于训练大规模VLA模型存在两个关键不匹配：1) 腕载鱼眼视图的严重径向畸变和局部夹爪中心视角导致预训练VLM出现分布外问题；2) 人类采集的轨迹常违反运动学限制、发生碰撞或超出控制器带宽，教会VLA策略执行物理上不可行的动作。
AI.method: 提出VISTA框架，包含三个协同组件：1) UMI-VQA - 首个针对腕载鱼眼观测的大规模VQA数据集，通过辅助视觉-语言监督对齐VLM表示；2) 物理验证管道 - 对每条轨迹进行数据完整性预检查、轨迹连续性、自碰撞风险和执行保真度评分；3) 两阶段协同训练 - 在UMI-VQA上联合学习视觉-语言基础，同时在验证后的轨迹上学习动作预测。
AI.result: 实验表明：UMI-VQA一致地提升了下游策略性能；物理验证得分能强预测部署成功率；在多样化的仿真和真实操作任务中，VISTA显著优于π₀.₅、LingBot-VLA和Wall-X等强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VISTA框架有效弥合了UMI数据与VLA模型之间的双重差距，物理验证管道和VQA数据对于提升策略的物理可行性和视觉鲁棒性至关重要。研究团队已开源物理验证管道、UMI-VQA数据集、验证后的轨迹数据和预训练模型。

title: Where, What, Why, and Importance: Structured Defect Grounding for Text-to-Image Feedback
summary: Despite generating increasingly photorealistic images, text-to-image (T2I) models still exhibit localized, subtle, and structurally complex failures. Diagnosing these failures requires instance-level feedback that answers where a defect occurs, what type it is, why it is defective, and its importance to overall image quality. While recent dense-feedback methods move beyond scalar supervision, their heatmap-centric representations still formulate diagnosis as pixel-field regression, making it difficult to localize variable-cardinality defects and bind semantic reasons to individual failures. To address this representation bottleneck, we propose Structured Defect Grounding (SDG), which casts T2I diagnosis as structured set prediction by modeling each defect as a (location, type, reason, importance) tuple. To make this formulation trainable and measurable, we introduce SDG-30K, a 30K-image dataset with box-grounded annotations across four modern T2I generators, together with a dedicated evaluation protocol, SDG-Eval. Building on this structured representation, we further present a diagnosis-to-alignment framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the SDG detector, and BoxFlow-GRPO converts predicted defect sets into box-derived, importance-weighted spatial rewards for diffusion model alignment. Extensive experiments show that our SDG detector outperforms leading proprietary VLMs on structured defect grounding, while SDG-guided rewards consistently improve T2I alignment and support localized image refinement. These results establish SDG as a unified, instance-level interface for diagnosing, evaluating, and enhancing modern generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化缺陷定位（SDG）框架，将文本到图像生成诊断转化为结构化集合预测，每个缺陷表示为（位置、类型、原因、重要性）元组，通过SDG-30K数据集和SDG-Eval评估协议实现训练与评测，并基于此构建诊断到对齐的闭环框架（SDG检测器+BoxFlow-GRPO奖励对齐），显著优于闭源VLM并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型存在局部、细微且结构复杂的失败模式，传统基于标量或热图回归的诊断方法难以定位可变基数缺陷并绑定语义原因，缺乏实例级的结构化反馈机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出SDG，将T2I诊断建模为结构化集合预测，每个缺陷表示为(位置, 类型, 原因, 重要性)元组；2) 构建SDG-30K数据集，包含30K图像及框级标注，覆盖四种现代T2I生成器；3) 设计SDG-Eval评估协议；4) 提出诊断到对齐框架：VLM作为SDG检测器，BoxFlow-GRPO将缺陷集合转换为框导出的重要性加权空间奖励用于扩散模型对齐。
AI.result: SDG检测器在结构化缺陷定位上优于领先的闭源VLM；SDG引导的奖励一致性地提升了T2I对齐质量，并支持局部图像精化。
AI.conclusion: SDG为诊断、评估和增强现代生成模型提供了统一的实例级接口，解决了表示瓶颈问题。

title: Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Efficient Knowledge Distillation
summary: Reasoning models produce long chain-of-thought traces that are costly to distill and encourage verbose student outputs. We study post-hoc compression of such traces before knowledge distillation. Two teachers, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and gpt-oss-120B, generate about 283k correct traces each; two instruction-tuned models then compress them to 8.6-21.0% of their original character length. Across a 48-run main grid plus seven Qwen-teacher truncation ablations, compressed traces reduce training tokens to 12-30% of raw, speed up training by 2.0-7.6x, and shorten inference outputs by 3-19x with smaller reductions under the shorter gpt-oss teacher. However, raw traces retain the highest downstream accuracy at every scale and for both teachers. A length-matched raw-trace truncation ablation shows that compression is not merely benefiting from a smaller token budget: model-compressed traces usually beat or match naive truncation, especially for smaller students, while maintaining shorter inference outputs. Overall, reasoning-trace compression offers an accuracy-efficiency trade-off rather than a free improvement: students retain up to 96% of raw-trace accuracy while gaining up to 18x higher per-token efficiency, and at the 0.8B scale under LoRA compressed traces narrow the raw-vs-compressed gap but do not exceed raw.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理模型链式思维（CoT）轨迹的后验压缩方法，使用两种教师模型生成约28.3万条正确轨迹，经指令微调模型压缩至原长度的8.6-21.0%。实验表明压缩轨迹可将训练token降至12-30%，训练速度提升2.0-7.6倍，推理输出缩短3-19倍，但原始轨迹在各类规模下均保持最高下游准确率。模型压缩轨迹通常优于或匹配朴素截断，尤其对小规模学生模型效果更佳。推理轨迹压缩呈现准确率-效率的权衡关系，学生模型可保留原始轨迹最高96%的准确率，同时获得最高18倍的每token效率提升。
AI.motivation: 推理模型产生的长链式思维轨迹在知识蒸馏过程中存在两个主要问题：一是蒸馏成本高昂，二是鼓励学生模型产生冗长的输出。因此，研究者希望探索在知识蒸馏之前对这些轨迹进行后验压缩的方法，以降低训练和推理成本，同时尽可能保持下游任务的准确率。
AI.method: 使用两种教师模型（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B和gpt-oss-120B）各生成约28.3万条正确推理轨迹，再利用两个指令微调模型将轨迹压缩至原长度的8.6-21.0%。设计48次主网格实验及7次Qwen教师截断消融实验，对比压缩轨迹、原始轨迹和朴素截断轨迹在不同规模学生模型上的训练效率、推理输出长度和下游准确率。
AI.result: 压缩轨迹将训练token降至原始轨迹的12-30%，训练速度提升2.0-7.6倍，推理输出长度缩短3-19倍（gpt-oss教师下缩减幅度较小）。原始轨迹在所有规模下保持最高下游准确率。模型压缩轨迹通常优于或匹配朴素截断，尤其对小规模学生模型更有效。在0.8B规模LoRA微调下，压缩轨迹缩小了与原始轨迹的差距但未超越。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹压缩并非免费改进，而是在准确率与效率之间提供权衡：学生模型可保留原始轨迹高达96%的准确率，同时获得最高18倍的每token效率提升。该方法在实际应用中具有实用价值，尤其适用于对推理效率有较高要求的场景。

title: Learning Predictive Visuomotor Coordination
summary: Understanding and predicting human visuomotor coordination is crucial for applications in robotics, human-computer interaction, and assistive technologies. This work introduces a forecasting-based task for visuomotor modeling, where the goal is to predict head pose, gaze, and upper-body motion from egocentric visual and kinematic observations. We propose a \textit{Visuomotor Coordination Representation} (VCR) that learns structured temporal dependencies across these multimodal signals. We extend a diffusion-based motion modeling framework that integrates egocentric vision and kinematic sequences, enabling temporally coherent and accurate visuomotor predictions. Our approach is evaluated on the large-scale EgoExo4D dataset, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse real-world activities. Our results highlight the importance of multimodal integration in understanding visuomotor coordination, contributing to research in visuomotor learning and human behavior modeling. Project Page: https://vjwq.github.io/VCR/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的视觉-运动协调表征（VCR），用于从自我中心的视觉和运动学观测中预测头部姿态、注视方向和上半身运动，并在EgoExo4D数据集上验证了其多模态融合的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 理解与预测人类视觉-运动协调对于机器人、人机交互和辅助技术至关重要，现有方法缺乏对头部姿态、注视和上半身运动等多模态信号之间结构化时序依赖关系的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出视觉-运动协调表征（VCR），扩展了基于扩散的运动建模框架，将自我中心视觉与运动学序列进行融合，学习多模态信号间的结构化时序依赖关系，实现时序连贯且准确的视觉-运动预测。
AI.result: 在大型EgoExo4D数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多种真实世界活动中表现出强泛化能力，多模态融合对理解视觉-运动协调具有关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 多模态信号的结构化融合对于视觉-运动预测至关重要，VCR为视觉-运动学习和人类行为建模提供了有效方案。

title: Diff-CA: Separating Common and Salient Factors with Diffusion Models
summary: Contrastive Analysis aims to separate factors that are common between two data distributions from those that are salient to only one of them. Existing contrastive methods are based on generative models (e.g., VAEs or GANs) that often suffer from limited reconstruction and image quality, which hampers effective latent factor separation and limits their applicability to high-fidelity image generation and edition. We propose a novel conditioning framework for diffusion models that enables contrastive decomposition without compromising generation quality. We first train a prompt-free, image-conditioned diffusion model, and then learn to decompose the conditioning into a common and a salient factor, using weak supervision. We prove that the additive contrastive factorization, commonly assumed in prior work, is identifiable under mild conditions. This factorization enables targeted operations by swapping or interpolating only the salient factor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型的条件框架，实现对比分解，通过弱监督学习将条件拆分为共同因子和显著因子，支持高保真图像生成和编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有对比分析方法基于VAE或GAN等生成模型，受限于重构质量和图像保真度，难以有效分离潜在因子，也无法应用于高保真图像生成和编辑。
AI.method: 先训练一个无提示、图像条件的扩散模型，再通过弱监督学习将条件分解为共同因子和显著因子，利用加性对比分解实现因子交换或插值操作。
AI.result: 在温和条件下证明了加性对比分解的可识别性，实现了高保真度的对比分解，支持针对显著因子的交换和插值操作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了传统对比分析方法在图像质量上的局限，将扩散模型引入对比分析领域，实现了高质量的因子分离与可控编辑。

title: HoT-SSM:Higher-order Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning with State Space Models for Health Care
summary: Medical knowledge graphs (MKGs) infused with clinical knowledge have been increasingly used to model electronic health records (EHRs) to support interpretable predictions in healthcare domain. However, existing MKG-based approaches are limited in capturing pairwise relations between clinical concepts (e.g., conditions, procedures, and medications), and restricts their ability to model higher-order interactions among co-occurring or semantically related concepts. In addition, most representation learning methods that leverage MKGs either collapse temporal information across visits or lack an explicit mechanism for modeling long-range temporal dependencies, which is critical for clinical tasks such as mortality prediction. To mitigate these limitations, we propose HoT-SSM, a parameter efficient and higher-order temporal graph reasoning with state space models. For each visit, HoT-SSM constructs hypergraphs by grouping semantically related clinical concepts into hyperedges using domain knowledge, thereby preserving visit-level clinical context. Further, to model the temporal dynamics while learning the representations, we introduce a novel dynamic hypergraph-based state space model that explicitly captures patients latent state evolution over time while preserving long-range information. The learned representations are used for downstream clinical prediction and reasoning. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets shows significant performance improvement over the current state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling higher-order clinical interactions and long-range temporal dependencies.

AI.tldr: HoT-SSM提出了一种参数高效的超图状态空间模型，通过构建临床概念的超边来捕捉高阶交互，并利用动态超图状态空间模型建模长程时间依赖，在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有医学知识图谱方法局限于捕获临床概念间的成对关系，难以建模共现或语义相关概念间的高阶交互；同时大部分表示学习方法要么坍缩了跨就诊的时间信息，要么缺乏显式的长程时间依赖建模机制，限制了在死亡率预测等临床任务上的表现。
AI.method: 提出HoT-SSM框架：1）对每次就诊，利用领域知识将语义相关的临床概念分组为超边构建超图，保留就诊级临床上下文；2）引入动态超图状态空间模型，显式捕捉患者潜在状态随时间的演化，同时保留长程信息；3）将学习到的表示用于下游临床预测与推理。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，HoT-SSM显著优于现有最先进模型，证明了联合建模高阶临床交互与长程时间依赖的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模高阶临床概念交互与长程时间依赖能有效提升临床预测性能，超图与状态空间模型的结合为医学知识图谱表示学习提供了新范式。

title: Test-Time Training for Visual Foresight Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Continual Adaptation at Scale (CATS)
summary: Visual Foresight VLA (VF-VLA) has become a prominent architectural choice in the recent VLA due to its impressive performance. Nevertheless, the inherent design of VF-VLA makes it particularly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts. Because the quality of action directly depends on the accuracy of the predicted future visual information, OOD conditions affect both stages at once. To address this vulnerability, we propose Test-Time Training Visual Foresight VLA ($T^3$VF), a test-time training approach motivated by the observation that the predicted future image and its subsequent observation form a natural supervision pair. To further address the practical challenges that arise from indiscriminate test-time updates, we introduce an adaptive update filtering mechanism. Empirically, $T^3$VF mitigates the OOD vulnerability of VF-VLA at a modest additional inference cost, without requiring any architectural modification or auxiliary modules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T³VF，一种测试时训练方法，通过利用预测未来图像与后续观测形成的自然监督对，并引入自适应更新过滤机制，有效缓解视觉前瞻VLA在分布外场景下的脆弱性，无需架构修改或辅助模块。
AI.motivation: VF-VLA架构因动作质量直接依赖未来视觉信息预测的准确性，在分布外(OOD)条件下两个阶段会同时受到影响，存在严重的OOD脆弱性问题。
AI.method: 提出T³VF测试时训练方法，核心是利用预测未来图像与其后续观测构成自然监督对进行自适应更新；同时引入自适应更新过滤机制，解决不加区分地进行测试时更新带来的实际挑战。
AI.result: T³VF以适度的额外推理成本有效缓解了VF-VLA的OOD脆弱性，无需任何架构修改或辅助模块。
AI.conclusion: 测试时训练是解决视觉前瞻VLA在分布外场景下脆弱性的有效途径，自适应更新过滤机制进一步提升了方法的实用性。

title: Computation-Aware Event-to-Frame Reconstruction via Selective Attention
summary: Event-to-frame (E2F) reconstruction bridges asynchronous event streams with frame-based vision pipelines, but existing methods often face a trade-off between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. In this work, we propose an efficient E2F framework that emphasizes causal temporal modeling and computation-aware design. The architecture adopts a recurrent encoder-decoder to incrementally aggregate event information with compact hidden states. To improve robustness under fast motion and illumination variations, a selective context fusion strategy is introduced to integrate event-driven features with prior intensity cues. Within this fusion process, a lightweight hybrid attention mechanism enhances feature selectivity without relying on heavy attention operations. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive reconstruction performance while maintaining a favorable balance between accuracy and model complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的事件到帧重建框架，采用循环编码器-解码器架构、选择性上下文融合策略和轻量级混合注意力机制，在保持高质量重建的同时实现了计算效率的优化。
AI.motivation: 现有事件到帧重建方法在重建质量与计算效率之间存在权衡，缺乏兼顾因果时序建模和计算效率感知的设计。
AI.method: 提出高效E2F框架：1) 采用循环编码器-解码器架构，通过紧凑隐状态增量聚合事件信息；2) 引入选择性上下文融合策略，整合事件驱动特征与先验强度线索以增强快速运动与光照变化的鲁棒性；3) 在该融合过程中使用轻量级混合注意力机制提升特征选择性，避免重注意力操作的开销。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法在重建性能上具有竞争力，并在精度与模型复杂度之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架有效打破了重建质量与效率之间的权衡，为事件到帧重建提供了一种兼顾因果时序建模和计算效率的实用方案。

title: Diffusion Models for Adaptive Sequential Data Generation
summary:
Generating realistic synthetic sequential data is critical in real-world applications across operations research, finance, healthcare, energy systems, and scientific computing, where time-indexed observations are used for prediction, simulation, risk assessment, and data-driven decision-making. While diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating static data, their direct extensions to sequential settings often fail to capture temporal dependence and information structure. Designing diffusion models that can simulate sequential data in an adapted manner, and hence without anticipation of future information, therefore remains an open challenge.
  In this work, we propose a sequential forward-backward diffusion framework for adapted time series generation. Our approach progressively injects and removes noise along the sequence, conditioning on the previously generated history to ensure adaptiveness. A novel score-matching objective is introduced for efficient parallel training. We derive rigorous statistical guarantees under a generic framework, then establish score approximation, score estimation, and distribution estimation results with ReLU networks serving as a concrete instance. Empirically, we validate our method on synthetic data, including ARMA models and Gaussian processes, and demonstrate its effectiveness in constructing mean-variance optimal portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种序列前向-反向扩散框架(Sequential Forward-Backward Diffusion Framework)，用于生成具有适应性的时间序列数据。该方法沿序列逐步注入和去除噪声，并基于先前生成的历史进行条件化，确保数据生成的适应性。论文提出了新颖的评分匹配目标用于高效并行训练，在理论上给出了严格的统计保证，并通过RELU网络实例建立了评分逼近、评分估计和分布估计的理论结果。实验在合成数据(ARMA模型、高斯过程)和均值-方差最优投资组合构建任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型在生成静态数据方面取得了显著成功，但直接扩展到序列设置时无法捕捉时间依赖性和信息结构。设计能够以适应性方式(即不预知未来信息)生成序列数据的扩散模型仍是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出序列前向-反向扩散框架，沿序列逐步注入和去除噪声，并基于先前生成的历史进行条件化以确保适应性；引入新的评分匹配目标实现高效并行训练；在理论上建立评分逼近、评分估计和分布估计的统计保证，以RELU网络作为具体实例进行理论分析。
AI.result: 在合成数据(ARMA模型、高斯过程)上验证了方法的有效性，并在均值-方差最优投资组合构建任务中展示了实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够有效生成具有适应性的时间序列数据，在理论和实验层面均有良好表现，为序列数据生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Adaptive Tokenisation Via Temporal Redundancy Masking And Latent Inpainting
summary:
Adaptive video tokenisation seeks to dynamically allocate token budgets based on the underlying visual complexity of a sequence. Current continuous-regime approaches achieve this via iterative binarised searches or trained neural regressors, while discrete methods often require a full-rate decoder pass to estimate information content. We demonstrate that such computational overheads are not strictly necessary. We show that the latent space of a frozen continuous video tokeniser inherently encodes temporal redundancy that can be exploited directly: spatial positions whose latent representations change minimally between consecutive frames carry near-zero additional information.
  We introduce a parameter-free adaptive token allocation mechanism that applies a fixed threshold to per-position temporal-L1 differences, identifying and dropping redundant latent positions. Consequently, the compression rate emerges naturally from the input content rather than being enforced top-down: static scenes get compressed aggressively, while highly dynamic sequences retain more tokens. To reconstruct the dropped positions, we propose the Latent Inpainting Transformer (LIT), a lightweight factorised spatial-temporal attention architecture. The resulting inference pipeline is highly efficient, requiring only a single encoder pass and one LIT forward pass, eliminating the need for auxiliary routing networks. Evaluations across TokenBench and DAVIS, which are the standard benchmarks used by recent tokenisers~\cite{infotok, agarwal2025cosmos}, indicate that our framework yields meaningful, content-driven token allocation while maintaining competitive reconstruction fidelity, and delivers a $31\times$ inference-time speedup over the continuous adaptive baseline (ElasticTok-CV) and an $\approx2\times$ speedup over the discrete information-theoretic baseline (InfoTok)

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需参数的自适应视频令牌分配方法，通过冻结连续视频分词器潜空间中的时间L1差异阈值来丢弃冗余位置，并设计轻量级Latent Inpainting Transformer（LIT）重建丢弃位置，实现单编码器前向+单LIT前向的高效推理，在TokenBench和DAVIS上相比连续自适应基线ElasticTok-CV实现31倍加速，相比离散信息论基线InfoTok实现约2倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应视频分词方法（连续域通过迭代二值搜索或神经网络回归器、离散域需完整解码器估计信息量）存在不必要的计算开销，本文证明无需这些额外计算即可直接利用冻结连续视频分词器潜空间中的时间冗余特征。
AI.method: 1) 对冻结连续视频分词器的每个空间位置计算帧间L1距离，应用固定阈值识别并丢弃变化极小的冗余潜变量；2) 提出Latent Inpainting Transformer（LIT）轻量级因式分解时空注意力架构用于重建被丢弃位置；3) 压缩率由内容自然决定而非自上而下控制。
AI.result: 在TokenBench和DAVIS标准基准上取得有竞争力的重建保真度，实现有意义的基于内容的令牌分配，相比ElasticTok-CV实现31倍推理加速，相比InfoTok实现约2倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 计算昂贵的自适应策略并非必要，通过直接利用潜空间时间冗余可以实现高效且内容驱动的自适应视频令牌化。

title: Adaptive Oscillatory-State Alignment for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from inductive biases that expose recurring temporal structure. Existing periodic forecasting methods typically model recurrence through predefined periods, global spectral components, or fixed learnable templates. However, real-world temporal dynamics are rarely rigidly periodic: oscillatory behavior often evolves through amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation. Under these conditions, fixed-template periodic modeling can become fundamentally mismatched to the underlying temporal states. We propose AOSNET, a Hilbert-guided forecasting framework that reformulates periodic forecasting from fixed template matching to adaptive oscillatory-state alignment. AOSNET extracts analytic-signal descriptors from both the observed sequence and a learnable global oscillatory prior, then adaptively aligns local states through a descriptor-conditioned gate that selectively preserves reliable observations while softly correcting mismatched regions. The learned prior serves not as a rigid repeated template but as a flexible oscillatory reference interpreted through local state dynamics. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive accuracy with fast inference speed. Controlled synthetic studies isolating amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation confirm that the advantage of oscillatory-state alignment consistently increases as non-stationarity intensifies.

AI.tldr: 提出AOSNET框架，将周期性时间序列预测从固定模板匹配转为自适应振荡状态对齐，通过希尔伯特变换提取解析信号描述符，并利用描述符条件门控自适应对齐局部状态，在八个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有周期性预测方法依赖预定义周期、全局频谱成分或固定可学习模板，但真实时间序列的振荡行为常伴随幅度调制、相位漂移和局部频率变化，导致固定模板与底层时间状态不匹配。
AI.method: 基于希尔伯特变换提取观测序列和可学习全局振荡先验的解析信号描述符；通过描述符条件门控自适应对齐局部状态，选择性保留可靠观测并软纠正不匹配区域；可学习先验作为灵活的振荡参考而非刚性重复模板。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上取得SOTA或极具竞争力的预测精度，且推理速度快。受控合成实验表明，随着非平稳性加剧（幅度调制、相位漂移、局部频率变化），振荡状态对齐方法的优势持续增强。
AI.conclusion: 将周期性预测从固定模板匹配转向自适应振荡状态对齐，能有效应对真实世界中的非平稳振荡动态，为长期时间序列预测提供新的范式。

title: RQUL-UIE: Revitalizing Quality-Unstable Labels for Underwater Image Enhancement via In-Dataset Self-Supervision
summary: Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) is essential for mitigating degradations caused by water medium. Although learning-based methods have advanced significantly, most rely on paired datasets with unstable label quality, which bottlenecks model performance. This paper proposes a diffusion-based, in-dataset self-supervised learning strategy designed to exploit the quality distribution of training labels. Specifically, we evaluate label quality via semantic perception embeddings from a pre-trained diffusion model in a training-free manner. These quality scores are subsequently quantized into noise-level indices, guiding a multi-step denoising process for level-wise supervision. This mechanism prevents low-quality labels from degrading the model while maximizing their utility during training. Furthermore, a Fourier-based refinement network is incorporated to explicitly reconstruct high-frequency components. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA approaches in restoration quality. The code and pre-trained model will be available once accepted in link.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于扩散模型的域内自监督学习策略，通过无训练方式评估标签质量并量化为噪声等级指导多步去噪，结合傅里叶细化网络，在无配对高质量标签的情况下实现水下图像增强，性能超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的水下图像增强方法依赖配对数据集，但标签质量不稳定，限制了模型性能。需要一种能利用训练标签质量分布、避免低质量标签损害模型的方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用预训练扩散模型的语义感知嵌入，以无训练方式评估标签质量；2) 将质量分数量化为噪声等级索引，指导多步去噪过程实现层级监督；3) 引入基于傅里叶变换的细化网络显式重建高频分量。
AI.result: 在多项评估中，该方法在恢复质量上持续优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的域内自监督扩散策略能有效利用训练标签的质量分布，避免低质量标签的负面影响，结合傅里叶细化网络实现了更优的水下图像增强效果。

title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，将知识蒸馏从输出空间提升到隐藏状态空间，通过在相同rollouts上对齐学生和教师模型的中间层表示，消除了输出空间蒸馏的采样方差问题，并提供更丰富的逐层结构信息。实验表明OPRD在数学推理任务上缩小了师生差距，且训练速度提升1.44倍，内存减少54%。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD)在输出空间监督学生存在两个限制：(1) 在大词表（如Qwen的~150k tokens）上进行蒙特卡洛KL估计带来的采样方差在整个训练过程中持续存在；(2) 将教师模型视为黑盒，丢弃了LM head之后的所有中间隐藏状态。
AI.method: 提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，在相同rollouts上对齐学生和教师模型选定层的隐藏状态表示，完全绕过LM head，将蒸馏提升到隐藏状态空间。
AI.result: OPRD在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，而输出空间的OPD基线在低于教师的水平上停滞。OPRD训练速度比top-k OPD快1.44倍，内存使用减少54%。
AI.conclusion: OPRD通过消除采样方差和提供更丰富的逐层结构信息，在理论和实践上均优于输出空间的on-policy蒸馏方法。

title: Adversarial Attacks Already Tell the Answer: Directional Bias-Guided Test-time Defense for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have shown strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, posing serious risks in real-world applications. Test-time defenses for VLMs have recently emerged as a promising and efficient approach to defend against adversarial attacks without requiring costly large-scale retraining. In this work, we uncover a surprising phenomenon: under diverse input transformations, adversarial images in CLIP's feature space consistently shift along a dominant direction, in contrast to the dispersed patterns of clean images. We hypothesize that this dominant shift, termed the Defense Direction, opposes the adversarial shift, pointing features back toward their correct class centers. Building on this insight, we propose Directional Bias-guided Defense (DBD), a test-time framework that estimates the Defense Direction and employs a DB-score-based two-stream reconstruction strategy to recover robust representations. Experiments on 15 datasets demonstrate that DBD not only achieves SOTA adversarial robustness while preserving clean accuracy, but also reveals the counterintuitive result that adversarial accuracy can even surpass clean accuracy. This demonstrates that adversarial perturbations inherently encode directional priors about the true decision boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文发现CLIP模型中，对抗性图像在特征空间沿主导方向移动，而干净图像呈分散模式。基于此提出方向偏差引导防御（DBD），一种测试时防御框架，通过估计防御方向并采用双流重建策略恢复鲁棒表征，在15个数据集上达到SOTA鲁棒性，甚至出现对抗精度超越干净精度的反直觉结果。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（如CLIP）虽具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但对对抗扰动高度脆弱，存在严重安全风险。现有测试时防御虽高效，但缺乏对对抗扰动在VLM特征空间中行为模式的深入理解。
AI.method: 提出方向偏差引导防御（DBD），核心步骤包括：(1) 发现对抗图像在特征空间中沿主导方向偏移；(2) 估计该主导方向的逆方向作为"防御方向"；(3) 设计基于DB分数的双流重建策略，将受扰特征沿防御方向投影以恢复鲁棒表征。
AI.result: 在15个数据集上，DBD达到SOTA对抗鲁棒性，同时保持干净精度。一个反直觉发现是对抗精度可超越干净精度，表明对抗扰动编码了关于真实决策边界的先验方向信息。
AI.conclusion: 对抗扰动本质上编码了关于真实决策边界的定向先验，利用这一特性可以实现超越干净样本的鲁棒性。DBD为VLM提供了一种高效、无需重训练的测试时防御方案。

title: Catastrophic Forgetting as Accessibility Collapse: A Three-Level Framework for Knowledge Persistence in Continual Learning
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Sequential continual-learning experiments on CIFAR-100 using ResNet-18
summary: Catastrophic forgetting is commonly interpreted as the irreversible erasure of previously acquired knowledge during sequential learning. In this work, we investigate an alternative perspective: that forgetting may arise not from complete destruction of task representations but from a loss of accessibility to preserved information. We introduce a three-level framework separating knowledge storage, representation, and accessibility, and evaluate each component through a series of continual-learning experiments on sequential CIFAR-100 classification using ResNet-18. Our analysis combines checkpoint persistence, linear probing, representation geometry, classifier-reset recovery, and layer-wise recoverability experiments. We observe complete behavioral forgetting of earlier tasks, with task accuracy collapsing from 54.8% to 0%, while linear probe performance retains approximately 76% of the original representational information. Furthermore, retraining only the final classifier restores 75.7% of the original task performance without modifying the backbone network. Layer-wise analysis reveals that early and intermediate layers preserve highly recoverable task information despite severe degradation at later stages. Projection-energy and principal-angle analyses indicate that retained knowledge persists as distributed high-dimensional representations rather than through preservation of a small dominant subspace. These findings suggest that catastrophic forgetting is better characterized as an accessibility failure than complete representational erasure, and that substantial task-relevant information remains embedded within neural representations even after functional forgetting has occurred.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明灾难性遗忘并非知识的完全擦除，而是可访问性失效——模型保留了大量可恢复的任务相关信息，仅需重训分类器即可恢复约75.7%的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观点——灾难性遗忘通常被视为先前知识的不可逆擦除。作者提出替代视角：遗忘可能源于信息可访问性的丧失而非表征的完全破坏。
AI.method: 构建三级框架（知识存储、表征、可访问性），在ResNet-18上进行序列CIFAR-100分类实验，结合检查点持久性、线性探测、表征几何、分类器重置恢复和逐层可恢复性分析。
AI.result: 行为遗忘严重（准确率从54.8%降至0%），但线性探测保留了约76%的表征信息；仅重训分类器恢复75.7%性能；早期和中间层保留了高度可恢复的任务信息；知识以分布式高维表征形式存留而非主导子空间。
AI.conclusion: 灾难性遗忘更应被描述为可访问性失效而非表征擦除，大量任务相关信息在功能遗忘后仍嵌入神经表征中。

title: SC-MFJ: A Simple Haptic Quality Metric for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Standard segmentation metrics such as Dice and Hausdorff distance measure geometric overlap but say nothing about whether a segmented surface is suitable for haptic rendering in surgical simulation. We propose SC-MFJ (Surface-Constrained Mean Force Jerk), a simple, inexpensive metric that samples a segmented organ surface with many short virtual stylus walks and measures how jerky the resulting contact forces are. The metric is computed from existing segmentation outputs and uses roughly one minute of CPU time per case. We evaluate three pancreas CT segmentation approaches-binary nnU-Net output, Gaussian-smoothed output, and learned signed distance function (SDF) regression-across 80 cases in five-fold cross-validation. SC-MFJ reveals a 147x gap in haptic quality between the raw binary baseline and simple Gaussian post-processing, a difference entirely invisible to Dice and HD95. It also shows that learned SDF regression, despite requiring full model retraining, produces more variable haptic quality than Gaussian smoothing, with a case-level standard deviation of 168 N/s2 compared with 22 N/s2 for Gaussian. A second evaluation on the LiTS liver dataset (131 cases) confirms the generality of these findings: the binary-to-Gaussian gap widens to 189x, and Gaussian smoothing again produces consistently low force jerk across all folds. Our results suggest that for haptic simulation applications, a one-line post-processing step may be sufficient, and that a cheap metric like SC-MFJ can flag problems that geometric metrics miss.

AI.tldr: 提出SC-MFJ指标，用于评估分割表面是否适合触觉渲染，发现简单高斯后处理相比原始二进制输出和学习的SDF回归能显著且稳定地提升触觉质量，而传统几何指标无法捕捉这些差异。
AI.motivation: 标准分割指标（Dice、Hausdorff距离）只衡量几何重叠，无法评估分割表面是否适合用于手术模拟中的触觉渲染。
AI.method: 提出SC-MFJ（表面约束平均力抖动）指标，通过在分割表面采样大量短虚拟触笔路径并测量接触力的抖动程度来量化触觉质量，计算仅需约1分钟CPU时间。
AI.result: 在80例胰腺CT（五折交叉验证）和131例LiTS肝脏数据集上，SC-MFJ显示：二进制nnU-Net与高斯后处理之间触觉质量差距达147-189倍；高斯后处理的触觉质量变异性远低于学习的SDF回归（标准差22 vs 168 N/s²）。
AI.conclusion: 对于触觉仿真应用，简单的一行高斯后处理可能就已足够；SC-MFJ这类低成本指标能发现几何指标遗漏的关键问题。

title: When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet
summary: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. We further extend our method to low-bits INT by mitigating the dynamic range expansion arising from repeated matrix power operations, and adapt the approximation order and residual step to the chunk size to minimize computational cost while preserving the model's accuracy. Experiments on Qwen3.5-family models demonstrate up to 5$\times$ kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in decode-layer overhead, while preserving accuracy under both floating-point and low-precision inference. Our method offers an efficient and hardware-friendly solution for scalable linear attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于截断Neumann级数展开和并行残差校正的矩阵乘法替代算法，用于加速分块并行线性注意力中的严格下三角矩阵求逆，在NPU上实现高达5倍的内核加速，并将解码层开销降低20%，同时支持低精度推理。
AI.motivation: 分块并行线性注意力中的矩阵求逆（特别是前向代入法）在NPU上并行度有限、硬件利用率低，成为长上下文建模的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用Neumann级数项快速衰减和逆矩阵对角集中的特性，采用截断Neumann展开结合结构掩码和并行残差校正，消除顺序依赖；为低比特INT量化设计动态范围压缩策略，并根据块大小自适应调整近似阶数和残差步长。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5系列模型上实现5倍内核级加速，解码层开销降低20%，且浮点和低精度推理下精度保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为可扩展线性注意力提供了一种高效且硬件友好的解决方案，突破了NPU上长上下文建模的性能瓶颈。

title: DisasterBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for UAV-Based Disaster Response in Complex Environments
summary: When a disaster unfolds, responders must answer not only what is happening, but also why it is happening, what will happen next, and what to do now, often from noisy low-altitude UAV views and under tight on-site compute constraints. However, most existing multimodal benchmarks emphasize perception (e.g., recognition/description), cover limited disaster types, and provide insufficient support for the multi-stage reasoning required in practical emergency response. We introduce DisasterBench, a multi-stage multimodal reasoning benchmark for UAV-Based disaster response in complex environments. DisasterBench spans 14 disaster-related scene types and 9 response-critical tasks across pre-, during-, and post-disaster stages, with fine-grained disaster-task mappings that explicitly test causal attribution, propagation prediction, damage analysis, and decision-oriented reasoning. To enable reasoning on the edge, we further propose DisasterVL, a lightweight multimodal model optimized with a three-stage pipeline combining domain instruction tuning, chain-of-thought-guided multimodal alignment, and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization. Experiments across 21 popular MLLMs show that our 2B-parameter DisasterVL outperforms all evaluated open-source models and substantially narrows the gap to state-of-the-art closed-source models, achieving GPT-4o-comparable reasoning accuracy with superior efficiency. The project page is available at https://github.com/TanmouTT/DisasterBench.

AI.tldr: DisasterBench是一个面向无人机灾害响应的多阶段多模态推理基准，涵盖14种灾害场景和9项任务；同时提出轻量级模型DisasterVL（2B参数），通过三阶段训练流水线在边缘设备上达到GPT-4o可比的推理精度。
AI.motivation: 现有灾害响应多模态基准主要侧重感知（识别/描述），覆盖灾害类型有限，且缺乏对多阶段推理（因果归因、传播预测、损害分析、决策导向推理）的支持，无法满足实际应急响应需求。
AI.method: 构建DisasterBench基准（14种灾害场景、9项任务、细粒度灾害-任务映射）；提出DisasterVL轻量级多模态模型（2B参数），采用三阶段流水线：领域指令微调、Chain-of-Thought引导的多模态对齐、基于强化学习的策略优化。
AI.result: 在21个流行MLLM上的实验表明，DisasterVL（2B参数）优于所有开源模型，性能接近GPT-4o，且计算效率更优。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基准和轻量级模型有效填补了灾害响应中多阶段推理与边缘部署的空白，实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。

title: Online KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation under Misspecification
summary: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits and episodic reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation with model misspecification. Existing guarantees rely on realizability and therefore do not extend to misspecified models, where classical regret bounds may fail. This work introduces KL misspecification formulations for contextual bandits and episodic RL and analyzes regression-based algorithms with Gibbs policy updates. High-probability KL-regret guarantees with explicit misspecification terms are established, recovering the standard realizable KL-regularized setting as a special case.

AI.tldr: 本文针对KL正则化的上下文赌博机和情景强化学习问题，在模型误设定的一般函数近似下，提出了KL误设定形式化方法，并分析了基于回归的Gibbs策略更新算法，建立了包含显式误设定项的高概率KL遗憾保证，将标准可实现KL正则化设定作为特例恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有KL正则化强化学习保证依赖于可实现性（realizability）假设，无法扩展到模型误设定（misspecification）场景，而经典遗憾界在误设定下可能失效。因此需要建立能够容忍模型误设定的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出了KL误设定（KL misspecification）形式化框架；设计了基于回归的算法，结合Gibbs策略更新（Gibbs policy updates）；推导了高概率下的KL遗憾界，其中包含显式的误设定项。
AI.result: 建立了带有显式误设定项的高概率KL遗憾保证；标准可实现KL正则化设定作为该框架的特例被恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将KL正则化设定从可实现性推广到更现实的误设定场景，为实际应用中的模型不匹配问题提供了理论依据。

title: Symb-xMIL: Symbolic Explanations for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
summary: Explanations of multiple instance learning (MIL) models are widely used for validation and discovery in digital histopathology. Existing methods primarily rely on heatmaps that highlight influential regions but do not explain how evidence from different tissue regions is combined to produce a prediction. This limits interpretability, especially when decisions depend on interactions between tissue features. We introduce Symbolic explainable MIL (Symb-xMIL), a post-hoc explanation framework that quantifies how a MIL model's behavior aligns with human-readable decision rules, expressed as logical relationships (e.g., AND, OR, NOT) between input features. These alignment scores reveal semantic patterns underlying the model's predictions. We evaluate Symb-xMIL on synthetic and real-world histopathology datasets. On synthetic MIL data, Symb-xMIL reliably recovers ground-truth logical rules. In a clinical tumor detection task, the best-aligned rules uncover heterogeneous decision patterns and expose hidden model errors. On an HPV-prediction task on TCGA-HNSCC, a cohort of head and neck cancer, our framework refines patient survival stratification beyond HPV status with potential clinical relevance. Overall, Symb-xMIL extends MIL explainability beyond visual attribution toward structured, rule-based reasoning, enabling more transparent and semantically grounded interpretation of model predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出Symb-xMIL框架，通过量化MIL模型与可读逻辑规则（AND/OR/NOT）的对齐程度，将病理组织学MIL解释从热力图扩展到结构化规则推理，揭示模型决策的语义模式并发现隐藏错误。
AI.motivation: 现有MIL解释方法主要依赖热力图突出影响区域，但无法解释模型如何组合不同组织区域的特征来产生预测，限制了可解释性，尤其是决策依赖于组织特征间交互时。
AI.method: 提出Symb-xMIL事后解释框架，通过量化MIL模型行为与人类可读决策规则（逻辑关系AND/OR/NOT）的对齐程度，生成对齐分数来揭示预测背后的语义模式。
AI.result: 在合成MIL数据上可靠恢复真实逻辑规则；在临床肿瘤检测任务中发现异质性决策模式并暴露隐藏错误；在TCGA-HNSCC头颈癌HPV预测任务中，改进了超越HPV状态的患者生存分层。
AI.conclusion: Symb-xMIL将MIL可解释性从视觉归因扩展到结构化规则推理，实现了更透明和语义化的模型预测解释。

title: MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference. 14 pages, 9 figures
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which stabilizes learning through (1) multi-temperature sampling to increase reward dispersion, (2) dual-anchor advantages to restore gradients in homogeneous groups and stop mean-centering blindness, (3) prospect-theoretic shaping to bound updates and penalize violations based on Kahneman and Tversky's theory, and (4) asymmetric KL regularization. Evaluated on FollowBench, IFEval, and a curated multi-constraint dataset, MDP-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO, improving strict constraint satisfaction by up to 5.0% on Llama-3.2-3B. Our method also enables stable convergence with small group sizes while preserving general capabilities on MMLU and ARC.

AI.tldr: 针对标准GRPO在离散、低分散奖励下不稳定的问题，提出MDP-GRPO，通过多温度采样、双锚优势、前景理论塑形和非对称KL正则化四项改进，在多约束指令跟随任务中提升严格约束满足率最高5.0%。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO在离散、低分散奖励设定下存在三个病理问题：低方差放大、均值中心化盲区和零方差崩溃，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出MDP-GRPO，包含四项改进：(1)多温度采样增加奖励分散度；(2)双锚优势解决均匀组中的梯度消失和均值中心化盲区；(3)基于Kahneman-Tversky前景理论的塑形函数约束更新并惩罚违规；(4)非对称KL正则化。
AI.result: 在FollowBench、IFEval及自建多约束数据集上，MDP-GRPO在Llama-3.2-3B上严格约束满足率提升最高5.0%，同时在小分组下保持稳定收敛，且不损害MMLU和ARC上的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: MDP-GRPO有效解决了低分散奖励下GRPO的不稳定问题，为多约束指令跟随提供了更稳健的强化学习框架。

title: SAM-Flow: Source-Anchored Masked Flow for Training-Free Image Editing
summary: Training-free image editing has recently attracted increasing attention due to its ability to modify real images using powerful pre-trained diffusion and flow-matching models without additional training. However, existing inversion-based and differential-flow-based methods usually perform global latent transport, which inevitably propagates editing effects to non-target regions and leads to background leakage. To address this problem, we propose SAM-Flow, a source-anchored masked flow framework for localized training-free image editing. Instead of updating the whole latent representation, SAM-Flow first uses a scout image and token-grounded attention maps to localize the editable semantic regions. It then applies differential velocity updates only within these regions, while anchoring the remaining areas to the source-image latent trajectory. To further improve spatial stability and boundary naturalness, we introduce a time-varying source-anchored projection mechanism with dynamic soft masks, transition regions, and temporal mask accumulation. The proposed method is plug-and-play and can be integrated with mainstream flow-matching backbones such as Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX without any fine-tuning. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that SAM-Flow achieves accurate semantic editing while significantly improving background preservation, providing a simple and general localized editing paradigm for training-free image editing. Code is available at: https://github.com/chwbob/Sam-Flow.

AI.tldr: SAM-Flow 提出了一种源锚定掩码流框架，通过仅在可编辑语义区域内进行差分速度更新，同时锚定非目标区域的潜在轨迹，实现了无需训练的图像局部编辑，有效防止了背景泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反演和差分流的免训练图像编辑方法通常执行全局潜在传输，导致编辑效果不可避免地传播到非目标区域，造成背景泄漏问题。
AI.method: 1) 使用侦察图像和基于token的注意力图定位可编辑语义区域；2) 仅在这些区域内应用差分速度更新，其余区域锚定到源图像潜在轨迹；3) 引入时变源锚定投影机制，结合动态软掩码、过渡区域和时间掩码累积，提升空间稳定性和边界自然度。
AI.result: 定性和定量实验表明，SAM-Flow 在实现精确语义编辑的同时显著提升了背景保留效果，且可即插即用地集成到 Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX 等主流流匹配主干中。
AI.conclusion: SAM-Flow 提供了一种简单且通用的局部编辑范式，有效解决了免训练图像编辑中的背景泄漏问题，无需任何微调即可实现精准的局部语义编辑。

title: On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is widely used for post-training reasoning models, but sparse outcome rewards make exploration difficult. A complementary approach is to optimize inference-time objectives such as pass@K and max@K directly, yet existing policy-gradient estimators for these objectives use different signals, baselines, and normalizations, making their relationships unclear. We study this issue through baseline design and advantage centering. Starting from the advantage estimator of a leading method in the field, we show that it is policy-gradient unbiased but yields a non-centered advantage. We then introduce a Leave-Two-Out baseline that preserves policy-gradient unbiasedness while making realized batch advantages exactly centered. The resulting method, MaxPO, has an efficient quadratic-time implementation and integrates naturally into group-based RL for LLM post-training. We further derive the canonical finite-batch advantage for max@K, providing a unified view of existing advantage estimators. Empirically, we verify that the L2O baseline reduces gradient variance and outperforms non-centered alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于可验证奖励的强化学习后训练中，针对max@K等推理时目标的策略梯度估计问题。通过基线设计和优势中心化，提出Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线实现精确中心化的优势估计，导出的MaxPO方法具有二次时间复杂度，能有效降低梯度方差并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在优化推理时目标（如pass@K和max@K）时使用了不同的信号、基线和归一化策略，彼此之间的关系不清晰。稀疏的结果奖励使探索困难，需要更有效的策略梯度估计方法。
AI.method: 从领先方法的优势估计器出发，证明了其策略梯度无偏但优势非中心化；提出Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线，保持无偏性的同时实现批次优势精确中心化；推导了max@K的规范有限批次优势估计，统一了现有优势估计器；MaxPO方法具有O(n²)的高效实现。
AI.result: L2O基线能有效降低梯度方差，在性能上优于非中心化的替代方法。
AI.conclusion: Leave-Two-Out基线结合优势中心化为推理时目标优化提供了统一且高效的策略梯度框架，MaxPO可自然集成到基于分组的LLM后训练强化学习中。

title: GRAMformer: Any-Order Modality Interactions via Volumetric Multimodal Cross-Attention
summary: Transformer-based multimodal models rely on attention mechanisms to integrate information across heterogeneous modalities. Despite their success, existing multimodal attention formulations compute their scores through collections of pairwise dot-product interactions or by concatenating all the modalities into the keys, even when multiple modalities should be jointly involved. As a consequence, current approaches either incur quadratic complexity in the number of modalities or fail to explicitly model interactions that depend on the joint configuration of multiple representations. In this work, we introduce the Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA), a novel cross-attention mechanism in which attention scores are defined as a function of the joint geometry of a query and multiple modality-specific keys. VMA computes the volume spanned by query and key vectors across multiple modalities, capturing joint multimodal dependencies beyond pairwise similarity, enabling native modeling of any-order modality interactions. We integrate VMA into our novel multimodal transformer architecture, named GRAMformer, explicitly designed to integrate any number of modalities. We evaluate the proposed model on multimodal learning tasks, demonstrating improved effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA)，通过计算查询和多个模态键的联合几何体积来定义注意力分数，捕获超越成对相似性的多模态联合依赖关系，并基于此设计了GRAMformer架构，在多模态学习任务中提升了有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的多模态注意力机制存在两个主要局限：要么计算复杂度随模态数量呈二次增长，要么无法显式建模依赖于多个表示联合配置的交互。亟需一种既能高效计算又能原生建模任意阶模态交互的跨注意力机制。
AI.method: 提出了Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA)，其核心创新在于将注意力分数定义为查询向量与多个模态键向量所张成的联合几何体积，从而捕获多模态间的联合依赖关系。基于VMA设计了GRAMformer多模态Transformer架构，支持任意数量模态的原生集成。
AI.result: 在多模态学习任务上的实验表明，所提出的模型在效果和效率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: VMA通过几何体积的方式建模多模态联合交互，克服了传统成对点积注意力的局限性，GRAMformer验证了该机制在任意数量模态集成中的有效性和高效性。

title: OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation
summary:
Policy-gradient methods usually optimize expected return, but many real world applications care about distributional properties of returns: tail risk, outlier robustness, or best-of-K discovery. We introduce OrderGrad, a family of likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives. OrderGrad optimizes finite-sample L-statistics, i.e., weighted averages of sorted rewards or costs, recovering objectives such as VaR, CVaR, trimmed means, medians, and top-m/best-of-K criteria by changing only the rank weights. For any fixed sample size and rank-weight vector, OrderGrad provides an unbiased gradient estimator for the corresponding order-statistic objective. The method is implemented as a simple reward transformation that can then be used in an otherwise standard policy-gradient or reparameterized update. We study the resulting estimator's variance behavior and evaluate it on tasks where mean optimization is mismatched to the deployment objective, including LLM math post-training and other tasks. OrderGrad provides a unified, plug-and-play route to risk-averse, robust, and exploratory learning.
  Code: https://github.com/paavo5/ordergrad

AI.tldr: OrderGrad提出了一族用于顺序统计量目标的似然比和重参数化梯度估计器，通过简单的奖励变换统一优化VaR、CVaR、截尾均值、中位数、top-m/best-of-K等目标，在LLM数学后训练等任务上优于标准均值优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现实应用往往关注回报的分布特性（如尾部风险、异常值鲁棒性、best-of-K发现），而标准策略梯度方法只优化期望回报，无法满足这些需求。
AI.method: 提出OrderGrad，定义了一族基于似然比和重参数化的梯度估计器，用于优化有限样本L-统计量（排序后奖励/成本的加权平均）。通过改变排序权重可恢复VaR、CVaR、截尾均值、中位数、top-m/best-of-K等目标。方法实现为简单的奖励变换，可直接嵌入标准策略梯度或重参数化更新中。
AI.result: 在LLM数学后训练等多种任务上评估，OrderGrad在均值优化与部署目标不匹配的场景下表现优于标准方法。
AI.conclusion: OrderGrad提供了一个统一的即插即用方案，支持风险厌恶、鲁棒性和探索性学习。

title: Geodesic Flow Matching on a Riemannian Degradation Manifold for Blind Image Restoration
summary: Blind image restoration requires recovering clean images from observations corrupted by unknown and potentially mixed degradations. While recent deterministic flow-based methods model restoration as transport processes that map degraded images to clean ones, they typically rely on Euclidean interpolation, implicitly assuming linear degradation geometry. In this paper, we explicitly model degradations as points on a low-dimensional Riemannian manifold and formulate restoration as geodesic transport on the joint image-manifold space. Using a geodesic flow matching objective, we learn intrinsic transport dynamics that respect the curvature of degradation space. This framework generalizes linear flow matching, provides a principled treatment of mixed degradations as geodesic compositions, and yields a clean theoretical interpretation for generalization beyond observed degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将退化显式建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，并利用测地流匹配学习内在传输动力学，将盲图像恢复转化为联合图像-流形空间上的测地传输，从而泛化传统的线性流匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于确定性流的方法将图像恢复建模为传输过程，但依赖欧几里得插值，隐含假设了线性退化几何结构，无法有效处理未知且可能混合的退化。
AI.method: 将退化显式建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，在联合图像-流形空间上通过测地流匹配目标学习尊重退化空间曲率的内在传输动力学。
AI.result: 该方法泛化了线性流匹配，为混合退化提供了作为测地合成的理论处理方式，并为超出观测退化的泛化提供了清晰的理论解释。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的黎曼几何框架在盲图像恢复中比欧几里得方法更优，尤其在处理复杂混合退化场景时具有理论上的优越性。

title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拉回欧几里得度量切片沃瑟斯坦（PEMSW）的通用框架，并在全秩相关矩阵流形上实例化了两种相关切片沃瑟斯坦（CorSW）散度，基于此构建了脑电解码的域泛化框架，在三个EEG数据集上证明了其在分布偏移下具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: EEG解码中的协方差描述子对通道缩放敏感，而全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代方案缺乏有效的差异度量方法。
AI.method: 提出PEMSW通用框架，将切片沃瑟斯坦散度推广到具有拉回欧几里得度量的流形上；基于两种相关几何（OLM和LSM）实例化CorSW散度；基于CorSW构建域泛化框架用于EEG解码。
AI.result: 在三个EEG数据集上，所提方法在分布偏移下泛化性能提升，训练开销低且无额外推理成本。
AI.conclusion: CorSW散度及其域泛化框架为EEG解码中尺度不变的相关矩阵表示提供了有效的差异度量与迁移学习方案。

title: Adaptive state-action abstractions via rate-distortion
summary: When learning to walk, infants seem to address a coarse version of the problem first - stay upright, reach the caregiver - and refine it only when further practice at that resolution stops paying off. Reinforcement learning offers multiple techniques for building simple versions of complex tasks, but lacks general principles for how to dynamically adjust the granularity of these abstractions during learning. This paper proposes one such principle: refine the abstraction as soon as the learning error within it becomes comparable to the error induced by the abstraction itself. Here, we investigate one way of formalising this principle via a performance certificate that decomposes value error into two terms: a learning error bound captured by a Bellman residual, and an abstraction error bound given by a bisimulation metric. The resulting switching strategy is implemented by soft state-action abstractions built from rate-distortion principles, whose resolution along state and action axes can be continuously adjusted. We validate this construction in a range of tabular settings, showing that near-optimal performance can be achieved under substantial lossy compression of state and action information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动态调整强化学习抽象粒度的原则：当学习误差与抽象误差相当时，细化抽象。通过基于率失真理论的软状态-动作抽象实现，并在表格环境中验证了在显著压缩下仍能保持近最优性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习缺乏动态调整抽象粒度的一般性原则，而婴儿学习行走时似乎先处理粗略版本问题，待收益递减后再细化。作者希望提出一种形式化机制，自动决定何时以及如何调整抽象层次。
AI.method: 提出基于性能证书（performance certificate）的切换策略，将值函数误差分解为两项：由Bellman残差界定的学习误差，以及由双模拟度量（bisimulation metric）界定的抽象误差。当两者相当时触发抽象细化。抽象本身通过率失真原理构建软状态-动作抽象，状态和动作轴的分辨率可连续调节。
AI.result: 在多种表格环境中验证，表明即使在状态和动作信息被大幅有损压缩的情况下，该方法仍能实现近最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 动态抽象调整是可行的，率失真框架为构建可调分辨率的抽象提供了理论基础，未来可推广到更复杂的连续控制场景。

title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
summary: Temporal Grounding (TG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a textual query. Prior research predominantly focuses on single-segment retrieval. Real-world scenarios, however, often require localizing multiple disjoint segments for a single query -- a setting we term One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG). Previous state-of-the-art MLLMs, optimized for one-to-one settings, struggle in this context, often yielding near-zero scores due to a lack of event cardinality perception. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic solution with three key contributions. First, we establish the first comprehensive OMTG benchmark, introducing Count Accuracy (C-Acc) and Effective Temporal F1 (EtF1) as evaluation metrics. Second, we curate a high-quality OMTG dataset comprising 56k samples through a sophisticated construction pipeline. Third, we develop novel temporal and caption reward functions specifically designed for OMTG. In particular, the caption reward leverages Chain-of-Thought reasoning over dense video captions to explicitly guide policy optimization toward both preciseness and completeness. Extensive experiments show our model achieves a new state-of-the-art EtF1 of 43.65\% on OMTG Bench, outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and Seed-1.8 by 15.85\% and 15.61\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦于One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG)任务，即根据单个文本查询定位多个不连续视频片段。作者系统性地提出了三个贡献：建立了首个OMTG基准和评估指标(C-Acc, EtF1)；构建了包含5.6万样本的高质量数据集；设计了专门用于OMTG的时间奖励和标题奖励函数（利用CoT推理进行策略优化）。模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，超越Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.8分别15.85%和15.61%。
AI.motivation: 现有时间定位研究主要针对单片段检索，但真实场景中常需为单个查询定位多个不连续片段（即OMTG任务）。先前最先进的MLLM在一对一设置下优化，缺乏事件基数感知能力，在OMTG场景中表现极差（近乎零分），因此亟需系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 建立首个OMTG基准，提出C-Acc和EtF1评估指标；2) 通过精细构建流程构建包含5.6万样本的高质量OMTG数据集；3) 设计时间奖励和标题奖励函数，其中标题奖励利用密集视频标题的思维链推理显式引导策略优化，兼顾精确性和完整性。
AI.result: 模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，超越Gemini 2.5 Pro（15.85%提升）和Seed-1.8（15.61%提升），达到新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的系统性解决方案有效填补了OMTG任务的空白，所设计的专门奖励函数（尤其是基于CoT的标题奖励）能显著提升模型在多片段时间定位中的事件基数感知和定位精度。

title: Tight list replicability bounds via a novel sphere covering theorem
summary:
In recent years, list replicability has emerged as a framework for formalizing reproducibility in learning theory. A central question is how the required list size relates to the accuracy parameter and natural complexity measures of the hypothesis class.
  To achieve sharp bounds on list replicability, we prove a novel topological sphere covering theorem, derived from the Borsuk-Ulam theorem. Specifically, if the $d$-sphere is covered by open sets, each of which lies in an open hemisphere, then $d+1$ of these sets must have a common intersection. Using this result, we obtain a sharp bound on the relationship between list size and accuracy for VC classes. We also show that for large-margin half-spaces, provided the margin is not too large, the optimal list size equals the ambient dimension. However, when the margin is taken to be very large, we devise a replicable algorithm achieving the minimal list size of $\lceil d/2 \rceil + 1$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过证明一个新的拓扑球面覆盖定理（源自Borsuk-Ulam定理），在列表可复现性框架下，精确刻画了VC类假设空间的列表大小与精度参数之间的关系，并针对大间隔半空间给出了最优列表大小的严格界限。
AI.motivation: 列表可复现性作为形式化机器学习可复现性的框架，核心问题在于确定列表大小与精度参数及假设类复杂度度量之间的精确关系，此前缺乏尖锐的界限。
AI.method: 证明了一个拓扑球面覆盖定理（若d-球面被开集覆盖，每个开集位于一个开半球内，则必有d+1个集合有公共交集），并利用该定理推导VC类的列表大小与精度的尖锐界；同时针对大间隔半空间分情况讨论，采用复现算法分别得出最优列表大小。
AI.result: 得到VC类列表大小与精度关系的尖锐界；证明大间隔半空间在间隔不太大时最优列表大小等于环境维度d；当间隔非常大时，可用复现算法达到最小列表大小⌈d/2⌉+1。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑方法为列表可复现性提供了理论支撑，给出了不同假设类下列表大小的精确刻画，推进了对可复现学习理论的理解。

title: RhymeFlow: Training-Free Acceleration for Video Generation with Asynchronous Denoising Flow Scheduling
summary: Video generation models based on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved remarkable performance in video synthesis, yet they suffer from high inference latency and computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of 3D attention. Existing acceleration methods primarily reduce computational complexity within each individual denoising steps through techniques such as sparse attention and KV-caching. However, they rigidly adhere to the inherent constraint of the standard diffusion pipeline: every frame in the target video sequence must be subjected to a complete, dense denoising process across all diffusion timesteps. We observe that due to the corresponding contents and motions among adjacent frames, when keyframes with critical semantic transitions are anchored, the intermediate states of others often follow more predictable trajectories, which indicates that such uniform, dense denoising process is inherently redundant for natural video data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{RhymeFlow}, a training-free framework that decouples the denoising trajectories of different frames. Specifically, we first identify a sparse set of pivotal key frames that dominate the latent semantic evolution.
