Then, only these keyframes undergo dense, step-by-step denoising to ensure structural integrity, while non-keyframes progressively skip denoising steps to minimize computational cost. Since skipped intermediate states of non-keyframes break the temporal coherence in keyframe denoising steps, leading to visual degradation, we further introduce a latent trajectory projection module, which enables keyframes to interact with a complete and temporally consistent sequence representation. Extensive experiments on current DiT-based video generation models demonstrate our method outperforms existing baselines with higher inference speed and better visual quality.

AI.tldr: RhymeFlow提出了一种无需训练的视频生成加速框架，通过解耦不同帧的去噪轨迹：仅对关键帧进行完整去噪，非关键帧逐步跳过去噪步骤，并引入潜在轨迹投影模块保持时间一致性，从而在基于DiT的视频生成模型中实现更高推理速度和更好视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DiT的视频生成模型因3D注意力的二次复杂度导致高推理延迟和计算成本。现有加速方法虽降低了单步计算复杂度，但仍遵循标准扩散管线的固有约束——所有帧必须在所有时间步上进行完整密集去噪。作者观察到相邻帧之间存在内容与运动相关性，当关键帧锚定后，其他帧的中间状态遵循可预测轨迹，因此这种均匀密集去噪过程对自然视频数据本质上是冗余的。
AI.method: 1) 识别一组稀疏的关键帧（主导潜在语义演化）；2) 仅关键帧执行密集逐步去噪以保证结构完整性，非关键帧逐步跳过去噪步骤以降低计算成本；3) 引入潜在轨迹投影模块，使关键帧能与完整且时间一致的序列表示交互，解决因非关键帧跳过中间状态导致的时间一致性问题。
AI.result: 在基于DiT的视频生成模型上的实验表明，RhymeFlow在推理速度和高视觉质量方面均优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦不同帧的去噪轨迹，RhymeFlow在不需额外训练的情况下有效提升了DiT视频生成模型的推理效率，同时保持了甚至提升了视觉质量。

title: Trust-Aware Predictive Emissions Monitoring for Gas Turbine Fleets with Limited Labelled Data
summary: Machine learning-based predictive emissions monitoring systems offer a practical alternative to direct emissions measurement, but their deployment across gas turbine fleets is challenging when emissions labels are available for only a small subset of assets. In this work, a trust-aware probabilistic framework is proposed for fleet-level gas turbine NOx prediction under limited labelled supervision. The framework combines a multi-head recurrent prediction model with learned confidence estimation, ensemble-based uncertainty quantification, auxiliary feature prediction, feature-space distance analysis, and operating-range diagnostics. These signals are calibrated on labelled data to produce interpretable per-sample trust scores, providing indicators of prediction reliability on unlabelled turbines, supporting the identification of predictions that should be treated with greater caution during fleet-level deployment. Confidence-based filtering reduces MAE from 0.202 at full coverage to 0.070 for the highest-confidence 10\% of predictions, demonstrating that confidence estimates are meaningfully related to prediction error. Unlabelled and out-of-distribution samples exhibit increased uncertainty and reduced confidence, indicating that the framework responds appropriately to distributional shift. The results show that the proposed trust framework provides actionable reliability information for emissions prediction on unlabelled turbines, supporting more transparent and trustworthy deployment of PEMS across industrial fleets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信任感知的概率框架，用于在仅有少量资产有排放标签的情况下，实现燃气轮机机队级别的NOx预测。该框架结合多头递归预测模型、置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，生成可解释的逐样本信任分数，帮助识别不可靠预测。基于置信度的过滤将MAE从0.202（全覆盖）降至0.070（最高置信度10%的预测），表明框架能有效提供可靠性信息。
AI.motivation: 基于机器学习的预测性排放监测系统是直接排放测量的实用替代方案，但在仅有少量资产有排放标签的情况下，跨燃气轮机机队部署面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出信任感知概率框架，结合多头递归预测模型、学习置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，在标注数据上校准生成逐样本信任分数。
AI.result: 置信度过滤将MAE从0.202（全覆盖）降至0.070（最高置信度10%的预测）。未标注和分布外样本表现出增加的不确定性和降低的置信度。
AI.conclusion: 该信任框架为未标注涡轮机上的排放预测提供了可操作的可靠性信息，支持PEMS在工业机队中更透明和可信赖的部署。

title: StoryVideoQA: Scaling Deep Video Understanding with a Large-Scale, Multi-Genre and Auto-Generated Dataset
summary: Video question answering (VideoQA) aims to answer questions about given videos. While existing approaches excel on factoid VideoQA, they struggle with deep video understanding (DVU), which requires the comprehension of complex storylines. This challenge arises from the inherent long-range video content, multi-faceted question types, and instance-level story elements, all of which constrain the scale and diversity of manually constructed DVU datasets. These difficulties constrain the scale and diversity of manually-constructed DVU dataset. To address these, we previously introduced StoryMind to automatically construct DVU datasets with balanced fine-grained topics. Though it can generate high-quality question-answer pairs (QAs) for TV series, it suffers significant performance degradation when handling longer and more complex movies. In this paper, we further design StoryMindv2, an enhanced multi-agent collaboration framework to generate high-quality DVU datasets for both TV series and movies. By integrating a novel supervisor-guided generation mechanism and a refined multi-reviewer voting strategy, the framework is utilized to construct StoryVideoQA, the largest DVU dataset to date, featuring over 363K QAs on 393.2 hours diverse story videos including TV series (avg. 1,635 seconds) and movies (avg. 7,878 seconds). Comprehensive evaluations of 20 state-of-the-art VideoQA methods on this large-scale benchmark reveal that they cannot fully maintain long-range character associations or construct a coherent understanding of complex storylines. To bridge this gap, we propose PlotTree, a novel video understanding agent, re-organizing long-range video content into a hierarchical plot structure, enabling efficient storyline reasoning on StoryVideoQA. Project page: https://github.com/nercms-mmap/StoryVideoQA/

AI.tldr: 本文提出StoryMindv2，一种增强的多智能体协作框架，用于自动构建大规模深度视频理解（DVU）数据集StoryVideoQA（含363K+问答对，覆盖393.2小时影视内容），并设计了基于分层情节结构的视频理解智能体PlotTree，以解决现有VideoQA方法在长时复杂视频理解上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有VideoQA方法在事实型问答上表现优异，但在深度视频理解（DVU）上效果不佳，原因在于长视频内容、多面问题类型和实例级故事元素导致人工构建DVU数据集规模有限且多样性不足。先前工作StoryMind在处理更长的电影时性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出StoryMindv2多智能体协作框架，引入监督引导生成机制（supervisor-guided generation）和精炼的多评审投票策略（multi-reviewer voting），自动构建高质量DVU数据集。同时提出PlotTree视频理解智能体，将长视频内容重新组织为层次化情节结构（hierarchical plot structure），实现高效的故事情节推理。
AI.result: 构建了目前最大的DVU数据集StoryVideoQA，包含363K+问答对，覆盖393.2小时视频（电视剧平均1635秒，电影平均7878秒）。在20种SOTA VideoQA方法上的评估表明，现有方法无法充分维持长程角色关联和构建连贯的故事情节理解。
AI.conclusion: StoryMindv2能有效生成高质量DVU数据集，StoryVideoQA为长视频理解提供了更具挑战性的基准，PlotTree通过层次化情节结构显著提升了长视频故事理解能力。

title: On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations
summary: Physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) aim to learn solution operators for partial differential equations by using the governing physics as supervision, rather than relying solely on paired input-output simulation data. By incorporating physical constraints into the training objective, PINOs combine the cross-instance generalization of neural operators with the data efficiency of physics-informed learning. Despite this promise, how to train PINOs efficiently and robustly remains less well-understood than the training of either data-driven neural operators or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To bridge this gap, we examine key components of the PINO training pipeline, including architecture design, optimizer choice, loss balancing, and collocation-point sampling strategy. We study three representative operator backbones, Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), across five diverse parametric PDE systems. Our results show that CViT provides consistently strong and stable performance across the considered benchmarks. Beyond architecture, we find that several optimization pathologies previously identified in PINN training naturally arise in PINOs, including gradient conflicts and causal violation. We also find that mitigation algorithms developed for PINNs remain effective in the PINO setting. We further compare physics-informed and data-driven training under different data regimes, revealing that a carefully designed physics-informed training pipeline can match, and in some cases, outperform purely data-driven neural operators. Taken together, these findings provide a systematic empirical understanding of the optimization challenges in PINO training and inform a practical pipeline for efficient and robust physics-informed operator learning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NanxiiChen/PI-CViT.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了物理信息神经算子（PINO）的训练管道，涵盖架构选择、优化器、损失平衡和采样策略。实验表明CViT架构表现最佳，PINO训练中存在梯度冲突和因果违反等优化问题，且PINN的缓解算法仍有效。精心设计的PINO管道在某些场景下可媲美甚至超越纯数据驱动方法。
AI.motivation: PINO结合了神经算子的跨实例泛化能力和物理信息学习的数据效率，但其训练效率与鲁棒性尚未被充分理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 系统研究了PINO训练管道的关键组件，包括架构设计（DeepONet、FNO、CViT）、优化器选择、损失平衡和配点采样策略，在五个参数化PDE系统上进行了实验对比。
AI.result: CViT在所有基准上表现最稳定；PINO训练中存在梯度冲突和因果违反等优化问题；PINN的缓解算法在PINO中仍然有效；精心设计的物理信息训练管道在某些场景下可媲美甚至超越纯数据驱动方法。
AI.conclusion: 系统揭示了PINO训练的优化挑战，提供了高效鲁棒的物理信息算子学习的实用训练管道建议。

title: Comparison of Deep Learning Frameworks For Rice Disease Mapping From UAV Multispectral Imaging
comment: This paper has been accepted in IGARSS 2026. Copyright 2026 IEEE
summary: In this study, UAV multispectral imagery is used to segment the severity of bacterial leaf blight (BLB) in rice using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformer-based models. The evaluated architectures include U-Net with a ResNet- 101 encoder, U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 and EfficientNetB7, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer, all trained under a common pipeline with three input configurations (multispectral only, multispectral+NDVI, and multispectral+NDRE). Experiments are conducted using the publicly available BLB dataset with performance reported using mean IoU (mIoU), mean F1 (mF1), mean accuracy (mAcc), precision, and recall. U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 achieved the highest performance, with an mIoU of 97.62%. SegFormer obtained lower segmentation accuracy but comparable inference speed. Overall, the results indicate that lightweight CNN backbones remain more reliable for operational BLB monitoring while integration of vegetation indices provides small and consistent improvements. The study also highlights the value of standardised UAV datasets to compare disease mapping methods and encourages the use of CNN architectures for field implementation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用无人机多光谱影像，结合CNN和Transformer模型对水稻白叶枯病严重程度进行分割。U-Net++搭配EfficientNet-B3取得了最佳性能（mIoU 97.62%），轻量级CNN骨干在病害监测中仍更为可靠，植被指数的引入带来了一致的小幅提升。
AI.motivation: 探索CNN和Transformer模型在无人机多光谱影像上分割水稻白叶枯病严重程度的表现，评估不同架构、骨干网络及输入配置（多光谱、多光谱+NDVI、多光谱+NDRE）的影响，为田间病害监测提供可靠方法。
AI.method: 使用U-Net（ResNet-101编码器）、U-Net++（EfficientNet-B3和EfficientNet-B7）、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer五种架构，在统一训练流程下，采用三种输入配置（仅多光谱、多光谱+NDVI、多光谱+NDRE），在公开BLB数据集上进行实验，以mIoU、mF1、mAcc、精确率和召回率评估性能。
AI.result: U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3取得最高性能（mIoU 97.62%）；SegFormer分割精度较低但推理速度相当；轻量级CNN骨干在操作监测中更可靠；植被指数的整合带来一致的小幅改进。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级CNN架构在无人机水稻白叶枯病监测中仍优于Transformer模型，标准化无人机数据集对对比病害绘图方法具有重要价值，建议在田间实施中采用CNN架构。

title: Learning to model pediatric asthma exacerbation from multiple risk factors: a case study in coastal Virginia
summary: Childhood asthma is a common illness exacerbated by air pollution as well as meteorological and neighborhood-level socioeconomic factors. Modeling asthma exacerbation (AE) in large spatiotemporal datasets requires disentangling impacts from multiple contributors. In this case study, we compared three techniques that balance predictive power with interpretability to predict AE in Hampton Roads, a coastal Virginia region comprising 7 cities and over 1.5 million people. After collating ambient air pollution measurements, weather data, and measures of neighborhood opportunity, we modeled zip code-level acute AE visits to a regional children's hospital and affiliated providers from 2018-2023. Generalized linear models (GLM) provided a baseline while neural networks (NN) served as a maximally predictive target. To bridge between statistical models and deep learning, we developed a framework based on sparse dictionary learning to identify and interpret parsimonious nonlinear interacting equations. After comparing each model's predictive performance, we estimated relative risks for AE due to input exposure variables and found consensus across frameworks. Our work links statistical and interpretable machine learning models to highlight possible synergistic interactions influencing AE, and may enable future studies to guide public health interventions in coastal Virginia.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了广义线性模型、神经网络和稀疏字典学习三种方法，用于预测弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区儿童哮喘急性发作，发现不同模型在预测性能和风险因素识别上具有共识。
AI.motivation: 儿童哮喘急性发作受空气污染、气象和社区社会经济因素共同影响，在大规模时空数据中建模需要厘清多个贡献因素的作用，现有方法在预测能力与可解释性之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 收集2018-2023年弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路7个城市、150万人口区域的空气污染、气象和社区机会数据，建立zip码级急性哮喘就诊模型。比较广义线性模型（基线）、神经网络（最大预测性）和基于稀疏字典学习的可解释框架，识别简约的非线性交互方程。
AI.result: 各模型在预测性能比较后，对输入暴露变量引发的急性哮喘相对风险估计表现出跨框架的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将统计模型与可解释机器学习模型相结合，揭示了影响哮喘急性发作的潜在协同交互作用，为未来指导弗吉尼亚沿海地区公共卫生干预措施提供了基础。

title: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them
summary: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws. We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model. Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable. Building on this insight, we propose PhaseLock, a training-free framework that preserves the valid motion priors from few-step inference throughout the denoising trajectory. Rather than relying on full-step inference for physical consistency, PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from just 2 steps and enforces it onto high-fidelity generation via Latent Delta Guidance. Our approach effectively mitigates phase degradation, improving physical consistency by an average of 6.2 points across diverse models while largely maintaining visual fidelity, with negligible overhead ($1.06\times$ time, $1.02\times$ memory) and reduced reliance on expensive external guidance methods ($\sim5\times$ time).

AI.tldr: 本文发现图像到视频扩散模型在少步（2步）生成时比多步（50步）具有更好的物理一致性，通过频谱分析将原因归结为去噪过程中的相位侵蚀（从2步到50步相位下降约18%）。基于此提出PhaseLock，一种无需训练的方法，从2步生成中提取运动先验并通过潜在增量引导（Latent Delta Guidance）将其强制作用于高保真生成过程，有效缓解相位退化，使物理一致性平均提升6.2分，同时几乎不增加计算开销（1.06倍时间，1.02倍内存），并减少对外部昂贵引导方法的依赖（约5倍时间）。
AI.motivation: 图像到视频扩散模型生成的视频虽然视觉惊艳，但经常产生违反物理规律的运动，需要解决这一物理不一致性问题。
AI.method: 通过频谱分析发现相位侵蚀是物理不一致的根源，提出PhaseLock框架：从2步推理中提取有效的运动先验，通过潜在增量引导（Latent Delta Guidance）在整个去噪轨迹中施加该先验，无需额外训练。
AI.result: PhaseLock在多种模型上将物理一致性平均提升6.2分，仅带来1.06倍时间和1.02倍内存的极小开销，同时减少约5倍的外部引导方法使用时间。
AI.conclusion: 少步推理蕴含更好的物理运动先验，通过相位保持策略可以有效提升视频扩散模型的物理一致性，是一种高效且通用的解决方案。

title: Learning to Route LLMs from Implicit Cost-Performance Preferences via Meta-Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) present a trade-off between performance and cost, where more powerful models incur greater expense. LLM routing aims to mitigate expenses while maintaining performance by sending queries to the most suitable model. However, existing methods cannot perform well for different user cost-performance preferences. To address this gap, we introduce a novel perceptive LLM routing paradigm for personalized and user-centric cost-performance optimization, which efficiently learns users' implicit preferences through little interaction. To handle the challenge of heterogeneous user needs, we formulate preference profiles as a set of distinct tasks in contextual bandit and propose MetaRouter, a meta-learning framework designed for preference-aware LLM routing. Experimental results show that MetaRouter outperforms strong baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. Furthermore, it exhibits high efficiency in learning user preferences, robustness to changes in the routable LLMs, and scalability to multi-model routing.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaRouter，一种基于元学习的LLM路由框架，通过少量交互学习用户隐性偏好，实现个性化成本-性能优化，在分布内/外任务上均优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法无法适应不同用户的成本-性能偏好差异，缺乏个性化优化能力。
AI.method: 将用户偏好建模为上下文赌博机中的不同任务，提出基于元学习（MetaRouter）的偏好感知LLM路由框架，通过少量交互高效学习用户隐性偏好。
AI.result: MetaRouter在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线，且在学习效率、对可路由LLM变化的鲁棒性以及多模型路由扩展性方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: MetaRouter有效解决了个性化成本-性能优化的LLM路由问题，具备高效学习、鲁棒和可扩展等优势。

title: GMBFormer: An NDVI-Guided Global Memory Bank Transformer for Urban Green-Space Extraction from Ultra-High-Resolution Imagery
summary: Urban green-space extraction from ultra-high-resolution (UHR) imagery is commonly performed patch by patch, which limits semantic reuse among spatially separated but visually similar vegetation patterns. Directly injecting the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) into red-green-blue (RGB) backbones can also blur the roles of visual appearance learning and physical vegetation confidence. We propose GMBFormer, a SegFormer-based framework that replaces adjacency-driven feature propagation with selective, similarity-driven prototype retrieval. Only RGB channels enter the backbone and decoder, while NDVI is decoupled as a physics-informed gate that admits high-confidence vegetation descriptors into a compact global memory bank through momentum updates. During training and inference, the current patch queries stored prototypes through memory-mediated cross-attention, and the retrieved response is integrated with bounded overhead. Experiments use a self-constructed Chengdu UHR dataset with 7,700 labeled 512 x 512 patches and two reduced-label settings derived from the public International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ISPRS) Potsdam dataset. Under the same training and evaluation protocol, GMBFormer obtains mean intersection over union (mIoU)/mean Dice (mDice) scores of 89.25%/94.31%, 92.17%/95.92%, and 83.72%/90.86%, respectively, improving the controlled SegFormer-B4 baseline in each setting. Ablation studies indicate that decoupled NDVI admission, memory retrieval, capacity, and momentum jointly shape the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出GMBFormer，一种基于SegFormer的框架，通过将NDVI解耦为物理信息门控，结合全局记忆库的原型检索机制，实现超高分遥感影像的绿地提取，在自建成都数据集和ISPRS Potsdam数据集上均取得优于基线SegFormer-B4的性能。
AI.motivation: 超高分遥感影像的绿地提取通常采用逐块处理方式，限制了空间分离但视觉相似的植被图案之间的语义复用；直接将NDVI注入RGB骨干网络会模糊视觉外观学习与物理植被置信度的各自作用。
AI.method: 基于SegFormer框架，仅RGB通道进入骨干和解码器，NDVI作为物理信息门控解耦，用于筛选高置信度植被描述符，通过动量更新存入紧凑的全局记忆库；训练和推理时，当前块通过记忆介导的交叉注意力查询存储的原型，并集成检索响应。
AI.result: 在自建成都UHR数据集（7700张512×512块）和ISPRS Potsdam数据集的两个减少标注设置下，GMBFormer分别获得89.25%/94.31%、92.17%/95.92%和83.72%/90.86%的mIoU/mDice，均优于对比的SegFormer-B4基线。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的NDVI准入机制、记忆检索、记忆容量和动量更新共同塑造了最终性能，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。

title: A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Discovering Huntington's Disease Stages: Integrating Graph Representation Learning and clustering to Uncover Progression Dynamics in Longitudinal Enroll-HD Dataset
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Medical and Health Informatics (ICMHI 2026), Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
summary: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive brain disorder that gradually affects movement, cognitive function, and behavior. Identifying the stage of the disease accurately and consistently is important for understanding its course, grouping patients, personalized care, and discovering treatment. Existing clinical staging frameworks rely primarily on predefined clinical measurement thresholds and clinical expert decisions, yet these discrete cut-offs may obscure meaningful intra-stage variability and remain vulnerable to inter-rater differences, especially in motor and functional assessments. To address these limitations, we developed an unsupervised machine learning framework based on dynamic graph representation learning to capture temporal relationships within and across patients from longitudinal clinical measurements. Using the learned representations, we applied K-means++ clustering to identify well-separated groups. We then iteratively increased the number of clusters (k), using stability analysis to assess robustness and reveal additional meaningful clusters beyond the initial optimal solution. We applied the framework to 302 individuals from the Enroll-HD cohort (1,477 visits, 44 clinical variables per visit; 80% manifest participants), enabling data-driven discovery of HD stages reflecting natural clinical progression. Despite the limited cohort size, the proposed framework achieved robust clustering performance using a four-dimensional latent space, identifying four meaningful and statistically distinct disease stages through clustering stability analysis. Each stage corresponded to well-defined clinical measurement boundaries, with minimal overlap compared to previously established clinical staging methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于动态图表示学习的无监督框架，利用纵向临床数据识别亨廷顿舞蹈症的疾病阶段，在302名患者中识别出4个有意义的疾病阶段，相比传统临床分期方法具有更清晰的边界和更少的重叠。
AI.motivation: 现有HD临床分期框架依赖预设临床阈值和专家决策，存在离散阈值模糊分期内变异、评估者间差异大等问题，尤其在运动和功能评估方面。
AI.method: 基于动态图表示学习捕捉患者内和患者间的纵向时序关系，使用K-means++聚类，通过稳定性分析迭代增加聚类数k以发现有意义的分期。
AI.result: 在302名Enroll-HD队列个体（1477次访视，44个临床变量）中，使用四维潜在空间实现鲁棒聚类，识别出4个统计上显著的疾病阶段，各阶段对应明确的临床测量边界。
AI.conclusion: 提出的数据驱动框架能有效发现反映自然临床进展的HD阶段，相比传统方法分期边界更清晰、重叠更少。

title: Visual Commonsense Driven Knowledge Refinements for Scene Graph Generation
summary: Learning-driven Scene Graph Generation (SGG) models excel on frequent relation types but degrade sharply under annotation sparsity, failing to capture reliable visual commonsense knowledge. We propose a model-agnostic, semantically-guided knowledge refinement framework that systematically mines commonsense-grounded constraints from training data - capturing spatial, functional, and qualitative relational regularities - and uses general declarative commonsense reasoning to correct and refine ranked SGG predictions at inference time. The framework requires no manual rule authoring, no model retraining, and transfers across datasets and architectures. On three standard benchmarks, we obtain consistent improvements over strong baselines, demonstrating that structured visual commonsense reasoning over deep scene semantics is a practical and effective complement to purely learning-based scene graph generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需人工规则编写和模型重训练的语义引导知识精炼框架，通过从训练数据中挖掘常识约束并进行声明式常识推理，在推理时修正和精炼场景图生成模型的预测结果，在三个标准基准上持续优于强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的场景图生成模型在常见关系类型上表现良好，但在标注稀疏的情况下性能显著下降，无法捕获可靠的视觉常识知识。
AI.method: 提出一种模型无关的语义引导知识精炼框架：从训练数据中系统性地挖掘常识约束（包括空间、功能和定性的关系规律），并在推理时通过通用声明式常识推理来修正和精炼排序后的场景图预测。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准数据集上，该框架持续优于强基线模型，取得了稳定一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视觉常识推理能够有效补充纯学习的场景图生成方法，说明了将深度场景语义的结构化常识推理应用于SGG的实用性和有效性。

title: Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Event Data
summary: Continuous-time event data, in which entities emit instantaneous events over time, arises naturally across many domains such as neuroscience, seismology, and social networks. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a natural tool to uncover interpretable structure in such data, but it has so far only been applied after binning or smoothing the entity-level counting measures. This preprocessing step comes with the risk of erasing entity-level heterogeneities and fine-grained temporal features. In this paper, we introduce EventNMF, a continuous-time non-negative factorization model that operates directly on event times: each entity's events are modeled as a Poisson process whose intensity factorizes through a non-negative B-spline basis, and a simple estimation procedure recovers interpretable temporal templates shared across entities. The resulting method is mathematically principled, easy to implement, and computationally efficient. We further show that standard binned-count approaches arise as the special case of degree-zero splines, explore bias-variance tradeoffs and compare against existing methods on a synthetic latent factor model, and demonstrate the effectiveness of EventNMF on several real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EventNMF，一种直接作用于连续时间事件数据的非负矩阵分解模型，通过Poisson过程与非负B样条基函数分解事件强度，避免传统分箱或平滑预处理导致的信息损失，并在合成与真实数据上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统NMF应用于连续时间事件数据时，必须先进行分箱或平滑预处理，这可能导致实体级异质性和细粒度时间特征的丢失。因此，需要一种能直接对原始事件时间建模的NMF方法。
AI.method: 将每个实体的事件建模为Poisson过程，其强度函数通过非负B样条基函数进行因子分解；采用简洁的估计过程恢复实体间共享的可解释时间模板；零次样条对应于标准分箱计数方法作为特例。
AI.result: 在合成潜在因子模型上分析了偏差-方差权衡并与现有方法对比；在多个真实世界应用上展示了EventNMF的有效性；证明了该方法在数学上严谨、易于实现且计算高效。
AI.conclusion: EventNMF提供了一种直接对连续时间事件数据建模的NMF框架，避免了预处理信息损失，同时保持了NMF的可解释性，在理论和实践中均表现出优势。

title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. Although effective, these approaches usually require additional training or model-specific adaptation and may overfit to particular disease morphologies, limiting their applicability to frozen medical VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose EasyLens, a training-free plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier for medical VLMs. EasyLens first constructs EasyBank, a pathology-anatomy prototype space that provides lesion-related prototypes and anatomy-aware normal references for comparing suspicious patches against both pathological and normal anatomical patterns. To avoid blindly amplifying normal tissues, EasyTag selects lesion-relevant patches through counterfactual prototype reasoning. To counteract the dilution of subtle lesion cues in global image representations, EasyAmplifier strengthens the selected lesion-relevant patch representations through morphology-guided residual enhancement, thereby increasing their contribution to the global image embedding. Experiments on multiple medical image datasets and frozen medical VLM backbones show that EasyLens improves subtle-lesion detection and outperforms existing encoder-enhancement baselines.

AI.tldr: EasyLens是一种无需训练的即插即用模块，通过构建病理-解剖原型空间（EasyBank）、反事实原型推理选择病变相关斑块（EasyTag）以及形态学引导的残差增强（EasyAmplifier），有效放大了医学视觉语言模型对细微病变的表征能力，在多个数据集上显著提升了病变检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VLM对细微病变（低对比度、稀疏视觉线索、嵌入复杂解剖背景）的敏感性不足，而现有增强方法依赖额外训练或模型特定适配，难以直接应用于冻结的医学VLM。
AI.method: 1) EasyBank：构建包含病变相关原型和解剖感知正常参考的原型空间；2) EasyTag：通过反事实原型推理选择病变相关斑块；3) EasyAmplifier：利用形态学引导的残差增强强化所选斑块表征，增加其在全局图像嵌入中的贡献。
AI.result: 在多个医学图像数据集和冻结的医学VLM骨干上，EasyLens显著提升了细微病变检测性能，优于现有的编码器增强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EasyLens作为一种无需训练的即插即用方案，有效解决了医学VLM对细微病变敏感性不足的问题，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting
summary: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成大语言模型（LLM）的死亡率预测接口，通过将自然语言输入转换为结构化配置，在保持统计严谨性的同时提升了非专业用户的可及性。系统采用三阶段方法：基于CoMoMo包构建基线预测流程、引入滚动起点评估和均方误差进行多步预测、利用本地LLM处理用户自然语言请求。实验表明，LLM能在不牺牲可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的前提下增强高利害分析工作流的可访问性。
AI.motivation: 死亡率预测在精算和政策决策中至关重要，但现有实现技术复杂、对非专业用户不友好。作者旨在解决这一可及性与可用性之间的矛盾，让非专家用户也能可靠地使用死亡率预测工具。
AI.method: 采用三阶段方法：1) 使用CoMoMo包构建基线确定性预测流程；2) 扩展为滚动起点评估的多步预测，以均方误差（MSE）衡量性能；3) 设计原型接口，通过本地LLM将用户自然语言输入转化为结构化的预测配置参数，LLM作为受约束的编排层，不直接参与数值计算。
AI.result: 系统成功实现了LLM增强的死亡率预测接口，在保持可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的同时，显著提升了非专业用户的可及性。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以作为高利害精算工作流中的受约束编排层，在增强用户体验和可访问性的同时，不牺牲预测结果的统计严谨性和可重复性。该设计范式为其他技术复杂的精算与政策分析场景提供了参考。

title: HomeWorld: A Unified Floorplan-to-Furnished Framework for Generating Controllable, Densely Interactive Whole-Home Scenes
summary: Indoor scene generation is crucial for robot simulation and modern interior design. However, complex layouts together with scarce 3D scene data make learning-based generation challenging. Existing methods often rely on hand-crafted rules or focus on isolated sub-tasks (e.g., floorplan synthesis or single-room furnishing), producing whole-home scenes that lack global coherence, realism, and simulation readiness. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a unified hierarchical framework that decomposes indoor scene synthesis into controllable stages. First, we curate a large-scale dataset of 300K real residential floorplans to train a large language model for whole-home floorplan generation. With detailed descriptions and a K-D tree-based representation, our method enables fine-grained, controllable whole-home floorplan generation. Building upon the generated whole-home floorplan, we leverage image generation models to draft furniture layouts from multi-level roaming viewpoints, and then generate the layouts of small manipulable objects on different supporting surfaces (e.g., cabinets, desks, and dining tables) for embodied AI simulation. During furniture and object layout generation, a VLM-based refiner iteratively corrects furniture and object placement, and a 3D generative model enables flexible replacement of individual assets. We further attach basic physical attributes and simple surface texture and lighting setups to complete the pipeline for embodied AI use. Experiments and user studies demonstrate that our pipeline produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on both quantitative and qualitative metrics. Finally, alongside our generation pipeline, we will release the floorplan dataset and 5K fully furnished scenes to the community. Project Page: https://kairos-homeworld.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的层次化框架用于室内场景生成，通过大规模数据集训练的语言模型生成整体楼层平面图，再结合图像生成模型和VLM精炼器生成家具及可操作物体布局，最终产出可用于具身AI模拟的完整室内场景。
AI.motivation: 现有室内场景生成方法依赖于手工规则或仅关注子任务（如平面图合成或单房间布置），难以生成具有全局连贯性、真实性和模拟可用性的完整住宅场景，且3D场景数据稀缺。
AI.method: 1) 收集30万真实住宅平面图数据集，基于大语言模型和K-D树表示进行可控的整体平面图生成；2) 利用图像生成模型从多视角生成家具布局草案；3) 在不同支撑面上生成小型可操作物体布局；4) 使用VLM精炼器迭代修正放置；5) 基于3D生成模型灵活替换资产；6) 附加物理属性、表面纹理和光照。
AI.result: 实验和用户研究表明，该方法在布局多样性和3D设计吸引力方面优于现有方法，定量和定性指标均表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的层次化框架能够生成布局多样、设计感强且可直接用于具身AI模拟的完整室内场景，并将开源30万平面图数据集和5000个完整场景。

title: Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction
summary: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 提出TrO（Tracing the Oracle）框架，通过动态规划优化扩散模型逆问题求解中的时间步调度，在少量采样步数下显著提升3D CT重建的保真度和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型在求解高度病态的3D CT逆问题中展现出潜力，但推理过程计算开销巨大，且现有均匀时间步调度无法捕捉逆条件扩散随机微分方程的非均匀演化，引入大量截断误差。
AI.method: 以少数样本上密集采样的数值积分轨迹作为参考oracle，利用动态规划全局最小化少量步近似与oracle之间的累积误差，提取优化后的时间步调度，将有限采样步精确分配到对截断误差高度敏感的关键演化阶段。
AI.result: 在AAPM数据集上的多个3D CT重建任务中，结合SOTA方法DDS，优化后的时间步在不超过10步的严格预算下显著优于现有启发式调度，提升了重建保真度和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: TrO是一种即插即用框架，通过数据驱动的方式优化时间步调度，有效解决了扩散模型在3D CT重建中计算效率与重建质量之间的权衡问题。

title: A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology
summary: Medical imaging artificial intelligence has achieved strong performance in isolated image interpretation, but remains poorly aligned with radiological practice, where diagnosis and follow-up rely on comparison across prior studies and analogous reference cases. Here we formulate radiological comparison as an entity-aware cross-image reasoning problem and introduce a framework that supports both reference-case retrieval and temporal comparative interpretation. We construct MedReCo-DB, a large-scale comparative imaging resource derived from routine image-report pairs, comprising more than 690,000 images from over 160,000 patients across eight institutions, four countries and seven imaging modalities. Reports are decomposed into anatomical structures, abnormal findings and pathological conditions to provide supervision for entity-conditioned retrieval and comparative visual question answering. Using this resource, we develop MedReCo, an entity-aware visual encoder for controllable retrieval of clinically analogous cases, and MedReCo-VLM, a vision--language extension for generative interpretation of interval change. Across internal, external and cross-center evaluations, MedReCo achieved the highest Recall@1 in all 12 internal retrieval settings and improved external retrieval by a mean of 6.0 percentage points. In clinically confusable differential groups, it consistently outperformed the strongest baselines. MedReCo-VLM achieved the best performance across all comparative generation evaluations and improved longitudinal follow-up accuracy by 14.5-46.5 percentage points on chest radiographs and 13.0-27.9 percentage points on CT. These findings suggest that entity-aware comparative reasoning can be learned from routine clinical data at scale and may provide a more clinically aligned foundation for medical imaging AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedReCo与MedReCo-VLM框架，将影像学比较形式化为实体感知的跨图像推理问题，支持参考病例检索和时序对比解读。基于来自8个机构、4个国家、7种模态的69万+图像构建MedReCo-DB，在内部12项检索设置中全部取得Recall@1最优，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点，时序随访准确率提升14.5-46.5个百分点（胸片）和13.0-27.9个百分点（CT）。
AI.motivation: 现有医学影像AI仅在孤立图像解读上表现良好，但缺乏放射学实践中依赖前后对照和类比参考病例的比较能力，与临床实践严重脱节。
AI.method: 将放射学比较形式化为实体感知的跨图像推理问题，构建大规模多机构多模态比较影像资源MedReCo-DB（69万+图像），将报告分解为解剖结构、异常发现和病理条件以提供监督。提出MedReCo（实体感知视觉编码器，支持可控参考病例检索）和MedReCo-VLM（视觉-语言扩展，支持时序变化生成式解读）。
AI.result: MedReCo在全部12项内部检索设置中Recall@1最优，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点，在临床易混淆鉴别组中持续优于最强基线。MedReCo-VLM在所有比较生成评估中取得最佳性能，时序随访准确率在胸片上提升14.5-46.5个百分点，在CT上提升13.0-27.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实体感知的比较推理可以从常规临床数据中大规模学习，为医学影像AI提供更贴近临床实践的基座。

title: Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, contributed to PAI 2026 Conference
summary: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统计场框架，将LLM的token嵌入视为一维自旋链，通过改变softmax温度T发现类似连续相变的现象：在特征温度Tc附近出现磁化率尖峰、序参量快速变化、语义方向坍缩及本征维数极小值，该现象在不同模型规模和提示类别中鲁棒存在。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏将LLM文本生成过程与统计物理中的相变理论进行系统关联的定量框架，作者希望建立一种统计场方法来探测LLM输出的集体统计结构，并探索解码策略与临界现象之间的联系。
AI.method: 将token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量，定义连接两点关联函数得到的磁化率和系综平均嵌入场的序参量，扫描softmax温度T观测关键指标变化，并用TwoNN方法独立估计本征维数进行佐证。
AI.result: 在特征温度Tc附近观察到磁化率尖峰且呈幂律标度行为，序参量发生急剧变化，Tc以下语义方向坍缩为单一方向，TwoNN本征维数在Tc附近达到极小值，这些结果在Qwen3 0.6B-32B模型和多种提示类别中一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为探测LLM输出的集体统计特性提供了定量工具，揭示了自回归生成与临界现象之间的潜在联系，但需注意自回归生成的非平衡性质与连续相变的严格区别有待进一步研究。

title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evidence by interacting with a world simulator during reasoning. We propose Astra, an agentic spatial reasoning framework that empowers VLMs with action-conditioned visual imagination. Specifically, Astra couples Astra-VL, an RL-trained VLM policy, with Astra-WM, a Bagel-based world simulator that generates novel-view observations from context images and natural-language camera motions. To provide reliable imagined evidence, Astra-WM is trained with view consistency tuning to improve pose and content consistency across views. In the RL stage, we propose a world-simulator-in-the-loop two-phase RL curriculum to stabilize tool-use exploration and advance the model's ability to invoke the simulator only when imagined observations improve over direct answering. Experiments demonstrate that both the world simulator and the agentic policy are necessary: Astra-WM improves simulator-augmented Gemini-3-Flash on MMSI-Bench from 45.1 to 49.5, while Astra-VL improves the Qwen3-VL backbone from 29.8 to 38.8 on MMSI-Bench and from 36.8 to 42.7 on MindCube. These results show that imagined observations can provide useful spatial evidence, but effective world-model-augmented reasoning requires learning when, where, and how to imagine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Astra框架，通过将VLM与基于Bagel的世界模拟器（Astra-WM）结合，实现动作条件化的视觉想象，并采用两阶段RL课程（Astra-VL）训练智能体策略，使VLM在空间推理任务中主动生成想象观测以增强证据，实验表明该方法在MMSI-Bench和MindCube上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在空间推理中受限于观测图像和文本思维链，难以推断未观测布局、保持跨视角一致性以及从替代视角推理，亟需一种能主动获取想象视觉证据的推理框架。
AI.method: 1）Astra-WM：基于Bagel的世界模拟器，从上下文图像和自然语言相机运动生成新视角观测，并通过视角一致性训练提升姿态和内容一致性；2）Astra-VL：RL训练的VLM策略，采用世界模拟器在环的两阶段RL课程，先稳定工具使用探索，再提升仅在想象观测优于直接回答时调用模拟器的能力。
AI.result: Astra-WM将模拟器增强的Gemini-3-Flash在MMSI-Bench上从45.1提升至49.5；Astra-VL将Qwen3-VL骨干在MMSI-Bench上从29.8提升至38.8，在MindCube上从36.8提升至42.7。
AI.conclusion: 想象观测能提供有效的空间证据，但有效的世界模型增强推理需要学习何时、何地以及如何想象，世界模拟器和智能体策略二者缺一不可。

title: Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了非无环GFlowNets与最优传输(OT)之间的理论联系，证明最小流GFlowNet在固定初始流分布时等价于Kantorovich OT问题，其学习到的策略编码了最优传输方案，并通过实验验证了该方法在大图上学习高质量传输计划的有效性。
AI.motivation: 建立非无环GFlowNets与最优传输之间的理论联系，将GFlowNet框架应用于大规模图上的最优传输问题。
AI.method: 通过固定最小流GFlowNet中的初始流分布，将目标函数简化为具有图诱导最短路径代价的Kantorovich OT问题；利用边流和神经参数化在大型图上应用GFlowNet学习框架求解OT问题。
AI.result: 理论证明最小流GFlowNet在最优解时编码了最优传输方案，采样轨迹可恢复最优耦合；实验证实与精确OT求解器结果一致，GFlowNet能够学习高质量的传输计划。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNet框架可有效应用于大规模图上的最优传输问题，为学习高质量传输计划提供了新途径。

title: Complexity-Balanced Diffusion Splitting
summary: Standard continuous-time generative models rely on monolithic architectures that must navigate vastly different signal regimes, from isotropic noise to intricate data distributions. While scaling model capacity improves performance, deploying a massive network uniformly across the entire generative timeline is inherently inefficient. In this work, we propose Complexity-Balanced Splitting (CBS), a principled framework for temporal capacity allocation that distributes the generative workload across multiple specialized sub-networks. Grounded in function approximation theory and de Boor's equidistribution principle, CBS partitions the diffusion timeline into segments of equal approximation burden, allocating more representational capacity to regions where the generative dynamics are more difficult to model. To estimate this local complexity, we introduce two complementary and tractable monitor functions: a spatial measure based on the flow's Dirichlet energy, and a geometric measure based on the acceleration of the sampling trajectories. Using a lightweight auxiliary model to estimate these complexity profiles, our approach eliminates the need for heuristic temporal splits or computationally expensive search procedures. Extensive evaluation across multiple architectures (SiT, JiT, and UNet) and datasets demonstrates that CBS consistently improves synthesis quality without increasing per-step inference cost. In particular, CBS improves FID by ~35% on SiT-XL with CFG relative to naive temporal partitioning. Project page is available at https://noamissachar.github.io/CBS/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复杂度平衡分割（CBS）框架，通过将扩散时间线划分为等逼近负担的片段，并分配多个专用子网络处理不同区域，从而优化生成模型的时序容量分配。基于de Boor等分布原理，利用Dirichlet能量和采样轨迹加速度作为复杂度度量，无需启发式分割或昂贵搜索，在多个架构和数据集上一致提升合成质量，FID改善约35%。
AI.motivation: 标准连续时间生成模型使用单一架构处理从各向同性噪声到复杂数据分布的全过程，但大规模网络均匀部署在整个生成时间线上本质上是低效的。本文旨在通过时序容量分配解决这一效率问题。
AI.method: 提出CBS框架：1) 基于函数逼近理论和de Boor等分布原理，将扩散时间线划分为等逼近负担的片段；2) 引入两种可计算复杂度度量——基于流Dirichlet能量的空间度量和基于采样轨迹加速度的几何度量；3) 使用轻量级辅助模型估计复杂度分布，避免启发式搜索。
AI.result: 在SiT、JiT和UNet等多种架构及数据集上，CBS一致提升合成质量，不增加每步推理成本。特别是SiT-XL结合CFG时，相比朴素时序分割，FID改善约35%。
AI.conclusion: CBS通过复杂度引导的时序分割和专用子网络分配，有效解决了生成模型中均匀资源分配的低效问题，为扩散模型提供了一种即插即用的性能提升方案。

title: PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis
summary: Whilst the vulnerability of graph neural networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks poses a critical threat to graph representation learning, the understanding of the robust generalization behavior remains a fundamental challenge in the adversarial setting. Recently, PAC-Bayesian margin-based generalization analysis substantially advances this line of research by providing a flexible and data-dependent analytical framework. However, existing robust analyses often rely on isotropic Gaussian posteriors and control weight perturbations in the full parameter space, which limits the ability to capture heterogeneous parameter sensitivity yet hinges on hidden-width-dependent complexity terms, resulting in not-tight-enough generalization bounds. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed sensitivity-aware PAC-Bayesian framework from deep neural networks to message passing GNNs (MPGNNs) and derive a tighter robust generalization bound in the adversarial setting. Specifically, we first quantify how sensitive the perturbations across different parameter blocks are to the network outputs by deriving the output Jacobians with respect to the weight parameters. Exploiting the fact that these Jacobian matrices have rank at most $K$ in $K$-class graph classification, we then construct Jacobian-aligned sensitivity matrices and use anisotropic Gaussian posteriors with optimized covariances to upper bound the KL divergence in a tight way. Notably, by refining the spectral-norm dependence on the learned weights and reducing the leading dimension factor from hidden-width-dependent terms to the number of classes $K$, our analysis yields much tighter robust generalization guarantees for MPGNNs, thereby guiding their designs to enhance adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对消息传递图神经网络（MPGNNs）在对抗攻击下的鲁棒泛化问题，将最近提出的敏感性感知PAC-Bayesian框架从深度神经网络扩展到MPGNNs，通过推导参数块输出雅可比矩阵并利用其低秩性质构造各向异性高斯后验，得到了更紧的鲁棒泛化界，将主导维度因子从隐藏宽度相关项降低为类别数K。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN的PAC-Bayesian鲁棒泛化分析依赖各向同性高斯后验并在全参数空间控制权重扰动，无法捕捉异构参数敏感性，且受限于隐藏宽度相关的复杂度项，导致泛化界不够紧。
AI.method: (1) 推导不同参数块相对于网络输出的雅可比矩阵，量化参数敏感性；(2) 利用K类图分类中雅可比矩阵秩至多为K的性质，构造雅可比对齐的敏感性矩阵；(3) 使用协方差优化的各向异性高斯后验紧化KL散度上界；(4) 将谱范数依赖从隐藏宽度项降至类别数K。
AI.result: 得到了比现有工作更紧的MPGNN鲁棒泛化保证，主导维度因子从隐藏宽度相关项降低为类别数K，显著提升了泛化界的紧致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的敏感性感知PAC-Bayesian框架能够为MPGNNs提供更紧的鲁棒泛化界，从而指导其设计以增强对抗鲁棒性。

title: PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding
summary: Recent advances in 3D multimodal large language models (3D-MLLMs) have enabled unified solutions for 3D scene understanding tasks, including visual question answering, captioning, and referring segmentation. However, existing 3D-MLLMs remain largely object-centric, limiting their ability to model fine-grained part structures that are essential for embodied interaction with 3D environments. In this work, we present PAR3D, a unified part-aware 3D-MLLM framework that enables models to understand, reason about, and ground both objects and their parts in 3D scenes. To enable training and evaluation of part-aware 3D scene understanding, we introduce ScenePart, a synthetic 3D scene dataset with part-level annotations and language instructions. We further develop Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning to enrich 3D visual representations with fine-grained part-level semantics, and propose Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation to ground part targets via hierarchical object-part queries. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves part-level question answering and referring segmentation, while also achieving strong performance across object-level vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: PAR3D是一个统一的部件感知3D多模态大语言模型框架，通过引入ScenePart数据集和部件感知3D表示学习，实现了对3D场景中物体及其部件的理解、推理和定位，在部件级问答和指代分割任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-MLLMs主要关注物体级别的理解，缺乏对细粒度部件结构的建模能力，限制了其在需要精细交互的3D环境中的应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建ScenePart合成3D场景数据集，包含部件级标注和语言指令；2) 提出部件感知3D表示学习，用细粒度部件语义丰富3D视觉表示；3) 提出层级化分割查询生成，通过物体-部件层级查询来定位部件目标。
AI.result: PAR3D在部件级问答和指代分割任务上大幅提升，同时在物体级视觉-语言任务上也表现出色。
AI.conclusion: PAR3D有效弥合了3D-MLLMs在部件级理解上的空白，为3D场景中更精细的具身交互提供了统一框架。

title: Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events
summary: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flux Matching框架，从反应轨迹数据中学习当前速度$u(z)$（主反应路径）和标量势$h(z)$（反应坐标），两者通过对反应路径系综的二次泛函最小化得到，无需动力学或稳态分布知识，适用于非马尔可夫投影变量，并能提升增强采样效率。
AI.motivation: 路径采样方法虽能生成连接亚稳态的反应轨迹系综，但从中提取机制性见解（如主反应路径和反应坐标）仍然困难。
AI.method: 通过加权亥姆霍兹-赫奇分解从反应电流中学习当前速度$u(z)$和标量势$h(z)$，两者最小化反应路径系综上的二次泛函，与生成建模中的flow matching损失类似。
AI.result: 在分子系统上验证了Flux Matching能够生成当前速度轨迹并进行速率常数计算。
AI.conclusion: Flux Matching提供了一种数据驱动的反应坐标和路径发现方法，不依赖committor，在非马尔可夫投影下仍保持良定义，且其水平集可作为增强采样的自适应界面。

title: Ask-to-Clarify: Resolving Instruction Ambiguity through Multi-turn Dialogue
summary: The ultimate goal of embodied agents is to create collaborators that can interact with humans, not mere executors that passively follow instructions. This requires agents to communicate, coordinate, and adapt their actions based on human feedback. Recently, advances in VLAs have offered a path toward this goal. However, most current VLA-based embodied agents operate in a one-way mode: they receive an instruction and execute it without feedback. This approach fails in real-world scenarios where instructions are often ambiguous. In this paper, we address this problem with the Ask-to-Clarify framework. Our framework first resolves ambiguous instructions by asking questions in a multi-turn dialogue. Then it generates low-level actions end-to-end. Specifically, the Ask-to-Clarify framework consists of two components, one VLM for collaboration and one diffusion for action. We also introduce a connection module that generates conditions for the diffusion based on the output of the VLM. This module adjusts the observation by instructions to create reliable conditions. We train our framework with a two-stage knowledge-insulation strategy. First, we fine-tune the collaboration component using ambiguity-solving dialogue data to handle ambiguity. Then, we integrate the action component while freezing the collaboration one. This preserves the interaction abilities while fine-tuning the diffusion to generate actions. The training strategy guarantees our framework can first ask questions, then generate actions. During inference, a signal detector functions as a router that helps our framework switch between asking questions and taking actions. We evaluate the Ask-to-Clarify framework in 8 real-world tasks, where it outperforms existing state-of-the-art VLAs. The results suggest that our proposed framework, along with the training strategy, provides a path toward collaborative embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，通过多轮对话解决指令歧义问题，使具身智能体从被动执行者转变为主动协作的交互伙伴，在8个真实世界任务中超越现有VLA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA具身智能体多为单向执行模式，只能接收指令并执行，无法处理现实世界中常见的模糊指令，缺乏与人类交互、沟通和根据反馈调整行为的能力。
AI.method: 提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，包含两个组件：VLM负责多轮对话澄清歧义指令，扩散模型负责生成底层动作。引入连接模块根据VLM输出为扩散模型生成条件。采用两阶段知识隔离训练策略：先微调协作组件处理歧义，再冻结协作组件微调动作组件。推理时使用信号检测器作为路由器，在提问与行动之间切换。
AI.result: 在8个真实世界任务中评估，Ask-to-Clarify框架优于现有最先进的VLA方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架和训练策略为构建协作型具身智能体提供了有效路径，使智能体能够先提问澄清再执行动作，实现从被动执行到主动协作的转变。

title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
summary:
Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which collectively lead to significant inefficiencies in existing LLM serving systems.
  To overcome these challenges, we present Tangram, a novel serving system designed to make Non-uniform KV caches practical. Tangram addresses systemic inefficiencies through three core techniques: (1) Deterministic Budget Allocation assigns a static memory footprint to each head based on its intrinsic pattern, entirely eliminating dynamic scheduling overhead and prefill stalls; (2) Head Group Page clusters attention heads with similar retention demands and manages them with independent, vectorized page tables, thereby maximizing physical memory reclamation; and (3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Load Balancing leverages static budget profiles to ensure uniform GPU utilization without runtime overhead. Experimental results show that Tangram improves throughput by up to 2.6x compared to existing baselines, while fully preserving model accuracy. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM.

AI.tldr: Tangram是一个面向多轮LLM服务的系统，通过确定性预算分配、头组分页和预加载平衡三种核心技术，解决非均匀KV缓存带来的内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率下降问题，在完全保持模型精度的前提下实现最高2.6倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 多轮LLM服务中KV缓存线性增长对GPU内存和带宽造成巨大压力。非均匀KV压缩虽能保留更多信息，但引入了内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率下降等系统性低效问题，现有系统无法有效应对这些挑战。
AI.method: Tangram提出三种核心技术：(1)确定性预算分配——基于每个注意力头的固有模式分配静态内存，消除动态调度开销和预填充停滞；(2)头组分页——将具有相似保留需求的注意力头聚合并用独立向量化页表管理，最大化物理内存回收；(3)预加载平衡——利用静态预算配置确保GPU负载均匀，无运行时开销。
AI.result: 相较于现有基线方法，Tangram实现了最高2.6倍的吞吐量提升，同时完全保留模型精度。
AI.conclusion: Tangram通过系统级优化使非均匀KV缓存变得实用，有效解决了异构KV缓存带来的各种系统性问题，显著提升了多轮LLM服务的效率。

title: Drishti AI-Event Guardian: An Intelligent Real-Time Crowd Monitoring and Emergency Response System for Mass Gathering Events
summary: Mass gathering events are associated with critical safety incidents caused by insufficient crowd monitoring and inadequate emergency response coordination. Traditional surveillance systems lack intelligent analytics, resulting in delayed threat identification, poor resource deployment, and weak support for vulnerable individuals during dense public assemblies. This paper presents Drishti AI-Event Guardian, an intelligent crowd management framework using deep learning for public safety enhancement. The architecture combines multimodal data from CCTV networks and UAV platforms, processed by models on Google Vertex AI infrastructure. Core methods include real-time crowd density estimation using YOLOv8, spatiotemporal anomaly detection, and predictive crowd-flow modeling through gradient-boosted regression. Drishti also integrates four modules: (i) facial recognition for missing person identification with crowd-wide notification; (ii) medical emergency reporting with automated dispatch; (iii) a conversational AI chatbot for reports and complaints; and (iv) an intelligent guard reallocation engine that dynamically reassigns personnel in response to crowd density changes. The system is evaluated on two scenarios: the Kumbh Mela gathering and the RCB Victory Parade event, achieving crowd density estimation MAE of 3.2 persons/m2, anomaly detection F1-score of 0.91, facial recognition precision of 0.93, and median alert latency of 111 ms. Predictive congestion modeling provides five-minute forecasts with MAPE of 8.3%, enabling preemptive intervention. The chatbot resolved 89% of incident filings without human operators, while guard reallocation reduced responder deployment latency by 34% versus manual reassignment. Results demonstrate a shift from passive surveillance toward active crowd intelligence and scalable foundation for events from local gatherings to mega festivals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Drishti AI-Event Guardian，一种基于深度学习的智能人群管理框架，融合多模态数据（CCTV+无人机）与Google Vertex AI基础设施，集成人群密度估计、异常检测、预测建模、人脸识别、医疗紧急响应、对话AI聊天机器人和智能警卫重分配等模块。在Kumbh Mela和RCB Victory Parade两个场景中验证，MAE为3.2人/m²，异常检测F1为0.91，人脸识别精度0.93，中位延迟111ms，预测MAPE 8.3%，聊天机器人解决89%事件，警卫部署延迟降低34%。
AI.motivation: 大型聚集活动常因人群监控不足和应急响应协调不力导致安全事故，传统监控系统缺乏智能分析能力，存在威胁识别延迟、资源部署低效、弱势群体支持薄弱等问题。
AI.method: 提出Drishti AI-Event Guardian框架：①基于YOLOv8的实时人群密度估计；②时空异常检测；③梯度提升回归的预测性人群流动建模；④人脸识别与失踪人员通告；⑤医疗紧急报告与自动调度；⑥对话式AI聊天机器人；⑦智能警卫重分配引擎。系统运行于Google Vertex AI，融合CCTV与无人机多模态数据。
AI.result: 人群密度估计MAE 3.2人/m²，异常检测F1-score 0.91，人脸识别精度0.93，中位告警延迟111ms；5分钟预测MAPE 8.3%；聊天机器人解决89%事件无需人工；警卫部署延迟降低34%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统实现了从被动监控到主动人群智能的转变，可扩展适用于从本地集会到大型节日的各类活动，显著提升公共安全水平和应急响应效率。

title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
summary: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.

AI.tldr: GILC是一个即插即用的框架，通过将预训练去噪网络作为变分代理来估计引导信号，并引入无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，实现了无需额外训练或重训的高效可控离散扩散生成，在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的可控生成方法存在计算开销大或需要重训练的问题，且高维离散空间中的梯度不稳定导致引导困难。
AI.method: 提出GILC框架：利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理来估计引导信号；引入无雅可比（Jacobian-free）机制，直接校正干净预测logits以规避离散空间中的梯度不稳定性；支持可微和不可微奖励函数。
AI.result: 在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC达到了最先进的性能，且经常优于需要微调的方法。
AI.conclusion: GILC是一种高效、即插即用的可控离散扩散生成框架，无需额外训练即可实现SOTA性能，具有良好的泛用性和实用性。

title: Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. We instead characterize it through the interaction with the retain objective: a token is forget-specific to the extent that minimizing the forget loss on that token does not conflict with retain optimality. We formalize this perspective as a joint optimization problem over the model parameters and the token weights and show that, under a natural separation condition, the resulting objective recovers the oracle forget-specific token support. Motivated by this formulation, we introduce Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning (ATWU), a lightweight framework that jointly learns token forget-specificity and model parameters during unlearning using a simple linear scorer over the hidden states, without external token level supervision. Across TOFU and RWKU, ATWU achieves state of the art forget-retain trade-offs, outperforming sample-level methods, probability-based token weighting heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based approaches. Moreover, the learned scores align substantially better with ground truth forget-specific spans, indicating that ATWU identifies semantically meaningful token level forgetting signals. Overall, our results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对自回归语言模型机器遗忘中token异质性问题，提出ATWU框架，通过保留集冲突准则联合学习token权重与模型参数，无需外部监督即可识别遗忘相关token，实现更优的遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法忽略遗忘样本中token级别的异质性，或依赖辅助模型、启发式规则、外部标注来估计每个token对遗忘的相关性，缺乏无监督且高效的token重要性判别机制。
AI.method: 提出ATWU框架：将遗忘问题形式化为模型参数与token权重的联合优化，基于"保留冲突"准则（最小化遗忘损失与保留最优性不冲突的程度）定义token的遗忘特异性；利用隐状态上的线性打分器学习token权重，无需外部token级监督。
AI.result: 在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU在遗忘-保留权衡上达到SOTA，优于样本级方法、概率加权启发式方法和辅助模型方法；学习的分数与真实遗忘跨度高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: 保留冲突是识别语言模型遗忘内容的有效准则，能从模型表征中无监督学习token级遗忘特异性，计算开销极低。

title: PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data
summary: In healthcare, multimodal time series tasks often operate on incomplete observations in practice, for example when ECG segments are lost because electrodes detach or an entire respiratory channel is unavailable during overnight monitoring. Such missingness typically appears in two structurally distinct patterns: within-modality missing, where values are absent within an otherwise observed modality, and modality-level missing, where an entire modality is unavailable. Existing methods typically represent unobserved data implicitly through masks or missing embeddings, without learning instance-specific missing information, and most are designed for only one missingness pattern. A natural approach is to explicitly estimate the missing data; however, existing imputation methods treat missingness uniformly despite their different structural priors, and the imputation process is often isolated from downstream tasks, preventing downstream tasks from guiding imputation toward more informative representations. To address these limitations, we present PAMF, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing. Specifically, the method initializes the flow-matching source state with type-specific priors to distinguish two missing types. It further connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing, transferring task-relevant representations into the imputation process. Experiments on multiple multimodal healthcare time-series benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves the strongest overall downstream performance across diverse datasets and missing settings compared with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: PAMF是一个面向多模态时间序列的框架，通过先验感知的流匹配和权重共享，显式处理两种缺失模式（模态内缺失和模态级缺失），并将插补与下游预测任务耦合，在多个医疗基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常通过掩码或缺失嵌入隐式表示未观测数据，缺乏实例级缺失信息的学习，且大多仅针对单一缺失模式设计；插补方法则同质化处理不同类型的结构性缺失，且插补过程与下游任务脱节。
AI.method: 提出PAMF框架：(1) 流匹配源状态初始化为类型特定的先验，以区分两种缺失类型；(2) 通过架构匹配的编码器与权重共享，将插补与分类任务连接，使任务相关表示传递到插补过程。
AI.result: 在多个多模态医疗时间序列基准上，PAMF在多种数据集和缺失设置下取得了最优的综合下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式区分缺失模式并将插补与下游任务耦合学习，能有效提升多模态时间序列在不完整观测下的预测性能。

title: Efficient Mean Curvature Computation on High-Dimensional Data Manifolds
summary: Estimating local mean curvature at each point of a high-dimensional dataset is a key ingredient of geometry-aware machine learning algorithms, such as the Mean Curvature Boundary Points (MCBP) method. The naive implementation of this computation, based on a local shape operator approximated from k-nearest neighbor patches, involves an explicit construction of a matrix $H$ whose trace form yields an $O(m^4)$ cost per point, rendering the approach intractable for datasets with more than a few dozen features. This paper introduces two complementary contributions that together reduce this cost by several orders of magnitude. The first contribution is an exact algebraic identity. This identity, derived from the orthogonality of the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix and the cyclicity of the trace operator, eliminates $H$ entirely and reduces the per-point cost to $O(m^2)$ after the eigendecomposition. The second contribution addresses the remaining $O(m^3)$ bottleneck of the full eigendecomposition. Since the local covariance matrix has rank at most $k-1 \ll m$, we replace it with a truncated SVD of the $k \times m$ centered data matrix, an $O(k^2 m)$ operation, and derive an analytical approximation for the contribution of the null-space eigenvectors based on the expected value of their outer product under the Haar measure. The resulting estimator has total cost $O(k^2 m + k m p^2)$, where $p = k-1$. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm speedups of 50 to 300 times relative to the original implementation, with negligible loss when the fast estimator is used to replace the original version. By providing a scalable and data-driven estimate of local curvature, the proposed method establishes curvature as a practical geometric feature for a broad range of machine learning tasks, from classical to modern deep learning pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补方法，将高维数据局部平均曲率计算的每点复杂度从O(m^4)降至O(k²m + kmp²)，其中m为特征维度，k为近邻数，p=k-1。方法一利用代数恒等式消除显式构造的H矩阵，降至O(m²)；方法二通过截断SVD和Haar测度下的零空间解析近似，避免全特征分解。实验表明加速50-300倍，精度损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 高维数据中局部平均曲率的计算是几何感知机器学习（如MCBP方法）的关键，但朴素实现基于k近邻局部形状算子近似，需显式构造H矩阵，其迹形式导致每点O(m⁴)的计算成本，对于特征维度m超过数十的数据集不可行。因此需要大幅降低计算复杂度，使曲率成为实际可用的几何特征。
AI.method: 第一个贡献是推导代数恒等式，利用协方差矩阵特征向量的正交性和迹算子的循环性质，完全消除H矩阵，将每点成本降至O(m²)（在特征分解之后）。第二个贡献针对剩余的全特征分解O(m³)瓶颈：利用局部协方差矩阵秩至多为k-1≪m的特点，将其替换为k×m中心化数据矩阵的截断SVD（复杂度O(k²m)），并基于Haar测度下零空间特征向量外积的期望值，推导出解析近似。最终估计器总复杂度为O(k²m + kmp²)，其中p=k-1。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，相比原始实现获得50-300倍的加速，使用快速估计器替代原始版本时精度损失可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法通过提供可扩展且数据驱动的局部曲率估计，将曲率确立为从经典到现代深度学习流水线等广泛机器学习任务中实用的几何特征。

title: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with single-direction decoders forces a number of atoms that is exponential in $d_i$. From an end-to-end optimization perspective, this splitting is not merely possible but actively preferred. We prove that there exists a continuous path from the true $d_i$-dimensional basis to a strictly lower risk of the $\ell_1$-regularized SAE objective, whose descent directions drive any trained dictionary into that exponential regime. A single coherent feature is therefore fragmented across many near-collinear latents, producing spurious multiplicity and obscuring the intrinsic geometry. Motivated by this, we introduce Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer. We then show that once the block size satisfies $r \ge d_i$, a single group not only can represent the entire feature slice but is the global minimizer of the SASA objective. This consolidation yields a sample complexity polynomial in $d_i$ rather than exponential -- a decisive advantage given that every training activation costs an LLM forward pass. Empirically, on GPT-2 and Mistral-7B, SASA reduces feature splitting and absorption, improves monosemanticity and interpretability, and matches or exceeds standard SAEs while training on roughly half the token budget.

AI.tldr: 本文发现稀疏自编码器（SAE）将每个潜在特征假设为一维的，与模型特征的多维结构不匹配，导致特征分裂。为此提出子空间感知稀疏自编码器（SASA），用学习到的子空间解码器替代单向量解码器，通过Top-s分组门控和核范数正则化实现块稀疏性，在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上减少了特征分裂和吸收，提升了单义性和可解释性，且训练预算减半。
AI.motivation: 标准SAE将每个潜在特征分配单个解码器方向，隐含假设特征是一维的，但这与大型语言模型中特征实际的多维结构不匹配，导致特征分裂（feature splitting）问题，影响可解释性。
AI.method: 提出SASA，包括：(1) 用学习到的子空间替代单向量解码器；(2) Top-s分组门控机制强制块稀疏性；(3) 核范数正则化自适应调整每组有效秩。理论上证明了当块大小满足r≥d_i时，单个分组可表示完整特征切片且是全局最优点。
AI.result: 在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收，提升了单义性和可解释性，性能匹配或超越标准SAE，同时训练预算仅需约一半的token预算。
AI.conclusion: SASA通过子空间解码器有效解决了SAE中因一维假设导致的特征分裂问题，在理论上有更优的样本复杂度（多项式而非指数级），在实践中以更低的训练成本实现了更好的可解释性。

title: Quantifying the Privacy of Counterfactuals by Leveraging Membership Inference Attacks Against Synthetic Data
summary: Counterfactuals are typically used in high-stakes decision areas to explain a machine learning model by showing how changes to the user profiles result in the desired outcome. However, explaining the model's decisions through counterfactuals can also be exploited by an adversary to conduct privacy attacks against the model or its training data. Drawing on the analogy that counterfactuals provide realistic substitutes for real training data, similar to synthetic data, we demonstrate in this paper how it is possible to successfully perform privacy attacks on counterfactuals by drawing on the attacks developed against synthetic data. More precisely, we investigate the effectiveness of the membership inference attacks designed for synthetic data on various types of counterfactuals. Additionally, while existing membership inference attacks against counterfactuals usually require to be able to query the model, we show how it is possible to perform successful membership inference attacks using only a set of counterfactuals, with no access to the model from which they are generated. Our results demonstrate that model developers should be more cautious when releasing counterfactuals to various users, as it can lead to a privacy breach.

AI.tldr: 本文证明反事实解释（counterfactuals）会像合成数据一样被攻击者利用进行隐私攻击，特别是成员推断攻击。研究发现，即使无法访问原始模型，仅凭反事实样本集也能成功实施攻击，提醒开发者发布反事实时需谨慎。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释在高风险决策领域被广泛用于解释模型，但其可能被恶意利用泄露模型或训练数据的隐私。现有研究主要关注反事实的可用性，而对其隐私风险关注不足，因此本文希望系统性地评估反事实面临的隐私威胁。
AI.method: 借鉴针对合成数据开发的成员推断攻击方法，将其应用于多种类型的反事实数据上，评估攻击效果。特别地，提出了一种无需查询原始模型、仅凭反事实样本集即可实施的成员推断攻击方案。
AI.result: 针对合成数据的成员推断攻击能够成功应用于反事实数据，并且即使攻击者无法访问生成反事实的原始模型，仅凭反事实样本集也能有效实施成员推断攻击。
AI.conclusion: 反事实发布会导致严重的隐私泄露风险，模型开发者在向用户发布反事实解释时需要更加谨慎。

title: Bridging Domain Expertise and Generalization for Performance Estimation
summary: Performance estimation under distribution shift aims to predict how a model behaves on an unlabeled test set whose distribution differs from the training data, a scenario that requires reliable indicators that can faithfully reflect model behavior without ground-truth labels. Existing approaches rely solely on the outputs of the given model whose biases are amplified once the distribution shifts, weakening the correlation with the true performance. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP), which leverages the complementary strengths of an external foundation model and the base model to construct a more reliable surrogate of the ground-truth labels. FRAP aligns the prediction distribution of the foundation model with that of the base model by applying temperature-scaled calibration that minimizes their divergence. The aligned predictions are fused through confidence-based weighting into a refined reference distribution that integrates robustness from the foundation model and domain-specific expertise from the base model, and performance estimation is obtained by measuring how closely the base model predictions agree with this reference. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures show that FRAP provides consistent and substantial improvements over representative performance-estimation methods under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: FRAP是一种通过融合基础模型与外部基础模型的互补优势来构建更可靠的伪标签，从而在分布偏移下更准确估计模型性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅依赖待评估模型的输出，但分布偏移会放大模型偏差，导致其输出与真实性能之间的相关性减弱，需要更可靠的性能估计指标。
AI.method: FRAP利用外部基础模型的互补优势，通过温度缩放校准使基础模型的预测分布与待评估模型对齐，然后基于置信度加权将两者融合为参考分布，最后通过衡量待评估模型与参考分布的一致程度来估计性能。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和架构上的实验表明，FRAP在分布偏移下相较现有代表性方法取得了一致且显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 融合基础模型的鲁棒性与待评估模型的领域专长可以构建更可靠的性能估计指标，有效应对分布偏移带来的挑战。

title: Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation
summary: Probabilistic inference over spatially embedded variables requires beliefs that respect $SE(3)$ symmetry, yet existing equivariant networks produce only scalars and vectors -- not the rank-2 precision tensors needed for anisotropic uncertainty, and single-component messages collapse multi-modal energy landscapes to physically meaningless averages. We introduce Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation (ENBP), a factor-graph framework whose messages are equivariant Gaussian mixture models with sufficient statistics that transform exactly under $SE(3)$. Rank-2 precision matrices are synthesised via equivariant outer products, ingested through differentiable spectral decomposition, and kept tractable by a greedy KL-based mixture reduction that provably commutes with $SE(3)$. On GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-Drugs, ENBP achieves 98.9% conformational coverage at 0.090 $\mathring{A}$ error with sub-second latency -- over $100\times$ faster than diffusion baselines at higher accuracy. On multi-body robotic inference, vanilla loopy BP diverges at 15+ agents while ENBP converges with near-zero collision rates and machine-precision equivariance error (${\sim}10^{-7}$ vs.\ $10^{-1}$ for augmented baselines).

AI.tldr: 本文提出等变神经置信传播（ENBP），一种因子图框架，其消息为等变高斯混合模型，能够合成秩2精度矩阵并保持SE(3)对称性。在GEOM-QM9/ Drugs上实现98.9%构象覆盖率和0.090Å误差，亚秒级推理速度比扩散基线快100倍以上；在多体机器人推理中，在15+智能体场景下收敛，碰撞率近乎为零，等变误差达10⁻⁷量级。
AI.motivation: 现有等变网络仅能输出标量和向量，无法生成各向异性不确定性所需的秩2精度张量；单分量消息会坍缩多模态能量景观为物理无意义的平均值，无法应对空间嵌入变量的概率推理任务。
AI.method: 提出ENBP框架，消息形式为等变高斯混合模型，其充分统计量在SE(3)下精确变换；通过等变外积合成秩2精度矩阵，利用可微谱分解处理；采用基于KL散度的贪婪混合约简方法，可证明与SE(3)交换。
AI.result: 在GEOM-QM9和GEOM-Drugs上，构象覆盖率达98.9%，误差0.090Å，亚秒级延迟，比扩散基线快100倍以上且精度更高；在多体机器人推理中，标准loopy BP在15+智能体时发散，ENBP收敛且碰撞率近乎为零，等变误差达10⁻⁷（增强基线为10⁻¹）。
AI.conclusion: ENBP通过等变高斯混合消息和秩2精度矩阵合成，有效解决了空间变量概率推理中的SE(3)对称性保持和多模态建模问题，在分子构象生成和多体机器人推理任务上显著优于现有方法。

title: Performance Evaluation of GraphCast for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting over Brazil
summary: The paradigm of global weather forecasting is rapidly shifting with the emergence of Machine Learning Weather Prediction models (MLWP). While these data-driven architectures demonstrate remarkable global skill, regional benchmarks in the Global South remain scarce, leaving their efficacy in complex, highly convective environments largely unverified. This study evaluates the performance of GraphCast operational against the deterministic ECMWF IFS HRES as baseline across four distinct Brazilian climatic sub-regions. Utilizing a scalable, cloud-native pipeline and the WeatherBench-X framework for benchmarking weather models, we assess selected tropospheric variables ($T_{850}$, $Q_{850}$, $Z_{500}$) over four selected seasonal windows, employing the operational IFS analysis as the ground truth to calculate the statistical metrics for both models. Results reveal a regime-dependent skill profile. During the austral winter, GraphCast underperforms in the medium range (lead days 2-7) for $Z_{500}$ when resolving fast-propagating baroclinic systems over southern Brazil, but regains an advantage in the extended range, where its inherent smoothing of chaotic small-scale variability becomes beneficial under deterministic skill metrics. Conversely, during the austral summer wet season, GraphCast accurately captures large-scale moisture transport while intrinsically dampening the high-frequency convective variability that degrades deterministic NWP temperature forecasts. These findings establish a baseline for Brazil and define the specific physical boundaries that will guide future ``tropicalization'' efforts, aiming to optimize these foundational AI models for regional resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了GraphCast与ECMWF IFS HRES在巴西四个气候子区域的预报性能，发现GraphCast在冬季中程预报中表现不佳，但在延伸期具有优势；在夏季湿季能准确捕捉大尺度水汽输送，同时抑制高频对流变率，为AI天气模型在热带/南半球的区域化应用建立了基准。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLWP模型在全球尺度表现出色，但在全球南方（尤其是巴西等复杂对流环境地区）缺乏区域基准验证，其在这些地区的有效性尚未得到检验。
AI.method: 利用可扩展的云原生管道和WeatherBench-X框架，以IFS分析为真值，评估GraphCast与确定性ECMWF IFS HRES在巴西四个气候子区域的对流层变量（T850、Q850、Z500），覆盖四个季节性窗口。
AI.result: 南半球冬季时，GraphCast在2-7天预报中对Z500表现不佳（难以解析快速传播的斜压系统），但在延伸期因固有的平滑效应反而获得优势；南半球夏季湿季时，GraphCast能准确捕捉大尺度水汽输送，同时通过抑制高频对流变率改善了确定性NWP温度预报。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为巴西建立了AI天气模型的基准性能，并定义了物理边界条件，为未来针对热带地区的模型"热带化"优化工作提供指导，以增强这些基础AI模型在区域韧性方面的应用能力。

title: Maximising the Set-Piece Return: Optimising Football Corner Tactics with Graph Reinforcement Learning
summary: Machine learning is increasingly employed for the evaluation of football tactics. However, existing approaches focus on characterising historical actions or analyst-specified counterfactual scenarios. In this work, we seek to go beyond the imitation of historically observed patterns towards discovering new generalisable player configurations and strategies. To tackle this, we focus on optimising corner kick routines, and formulate a decision-making problem in which a central policy makes adjustments to attacking player positions and velocities to maximise first contact shot probability. Unlike classic optimisation that solves for isolated setups, we contribute a reinforcement learning architecture operating on graph-structured data that yields a general policy for adjusting arbitrary starting player positions. Evaluated on over 3,000 Premier League corners, our approach strongly outperforms baseline optimisation techniques under matched inference budgets. Our results suggest that graph reinforcement learning can shift set-piece analysis from historical evaluation and imitation towards reward-driven tactical discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图强化学习的角球战术优化框架，通过学习通用策略调整进攻球员位置与速度，最大化首次触球射门概率，在3000+英超角球数据上显著优于传统优化方法，实现从历史模仿到奖励驱动战术发现的范式转变。
AI.motivation: 现有足球战术ML方法局限于刻画历史动作或分析师指定的反事实场景，缺乏发现可泛化的新球员配置与策略的能力。
AI.method: 将角球战术优化建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用图神经网络处理球员位置等结构化数据，通过强化学习训练中心化策略网络，输出对任意起始球员位置的调整动作以最大化首次触球射门概率。
AI.result: 在3000+英超角球数据集上，该方法在同等推理预算下显著优于基线优化技术。
AI.conclusion: 图强化学习能够推动定位球分析从历史评估与模仿转向奖励驱动的战术发现。

title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. A model pretrained on a mixture of these generators inherits their per-task strengths and achieves the best average performance across twelve MIL benchmarks, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Perceiver架构的上下文学习器，通过合成数据预训练，在少样本条件下实现多实例学习（MIL），无需梯度更新即可在新任务上进行单次前向传播分类，在12个MIL基准上超越需要任务特定训练的监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MIL算法在低标记样本场景下表现不佳：灵活模型容易过拟合，刚性模型难以适应任务需求。因此需要一种能够在少量标注包的情况下有效解决新MIL任务的方法。
AI.method: 采用Perceiver风格的架构构建上下文学习器，在合成数据上进行预训练。提出并研究了多种面向包结构数据的合成数据生成器，这些生成器捕获了互补的归纳偏置。推理时通过单次前向传播完成分类，无需梯度更新。
AI.result: 在12个MIL基准数据集上，使用混合生成器预训练的模型实现了最佳平均性能，超越了需要任务特定训练的监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据预训练的上下文学习器能够有效解决MIL中的少样本问题，混合多种合成数据生成器可以继承各自优势，提升泛化能力。

title: End-to-End Subgraph Detection with GraphDETR
summary: Subgraph detection seeks to identify whether and where instances of query patterns occur within a larger graph. This problem is fundamental across scientific domains and is closely related to subgraph isomorphism, which is NP-complete, limiting combinatorial approaches to small patterns or moderately sized graphs. We introduce GraphDETR, a deep learning framework that formulates subgraph detection as a set prediction problem, analogous to DETR in object detection.
