To address this limitation, we introduce the MAviS-Dataset, a large-scale multimodal avian species dataset that integrates image, audio, and text modalities for over 1,000 bird species, comprising both pretraining and instruction-tuning subsets enriched with structured question-answer pairs. Building on the MAviS-Dataset, we introduce MAviS-Chat, a multimodal LLM that supports audio, vision, and text and is designed for fine-grained species understanding, multimodal question answering, and scene-specific description generation. Finally, for quantitative evaluation, we present MAviS-Bench, a benchmark of over 25,000 QA pairs designed to assess avian species-specific perceptual and reasoning abilities across modalities. Experimental results show that MAviS-Chat outperforms the baseline MiniCPM-o-2.6 by a large margin, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results and demonstrating the effectiveness of our instruction-tuned MAviS-Dataset. Our findings highlight the necessity of domain-adaptive multimodal LLMs for ecological applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MAviS-Dataset（多模态鸟类数据集）、MAviS-Chat（多模态大语言模型）和MAviS-Bench（评测基准），在鸟类物种细粒度理解与多模态问答任务上，MAviS-Chat显著超越基线模型MiniCPM-o-2.6，证明了领域自适应多模态大模型在生态应用中的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态大语言模型在鸟类等专业领域缺乏细粒度理解和准确的上下文信息，无法支持生物多样性保护与生态监测所需的物种级多模态问答。
AI.method: 1) 构建MAviS-Dataset：包含图像、音频、文本三种模态，覆盖1000+鸟类物种，含预训练和指令微调子集及结构化QA对；2) 提出MAviS-Chat：支持音频、视觉和文本的多模态LLM，用于细粒度物种理解、多模态问答和场景描述生成；3) 构建MAviS-Bench：25000+QA对的评测基准，评估跨模态感知与推理能力。
AI.result: MAviS-Chat在鸟类物种细粒度理解和多模态问答任务上大幅超越基线模型MiniCPM-o-2.6，取得开源模型最优结果，验证了指令微调数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应的多模态大语言模型对于生态应用（如生物多样性保护与生态监测）十分必要，本研究提出的数据、模型和基准为后续研究提供了基础。

title: Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework
summary: Cross-modal Geo-localization (CMGL) matches ground-level text descriptions with geo-tagged aerial imagery, which is crucial for pedestrian navigation and emergency response. However, existing studies are constrained by narrow geographic coverage and simplistic scene diversity, failing to reflect the immense spatial heterogeneity of global architectural styles and topographic features. To bridge this gap and facilitate universal positioning, we introduce CORE, the first million-scale dataset dedicated to global CMGL. CORE comprises 1,034,786 cross-view images sampled from 225 distinct geographic regions across six continents, offering an unprecedented variety of perspectives in varying environmental conditions and urban layouts. We leverage the zero-shot reasoning of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to synthesize high-quality scene descriptions rich in discriminative cues. Furthermore, we propose a physical-law-aware network (PLANET) for cross-modal geo-localization. PLANET introduces a novel contrastive learning paradigm to guide textual representations in capturing the intrinsic physical signatures of satellite imagery. Extensive experiments across varied geographic regions demonstrate that PLANET significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for robust, global-scale geo-localization. The dataset and source code will be released at https://github.com/YtH0823/CORE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个百万级全球跨模态地理定位数据集CORE（覆盖6大洲225个区域，103万+跨视图图像），并设计了物理定律感知网络PLANET，通过新型对比学习范式引导文本表示捕捉卫星图像的固有物理特征，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态地理定位研究受限于狭窄的地理覆盖范围和单一的场景多样性，无法反映全球建筑风格和地形特征的巨大空间异质性，缺乏能够支持普适定位的大规模数据集。
AI.method: 构建CORE百万级数据集（225个地理区域，6大洲）；利用大型视觉语言模型的零样本推理合成高质量场景描述；提出物理定律感知网络PLANET，引入新型对比学习范式使文本表示学习卫星图像中的固有物理特征。
AI.result: PLANET在不同地理区域的广泛实验中显著优于现有最先进方法，建立了鲁棒的全球尺度地理定位新基准。
AI.conclusion: CORE数据集和PLANET方法有效弥补了全球跨模态地理定位的数据和方法空白，为普适定位提供了新的基准。

title: Efficient Brood Cell Detection in Layer Trap Nests for Bees and Wasps: Balancing Labeling Effort and Species Coverage
summary:
Monitoring cavity-nesting wild bees and wasps is vital for biodiversity research and conservation. Layer trap nests (LTNs) are emerging as a valuable tool to study the abundance and species richness of these insects, offering insights into their nesting activities and ecological needs. However, manually evaluating LTNs to detect and classify brood cells is labor-intensive and time-consuming.
  To address this, we propose a deep learning based approach for efficient brood cell detection and classification in LTNs. LTNs present additional challenges due to densely packed brood cells, leading to a high labeling effort per image. Moreover, we observe a significant imbalance in class distribution, with common species having notably more occurrences than rare species. Comprehensive labeling of common species is time-consuming and exacerbates data imbalance, while partial labeling introduces data incompleteness which degrades model performance.
  To reduce labeling effort and mitigate the impact of unlabeled data, we introduce a novel Constrained False Positive Loss (CFPL) strategy. CFPL dynamically masks predictions from unlabeled data, preventing them from interfering with the classification loss during training.
  Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves detection performance, balances model accuracy and labeling effort, while also mitigating class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 针对巢穴陷阱（LTN）中野生蜜蜂与胡蜂的育雏细胞检测与分类任务，提出基于深度学习的CFPL损失策略，通过动态掩蔽未标注数据预测，减少标注成本并缓解类别不平衡问题，实验证明该方法在检测性能、标注效率与类别平衡间取得了良好折中。
AI.motivation: 人工评估巢穴陷阱（LTN）中的育雏细胞既耗时又费力，而深度学习标注面临育雏细胞密集排列导致标注成本高、常见种与稀有种类别分布严重不平衡、完整标注常见种加剧数据不平衡、部分标注导致数据不完整进而降低模型性能等问题，亟需一种能减少标注工作量同时缓解未标注数据负面影响的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于深度学习的育雏细胞检测与分类方法，核心创新为Constrained False Positive Loss (CFPL)策略，该策略在训练过程中动态掩蔽未标注数据的预测结果，阻止其干扰分类损失的计算，从而有效利用部分标注数据。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在提升检测性能的同时，平衡了模型精度与标注工作量，并有效缓解了类别不平衡问题。
AI.conclusion: CFPL策略为LTN中育雏细胞的自动检测与分类提供了一种高效解决方案，在降低人工标注成本的同时保持了良好的模型性能，对巢穴陷阱在生物多样性研究与保护中的规模化应用具有积极意义。

title: Attention, May I Have Your Decision? Localizing Generative Choices in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative capabilities, yet their internal operations remain opaque, particularly when handling prompts that are not fully descriptive. In such scenarios, models must make implicit decisions to generate details not explicitly specified in the text. This work investigates the hypothesis that this decision-making process is not diffuse but is computationally localized within the model's architecture. While existing localization techniques focus on prompt-related interventions, we notice that such explicit conditioning may differ from implicit decisions. Therefore, we introduce a probing-based localization technique to identify the layers with the highest attribute separability for concepts. Our findings indicate that the resolution of ambiguous concepts is governed principally by self-attention layers, identifying them as the most effective point for intervention. Based on this discovery, we propose ICM (Implicit Choice-Modification) - a precise steering method that applies targeted interventions to a small subset of layers. Extensive experiments confirm that intervening on these specific self-attention layers yields superior debiasing performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, minimizing artifacts common to less precise approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/kzaleskaa/icm.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探针定位方法发现文本到图像扩散模型对模糊概念的隐式决策主要由自注意力层控制，并提出ICM方法通过对少量自注意力层进行精准干预，实现更优的去偏效果且减少伪影。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在处理非完全描述性文本提示时，需要隐式地决定生成哪些未明确指定的细节，但这一决策过程的内部机制尚不透明。现有定位技术关注显式条件干预，而隐式决策可能与之不同，因此需要探索隐式选择的计算定位。
AI.method: 提出基于探针（probing）的定位技术，识别对模糊概念具有最高属性可分性的层；发现自注意力层是模糊概念消歧的关键；基于此提出ICM（Implicit Choice-Modification）方法，对少量自注意力层进行定向干预。
AI.result: 实验表明，对特定自注意力层进行干预的去偏效果优于现有最先进方法，且能最小化伪影生成。
AI.conclusion: 自注意力层是扩散模型中隐式选择决策的核心区域，精准定位并干预这些层能有效改善模型在模糊提示下的生成偏差。

title: BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{BareBones}$, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (eg. GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the $\textit{Texture Bias Cliff}$. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding. Project Page: https://eternal-f1ame.github.io/WTP-Bench/

AI.tldr: 本文提出BareBones基准测试，通过剥离RGB纹理、仅保留像素级轮廓，系统评估26个主流视觉语言模型（如GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA）的纯几何形状理解能力。结果发现所有模型在缺少纹理信息时均出现严重性能崩溃，作者称之为"纹理偏差悬崖"（Texture Bias Cliff），表明当前VLM并未真正理解几何结构，而是依赖纹理和上下文先验作为统计捷径。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在零样本多模态任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚其是否真正理解几何结构，抑或仅利用RGB纹理和上下文先验作为统计捷径。已有评估未能隔离这一机制，常混淆语义推理与纹理映射，且依赖不精确的标注会无意泄露环境线索。
AI.method: 提出BareBones零样本基准测试，包含六个数据集：五个现有分割数据集（ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200）及自建旗舰数据集WTP-Bench。将所有数据剥离为像素级轮廓（silhouettes），去除RGB纹理信息，构建无噪声的几何分类体系。评估26个先进VLM（包括GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA等专有及开源模型）。
AI.result: 所有26个评估模型在去除RGB纹理后均出现一致的严重性能下降，作者将这一现象命名为"纹理偏差悬崖"（Texture Bias Cliff）。模型在纯几何轮廓识别任务中暴露出普遍的结构性盲点，证明了当前VLM普遍缺乏真正的几何基础能力。
AI.conclusion: BareBones为评估VLM的纯几何理解能力建立了严格的基准尺度。结果表明当前最先进的视觉语言模型在几何形状感知方面存在系统性缺陷，没有真正理解几何结构，而是依赖纹理和上下文捷径。这一发现对VLM在需要几何推理的真实应用中的可靠性提出了根本性质疑。

title: Topology-Aware Layer Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
comment: This manuscript has been withdrawn by the authors. It reproduced the methodology of Gardinazzi et al., arXiv:2410.11042, without citation, and utilized code and data from the associated repository (github.com/RitAreaSciencePark/ZigZagLLMs) without disclosure or violate the MIT License. A revised future version with full attribution may be prepared. For any feedback, please contact Pengcheng Zheng
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language understanding and reasoning, while recent extensions that incorporate visual inputs enable them to process multimodal information. Despite these advances, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur substantial computational and memory costs, hindering deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing layer pruning methods typically rely on local similarity metrics or static proxy signals, failing to capture the global and dynamic evolution of representations across model depth, which often leads to the removal of transition-critical layers. To address this limitation, we propose a topology-aware layer pruning framework for LVLMs. Specifically, we represent layer wise hidden states as point clouds and models their evolution using \textit{simplicial complexes}. By leveraging \textit{zigzag persistent homology}, we quantify inter-layer topological consistency and enable adaptive pruning that preserves critical representational transitions. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing pruning methods across a wide range of sparsity ratios. Our code is available at https://github.com/zpc456/TopoVLM.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于拓扑感知的层剪枝框架TopoVLM，利用持续同调（zigzag persistent homology）分析LVLM层间隐藏状态的拓扑演变，识别并保留关键过渡层，从而在减少计算开销的同时保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有层剪枝方法依赖局部相似性度量或静态代理信号，无法捕捉跨层表征的全局和动态演化，容易误删过渡关键层。LVLMs在资源受限场景下部署面临严重的计算和内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 将各层隐藏态表示为点云；2) 通过单纯复形（simplicial complexes）建模跨层演化；3) 利用zigzag持续同调量化层间拓扑一致性；4) 基于拓扑一致性分数进行自适应剪枝，保留拓扑关键过渡层。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上，所提框架在不同稀疏率下均一致优于现有层剪枝方法。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知的层剪枝能更准确地识别模型中的关键过渡层，为LVLMs的高效部署提供了新思路。代码已开源。

title: Semi-Offline Reinforcement Learning for Optimized Text Generation
comment: In Proceedings of the 40th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2023)
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), there are two major settings for interacting with the environment: online and offline. Online methods explore the environment at significant time cost, and offline methods efficiently obtain reward signals by sacrificing exploration capability. We propose semi-offline RL, a novel paradigm that smoothly transits from offline to online settings, balances exploration capability and training cost, and provides a theoretical foundation for comparing different RL settings. Based on the semi-offline formulation, we present the RL setting that is optimal in terms of optimization cost, asymptotic error, and overfitting error bound. Extensive experiments show that our semi-offline approach is efficient and yields comparable or often better performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出半离线强化学习（semi-offline RL）这一新范式，实现了从离线到在线的平滑过渡，在探索能力与训练成本间取得平衡，并提供了不同RL设置的理论基础。基于该框架，论文给出了在优化成本、渐近误差和过拟合误差界方面最优的RL设置，实验表明该方法高效且性能达到或超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 在线RL探索成本高，离线RL虽效率高但牺牲了探索能力，现有方法无法在两者间有效平衡。作者希望提出一种新范式，既能兼顾探索能力与训练效率，又能为不同RL设置提供统一的理论比较基础。
AI.method: 提出半离线RL范式，实现从离线到在线的平滑过渡；基于该框架推导出在优化成本、渐近误差和过拟合误差界方面最优的RL设置。
AI.result: 半离线方法训练高效，性能与现有最优方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 半离线RL是一种有效的平衡探索与效率的新范式，能够从理论上统一比较不同RL设置，并在实践中取得优异性能。

title: CityRAG: Stepping Into a City via Spatially-Grounded Video Generation
summary: We address the problem of generating a 3D-consistent, navigable environment that is spatially grounded: a simulation of a real location. Existing video generative models can produce a plausible sequence that is consistent with a text (T2V) or image (I2V) prompt. However, the capability to reconstruct the real world under arbitrary weather conditions and dynamic object configurations is essential for downstream applications including autonomous driving and robotics simulation. To this end, we present CityRAG, a video generative model that leverages large corpora of geo-registered data as context to ground generation to the physical scene, while maintaining learned priors for complex motion and appearance changes. CityRAG relies on temporally unaligned training data, which teaches the model to semantically disentangle the underlying scene from its transient attributes. Our experiments demonstrate that CityRAG can generate coherent minutes-long, physically grounded video sequences, maintain weather and lighting conditions over thousands of frames, achieve loop closure, and navigate complex trajectories to reconstruct real-world geography.

AI.tldr: CityRAG是一种视频生成模型，利用地理注册数据作为上下文，生成与真实物理场景一致、支持任意天气条件和动态物体配置的3D连贯可导航环境，适用于自动驾驶和机器人仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型（T2V/I2V）能生成与文本或图像提示一致的合理序列，但缺乏重建真实世界在任意天气条件和动态物体配置下的能力，而这对于自动驾驶和机器人仿真等下游应用至关重要。
AI.method: CityRAG利用大规模地理注册数据作为上下文将生成结果扎根于物理场景，同时保持学习到的复杂运动和外观变化先验。模型使用时间上未对齐的训练数据，使其学会从瞬态属性中语义解耦底层场景。
AI.result: CityRAG能够生成数分钟长的连贯、物理扎根的视频序列，在数千帧中保持天气和光照条件一致，实现闭环，并导航复杂轨迹以重建真实世界地理。
AI.conclusion: CityRAG通过地理上下文嵌入和时间未对齐训练，成功实现了对真实场景的物理级重建，具备长时间连贯性、条件一致性和复杂轨迹导航能力。

title: Uncovering Model Processing Strategies with Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization
summary: We introduce NPEFF (Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization), an interpretability method that aims to uncover strategies used by a model to generate its predictions. NPEFF decomposes per-example Fisher matrices using a novel decomposition algorithm that learns a set of components represented by learned rank-1 positive semi-definite matrices. Through a combination of human evaluation and automated analysis, we demonstrate that these NPEFF components correspond to model processing strategies for a variety of language models and text processing tasks. We further show how to construct parameter perturbations from NPEFF components to selectively disrupt a given component's role in the model's processing. Along with conducting extensive ablation studies, we include experiments to show how NPEFF can be used to analyze and mitigate collateral effects of unlearning and use NPEFF to study in-context learning. Furthermore, we demonstrate the advantages of NPEFF over baselines such as gradient clustering and using sparse autoencoders for dictionary learning over model activations. We release the code used in this work.

AI.tldr: NPEFF是一种新颖的可解释性方法，通过分解逐样本Fisher信息矩阵来揭示模型预测策略，在多种语言模型和文本任务上验证了有效性，并能用于分析未学习的影响和上下文学习。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法难以揭示模型内部处理策略，作者提出NPEFF以非负逐样本Fisher分解的方式，捕获模型处理策略对应的可解释成分。
AI.method: 提出非负逐样本Fisher分解（NPEFF），对每个样本的Fisher信息矩阵进行分解，使用一种新颖的分解算法学习一组由秩1正半定矩阵表示的成分。
AI.result: 通过人工评估和自动化分析，NPEFF成分对应模型处理策略；能通过参数扰动选择性破坏特定成分；在未学习影响分析、上下文学习研究中优于梯度聚类和稀疏自编码器等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: NPEFF是一种有效的可解释性工具，能揭示模型策略、分析未学习的副作用以及研究上下文学习，优于现有基线方法。

title: Image Generators are Generalist Vision Learners
summary: Recent works show that image and video generators exhibit zero-shot visual understanding behaviors, in a way reminiscent of how LLMs develop emergent capabilities of language understanding and reasoning from generative pretraining. While it has long been conjectured that the ability to create visual content implies an ability to understand it, there has been limited evidence that generative vision models have developed strong understanding capabilities. In this work, we demonstrate that image generation training serves a role similar to LLM pretraining, and lets models learn powerful and general visual representations that enable SOTA performance on various vision tasks. We introduce Vision Banana, a generalist model built by instruction-tuning Nano Banana Pro (NBP) on a mixture of its original training data alongside a small amount of vision task data. By parameterizing the output space of vision tasks as RGB images, we seamlessly reframe perception as image generation. Our generalist model, Vision Banana, achieves SOTA results on a variety of vision tasks involving both 2D and 3D understanding, beating or rivaling zero-shot domain-specialists, including Segment Anything Model 3 on segmentation tasks, and the Depth Anything series on metric depth estimation. We show that these results can be achieved with lightweight instruction-tuning without sacrificing the base model's image generation capabilities. The superior results suggest that image generation pretraining is a generalist vision learner. It also shows that image generation serves as a unified and universal interface for vision tasks, similar to text generation's role in language understanding and reasoning. We could be witnessing a major paradigm shift for computer vision, where generative vision pretraining takes a central role in building Foundational Vision Models for both generation and understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vision Banana，通过对Nano Banana Pro进行指令微调，将视觉任务输出参数化为RGB图像，从而将感知任务重构为图像生成问题。实验表明，图像生成预训练能习得强大的通用视觉表征，在2D和3D视觉任务上达到SOTA，超越了SAM 3和Depth Anything等专业模型，证明图像生成可作为视觉任务的统一接口，预示着生成式视觉预训练将成为构建基础视觉模型的核心范式。
AI.motivation: 验证图像生成预训练能否像LLM的语言生成预训练一样，赋予模型强大的视觉理解能力，并探索图像生成作为视觉任务统一接口的可行性。
AI.method: 对Nano Banana Pro（NBP）进行指令微调，将原始训练数据与少量视觉任务数据混合训练；通过将视觉任务的输出空间参数化为RGB图像，将分割、深度估计等感知任务统一转化为图像生成问题。
AI.result: Vision Banana在2D和3D视觉理解任务上达到SOTA，在分割任务上超越SAM 3，在度量深度估计上超越Depth Anything系列；轻量级指令微调即可实现，且不牺牲基础模型的图像生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 图像生成预训练是一种通用视觉学习器，图像生成可作为视觉任务的统一接口，类似于文本生成在语言理解中的角色，预示着生成式视觉预训练将成为构建基础视觉模型的核心范式转变。

title: Exploration via linearly perturbed loss minimisation
comment: Updated with erratum note: Appendix I contains a gap in the proof; all main-paper claims remain valid via the corrected argument of Perneczky, Abeille & Janz (2026, arXiv:2606.00431)
summary: We introduce exploration via linear loss perturbations (EVILL), a randomised exploration method for structured stochastic bandit problems that works by solving for the minimiser of a linearly perturbed regularised negative log-likelihood function. We show that, for the case of generalised linear bandits, EVILL reduces to perturbed history exploration (PHE), a method where exploration is done by training on randomly perturbed rewards. In doing so, we provide a simple and clean explanation of when and why random reward perturbations give rise to good bandit algorithms. We propose data-dependent perturbations not present in previous PHE-type methods that allow EVILL to match the performance of Thompson-sampling-style parameter-perturbation methods, both in theory and in practice. Moreover, we show an example outside generalised linear bandits where PHE leads to inconsistent estimates, and thus linear regret, while EVILL remains performant. Like PHE, EVILL can be implemented in just a few lines of code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVILL，一种通过线性损失扰动实现结构化随机摇臂问题探索的方法。对于广义线性摇臂，EVILL等价于扰动历史探索（PHE），并引入数据依赖的扰动以匹配汤普森采样方法的性能。在非广义线性设置下，PHE可能失效而EVILL依然有效。
AI.motivation: 现有随机奖励扰动方法（PHE）缺乏理论解释且在某些场景下失效，作者希望提出一种通用框架来理解何时及为何随机奖励扰动能产生好的摇臂算法，并克服PHE的局限性。
AI.method: 提出EVILL方法：通过求解线性扰动的正则化负对数似然函数的最小值来进行探索。在广义线性摇臂中，该方法退化为PHE；此外引入数据依赖的扰动项，使其匹配汤普森采样风格参数扰动的性能。
AI.result: EVILL在广义线性摇臂中与PHE等价，但通过数据依赖扰动匹配了汤普森采样的理论/实践性能。在非广义线性设置中，PHE导致不一致估计和线性遗憾，而EVILL仍表现良好。
AI.conclusion: EVILL提供了随机奖励扰动方法何时有效的清晰解释，且实现简洁（仅需几行代码），在更广泛的结构化摇臂问题中优于传统PHE方法。

title: JI-ADF: Joint-Individual Learning with Adaptive Decision Fusion for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification
summary: Skin lesion classification is essential for early dermatological diagnosis, yet many existing computer-aided systems rely primarily on dermoscopic images and underutilize the multimodal evidence routinely available in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{JI-ADF}, a trimodal deep learning framework that integrates dermoscopic images, clinical photographs, and structured patient metadata for clinically grounded skin lesion classification. The proposed architecture combines joint multimodal representation learning with modality-specific auxiliary supervision and an adaptive decision fusion mechanism that dynamically calibrates modality contributions on a per-sample basis. To enhance cross-modal reasoning while preserving modality-specific evidence, we further introduce a multimodal fusion attention (MMFA) module. We evaluate JI-ADF on the large-scale MILK10k benchmark, which reflects real-world clinical acquisition conditions and severe class imbalance. The proposed method demonstrates strong and well-balanced performance across lesion categories, improving sensitivity and Dice score while maintaining high specificity and good calibration. Extensive analyses, including modality ablation, calibration evaluation, and Grad-CAM visualization, further confirm the robustness and clinically meaningful behavior of the model. These results indicate that JI-ADF provides a reliable and practical foundation for multimodal skin lesion classification in real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JI-ADF，一个集成皮肤镜图像、临床照片和结构化患者元数据的三模态深度学习框架，通过联合表示学习、模态特异性辅助监督和自适应决策融合机制，在MILK10k基准上实现了鲁棒且均衡的皮肤病变分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机辅助皮肤病变分类系统大多仅依赖皮肤镜图像，未能充分利用临床实践中常规可获取的多模态证据（临床照片、患者元数据），导致诊断信息利用不充分。
AI.method: JI-ADF框架包含三个核心组件：1）联合多模态表示学习；2）模态特异性辅助监督；3）自适应决策融合机制，可动态校准每个样本的模态贡献；此外还引入多模态融合注意力（MMFA）模块以增强跨模态推理并保留模态特异性证据。
AI.result: 在反映真实临床采集条件和严重类别不平衡的MILK10k基准上，JI-ADF实现了强且均衡的跨类别性能，提升了灵敏度和Dice分数，同时保持高特异性和良好校准。消融实验、校准评估和Grad-CAM可视化进一步证实了模型的鲁棒性和临床合理性。
AI.conclusion: JI-ADF为真实临床环境下的多模态皮肤病变分类提供了可靠且实用的基础框架。

title: Separation Power of Equivariant Neural Networks
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025
summary: The separation power of a machine learning model refers to its ability to distinguish between different inputs and is often used as a proxy for its expressivity. Indeed, knowing the separation power of a family of models is a necessary condition to obtain fine-grained universality results. In this paper, we analyze the separation power of equivariant neural networks, such as convolutional and permutation-invariant networks. We first present a complete characterization of inputs indistinguishable by models derived by a given architecture. From this results, we derive how separability is influenced by hyperparameters and architectural choices-such as activation functions, depth, hidden layer width, and representation types. Notably, all non-polynomial activations, including ReLU and sigmoid, are equivalent in expressivity and reach maximum separation power. Depth improves separation power up to a threshold, after which further increases have no effect. Adding invariant features to hidden representations does not impact separation power. Finally, block decomposition of hidden representations affects separability, with minimal components forming a hierarchy in separation power that provides a straightforward method for comparing the separation power of models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了等变神经网络（如卷积网络和置换不变网络）的分离能力，提出了输入不可区分性的完整表征，并揭示了激活函数、深度、宽度和表示类型等超参数对分离能力的影响规律。
AI.motivation: 分离能力是衡量模型表达力的重要指标，理解模型的分离能力是获得细粒度普适性结果的必要条件。本文旨在系统分析等变神经网络的分离能力及其受超参数和架构选择的影响。
AI.method: 首先对给定架构下模型无法区分的输入进行完整表征，然后基于此结果分析激活函数、深度、隐藏层宽度和表示类型等超参数对分离能力的影响。
AI.result: 所有非多项式激活函数（包括ReLU和sigmoid）在表达力上等价，均能达到最大分离能力；深度在一定阈值内提升分离能力，超过后无进一步效果；向隐藏表示添加不变特征不影响分离能力；隐藏表示的块分解影响分离能力，最小成分形成分离能力层级结构，可提供比较不同模型分离能力的简便方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了等变神经网络分离能力的系统性分析，为比较不同架构模型的表达力提供了理论依据和方法指导。

title: Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video
summary: Existing 3D sign language avatar reconstruction methods are developed and evaluated exclusively on Western sign languages, and no 3D parametric annotations exist for any Arabic Sign Language dataset, a gap that blocks the development of avatar-based accessibility applications for the Arab Deaf community. We release the first SMPL-X parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 Saudi Sign Language dataset, enabling quantitative evaluation and downstream sign language generation for Arabic Sign Language. We introduce Tamaththul3D, a reconstruction pipeline that aligns hand and body estimates through geometric inverse kinematics on the forearm chain followed by 2D-supervised shoulder refinement. The closed-form integration is decoupled from the specific choice of body and hand estimators: any SMPL-X-compatible body estimator and any MANO-compatible hand estimator can be substituted, as we demonstrate by swapping each module independently. Tamaththul3D achieves up to 32% lower hand error than prior methods, runs 32x faster than the strongest baseline, and generalizes across five typologically distinct sign languages without dataset-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 首个面向阿拉伯手语的3D参数化标注数据集及高效重建管线Tamaththul3D，在跨5种手语上实现32%手部误差降低与32倍速度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3D手语虚拟人重建方法仅针对西方手语开发，缺乏面向阿拉伯手语（尤其是沙特手语）的3D参数化标注，阻碍了阿拉伯聋人社群的无障碍应用发展。
AI.method: 提出Tamaththul3D重建管线：通过几何逆运动学对齐前臂链上的手部和身体估计，再经2D监督的肩膀精细化调整；身体与手部估计器可独立替换（兼容SMPL-X和MANO）。
AI.result: 相比现有方法，手部误差降低最高32%，运行速度比最强基线快32倍；不经数据集特定适配即可泛化至5种类型学上不同的手语。
AI.conclusion: 发布首个阿拉伯手语SMPL-X参数化标注，并验证了Tamaththul3D在跨语言泛化和效率上的显著优势，为阿拉伯聋社群的无障碍应用奠定了数据与算法基础。

title: FATE: Focal-modulated Attention Encoder for Multivariate Time-series Forecasting
summary: Climate change stands as one of the most pressing global challenges of the twenty-first century, with far-reaching consequences such as rising sea levels, melting glaciers, and increasingly extreme weather patterns. Accurate forecasting is critical for monitoring these phenomena and supporting mitigation strategies. While recent data-driven models for time-series forecasting, including CNNs, RNNs, and attention-based transformers, have shown promise, they often struggle with sequential dependencies and limited parallelization, especially in long-horizon, multivariate meteorological datasets. In this work, we present Focal Modulated Attention Encoder (FATE), a novel transformer architecture designed for reliable multivariate time-series forecasting. Unlike conventional models, FATE introduces a tensorized focal modulation mechanism that explicitly captures spatiotemporal correlations in time-series data. We further propose two modulation scores that offer interpretability by highlighting critical environmental features influencing predictions. We benchmark FATE across seven diverse real-world datasets, including ETTh1, ETTm2, Traffic, Weather5k, USA-Canada, Europe, and LargeST datasets, and show that it consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art methods, including temperature datasets. Our ablation studies also demonstrate that FATE generalizes well to broader multivariate time-series forecasting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FATE（Focal Modulated Attention Encoder），一种新颖的Transformer架构，通过张量化焦点调制机制显式捕获时空相关性，在多个多变量时间序列预测数据集上超越现有最先进方法，并提供了可解释性调制分数。
AI.motivation: 气候变化是21世纪最紧迫的全球挑战之一，准确预测对监测和缓解策略至关重要。现有数据驱动模型（CNN、RNN、基于注意力的Transformer）在长序列多变量气象数据中面临序列依赖和并行化限制问题。
AI.method: 提出FATE（Focal Modulated Attention Encoder），一种新颖的Transformer架构，引入张量化焦点调制机制显式捕获时空相关性，并设计了两种调制分数用于可解释性分析。
AI.result: 在ETTh1、ETTm2、Traffic、Weather5k、USA-Canada、Europe、LargeST等7个真实数据集上，FATE一致优于所有现有最先进方法。消融研究证明其能泛化到更广泛的多变量时间序列预测任务。
AI.conclusion: FATE通过张量化焦点调制机制有效解决了长序列多变量时间序列预测中的挑战，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能，同时具备良好的可解释性和泛化能力。

title: Inverse Entropic Optimal Transport Solves Semi-supervised Learning via Data Likelihood Maximization
summary: Learning conditional distributions $π^*(\cdot|x)$ is a central problem in machine learning, which is typically approached via supervised methods with paired data $(x,y) \sim π^*$. However, acquiring paired data samples is often challenging, especially in problems such as domain translation. This necessitates the development of $\textit{semi-supervised}$ models that utilize both limited paired data and additional unpaired i.i.d. samples $x \sim π^*_x$ and $y \sim π^*_y$ from the marginal distributions. The usage of such combined data is complex and often relies on heuristic approaches. To tackle this issue, we propose a new learning paradigm called $\textbf{EBiEOT}$ that integrates both paired and unpaired data seamlessly using data likelihood maximization techniques. We demonstrate that our approach also connects intriguingly with inverse entropic optimal transport (OT). This finding allows us to apply recent advances in computational OT to establish an $\textit{end-to-end}$ learning algorithm to get $π^*(\cdot|x)$. In addition, we derive the universal approximation property, demonstrating that our approach can theoretically recover true conditional distributions with arbitrarily small error. Finally, we demonstrate through empirical tests that our method effectively learns conditional distributions using paired and unpaired data simultaneously. The code of $\texttt{EBiEOT}$ is available at https://github.com/MuXauJl11110/EBiEOT.

AI.tldr: 提出EBiEOT框架，通过数据似然最大化技术无缝整合配对数据与未配对数据以学习条件分布，并揭示了其与逆熵最优输运的内在联系，具备通用逼近性质，实验验证有效。
AI.motivation: 在机器学习中学习条件分布通常需要配对数据，但配对数据获取困难（如域翻译任务），因此需要半监督方法同时利用有限的配对数据和额外的未配对边际分布样本，现有方法常依赖启发式策略，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出EBiEOT（Entropic Bi-Encoder Optimal Transport）学习范式，通过数据似然最大化技术整合配对和未配对数据；揭示了该方法与逆熵最优输运（inverse entropic OT）的理论联系，并利用计算OT的最新进展构建端到端学习算法。
AI.result: 推导了通用逼近性质，证明该方法理论上可以任意小误差恢复真实条件分布；通过实证测试验证了方法能有效同时利用配对和未配对数据学习条件分布。
AI.conclusion: EBiEOT为利用混合数据学习条件分布提供了理论严谨且实用的解决方案，弥合了半监督学习与最优输运理论之间的鸿沟。

title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model
summary: Since the emergence of Vision Transformer (ViT), it has been widely used in generative language model and generative visual model. Especially in the current state-of-art open source multimodal models, ViT obtained by CLIP or SigLIP method serves as the vision encoder backbone to help them acquire visual understanding capabilities. But this method leads to limitations in visual understanding for details, such as difficulty in recognizing small text or numbers in images. To address these issues, we propose a new model to unify pix token and word token into the generative language model. The new model also features with each pix of image having its own token embedding, color folding, global conditional attention approximation and image unsupervised pretraining. We conducted image unsupervised pretraining experiments using our new model to explore its potential. The experimental results show that it has good performance even in small model and with limited training data. We believe our model also conforms to the scaling law, as long as model parameters and training data increased, its performance will continue to improve.

AI.tldr: 针对ViT在细节视觉理解（如小文字/数字识别）上的局限，提出一种将图像像素token与文本token统一纳入生成语言模型的新方法，每个像素拥有独立token嵌入，采用颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似和无监督图像预训练，实验表明小模型和有限数据下表现良好，且符合缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP/SigLIP的ViT方法作为多模态模型的视觉编码器时，在细节视觉理解（如识别图像中的小文字或数字）方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出一种统一像素token和文本token的生成式语言模型，每个图像像素拥有独立的token嵌入，引入颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似以及图像无监督预训练方法。
AI.result: 在图像无监督预训练实验中，即使模型规模较小、训练数据有限，新模型仍表现出良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 该模型符合缩放定律，随着模型参数和训练数据的增加，性能将持续提升。

title: Comprehensive and Reliable Feature Attribution for Diverse Modalities and Models via Frequency-Domain Insights
summary: Personalized Federal learning(PFL) allows clients to cooperatively train a personalized model without disclosing their private dataset. However, PFL suffers from Non-IID, heterogeneous devices, lack of fairness, and unclear contribution which urgently need the interpretability of deep learning model to overcome these challenges. These challenges proposed new demands for interpretability. Low cost, privacy, and detailed information. There is no current interpretability method satisfying them. In this paper, we propose a novel interpretability method \emph{FreqX} by introducing Signal Processing and Information Theory. Our experiments show that the explanation results of FreqX contain both attribution information and concept information. FreqX runs at least 10 times faster than the baselines which contain concept information.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FreqX的新型可解释性方法，通过引入信号处理和信息理论，同时提供归因信息和概念信息，运行速度至少比包含概念信息的方法快10倍，以解决个性化联邦学习在非独立同分布、异构设备、公平性缺失和贡献不清等挑战下对可解释性的新需求（低成本、隐私保护和详细信息）。
AI.motivation: 个性化联邦学习面临Non-IID、异构设备、缺乏公平性和贡献不清等挑战，亟需深度学习模型的可解释性来克服这些问题，但现有可解释性方法无法同时满足低成本、隐私保护和详细信息这三项新需求。
AI.method: 提出FreqX方法，引入信号处理和信息理论来生成可解释性结果，同时包含归因信息（attribution information）和概念信息（concept information）。
AI.result: FreqX的解释结果同时包含归因信息和概念信息，运行速度至少比包含概念信息的基线方法快10倍。
AI.conclusion: FreqX是一种满足个性化联邦学习对可解释性新需求（低成本、隐私保护、详细信息）的有效方法，通过信号处理和信息理论的引入实现了高效且信息丰富的模型解释。

title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation
comment: [14] pages, [6] figures, [11] tables, appendix included. Preprint
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAVEN框架，通过多智能体提示精细化方法提升文本到视频生成中的文化保真度，在单文化和跨文化场景下均取得显著效果，并构建了包含243个文化提示、972个视频的基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前T2V生成在视觉保真度上进展迅速，但对单一提示中多文化忠实表征的能力尚缺乏系统探索，尤其是跨文化场景下的文化保真度问题亟待解决。
AI.method: 提出MAVEN多智能体提示精细化框架，将提示分解为人、行为、地点三个维度，由并行或串行运作的专门智能体分别处理；构建跨三个文化（中国、美国、罗马尼亚）、三类动作、单文化和跨文化场景的基准数据集进行系统评估。
AI.result: 结合CLIP指标、VLM评判和视频质量评估，表明多智能体精细化（尤其是并行专业化）在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时，显著提升了文化相关性。
AI.conclusion: MAVEN框架有效提升了T2V生成中的文化保真度，验证了多智能体并行专业化策略在跨文化视频生成中的优势，为多文化AI生成内容提供了新的方法论。

title: Scalable Temporal Anomaly Causality Discovery in Large Systems: Achieving Computational Efficiency with Binary Anomaly Flag Data
comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables, published version at EPJ-C: Computing, Software and Data Science
summary: Extracting anomaly causality facilitates diagnostics once monitoring systems detect system faults. Identifying anomaly causes in large systems involves investigating a broader set of monitoring variables across multiple subsystems. However, learning graphical causal models (GCMs) comes with a significant computational burden that restrains the applicability of most existing methods in real-time and large-scale deployments. In addition, modern monitoring applications for large systems often generate large amounts of binary alarm flags, and the distinct characteristics of binary anomaly data -- the meaning of state transition and data sparsity -- challenge existing causality learning mechanisms. This study proposes an anomaly causal discovery approach (AnomalyCD), addressing the accuracy and computational challenges of generating GCMs from temporal binary flag datasets. The AnomalyCD presents several strategies, such as anomaly data-aware causality testing, sparse data and prior link compression, and edge pruning adjustment approaches. We validate the performance of the approach on two datasets: monitoring sensor data from the readout-box system of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment at CERN, and a public dataset from an information technology monitoring system. The results on temporal GCMs demonstrate a considerable reduction of computation overhead and a moderate enhancement of accuracy on the binary anomaly datasets. Code: https://github.com/muleina/AnomalyCD .

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnomalyCD方法，用于从时间序列二元报警标志数据中高效、准确地发现异常因果关系，并在CERN CMS实验和IT监控数据集上验证了该方法在降低计算开销和提升准确性方面的效果。
AI.motivation: 大规模系统中异常因果关系的提取对故障诊断至关重要，但现有图因果模型学习方法计算负担重，难以应用于实时和大规模场景；同时二元报警数据的状态转移含义和数据稀疏性特征对传统因果学习机制构成挑战。
AI.method: 提出AnomalyCD方法，包含异常数据感知的因果检验、稀疏数据与先验链接压缩、边剪枝调整等策略，从时间序列二元标志数据中生成图因果模型。
AI.result: 在CERN CMS实验读出箱系统的监控传感器数据和IT监控系统公开数据集上，AnomalyCD显著降低了计算开销，并在二元异常数据集上适度提升了准确性。
AI.conclusion: AnomalyCD能够有效应对二元异常数据的特性，在大规模实时监控场景中实现高效且准确的异常因果关系发现。

title: When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data
comment: ICML 2026 Camera Ready; Project Page: https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign
summary: Preference alignment aims to guide generative models by learning from comparisons between preferred and non-preferred samples. In practice, most existing approaches rely on preference pairs constructed from model-generated images. Such supervision is inherently relative and can be ambiguous when both samples exhibit artifacts or limited visual quality, making it difficult to infer what constitutes a truly desirable output. In this work, we investigate whether real data can serve as an alternative source of supervision for preference alignment. We adopt a data-centric perspective and study a curation strategy that treats real images as reference points and constructs preference signals by contrasting them with generated or perturbed samples, without requiring manually annotated preference pairs. Through empirical analysis, we show that real-data-based supervision provides effective guidance for aligning diffusion models and achieves performance comparable to existing preference-based methods. Our results suggest that real data offers a practical and complementary source of supervision for preference alignment and highlight directions of label-efficient alignment strategies. Code and models are available at https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用真实数据作为偏好对齐的监督信号替代传统模型生成样本对，通过对比真实图像与生成/扰动图像构建偏好信号，无需人工标注偏好对，实验表明该方法在扩散模型对齐上达到与现有偏好方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖模型生成的图像构建偏好对，这种相对监督在双方都存在伪影或视觉质量受限时具有歧义性，难以确定真正理想的输出。因此研究能否使用真实数据作为偏好对齐的替代监督源。
AI.method: 采用数据为中心的视角，以真实图像作为参考点，通过对比真实图像与生成图像或扰动图像来构建偏好信号，无需人工标注的偏好对。
AI.result: 实证分析表明基于真实数据的监督能为扩散模型对齐提供有效指导，性能与现有基于偏好的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 真实数据作为偏好对齐的监督源是实用且互补的，为标签高效的齐策略指明了方向。

title: Advances in Temporal Point Processes: Bayesian, Neural, and LLM Approaches
summary: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are stochastic process models used to characterize event sequences occurring in continuous time. Traditional statistical TPPs have a long-standing history, with numerous models proposed and successfully applied across diverse domains. In recent years, advances in deep learning have spurred the development of neural TPPs, enabling greater flexibility and expressiveness in capturing complex temporal dynamics. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has further sparked excitement, offering new possibilities for modeling and analyzing event sequences by leveraging their rich contextual understanding. This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent research on TPPs from three perspectives: Bayesian, deep learning, and LLM approaches. We begin with a review of the fundamental concepts of TPPs, followed by an in-depth discussion of model design and parameter estimation techniques in these three frameworks. We also revisit classic application areas of TPPs to highlight their practical relevance. Finally, we outline challenges and promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了时间点过程（TPP）从贝叶斯、深度学习和大型语言模型三个视角的研究进展，覆盖了基础概念、模型设计、参数估计方法、经典应用领域以及未来挑战与方向。
AI.motivation: 时间点过程（TPP）是刻画连续时间事件序列的关键随机过程模型。传统统计TPP历史悠久且应用广泛，而深度学习尤其是大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起为TPP带来了更大的灵活性和表达能力。本文旨在系统梳理这三个视角下的最新研究进展，为研究者提供全面的参考。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，从三个主要视角（贝叶斯方法、深度学习方法、LLM方法）对TPP进行系统性回顾，涵盖基础概念、模型设计与参数估计技术，并回顾经典应用领域。
AI.result: 系统梳理了贝叶斯、深度学习和LLM三类TPP方法的研究现状，总结了各自的模型设计思路与参数估计策略，并列举了TPP在多个领域的经典应用案例。
AI.conclusion: TPP研究已从传统统计模型演进到深度学习驱动的神经TPP，并进一步拓展到利用LLM的上下文理解能力进行事件序列建模。未来研究面临诸多挑战，同时也存在广阔的发展空间。

title: TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge
comment: Technical Report for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge
summary: Video-text retrieval has witnessed remarkable progress driven by large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet most existing approaches inherit an implicit assumption from image-text retrieval: that visual semantics can be captured frame-by-frame. This assumption overlooks the temporal dynamics of egocentric videos. The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval (MIR) challenge further raises the bar by providing soft-label relevance matrices rather than binary labels, demanding models that can resolve graded semantic correspondences across modalities. In this report, we present our solution, termed TempRet, to the CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR challenge. Our approach builds upon a CLIP-based dual-encoder backbone and introduces two key components to address the temporal and cross-modal challenges. First, a temporal transformer operates exclusively on the video side, modeling inter-frame dependencies through learnable positional encodings and multi-head self-attention over frame-level CLIP features. Second, a two-stage reranking pipeline first retrieves Top-K candidates via the dual-encoder, then refines their scores using a cross-encoder equipped with an Image-Text Matching (ITM) head. The entire system is trained with Symmetric Multi-Similarity Loss to exploit the soft-label relevance matrices provided by the challenge. Our method achieves 67.97% average mAP and 82.92% average nDCG on the EK-100 MIR benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal refinement for egocentric video retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TempRet方法，针对第一人称视频的多实例检索任务，通过视频端时间Transformer建模帧间依赖，并采用两阶段重排流程（双编码器检索+交叉编码器精排），在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR基准上达到67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-文本检索方法继承了图像-文本检索的逐帧处理假设，忽略了第一人称视频的时间动态特性；EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR挑战进一步引入软标签相关性矩阵，要求模型能处理跨模态间的分级语义对应关系。
AI.method: 基于CLIP双编码器骨架，提出两个关键组件：1) 视频端时间Transformer，通过可学习位置编码和多头自注意力建模帧级CLIP特征间的帧间依赖；2) 两阶段重排流程，先由双编码器检索Top-K候选，再通过带图像-文本匹配头的交叉编码器精化分数。使用对称多相似性损失训练以利用软标签矩阵。
AI.result: 在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR基准上，平均mAP达67.97%，平均nDCG达82.92%，证明了时间建模和跨模态精化对第一人称视频检索的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 时间Transformer和两阶段重排能有效提升第一人称视频检索的细粒度语义匹配能力，软标签相关性矩阵配合对称多相似性损失有助于挖掘分级语义对应关系。

title: Reformulating Neural Operators in $d+1$ Dimensions for Embedding Evolution
summary:
Neural Operators (NOs) are powerful architectures for learning mappings between function spaces. While most advances focus on refining kernel parameterizations over the $d$-dimensional physical domain, the evolution of lifted embeddings remains underexplored, which often drives models toward computationally expensive embedding-scaling designs to improve approximation.
  In this paper, we introduce an auxiliary function dimension that models embedding evolution in operator form, thereby reformulating the NO pipeline in $d+1$ dimensions. We instantiate this framework via Fourier-based operators acting jointly on the physical and auxiliary domains, yielding a basis-diversified auxiliary evolution module as an alternative to brute-force embedding scaling. Across more than ten increasingly challenging benchmarks, ranging from the 1D heat equation to the highly nonlinear 3D Rayleigh-Taylor instability, our model consistently achieves the lowest relative $L_2$ error among the evaluated baselines. Crucially, this advantage is empirically supported by (1) controlled budget-aware comparisons against scaled and ablated baselines; (2) robustness under mixed-resolution training and super-resolution inference; and (3) zero-shot generalization to unseen temporal regimes. In addition, we present a broader set of design choices for lifting and recovery operators, demonstrating their impact on our model's predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种辅助函数维度方法，通过将神经算子（NO）管道重构为d+1维，引入基于傅里叶的辅助演化模块来替代暴力嵌入缩放，在多个基准测试（从1D热方程到3D瑞利-泰勒不稳定性）中均取得最低相对L2误差，并展示了在预算对比、混合分辨率训练、超分辨率推理和零样本时间泛化上的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子研究多聚焦于物理域上的核参数化改进，而嵌入维度的演化机制尚未被充分探索。当前模型往往依赖计算昂贵的嵌入缩放设计来提升逼近性能，缺乏更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出将神经算子管道重构为d+1维，引入一个辅助函数维度以算子形式建模嵌入演化。通过傅里叶算子联合作用于物理域和辅助域，实现一种基多样化的辅助演化模块，替代暴力嵌入缩放策略。同时设计了多种提升/恢复算子。
AI.result: 在超过十个基准测试（从1D热方程到3D非线性瑞利-泰勒不稳定性）中，模型一致取得最低相对L2误差。优势通过预算感知对比、混合分辨率训练/超分辨率推理的鲁棒性、以及零样本时间泛化得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提的d+1维辅助演化框架可有效替代计算昂贵的嵌入缩放设计，在多个维度和复杂度的算子学习任务中表现优异，且具有良好的泛化能力。

title: OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026
comment: Technical Report for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026
summary: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards. The codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/OmniEgo-R2

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniEgo-R²，一种统一的路由推理框架，用于解决跨域自我中心视频推理中的三个关键挑战（时间边界模糊、跨域语义粒度不匹配、相近选项决策不稳定），在EgoCross挑战赛的双赛道中均获得第二名。
AI.motivation: EgoCross挑战赛旨在评估多模态大语言模型在手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角等跨域自我中心视频上的推理能力。现有方法将任务简单视为多项选择VQA，未能充分处理跨域具身视频推理的特殊困难。
AI.method: 提出OmniEgo-R²（全领域自我中心路由推理）管线，包含：时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证、防御性答案校准。基于Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT检查点作为视觉语言骨干，搭配轻量级测试时推理和解析程序。
AI.result: 在Source-Limited赛道获得66.35%总体准确率，Open-Source赛道获得66.77%总体准确率，均位列第二。
AI.conclusion: 将EgoCross重新定义为鲁棒的跨域具身视频推理问题，而非简单的多项选择VQA任务，所提方法通过结构化路由推理有效提升了跨域自我中心视频推理性能。

title: HOPSE: Scalable Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder for Combinatorial Representations
summary: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven highly effective at modeling relational data, pairwise connections cannot fully capture multi-way relationships naturally present in complex real-world systems. In response to this, Topological Deep Learning (TDL) leverages more general combinatorial representations--such as simplicial or cellular complexes--to accommodate higher-order interactions. Existing TDL methods often extend GNNs through Higher-Order Message Passing (HOMP), but face critical scalability challenges due to the steep complexity overhead of propagating messages through combinatorial structures. To overcome this limitation, we propose HOPSE (Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder), a framework free of message passing layers that uses Hasse graph decompositions to derive efficient and expressive encodings over arbitrary higher-order domains. Notably, HOPSE scales linearly with the size of combinatorial representations while preserving the expressive power and permutation equivariance of the HOMP approaches. Experiments on molecular and topological benchmarks show that it matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance while consistently achieving speedups over HOMP-based models, opening a new path for scalable TDL. The code is available at https://github.com/geometric-intelligence/topobench.git.

AI.tldr: 提出HOPSE框架，通过Hasse图分解实现无消息传递的高阶拓扑表示学习，在保持表达能力的同时实现线性复杂度，在分子和拓扑基准上达到SOTA性能并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的高阶消息传递（HOMP）方法在拓扑深度学习（TDL）中面临严重的可扩展性挑战，因为通过组合结构传播消息的计算复杂度太高。
AI.method: 提出HOPSE（高阶位置和结构编码器），利用Hasse图分解在任意高阶域上推导高效且富有表达力的编码，完全避免消息传递层，实现线性缩放并保持置换等变性。
AI.result: 在分子和拓扑基准测试中，HOPSE匹配或超越了现有最佳方法，同时持续实现了比HOMP模型更快的运行速度。
AI.conclusion: HOPSE为可扩展的拓扑深度学习开辟了新路径，证明了无消息传递的高阶编码方案在兼顾表达力和效率方面的可行性。

title: EgoAction: Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion for the EPIC-KITCHENS Action Detection Challenge at CVPR 2026
comment: Technical Report for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection Challenge
summary: The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection challenge evaluates whether a model can localize the start and end of each action in long untrimmed egocentric videos and assign the corresponding verb--noun action label. In this report, we formulate our submission as EgoAction (Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion), a unified decoupled detection and fusion pipeline. The pipeline uses EPIC-finetuned VideoMAE-L features, trains separate noun and verb temporal detectors with causal temporal modeling, composes action hypotheses from top noun--verb pairs, and introduces a confidence-adaptive boundary fusion rule at post-processing time. The key observation is that verb and noun streams often fail differently: verb scores are sensitive to motion transitions, whereas noun scores are sensitive to hand-object visibility and object clutter. A fixed arithmetic mean of their predicted boundaries can therefore amplify localization errors when one stream degenerates. We replace this hard-coded mean with Dynamic Weighted Fusion (DWF), which normalizes the maximum noun and verb classification confidences into proposal-wise boundary weights and linearly combines the two intervals. This lightweight tensor-only operator shifts boundary authority toward the more reliable stream while preserving the decoupled action scoring mechanism. Together with sliding-window inference, top-K noun--verb action composition, and class-wise Soft-NMS, EgoAction provides a compact and reproducible system for egocentric temporal action detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoAction，一个基于解耦检测与可靠性感知时序融合的流水线，用于第一人称视频动作检测。其核心创新是动态加权融合（DWF），通过归一化动词和名词分类置信度来动态调整边界融合权重，从而在某一模态退化时抑制定位误差。
AI.motivation: 动词和名词流在时序定位中失效方式不同：动词分数对运动过渡敏感，名词分数对手-物可见性和物体杂乱敏感。使用固定的算术平均融合两种边界会在一流退化时放大定位误差。
AI.method: 1) 使用EPIC微调的VideoMAE-L提取特征；2) 分别训练名词和动词的因果时序检测器；3) 从top名词-动词对组合动作假设；4) 提出动态加权融合(DWF)，将最大名词和动词分类置信度归一化为提议级边界权重，线性组合两个区间；5) 配合滑动窗口推理、top-K名词-动词动作组合和类别Soft-NMS。
AI.result: 提供了紧凑且可复现的检测系统，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection挑战中取得优异表现。
AI.conclusion: DWF作为轻量级张量算子，将边界权威动态转移至更可靠的模态流，同时保持解耦动作评分机制，有效提升第一人称时序动作检测的鲁棒性。

title: Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer for Online Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
summary: Early and accurate detection of anomalies in time-series data is critical due to the substantial risks associated with false or missed detections. While MLP-based mixer models have shown promise in time-series analysis, they do not maintain temporal causality during data processing. Moreover, real-world multivariate time series often contain numerous channels with diverse inter-channel correlations. Spurious correlations in the reconstructed time series lead to noisy representations, resulting in inaccurate anomaly detection. In addition, anomaly scoring methods that ignore temporal continuity can mislead sequential detection. To address these challenges, we propose a cluster-aware causal mixer for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Channels are grouped into clusters based on their correlations, and each cluster is embedded through a dedicated embedding layer. A causal mixer is introduced to integrate information while maintaining temporal causality. We further develop a sequential anomaly-scoring method that accumulates evidence over time and refines anomaly boundaries. Our proposed model operates in an online fashion, making it suitable for real-time time-series anomaly detection. Experimental evaluations across six public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves superior performance.

AI.tldr: 针对多变量时间序列异常检测中时序因果性缺失、通道间虚假相关及异常评分忽略时序连续性的问题，提出了一种基于聚类感知的因果混合器模型，通过通道聚类、因果混合器及序列化异常评分方法，在6个公开数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLP混合器模型在处理时间序列时未保持时序因果性，且真实世界多变量时间序列存在大量通道间的虚假相关，导致重构序列产生噪声表示，进而影响异常检测准确性。此外，忽略时序连续性的异常评分方法会误导顺序检测。
AI.method: 1) 基于通道相关性的聚类分组，每个簇使用专用嵌入层；2) 引入因果混合器在保持时序因果性的同时整合信息；3) 开发序列化异常评分方法，随时间累积证据并细化异常边界；模型以在线方式运行。
AI.result: 在6个公开基准数据集上的实验评估表明，所提方法一致达到了最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的聚类感知因果混合器有效解决了多变量时间序列异常检测中的时序因果性、通道虚假相关及异常评分连续性等关键问题，适用于实时在线检测场景。

title: EgoAdapt: A Multi-Scene Egocentric Adaptation Method for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
comment: Technical Report for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
summary: This technical report presents our solution, EgoAdapt (Egocentric Adaptation via Category, Calibration, and Consistency), to the CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA challenge. HD-EPIC evaluates whether a vision-language model can reason over realistic first-person kitchen videos, where the evidence for an answer may be a short hand-object interaction, a long recipe trajectory, a spatial relation to a fixture, or a subtle gaze cue. The benchmark contains 26K multiple-choice questions across seven macro-categories: recipe, ingredient, nutrition, fine-grained action, 3D perception, object motion, and gaze. We observe that the main difficulty is not only model capacity, but also the mismatch between a single generic inference recipe and the heterogeneous temporal, spatial, and semantic structure of the benchmark. Our method, EgoAdapt, introduces three inference-time components: (1) category-conditioned routing with per-category prompts, frame budgets, and sampling rates; (2) calibrated option scoring that evaluates all candidate answers with letter-token likelihoods and generation agreement instead of relying only on direct generation; and (3) test-time consistency adaptation that aggregates predictions across option permutations and verification-style prompts for ambiguous cases. This design substantially improves over the available HD-EPIC baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了EgoAdapt方法，针对CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA挑战，通过类别条件路由、校准选项评分和测试时一致性适应三个推理时组件，解决了第一人称厨房视频问答中通用推理模板与异构视频结构不匹配的问题，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: HD-EPIC基准测试包含7个宏类别的26K多项选择题，涉及食谱、动作、3D感知等不同时空语义结构。主要难点不在于模型容量，而在于单一通用推理模板与异构时空语义结构之间的不匹配。
AI.method: EgoAdapt包含三个推理时组件：(1) 类别条件路由——为每个类别设计专用提示、帧预算和采样率；(2) 校准选项评分——利用字母-令牌似然和生成一致性评估所有候选答案，而非仅依赖直接生成；(3) 测试时一致性适应——聚合选项排列和验证风格提示下的预测结果，处理模糊情况。
AI.result: 该方法在HD-EPIC基准测试上显著优于现有基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对异构视频问答结构设计专门的推理策略，EgoAdapt有效解决了领域不对齐问题，验证了测试时自适应方法在复杂第一人称视频理解中的有效性。

title: GenFT: A Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Method for Pretrained Foundation Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a resource-efficient strategy for adapting Pretrained Foundation Models (PFMs) by learning a small number of task-specific updates $ΔW$. Existing methods often learn $ΔW$ largely independently of pretrained weights $W_0$, or exploit $W_0$ mainly through initialization or simple reparameterization. To further leverage the structural information encoded in $W_0$, we propose Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (GenFT), a $W_0$-conditioned PEFT method that uses a deterministic weight generator to produce task-specific updates. Specifically, GenFT performs row and column transformations with nonlinear activations to extract structured patterns from $W_0$, and introduces a shared-specific decomposition to balance cross-layer information reuse and layer-specific flexibility. GenFT is simple and parameter-efficient, achieving competitive or better average performance across NLP and CV benchmarks. We further provide a pilot study on LLaMA-7B to examine its feasibility for generative models. The code is available at GitHub https://github.com/xuguangning1218/GenFT.

AI.tldr: GenFT是一种基于预训练权重$W_0$条件生成任务特定增量$ΔW$的参数高效微调方法，通过对$W_0$进行行列变换、非线性激活及共享-特异分解，在NLP和CV基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并在LLaMA-7B上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法学习$ΔW$时大多与预训练权重$W_0$独立，或仅通过初始化/简单重参数化利用$W_0$，未能充分利用$W_0$中编码的结构信息。
AI.method: 提出GenFT，使用确定性权重生成器以$W_0$为条件生成任务特定增量。具体包括：对$W_0$进行行/列变换和非线性激活以提取结构化模式；引入共享-特异分解（shared-specific decomposition）来平衡跨层信息复用与逐层灵活性。
AI.result: 在NLP和CV基准上取得有竞争力或更优的平均性能；在LLaMA-7B上进行了可行性初步研究。
AI.conclusion: GenFT是一种简单且参数高效的PEFT方法，能更充分利用预训练权重的结构信息，在多种任务上表现良好，并具有向生成式模型扩展的潜力。

title: RAPTOR+: A Visually Grounded Vision-Language Framework to Improve Clinical Trust and Auditability in Automated Cancer Referral Processing
summary: Urgent suspected colorectal cancer (CRC) referrals create operational bottlenecks because semi-structured clinical documents often require manual review and transcription. The original RAPTOR system used Large Language Models for structured extraction but relied on a separate OCR stage, making it vulnerable to handwriting, layout variation, and loss of visual evidence linkage. We present RAPTOR+, a multimodal extension that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for end-to-end referral understanding. We evaluate fine-tuned VLMs, commercial and open-source zero-shot VLMs, and the original OCR-based pipeline on 223 clinically curated CRC urgent referral forms. We also introduce a grounding-aware evaluation framework that measures both extraction accuracy and evidence localisation. Results show a clear grounding gap in zero-shot models. Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved 92.6% Reading Accuracy but only 1.2% Strict Safety. In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B achieved 96.1% Reading Accuracy and 60.6% Strict Safety, substantially improving verifiable evidence grounding. These findings show that task-specific fine-tuning is essential for reliable, auditable clinical document understanding. RAPTOR+ enables extracted referral decisions to be linked to visual evidence, supporting safer and more efficient cancer referral triage.

AI.tldr: RAPTOR+ 是一个多模态扩展系统，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）实现结直肠癌紧急转诊文档的端到端理解，通过任务特定微调显著提升信息提取准确性和可验证证据定位能力，相比零样本模型和传统OCR管线更具可靠性和可审计性。
AI.motivation: 传统结直肠癌紧急转诊流程中半结构化临床文档需要人工审查和转录，造成操作瓶颈。原RAPTOR系统依赖独立的OCR阶段，容易受到手写、布局变化影响，且丢失视觉证据关联性，亟需一种端到端的多模态理解方案来提升转诊分诊的安全性和效率。
AI.method: 提出RAPTOR+多模态扩展系统，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行端到端转诊文档理解。在223份临床整理的CRC紧急转诊表单上评估了微调VLM、商业及开源零样本VLM以及原OCR管线。引入了一种基于定位感知（grounding-aware）的评估框架，同时衡量提取准确性和证据定位能力。
AI.result: 零样本模型存在明显的定位差距：Gemini 2.5 Flash的读取准确率达92.6%，但严格安全性仅1.2%。相比之下，微调的Qwen3-VL-8B读取准确率达96.1%，严格安全性达60.6%，在可验证证据定位方面有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的微调对于实现可靠、可审计的临床文档理解至关重要。RAPTOR+能够将提取的转诊决策与视觉证据相链接，支持更安全、更高效的癌症转诊分诊。

title: Robust Causal Discovery in Real-World Time Series with Power-Laws
summary: Exploring causal relationships in stochastic time series is a challenging yet crucial task with a vast range of applications, including finance, economics, neuroscience, and climate science. Many algorithms for Causal Discovery (CD) have been proposed; however, they often exhibit a high sensitivity to noise, resulting in spurious causal inferences in real data. In this paper, we observe that the frequency spectra of many real-world time series follow a power-law distribution, notably due to an inherent self-organizing behavior. Leveraging this insight, we build a robust CD method based on the extraction of power-law spectral features that amplify genuine causal signals. Our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets with known causal structures, demonstrating its robustness and practical relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于幂律谱特征提取的鲁棒因果发现方法，利用真实世界时间序列的幂律分布特性增强真实因果信号，在合成基准和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现算法对噪声高度敏感，易在真实数据中产生虚假因果推断，亟需一种鲁棒的因果发现方法。
AI.method: 观察到真实时间序列的频谱服从幂律分布（源于自组织行为），据此提取幂律谱特征来放大真实因果信号，构建鲁棒的因果发现方法。
AI.result: 在合成基准和已知因果结构的真实数据集上，该方法持续优于现有最先进方法，展现了鲁棒性和实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 基于幂律谱特征的因果发现方法能有效抑制噪声干扰，提升因果推断的可靠性。

title: PathWISE: Multi-Agent Cancer Pathway Triaging Ontology Learning from Clinical Flowcharts
summary: Clinical pathways are disseminated as visual flowcharts where spatial topology, arrow direction, colour coding, and font weight encode critical triage logic that remains inaccessible to computational systems. We present PathWISE, a five-phase pipeline combining four LLM-based agents with a deterministic depth-first search auditor and a Java compiler critic, transforming these non-computable artefacts into validated, executable HL7 Clinical Quality Language (CQL) libraries deployable as FHIR CDS Hooks services. Purpose-built agents extract flowchart structure into a typed directed graph, perform deterministic path enumeration, conduct a structured semantic audit of every node's computability, generate terminology-constrained CQL definitions verified by the official Java CQL-to-ELM compiler, and produce routing logic covering 100% of enumerated patient journeys. Demonstrated across five UK NHS cancer pathways (colorectal, lung, skin, upper GI, and breast), PathWISE audits up to 183 nodes (182 under the Hybrid configuration), identifies 544 structured governance findings across four issue categories, achieves 100% syntactic compilation success, with UNCOMPUTABLE nodes receiving false placeholders that preserve compilability while surfacing governance gaps for clinical review, and produces zero hallucinated terminology codes for dictionary-covered concepts. Critically, PathWISE confines non-deterministic LLM inference to knowledge extraction while deterministic graph mathematics and a standard compiler underpin every verification step.

AI.tldr: PathWISE是一个五阶段流水线，结合四个基于LLM的智能体、确定性深度优先搜索审计器和Java编译器批评器，将临床路径视觉流程图转化为可执行的HL7 CQL库。在五种NHS癌症路径上验证，实现100%编译成功，零幻觉术语代码。
AI.motivation: 临床路径以视觉流程图形式传播，其空间拓扑、箭头方向、颜色编码和字体粗细编码了关键的预检分诊逻辑，但这些信息对计算系统不可访问，导致非可计算的人工制品无法被自动化系统利用。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：(1) 基于LLM的智能体提取流程图结构为类型化有向图；(2) 确定性路径枚举；(3) 结构化语义审计每个节点的可计算性；(4) 生成经官方Java CQL-to-ELM编译器验证的术语约束CQL定义；(5) 生成覆盖100%枚举患者旅程的路由逻辑。非确定性LLM推理仅限于知识提取，确定性图数学和标准编译器支撑所有验证步骤。
AI.result: 在五种NHS癌症路径（结直肠、肺、皮肤、上消化道和乳腺）上验证：审计最多183个节点（混合配置下182个），识别544个结构化治理发现（分为四个问题类别），实现100%语法编译成功，不可计算节点使用假占位符保持可编译性并揭示治理缺口，零幻觉术语代码。
AI.conclusion: PathWISE成功将非计算性的视觉临床路径转化为可验证、可执行的CQL库，通过将LLM的非确定性限制在知识提取阶段，同时依靠确定性方法进行验证，确保了输出的可靠性和临床治理合规性。

title: Learning What Matters: Probabilistic Task Selection via Mutual Information for Model Finetuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete selection variants. Across multiple model families (LLaMA-7B, Qwen2-7B) and evaluation suites (BIG-Bench Hard), TaskPGM improves over standard mixing strategies and provides interpretable structure over task interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出TaskPGM框架，利用基于能量模型的任务关系图学习连续任务混合比例，在有限预算下平衡任务覆盖与冗余，提升大语言模型监督微调性能。
AI.motivation: 监督微调中训练预算在异构任务间的分配方式对性能影响很大，而现有固定启发式混合策略（如均匀采样或按规模比例采样）忽略了任务间的交互关系，导致负迁移和预算浪费。
AI.method: 将任务构建为马尔可夫随机场的节点，单点势捕获任务自身效用，成对势通过单任务微调模型的预测分布计算行为散度（如Jensen-Shannon散度、点互信息）编码任务间关系；优化该能量目标得到连续任务混合比例，并证明该集合函数在预算约束下是弱子模的，为离散选择变体提供近似保证。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-7B、Qwen2-7B等多个模型族和BIG-Bench Hard评估套件上，TaskPGM优于标准混合策略，并提供可解释的任务交互结构。
AI.conclusion: TaskPGM通过建模任务间关系来优化混合比例，能有效提升微调效果并提供可解释性，验证了考虑任务交互在预算分配中的重要性。

title: DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Co-speech gesture generation requires both semantic expressivity and biomechanically plausible rhythmic motion. Existing holistic gesture models mix lexically grounded semantic gestures with frequent prosody-aligned beat gestures. This limits semantic grounding, speech-motion alignment, and kinematic smoothness. We propose \emph{DuoGesture}, a neuro-inspired and biomechanically informed dual-stream approach that decomposes co-speech gesture synthesis into coupled semantic and beat streams. The two streams are coordinated by a \emph{Semantic Variational Information Bottleneck}, a stochastic frame-level gate that learns when semantic gestures should override rhythmic beat motion. The semantic stream is controlled by \emph{Motion-Grounded Semantic Conditioning}, which replaces purely linguistic word embeddings with motion-language representations to provide motion-aligned semantic priors for long-tailed lexical triggers of gestures. The beat stream is further regularised by an \emph{Inertial Beat Prior}, an anthropometry-weighted arm-chain module that reduces jitter and improves rhythmic consistency without constraining semantic frames. Objective evaluations and subjective experiments show that DuoGesture outperforms strong holistic baselines, while component ablations confirm the complementary roles of semantic grounding, stochastic stream selection, and biomechanical regularisation.

AI.tldr: 提出DuoGesture双流框架，将共语手势生成分解为语义流和节拍流，通过语义变分信息瓶颈协调、运动接地语义条件化和惯性节拍先验，在语义表达和节奏运动上超越整体式基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有整体式手势模型将基于词汇的语义手势与韵律对齐的节拍手势混合在一起，导致语义接地性差、语音-运动对齐不足以及运动平滑度欠佳，需要一种能兼顾语义表达性与生物力学合理性节奏运动的解耦方法。
AI.method: 提出DuoGesture神经启发双流方法：(1) 语义变分信息瓶颈作为随机帧级门控，学习何时语义手势应覆盖节奏节拍运动；(2) 运动接地语义条件化，用运动-语言表示替代纯语言词嵌入，为长尾词汇手势提供运动对齐的语义先验；(3) 惯性节拍先验，基于人体测量学加权的臂链模块，减少抖动并提升节奏一致性。
AI.result: 客观评估和主观实验均表明DuoGesture优于强基线整体式模型，消融实验证实了语义接地、随机流选择和生物力学正则化的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的语义-节拍双流架构能有效改善共语手势生成的语义表达和节奏运动质量，生物力学先验和随机门控机制是关键组件。

title: In-Training Defenses against Emergent Misalignment in Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning lets practitioners repurpose aligned large language models (LLMs) for new domains, yet recent work reveals emergent misalignment (EM): Even a small, domain-specific fine-tune can induce harmful behaviors far outside the target domain. Even in the case where model weights are hidden behind a fine-tuning API, this gives attackers inadvertent access to a broadly misaligned model in a way that can be hard to detect from the fine-tuning data alone. We present the first systematic study of in-training safeguards against EM that are practical for providers who expose fine-tuning via an API: We evaluate whether they a) prevent broad misalignment, b) allow narrow misalignment, c) learn well on benign tasks, and d) remain coherent. We investigate five training regularization interventions: (i) KL-divergence regularization toward a safe reference model, (ii) $\ell_2$ distance in feature space, (iii) preventive steering with an evil persona vector, (iv) interleaving training examples from a general instruct-tuning dataset and (v) inoculation prompting. We demonstrate that selecting interleaving data by the perplexity gap between aligned and misaligned models yields the best results overall.

AI.tldr: 针对微调引发的新兴错位问题，本文首次系统研究了对API微调提供商实用的训练中防护措施，评估五种正则化干预方法，发现基于困惑度差距选择交错数据效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 微调可使已对齐的LLM适用于新领域，但近期研究发现即使小规模领域微调也能引发目标域外的有害行为（新兴错位EM）。即便模型权重隐藏在API后，攻击者仍可通过微调无意中访问广泛错位的模型，且难以从微调数据中检测。因此需要实用的训练中防护措施。
AI.method: 研究五种训练正则化干预方法：(i)对安全参考模型的KL散度正则化；(ii)特征空间ℓ2距离；(iii)使用邪恶人格向量进行预防性引导；(iv)交错使用通用指令微调数据集；(v)接种提示。并基于对齐模型与错位模型之间的困惑度差距来选择交错数据。
AI.result: 基于困惑度差距选择交错数据的方法在整体上取得了最佳效果，平衡了防止广泛错位、允许窄域错位、良性任务学习能力和模型一致性。
AI.conclusion: 针对API微调场景下的新兴错位问题，基于困惑度差距的数据交错选择方法是最有效的训练中防护策略。

title: Once-For-All: A Train-Once and Select-Anytime Framework for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Mingkang Dong and Hongyi Cai contributed equally to this work. Muxin Pu is the corresponding author
summary: Multimodal instruction tuning is the de facto recipe for adapting vision language models (VLMs), yet instruction data are highly redundant, making data selection critical for training efficiency. Existing methods derive selection signals from a specific model or dataset, so whenever the target model or candidate pool changes, the criteria must be recomputed from scratch at substantial cost. To address this, we propose OFA, a data selection framework that trains a reusable selector once and applies it to any dataset or model without recomputation. OFA clusters multimodal instructions in a frozen CLIP space, derives pseudo labels from the cluster structure, and trains a lightweight selector for only a few epochs; samples on which this selector is least confident are selected as the most informative. Once trained, the frozen selector transfers directly across datasets and model scales. The selector is trained once on LLaVA-665K and applied both to LLaVA-665K itself and, without any retraining, to the unseen Vision-Flan-186K. Selecting only 15% of the data, OFA achieves 98.3% of full data performance across 10 downstream benchmarks; on the smaller Vision-Flan-186K, the transferred selector surpasses full data training by 10.6%, confirming that the learned signal generalizes to datasets never seen during selector training. The same selected subsets benefit VLMs at both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-v1.5-7B without per model recomputation, decoupling selection from the target model. These results demonstrate that a single, transferable selector provides an effective and reusable solution for efficient multimodal instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出OFA框架，通过一次训练可复用的数据选择器，无需重新计算即可跨数据集和模型规模高效选择多模态指令数据，仅用15%数据即可达到98.3%的完整数据性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法依赖特定模型或数据集，当目标模型或候选池变化时需要从头重新计算，计算成本高昂，缺乏可迁移性。
AI.method: 1) 在冻结的CLIP空间中对多模态指令进行聚类；2) 从聚类结构中推导伪标签；3) 训练轻量级选择器仅数个epoch；4) 选择器置信度最低的样本作为最有信息量的样本。训练一次后，冻结的选择器可直接跨数据集和模型规模迁移。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-665K上仅选15%数据，10个下游基准达98.3%全数据性能；迁移到未见过的Vision-Flan-186K上超越全数据训练10.6%；选择器可在Qwen2.5-VL-3B和LLaVA-v1.5-7B上无需重新计算直接使用。
AI.conclusion: 单次训练的可迁移选择器为高效多模态指令微调提供了有效且可复用的解决方案，实现了选择与目标模型的解耦。

title: Towards Label-Noise Resistant Learning via Optimal Brain Damage Masking
summary: Noisy labels are inevitable in real-world scenarios. Due to the strong capacity of deep neural networks to memorize corrupted labels, these noisy labels cause significant performance degradation. Existing noise-robust methods have mainly focused on robust loss functions and sample selection, with comparatively limited exploration of dynamic architectural adaptation. In this paper, we rethink the role of model connectivity in the presence of label noise. Intuitively, performance degradation caused by noisy labels stems from the backpropagation of noisy gradients. Since the final classifier layer acts as the primary gateway for this error propagation, directly discarding redundant connections within the classifier can structurally intercept noisy gradients at the root. Consequently, to identify these redundant connections, we leverage the seminal Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory from model compression, which posits that parameters causing negligible loss perturbation can be safely removed without impairing performance. Guided by this principle, we reveal that masking low-activation edges maintains the network's normal fitting capacity while effectively reducing the risk of backpropagating noisy gradients. To bridge this theoretical insight with practical training, we propose a novel Selective Edge Masking (SEM) mechanism for the widely-adopted fully connected (FC) layer to enhance model robustness against noisy labels. It can adaptively preserve only the most critical edges for information propagation while suppressing gradient errors caused by noisy labels. As a plug-and-play component, SEM can be seamlessly integrated into various noise-robust methods, including robust loss functions and sample selection. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our OBD-driven approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于最优脑损伤（OBD）理论的 Selective Edge Masking（SEM）机制，通过在全连接层中自适应屏蔽冗余连接来拦截噪声梯度传播，从而增强模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性，可作为即插即用模块集成到现有噪声鲁棒方法中。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声鲁棒方法主要聚焦于鲁棒损失函数和样本选择，对动态架构适应的探索有限。性能退化源于噪声梯度反向传播，而最终分类层是错误传播的主要入口，因此从结构层面直接拦截冗余连接中的噪声梯度是一个被忽视但有效的方向。
AI.method: 基于OBD理论（可安全移除对损失扰动可忽略的参数），提出Selective Edge Masking（SEM）机制：在全连接层中识别并屏蔽低激活值的边，保留最关键的信息传播边，同时抑制噪声梯度传播。SEM作为即插即用组件可集成到现有鲁棒损失函数和样本选择方法中。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上的大量评估表明，所提出的OBD驱动方法在对抗标签噪声方面持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的连接剪枝（而非传统损失函数或样本选择）可以从根源上拦截噪声梯度传播，OBD理论为噪声鲁棒训练提供了新的理论视角和实用工具。

title: SalsaAgent: A multimodal embodied language model for interactive dance generation
summary: Interaction between humanoids involves bidirectional and nonverbal reactivity, coordination and synchrony. Toward socially aware robots and interactive virtual agents, we present SalsaAgent, a language model that generates expressive, full-body salsa dance motions in reaction to a human leader and against a contextual music backdrop. We formulate interaction as nonverbal motion token passing, extending the vocabulary of a large language model (LLM) to process discrete motion tokens, pairwise relation tokens, and audio. Our contributions include new tokens for full-body and motion relations, LLM fine-tuning using automatically derived text descriptions of skeleton dynamics for token grounding, and a two-stage token-to-diffusion pipeline. Subjective and objective evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in terms of motion quality, music and partner coordination, and consistent two-person spatial behavior, with significant improvements over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SalsaAgent，一个通过扩展大语言模型词汇表以处理离散动作、配对关系及音频令牌，从而生成与人类领舞者及音乐背景相协调的全身萨尔萨舞动作的模型。
AI.motivation: 实现具有社交感知能力的机器人及交互式虚拟代理，能够与人进行双向、非言语的全身协调互动。
AI.method: 将交互形式化为非言语动作令牌传递，扩展LLM词汇表以处理离散动作令牌、配对关系令牌及音频；利用自动生成的骨架动力学文本描述对LLM进行微调以实现令牌接地；采用两阶段令牌到扩散的生成管道。
AI.result: 在动作质量、音乐与伙伴协调性、一致的双人空间行为方面显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SalsaAgent能有效生成与人类领舞者和音乐背景协调的全身萨尔萨舞动作，为主观和客观评估所证实。

title: Concept-SAE: A Controllable and Invertible Concept Interface for Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Accepted by ECML PKDD 2026, the project can be found at https://github.com/RafaDD/Concept-SAE
summary: Standard Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) excel at discovering a dictionary of a model's learned features, providing a powerful lens for passive feature discovery. However, this passive nature makes it difficult to systematically evaluate or analyze concepts that users explicitly care about. We introduce Concept-SAE, a framework that augments SAEs with a structured and controllable interface for probing user-defined concepts. Concept-SAE decomposes an activation subspace into two orthogonal components: Concept Tokens, which are aligned to externally specified semantics through dual supervision on both concept existence and spatial localization, and Free Tokens, which operate like standard SAEs to capture all remaining information. This hybrid disentanglement strategy ensures that Concept Tokens are faithful, spatially grounded, and cleanly separated from the residual subspace while preserving the ability of SAEs for open-ended concept discovery. We conduct extensive experiments demonstrating that Concept-SAE yields high-fidelity, well-localized, and strongly disentangled concept representations, outperforming alternatives in interface quality. Finally, we validate the utility of this conceptual interface through three diagnostic evaluations: a detection test on classifying adversarial image samples, a controllability test focusing on controlled counterfactual editing and a stability test using adversarial perturbations. Together, these results show that Concept-SAE equips SAEs with a reliable mechanism for evaluating, probing, and diagnosing user-defined concepts.

AI.tldr: Concept-SAE是一种增强稀疏自编码器的框架，通过将激活空间分解为概念令牌（受双重监督对齐用户定义语义）和自由令牌（保留标准SAE的开放特征发现能力），实现了对用户指定概念的结构化、可控探测与评估。
AI.motivation: 标准SAE虽然擅长被动发现模型学习到的特征字典，但难以系统性地评估或分析用户明确关心的概念，缺乏对指定概念的可控探测与评估机制。
AI.method: 将激活子空间分解为两个正交分量：概念令牌通过概念存在和空间定位的双重监督与外部指定语义对齐；自由令牌像标准SAE一样捕获所有剩余信息。这种混合解耦策略确保概念令牌的忠实性、空间基础性以及与残差子空间的干净分离。
AI.result: 实验表明Concept-SAE能够产生高保真、良好定位且强解耦的概念表示，在接口质量上优于替代方案。三项诊断评估（对抗样本检测、反事实编辑控制、对抗扰动稳定性）验证了该概念接口的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Concept-SAE为SAE配备了可靠机制，用于评估、探测和诊断用户定义的概念。

title: Clustering Guided Domain-Specific Pretrained Foundation Model for Very High-Resolution Arctic Remote Sensing
summary: This study introduces a novel Arctic-focused remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) by combining diversity-aware regional-scale image curation with masked autoencoder (MAE) self-supervised pretraining of a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder for very-high-spatial-resolution (VHSR) satellite image analysis. Spectral and acquisition-metadata descriptors were used in a scalable affinity-propagation clustering workflow to select approximately 3 million chips from 267 TB of Vantor VHSR imagery This curation strategy was designed to reduce oversampling of visually repetitive or low-information areas while preserving broad scene diversity across the study domain. We pretrained a ViT-Large encoder on the curated corpus using a domain-adapted MAE reconstruction objective, producing Arctic-specific transformer weights for downstream feature mapping. The pretrained encoder was integrated into an existing location-aware detection and segmentation framework and evaluated across four hand-labeled Arctic datasets. Compared to ImageNet-initialized ViT-Large baseline, Arctic MAE pretraining produced consistent improvements in foreground mean F1 scores of 0.87, 0.72, 0.93, and 0.87, for infrastructure, IWP, RTS, and TCNs, with approximately 5-8 percentage increase.
