Surprisingly, MIPO can also be useful in verifiable domains, such as math and multiple-choice question answering, yielding 1-20% gains *without any additional data or external supervision*. These results suggest a promising direction for self-improvement using intrinsic signals derived from contrastive data pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出MIPO方法，通过对比数据增强（正样本用正确提示，负样本用无关提示）构建偏好对，利用DPO优化互信息，在不依赖外部信号的情况下提升LLM在个性化和可验证任务上的表现（3-51%增益）。
AI.motivation: 后训练阶段依赖人工标注或外部验证器，已有数据已充分利用而新数据成本高，且真正的智能超越可验证任务，因此需要对外部信号依赖更少、适用范围更广的自我改进框架。
AI.method: 提出MIPO（互信息偏好优化）：通过对比数据增强构建偏好对——正样本基于正确提示生成，负样本基于随机无关提示生成；然后使用DPO学习该偏好数据，其目标等价于在基座LLM下最大化提示与响应的逐点互信息。
AI.result: 在1-7B参数规模的Llama和Qwen instruct模型上，MIPO在个性化任务中相比提示基线提升3-16%，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct提升51%；在数学和多项选择等可验证任务中，无需额外数据或外部监督即获得1-20%增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用对比数据对中内在信号的自我改进是一个有前景的方向，可减少对外部监督的依赖。

title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
summary: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling framework for learning world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods remain fragile, relying on complex multi-term losses, exponential moving averages, pre-trained encoders, or auxiliary supervision to avoid representation collapse. In this work, we introduce LeWorldModel (LeWM), the first JEPA that trains stably end-to-end from raw pixels using only two loss terms: a next-embedding prediction loss and a regularizer enforcing Gaussian-distributed latent embeddings. This reduces tunable loss hyperparameters from six to one compared to the only existing end-to-end alternative. With ~15M parameters trainable on a single GPU in a few hours, LeWM plans up to 48x faster than foundation-model-based world models while remaining competitive across diverse 2D and 3D control tasks. Beyond control, we show that LeWM's latent space encodes meaningful physical structure through probing of physical quantities. Surprise evaluation confirms that the model reliably detects physically implausible events.

AI.tldr: LeWM是首个仅用两项损失函数（下一嵌入预测损失+高斯分布正则化）即可端到端稳定训练的JEPA模型，参数量约15M，在单GPU上数小时可完成训练，规划速度比基于基础模型的世界模型快48倍，在2D/3D控制任务上表现有竞争力，且潜在空间能编码物理结构并检测物理不合理事件。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA方法脆弱，依赖复杂的多术语损失、指数移动平均、预训练编码器或辅助监督来避免表示坍塌，亟需一种更简洁、稳定、端到端可训练的世界模型框架。
AI.method: 提出LeWM，仅使用两项损失：下一嵌入预测损失和高斯分布潜在嵌入正则化器，将可调损失超参数从6个降至1个，实现从原始像素端到端稳定训练。
AI.result: 参数量约15M，单GPU数小时可训练完成；规划速度比基于基础模型的世界模型快48倍；在多种2D/3D控制任务上表现有竞争力；潜在空间通过物理量探测可编码有意义的结构；异常评估可可靠检测物理不合理事件。
AI.conclusion: LeWM证明了简洁的JEPA设计同样可以实现稳定高效的端到端世界模型学习，在效率、可扩展性和物理理解能力上具有优势。

title: From Causal Discovery to Dynamic Causal Inference in Neural Time Series
summary: Time-varying causal models provide a powerful framework for studying dynamic scientific systems, yet most existing approaches assume that the underlying causal network is known a priori - an assumption rarely satisfied in real-world domains where causal structure is uncertain, evolving, or only indirectly observable. This limits the applicability of dynamic causal inference in many scientific settings. We propose Dynamic Causal Network Autoregression (DCNAR), a two-stage neural causal modeling framework that integrates data-driven causal discovery with time-varying causal inference. In the first stage, a neural autoregressive causal discovery model learns a sparse directed causal network from multivariate time series. In the second stage, this learned structure is used as a structural prior for a time-varying neural network autoregression, enabling dynamic estimation of causal influence without requiring pre-specified network structure. We evaluate the scientific validity of DCNAR using behavioral diagnostics that assess causal necessity, temporal stability, and sensitivity to structural change, rather than predictive accuracy alone. Experiments on multi-country panel time-series data demonstrate that learned causal networks yield more stable and behaviorally meaningful dynamic causal inferences than coefficient-based or structure-free alternatives, even when forecasting performance is comparable. These results position DCNAR as a general framework for using AI as a scientific instrument for dynamic causal reasoning under structural uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态因果网络自回归（DCNAR），一种两阶段神经因果建模框架，先在多变量时间序列上学习稀疏有向因果网络，再将其作为结构先验进行时变因果推断，避免了预设网络结构的限制。
AI.motivation: 现有动态因果模型大多假设因果网络已知，但现实中因果结构往往不确定、随时间演变或仅能被间接观测，这限制了动态因果推断在科学领域的应用。
AI.method: DCNAR 包含两个阶段：第一阶段使用神经自回归因果发现模型从多变量时间序列中学习稀疏有向因果网络；第二阶段将学习到的因果结构作为先验，用于时变神经网络自回归，实现无需预设网络结构的动态因果影响估计。
AI.result: 在多国面板时间序列数据上的实验表明，与基于系数或无结构替代方法相比，学习到的因果网络能产生更稳定和更具行为意义的动态因果推断，即使在预测性能相当的情况下也是如此。
AI.conclusion: DCNAR 可作为在结构不确定性下进行动态因果推理的通用框架，将 AI 用作科学工具。

title: Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold
summary: Neural collapse (NC) -- the convergence of penultimate-layer features to a simplex equiangular tight frame -- is well understood at equilibrium, but the dynamics governing its onset remain poorly characterised. We identify a simple and predictive regularity: NC occurs when the mean feature norm reaches a model-dataset-specific critical value, fn*, that is largely invariant to training conditions. This value concentrates tightly within each (model, dataset) pair (CV < 8%); training dynamics primarily affect the rate at which fn approaches fn*, rather than the value itself. In standard training trajectories, the crossing of fn below fn* consistently precedes NC onset, providing a practical predictor with a mean lead time of 62 epochs (MAE 24 epochs). A direct intervention experiment confirms fn* is a stable attractor of the gradient flow -- perturbations to feature scale are self-corrected during training, with convergence to the same value regardless of direction (p>0.2). Completing the (architecture)x(dataset) grid reveals the paper's strongest result: ResNet-20 on MNIST gives fn* = 5.867 -- a +458% architecture effect versus only +68% on CIFAR-10. The grid is strongly non-additive; fn* cannot be decomposed into independent architecture and dataset contributions. Four structural regularities emerge: (1) depth has a non-monotonic effect on collapse speed; (2) activation jointly determines both collapse speed and fn*; (3) weight decay defines a three-regime phase diagram -- too little slows, an optimal range is fastest, and too much prevents collapse; (4) width monotonically accelerates collapse while shifting fn* by at most 13%. These results establish feature-norm dynamics as an actionable diagnostic for predicting NC timing, suggesting that norm-threshold behaviour is a general mechanism underlying delayed representational reorganisation in deep networks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现神经塌缩（NC）发生在特征均值范数达到一个模型-数据集特异性的临界值 fn* 时，该值在不同训练条件下高度稳定。训练动力学主要影响 fn 接近 fn* 的速度而非该值本身。通过完整网格实验揭示了架构与数据集的强非加性效应，并总结了四个结构规律。
AI.motivation: 神经塌缩在平衡态已得到充分理解，但其发生动力学机制尚不清晰，缺乏可预测的规律性。
AI.method: 通过实证分析特征均值范数与NC onset的关系，识别出临界值 fn*；进行扰动实验验证其作为梯度流吸引子的稳定性；完成(架构)×(数据集)完整网格实验揭示非加性效应。
AI.result: NC发生在特征均值范数低于临界值 fn* 时，平均提前62个epoch可预测；fn*在模型-数据集对内变异系数<8%；网格实验显示强非加性，ResNet-20在MNIST上fn*=5.867，架构效应达+458%而CIFAR-10仅+68%；发现四个结构规律。
AI.conclusion: 特征范数动力学可作为预测NC时序的实用诊断工具，范数阈值行为是深度网络中延迟表征重组的一般机制。

title: PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction
summary: Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce \textbf{PI-JEPA} (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains \emph{without any completed PDE solves}, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves $1.9\times$ lower error than FNO and $2.4\times$ lower error than DeepONet at $N_\ell{=}100$, with 24\% improvement over supervised-only training at $N_\ell{=}500$, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出PI-JEPA框架，利用无标签参数场进行掩码潜在预测和PDE残差正则化预训练，无需完整模拟轨迹，结合Lie-Trotter算子分裂对齐的预测器模块，仅需少量标记数据即可微调，显著降低多物理场代理模型部署所需的模拟预算。
AI.motivation: 解决储层模拟中数据不对称问题：输入参数场可任意生成，但现有神经算子代理需要大量昂贵的有标签模拟轨迹，无法利用丰富的无标签结构数据。
AI.method: PI-JEPA：无需完整PDE求解的无监督预训练框架，在无标签参数场上进行掩码潜在预测，施加每个子算子的PDE残差正则化；预测器库与Lie-Trotter算子分裂分解结构对齐，为每个子过程（压力、饱和度输运、反应）分配独立的物理约束潜在模块。
AI.result: 在单相达西流中，Nℓ=100时误差比FNO低1.9倍、比DeepONet低2.4倍；Nℓ=500时比纯监督训练提升24%。
AI.conclusion: 无标签代理预训练可大幅减少多物理场代理部署所需的模拟预算，验证了利用无标签参数场进行物理约束预训练的有效性。

title: CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe
summary: High-performance GPU kernels are critical to modern machine learning systems, yet developing them remains a manual, expert-driven process. Recent work has explored using LLMs to automate kernel generation, but generated kernels still fall short of carefully tuned references on standardized benchmarks. We present CuTeGen, an agentic GPU kernel synthesis framework that treats kernel development as a structured generate-test-refine workflow over the CuTe abstraction layer. Two design choices distinguish CuTeGen from prior work: targeting CuTe rather than raw CUDA, which exposes performance-critical structures such as tiling and data movement while remaining stable enough for iterative refinement, and a delayed profiling schedule that withholds low-level performance feedback until the kernel's high-level structure has stabilized. On the 209 tasks of KernelBench Level-1 and Level-2, CuTeGen achieves an average speedup of 1.71$\times$ over PyTorch and outperforms the prior agentic baseline CudaForge (0.89$\times$) at comparable per-task generation cost. Code available at https://github.com/taratt/cutegen.git

AI.tldr: CuTeGen是一个基于CuTe抽象层的智能体GPU内核合成框架，采用结构化生成-测试-精炼流程，在KernelBench的209个任务上平均比PyTorch快1.71倍，优于此前基线CudaForge（0.89倍）。
AI.motivation: 高性能GPU内核对现代机器学习系统至关重要，但开发过程仍依赖手动专家驱动。现有LLM自动生成内核的工作在标准化基准上仍落后于精心调优的参考实现。
AI.method: CuTeGen采用（1）基于CuTe抽象层而非原始CUDA的目标选择，暴露平铺、数据移动等性能关键结构；（2）延迟性能分析调度策略，在内核高层结构稳定后再提供底层性能反馈；（3）结构化的生成-测试-精炼智能体工作流。
AI.result: 在KernelBench Level-1和Level-2的209个任务上，平均加速比达到PyTorch的1.71倍，优于CudaForge的0.89倍，且单任务生成成本相当。
AI.conclusion: CuTeGen通过选择更合适的抽象层（CuTe）和设计延迟性能分析策略，在自动GPU内核生成任务上取得了显著优于此前方法的性能，证明了结构化工作流与适当抽象层结合的有效性。

title: Algebraic Diversity: Group-Theoretic Spectral Estimation from Single Observations
comment: 41 pages, 14 figures. v3: Retracted six quantitative findings in Section 11, transformer application, due to implementation error in spectral concentration metric. Corrected results deferred to separate publication. Remark added after Conjecture 23 on orbit-structure bias in psi criterion. All other sections unaffected v4: new result on blind group matching; v5: corrected/updated metrics
summary: We establish that temporal averaging over multiple observations is the degenerate case of algebraic group action with the trivial group $G=\{e\}$. A General Replacement Theorem proves that a group-averaged estimator from one snapshot achieves equivalent subspace decomposition to multi-snapshot covariance estimation. The Trivial Group Embedding Theorem proves that the sample covariance is the accumulation of trivial-group estimates, with variance governed by a $(G,L)$ continuum as $1/(|G|\cdot L)$. The processing gain $10\log_{10}(M)$ dB equals the classical beamforming gain, establishing that this gain is a property of group order, not sensor count. The DFT, DCT, and KLT are unified as group-matched special cases. We conjecture a General Algebraic Averaging Theorem extending these results to arbitrary statistics, with variance governed by the effective group order $d_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Monte Carlo experiments on the first four sample moments across five group types confirm the conjecture to four-digit precision. The framework exploits the $structure$ of information (representation-theoretic symmetry of the data object) rather than the content, complementing Shannon's theory. Five applications are demonstrated: single-snapshot MUSIC, massive MIMO, single-pulse waveform classification, graph signal processing, and analysis of transformer LLMs. Techniques for blind group matching are described.

AI.tldr: 本文证明时间平均是多观测退化为平凡群作用的特例，提出群平均估计器可在单快照下实现多快照协方差估计的等效子空间分解。将DFT、DCT、KLT统一为群匹配特例，并通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了广义代数平均定理的猜想。处理增益10log₁₀(M) dB等于经典波束形成增益，证明该增益是群阶属性而非传感器数量属性。
AI.motivation: 传统信号处理中，时间/空间平均（多快照）与群论方法（单快照）之间的数学联系未被揭示；波束形成增益的根源（传感器数 vs 群阶）存在混淆；DFT/DCT/KLT等变换缺乏统一代数框架。
AI.method: ① 建立群平均估计器与多快照协方差估计的等价性（General Replacement Theorem）；② 证明样本协方差是平凡群估计的累积（Trivial Group Embedding Theorem）；③ 引入(G,L)连续统描述方差；④ 通过五种群类型、前四阶样本矩的蒙特卡洛实验验证猜想。
AI.result: 群平均估计器在单快照下实现与多快照协方差估计等效的子空间分解；处理增益10log₁₀(M) dB被证明是群阶M的函数而非传感器数；DFT/DCT/KLT统一为群匹配特例；蒙特卡洛实验以四位精度验证猜想；在单快照MUSIC、大规模MIMO、单脉冲波形分类、图信号处理、Transformer LLM分析中展示了应用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过利用数据的表示论对称性（信息结构）而非信息内容，补充了香农信息论，为信号处理提供了一种基于群论的统一代数视角。

title: Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network for High-Dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii Equations on Unbounded Domains
summary: This paper introduces the Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network (SD-FSNN), a novel computational framework for solving high-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation (GPE) on unbounded domain. The proposed method circumvents the curse-of-dimensionality that plagues traditional discretizations and the computational bottlenecks of gradient-based neural network solvers through a synergistic combination of techniques. First, a prescribed Gaussian envelope encodes the far-field decay of the wavefunction, enabling a space-time separation where the spatial approximation is handled by a frozen, single-hidden-layer neural network with data-driven sampled features. This yields a gradient-free formalism where spatial derivatives are analytically precomputed and time-dependence is evolved via reduced ODEs. Second, a stochastic-dimension sampler provides a conditionally unbiased estimate of the spatial operator by evaluating only a small subset of spatial dimensions at each time step, essentially reducing computational and memory costs. Discrete conservation laws are also enforced, ensuring long-term stability. Extensive numerical experiments on GPE in up to 1000 dimensions demonstrate that SD-FSNN achieves significantly higher accuracy and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods, including PINNs, randomized feature methods, and tensor-network approaches. The results confirm that SD-FSNN effectively mitigates the Kolmogorov $n$-width barrier for frozen-basis models on structured solution manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机维度冻结采样神经网络（SD-FSNN），通过高斯包络、冻结单隐层神经网络、随机维度采样和离散守恒律的协同组合，高效求解高达1000维的Gross-Pitaevskii方程，在精度和效率上显著优于PINNs、随机特征方法和张量网络方法。
AI.motivation: 传统离散化方法在高维问题中受困于维度灾难，而基于梯度的神经网络求解器存在计算瓶颈。本文旨在开发一种既能规避维度诅咒、又能避免梯度计算瓶颈的框架，用于求解无界域上的高维Gross-Pitaevskii方程。
AI.method: (1) 采用预定义高斯包络编码波函数的远场衰减，实现时空分离；(2) 空间逼近由冻结的单隐层神经网络处理，使用数据驱动采样特征，通过解析预计算空间导数，时间演化由降阶ODE控制，形成无梯度形式；(3) 随机维度采样器在每时间步仅评估少量空间维度，提供空间算子的条件无偏估计，大幅降低计算和内存成本；(4) 强制执行离散守恒律以确保长期稳定性。
AI.result: 在高达1000维的GPE数值实验中，SD-FSNN在精度和效率上均显著优于PINNs、随机特征方法和张量网络方法。结果证实该方法在结构化解流形上有效缓解了冻结基模型的Kolmogorov n-width障碍。
AI.conclusion: SD-FSNN通过巧妙组合高斯包络、冻结网络、随机维度采样和守恒律约束，在高维GPE求解中同时克服了维度灾难和梯度计算瓶颈，为高维非线性偏微分方程的高效求解提供了新范式。

title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling
summary: Recent advances in recommendation scaling laws have led to foundation models of unprecedented complexity. While these models offer superior performance, their computational demands make real-time serving impractical, often forcing practitioners to rely on knowledge distillation-compromising serving quality for efficiency. To address this challenge, we present SOLARIS (Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling), a novel framework inspired by speculative decoding. SOLARIS proactively precomputes user-item interaction embeddings by predicting which user-item pairs are likely to appear in future requests, and asynchronously generating their foundation model representations ahead of time. This approach decouples the costly foundation model inference from the latency-critical serving path, enabling real-time knowledge transfer from models previously considered too expensive for online use. Deployed across Meta's advertising system serving billions of daily requests, SOLARIS achieves 0.67% revenue-driving top-line metrics gain, demonstrating its effectiveness at scale.

AI.tldr: SOLARIS提出了一种基于预计算用户-物品交互嵌入的投机性卸载框架，通过异步生成基础模型表征，将高成本推理与延迟关键的服务路径解耦，实现实时知识蒸馏。在Meta广告系统中部署后，关键业务指标提升0.67%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐基础模型计算成本极高，实时服务难以承受，而知识蒸馏虽可降低计算开销但会牺牲服务质量。需要一种既能利用大模型能力又不牺牲在线推理延迟的方法。
AI.method: 受到投机解码启发，SOLARIS通过预测未来请求中可能出现的用户-物品对，提前异步计算其基础模型表征，将昂贵的大模型推理从延迟关键的服务路径中解耦出来，从而实现实时的大模型知识迁移。
AI.result: 在Meta每日服务数十亿请求的广告系统中部署，SOLARIS实现了0.67%的营收驱动关键指标提升。
AI.conclusion: SOLARIS通过投机性预计算策略，成功将原本被认为在线使用过于昂贵的基础模型应用于实时推荐场景，在工业级规模系统中验证了其有效性。

title: The Topological Trouble With Transformers
summary: Transformers encode structure in sequences via an expanding contextual history. However, their purely feedforward architecture fundamentally limits dynamic state tracking. State tracking -- the iterative updating of latent variables reflecting an evolving environment -- involves inherently sequential dependencies that feedforward networks struggle to maintain. Consequently, feedforward models push evolving state representations deeper into their layer stack with each new input step, rendering information inaccessible in shallow layers and ultimately exhausting the model's depth. While this depth limit can be bypassed by dynamic depth models and by explicit or latent thinking that externalizes state representations, these solutions are computationally and memory inefficient. In this article, we argue that temporally extended cognition requires refocusing from explicit thought traces to implicit activation dynamics via recurrent architectures. We introduce a taxonomy of recurrent and continuous-thought transformer architectures, categorizing them by their recurrence axis (depth versus step) and their ratio of input tokens to recurrence steps. Finally, we outline promising research directions, including enhanced state-space models and coarse-grained recurrence, to better integrate state tracking into modern foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Transformer的纯前馈架构在动态状态跟踪方面存在根本性局限，提出应转向循环架构以实现隐式激活动力学，并给出了循环与连续思维Transformer架构的分类体系及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: Transformer的前馈架构在动态状态跟踪（即根据不断变化的环境迭代更新潜在变量）方面存在根本性局限：前馈网络将状态表示逐层推入更深层，导致浅层信息不可访问，最终耗尽模型深度。现有解决方案（动态深度模型、显式/潜在思维）虽可绕过深度限制，但计算和内存效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了一种循环与连续思维Transformer架构的分类法，根据循环轴（深度轴 vs 时间步轴）以及输入令牌与循环步的比率对现有架构进行归类。
AI.result: 明确了前馈Transformer在状态跟踪上的深度限制，并给出了循环架构的分类视角（深度循环/时间步循环），指出不同架构在状态跟踪能力上的差异。
AI.conclusion: 主张时间扩展认知应从显式思维轨迹转向通过循环架构实现隐式激活动力学，并指出增强状态空间模型和粗粒度循环是未来将状态跟踪更好地整合进基础模型的有前景方向。

title: Adaptive Head Budgeting for Efficient Multi-Head Attention
summary: Multi-head attention enables Transformers to capture diverse representations, but all attention heads are typically activated for every input, regardless of task complexity. For coarse-grained tasks such as text classification, where relevant information is often global, this fixed allocation can introduce unnecessary computation. We propose BudgetFormer, a Transformer architecture that dynamically allocates attention heads on a per-input basis. The model learns both a head budget and a relevance distribution to select the most informative heads. To support effective head selection, we introduce a training strategy that balances exploration and exploitation. Experiments on text classification tasks show that BudgetFormer reduces FLOPs and memory usage while matching or surpassing the performance of standard multi-head attention. These results highlight adaptive head allocation as an effective approach to improving Transformer efficiency and performance.

AI.tldr: BudgetFormer提出了一种动态分配注意力头数的Transformer架构，根据输入复杂度自适应选择最相关的注意力头，在文本分类任务中减少计算量和内存使用，同时保持或提升性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer中所有注意力头对每个输入都激活，导致粗粒度任务（如文本分类）中存在不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出BudgetFormer，学习每个输入的头预算（head budget）和相关性分布（relevance distribution）来选择信息最丰富的注意力头；并引入平衡探索与利用的训练策略。
AI.result: 在文本分类任务中，BudgetFormer降低了FLOPs和内存使用，同时匹配或超越了标准多头注意力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应头分配是提升Transformer效率和性能的有效方法。

title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs
summary:
NVIDIA's CUDA Tile (CuTile) introduces a Python-based, tile-centric abstraction for GPU kernel development that aims to simplify programming while retaining Tensor Core and Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) efficiency on modern GPUs. We present the first independent, cross-architecture evaluation of CuTile against established approaches such as cuBLAS, Triton, WMMA, and raw SIMT on three NVIDIA GPUs spanning Hopper and Blackwell: H100 NVL, B200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition. We benchmark representative AI workloads, including GEMM, fused multi-head attention, and end-to-end LLM inference in BF16/FP16 precision, to assess both performance and portability.
  Our results show that CuTile effectiveness is strongly workload- and architecture-dependent. On datacenter-class Blackwell (B200), CuTile achieves up to 1007 TFLOP/s for fused attention, outperforming FlashAttention-2 by 2.5x while requiring only 60 lines of Python kernel code. For GEMM, CuTile reaches 52-79% of cuBLAS performance in 22 lines of code (versus 123 for WMMA), making it a practical replacement for hand-written CUDA kernels but not yet for vendor-optimized libraries. However, the same CuTile attention kernel achieves only 53% of FlashAttention-2 throughput on RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120), exposing significant cross-architecture optimization gaps. In contrast, Triton sustains 62-101% of cuBLAS performance across all tested platforms without architecture-specific tuning, demonstrating substantially stronger portability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次独立评估了NVIDIA的CuTile编程抽象在多种GPU架构（H100、B200、RTX PRO 6000）上的性能表现，涵盖GEMM、融合注意力及LLM推理等AI负载。结果表明CuTile在Blackwell B200上融合注意力达1007 TFLOP/s，性能为FlashAttention-2的2.5倍，但跨架构移植性较差；Triton则在不同架构间保持稳定的高性能移植性。
AI.motivation: 评估CuTile这一新型Python磁贴级GPU编程抽象在实际多架构环境中的性能表现和可移植性，填补其独立跨架构评测的空白，为开发者选择GPU编程方案提供参考。
AI.method: 在Hopper和Blackwell架构的三款GPU（H100 NVL、B200、RTX PRO 6000）上，将CuTile与cuBLAS、Triton、WMMA及原始SIMT进行对比，使用BF16/FP16精度的GEMM、融合多头注意力和端到端LLM推理作为基准负载进行性能评估。
AI.result: CuTile在B200上融合注意力达1007 TFLOP/s，是FlashAttention-2的2.5倍，仅需60行Python代码；GEMM达cuBLAS的52-79%，仅需22行代码。但在RTX PRO 6000上仅达FlashAttention-2的53%。Triton在所有平台保持62-101%的cuBLAS性能，移植性显著更强。
AI.conclusion: CuTile在特定架构上表现优异且代码简洁，是手写CUDA内核的实用替代方案，但跨架构移植性不足；Triton以牺牲极致的峰值性能为代价，提供了更强的跨平台可移植性。

title: Electricity price forecasting across Norway's five bidding zones in the post-crisis era
comment: This version removes variables unavailable at prediction time to eliminate look-ahead leakage, clarifies the forecasting task definition, and updates the results and discussion accordingly. All tables and figures have been recomputed
summary: Norway's electricity market is heavily dominated by hydropower, but the 2021-2022 energy crisis and stronger integration with Continental Europe have fundamentally altered price formation, reducing the reliability of forecasting models calibrated on historical data. Despite the critical need for updated models, a unified benchmark evaluating feature contributions across all structurally diverse Norwegian bidding zones remains lacking. Here we present a comprehensive evaluation of one-step-ahead forecasting of the Nord Pool market across all five Norwegian bidding zones. We constructed a multimodal hourly dataset spanning 2019-2025 and evaluated eight forecasting model families, including Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), autoregressive models with exogenous variables, and advanced deep learning architectures, using a strictly causal test set. We implemented robust rolling-origin backtesting, leave-one-group-out feature ablation, and conditional regime analysis to dissect model performance and feature utility. Our results show that LightGBM achieves the best performance in every zone, with mean absolute error ranging from 1.60 to 5.58 euros per megawatt-hour, while a ridge-regularized autoregressive model with exogenous variables remains a highly competitive linear benchmark in northern zones. Feature ablation reveals that models relying solely on lagged prices and calendar variables achieve high accuracy and often match or closely approach the performance of the full multimodal model. However, conditional regime analysis demonstrates that external features like reservoir levels and gas prices remain crucial to stratify forecast errors, which consistently increase under stressed market regimes. This highlights the practical value of model interpretability and regime awareness for decision makers facing structural changes in market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文对挪威五个竞标区的Nord Pool日前电价进行了一步预测综合评估，使用2019-2025年多模态小时级数据集，测试了八种预测模型家族。结果表明LightGBM在所有区域表现最佳（MAE 1.60–5.58欧元/MWh），仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的模型即可达到接近全模态模型的精度，但外部特征（如水库水位、天然气价格）在压力市场状态下对误差分层至关重要。
AI.motivation: 2021-2022年能源危机及与欧洲大陆的强化整合从根本上改变了挪威水电主导市场的价格形成机制，基于历史数据校准的预测模型可靠性下降，而目前缺乏一个统一的基准来评估所有结构各异的挪威竞标区中的特征贡献。
AI.method: 构建2019-2025年多模态小时级数据集，评估八种预测模型家族（包括LightGBM、带外生变量的自回归模型和先进深度学习架构），采用严格因果测试集、稳健滚动原点回测、留一组特征消融和条件机制分析。
AI.result: LightGBM在所有区域表现最优（MAE 1.60–5.58欧元/MWh）；Ridge正则化自回归模型在北部区域是具有竞争力的线性基准；仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的模型可接近全模态模型精度；外部特征在压力市场状态下对误差分层至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 模型可解释性和机制感知对于面临市场结构性变化的决策者具有实际价值，强调了在电力市场预测中结合特征贡献分析和市场状态识别的重要性。

title: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation
summary: What does it mean to understand the world? Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space. Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired. Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations. We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learning-to-Theorize学习范式及其实例化模型NEO，通过从原始非文本观测中推断可执行的显式解释性理论（程序化语言），实现基于解释的泛化，模拟人类认知中的理论构建过程。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型将"理解"操作化为准确预测，但发展认知科学表明人类理解源于构建内部理论。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，提出一种从原始观测中学习显式解释性理论的学习范式。
AI.method: 提出Learning-to-Theorize范式，实例化为神经理论家（NEO）模型。NEO是一种概率神经模型，将理论表示为可执行的组合性程序，通过学习到的思维语言（Language of Thought）基元，并通过共享的转移模型执行这些程序。
AI.result: 实验表明，该公式能够实现基于解释的泛化，使观测能够被理解为生成它们的程序。
AI.conclusion: 从原始观测中诱导显式理论是可行的，且能够实现超越单纯预测的解释驱动泛化，更接近人类认知中的理解方式。

title: Query-efficient model evaluation using cached responses
summary: Evaluating a new model on an existing benchmark is often necessary to understand its behavior before deployment. For modern evaluation frameworks, generating and evaluating a response for all queries can be prohibitively expensive. In practice, responses from previously-evaluated models are often cached -- creating a potential opportunity to use this additional information to decrease the number of queries required to accurately evaluate a new model. In this paper, we introduce an approach for predicting benchmark performance that leverages cached model responses based on the Data Kernel Perspective Space (DKPS), a method for quantifying the relationship between models in the black-box setting. Theoretically, we show that DKPS-based methods are query-efficient under certain conditions. Empirically, we demonstrate that DKPS-based methods achieve the same mean absolute error as baselines with a substantially decreased query budget. We conclude by proposing an offline method for selecting a set of queries that maximizes the goodness-of-fit on reference models, improving prediction accuracy over random query selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）的方法，利用缓存的模型响应来预测新模型在基准测试上的性能，从而大幅减少评估所需的查询次数。
AI.motivation: 在现代评估框架中，对每个查询都生成并评估响应成本过高。由于已有模型的响应通常被缓存，可以利用这些额外信息来减少评估新模型所需的查询数量。
AI.method: 提出DKPS（Data Kernel Perspective Space）方法，在黑盒设置下量化模型间关系，基于缓存的模型响应预测新模型性能。同时提出离线查询选择方法，基于参考模型拟合优度选择最优查询子集。
AI.result: 理论上证明了DKPS方法在特定条件下具有查询效率；实验上表明DKPS方法在显著降低查询预算的情况下，能达到与基线方法相同的平均绝对误差。
AI.conclusion: DKPS方法能有效利用缓存响应减少评估新模型的查询成本，且离线查询选择策略能进一步提升预测精度。

title: SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlearning method built on a key insight: not all tokens within a forget set instance carry memorized information equally. High-information tokens concentrate the model's memorized knowledge, while low-information tokens reflect general language competence. SHRED operates in two stages. (1) Selection: We perform a forward pass on a forget set instance, collect per-token autoregressive probabilities, and select the bottom (lowest probability, highest Shannon information) as forget positions; the remaining positions are retained as benign anchors. (2) Training: We construct modified KL targets that demote the memorized token's logit at forget positions while preserving the original distribution at benign positions. The model is then trained via a single top KL self-distillation objective that simultaneously drives forgetting and utility preservation. We evaluate SHRED across four standard unlearning benchmarks and demonstrate that it establishes a new Pareto-optimal trade-off between forget efficacy and model utility, outperforming retain-set-dependent methods. Our analysis shows that SHRED is robust against relearning attacks and membership-inference attacks, and it maintains stable utility even after many sequential unlearning runs.

AI.tldr: SHRED提出了一种无需保留集的大语言模型机器遗忘方法，通过识别遗忘样本中携带记忆信息的高信息量token（低概率token）进行选择性遗忘，同时保留低信息量token以维持模型通用能力，实现了遗忘效果与模型效用之间的帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘方法大多依赖保留集（retain set）来防止模型效用灾难性下降，这增加了数据依赖和部署复杂度。作者希望设计一种无需保留集的遗忘方法，同时避免对模型通用能力的破坏。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：(1) 选择阶段：对遗忘样本进行前向传播，收集每个token的自回归概率，选择概率最低（即香农信息量最高）的token作为遗忘位置，其余位置作为良性锚点；(2) 训练阶段：构建修改后的KL目标，在遗忘位置降低记忆token的logit，在良性位置保持原始分布，通过单一top KL自蒸馏目标同时实现遗忘和效用保持。
AI.result: 在四个标准遗忘基准上，SHRED建立了新的帕累托最优权衡，超越了依赖保留集的方法。该方法对重学习攻击和成员推理攻击具有鲁棒性，即使在多次连续遗忘后仍能保持稳定的模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别遗忘样本中高信息量token并仅对其进行针对性遗忘，可以在不依赖保留集的情况下实现有效的机器遗忘，同时保持模型的通用能力。

title: Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, but existing finite-support or quantile-based methods rely on projections, while recent flow-based approaches can suffer from \emph{boundary mismatch} at the flow source or from \emph{high-variance} bootstrapping when current and successor noises are independent. We propose Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time DRL method that learns return distributions with flow matching using \textbf{source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths}: the current path starts from the required base prior at $t{=}0$, reaches the Bellman target at $t{=}1$, and maintains a pathwise affine relation to the successor flow at intermediate times (without requiring time-$t$ marginals to satisfy a distributional Bellman fixed point for all $t$). PCBF couples current and successor return flows through shared base noise and uses a $λ$-parameterized control-variate target: $λ{=}0$ recovers an unbiased sample Bellman target, while $λ{>}0$ trades controlled bias for variance reduction. Experiments on analytically tractable MRPs, OGBench, and D4RL show improved distributional fidelity and training stability, and competitive offline RL performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF)，一种通过源一致Bellman耦合路径和共享基噪声的连续时间分布强化学习方法，有效解决了边界不匹配和高方差自举问题。
AI.motivation: 现有分布强化学习方法存在局限：有限支撑或分位数方法依赖投影，流式方法存在源端边界不匹配问题，且当前噪声与后继噪声独立时自举方差高。
AI.method: PCBF采用源一致Bellman耦合路径：当前路径从t=0的先验分布出发，在t=1到达Bellman目标，中间时刻与后继流保持仿射关系（不要求所有t满足分布Bellman不动点）。通过共享基噪声耦合当前与后继回报流，并使用λ参数化控制变量目标（λ=0无偏，λ>0以可控偏差换取方差降低）。
AI.result: 在解析MRP、OGBench和D4RL上的实验表明，PCBF在分布保真度和训练稳定性上均有提升，离线RL性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PCBF通过路径耦合和共享噪声机制，在连续时间DRL框架下实现了更稳定的训练和更准确的分布学习。

title: When Attention Beats Fourier: Multi-Scale Transformers for PDE Solving on Irregular Domains
summary: We study the problem of \emph{architecture selection} for deep learning models trained to solve partial differential equations (PDEs), asking when transformer-based architectures with learned attention outperform Fourier-domain neural operators. We introduce the \textbf{Multi-Scale Attention Transformer} (\msat{}), a deep learning architecture that encodes spatiotemporal solution histories as token sequences and trains end-to-end via a composite supervised objective with optional physics-informed regularization terms. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation against nine baselines -- including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators (FNO, DeepONet, GNOT), and state-space models (Mamba-NO) -- across five benchmark problems from the PINNacle suite, using identical train/test splits and reference data for all methods. \msat{} achieves state-of-the-art generalization on complex geometry problems ($L^2_\mathrm{rel} = 0.0101$ on Heat2D-CG, a $3.7\times$ improvement over FNO) at $34\,\mathrm{s}$ total inference vs.\ $120{,}812\,\mathrm{s}$ for Mamba-NO. Ablation studies over the physics regularization component reveal a precise inductive bias tradeoff: physics priors reduce test error on diffusion-dominated problems but degrade generalization on chaotic and recirculating-flow regimes, directly characterizing the prior misspecification boundary. Approximation error bounds as a function of domain boundary complexity $κ$ provide a theoretical basis for these empirical findings and a principled rule for architecture selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多尺度注意力Transformer（MSAT）用于求解偏微分方程，在复杂几何问题上相比FNO实现3.7倍精度提升（L²_rel=0.0101），推理速度比Mamba-NO快约3553倍，并通过理论分析和消融实验揭示了物理先验在扩散主导与混沌对流问题之间的精确偏差权衡，为深度学习求解PDE的架构选择提供了理论指导原则。
AI.motivation: 解决深度学习模型求解偏微分方程时的架构选择问题，特别是探究基于Transformer的架构（带学习注意力）何时优于傅里叶域神经算子（如FNO），并量化物理先验正则化在不同类型PDE问题中的适用边界。
AI.method: 提出MSAT架构：将时空解历史编码为token序列，通过复合监督目标（可选物理信息正则化项）进行端到端训练。在五个PINNacle基准问题上，与九种基线方法（PINNs、FNO、DeepONet、GNOT、Mamba-NO等）进行同等条件下的对比评估，并进行了物理正则化消融实验和域边界复杂度κ的近似误差界理论分析。
AI.result: MSAT在复杂几何Heat2D-CG上L²_rel=0.0101（比FNO提升3.7倍），总推理时间34秒（Mamba-NO需120,812秒）。物理先验在扩散主导问题降低测试误差，但在混沌和回流问题中损害泛化性能。近似误差界受域边界复杂度κ影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于注意力机制的Transformer架构在复杂几何PDE问题上具有显著优势；物理先验正则化存在精确的偏差权衡边界，需要根据问题类型（扩散主导vs.混沌/回流）进行架构选择；理论误差界为架构选择提供了原则性规则。

title: Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)
comment: 15 Pages, 3 Figures, AutoML (International Conference on Automated Machine Learning) 2026
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) is a powerful approach for automating model design, but existing methods often optimize for accuracy alone or rely on proxy metrics such as bit operations (BOPs) that correlate poorly with hardware cost. This gap is particularly large for FPGA deployment, where cost is dominated by a multi-dimensional budget of lookup tables, DSPs, flip-flops, BRAM, and latency. We present the Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack), an open-source AutoML framework for hardware-aware neural architecture codesign and end-to-end FPGA deployment. SNAC-Pack runs a multi-objective global search with Optuna and NSGA-II, loading trials to a shared SQLite store that enables parallel workers across compute nodes. A hardware surrogate model outputs per-trial resource and latency estimates, avoiding the synthesis cost that would otherwise dominate the search loop. A local search stage then applies quantization-aware training (QAT) together with iterative magnitude pruning in a combined compression loop, after which the final model is synthesized to FPGA firmware via the hls4ml Python library. A YAML configuration and an optional agentic frontend let users run the pipeline on new datasets without modifying the framework. We demonstrate SNAC-Pack on jet classification at the Large Hadron Collider and superconducting qubit readout, discovering compact architectures that match or exceed strong baselines on the task metric while reducing FPGA resource utilization and, in the qubit readout case, reducing the design space exploration process from months of manual fine-tuning to hours of automated search.

AI.tldr: SNAC-Pack 是一个开源 AutoML 框架，用于硬件感知的神经架构协同设计和端到端 FPGA 部署。它通过多目标搜索（Optuna + NSGA-II）、硬件替代模型预测资源/延迟、量化感知训练与迭代剪枝的联合压缩，以及 hls4ml 自动合成，在无需修改代码的情况下自动发现紧凑架构。在粒子喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任务上，该方法匹配或超越强基线，同时降低 FPGA 资源消耗，并将设计空间探索从数月人工调优缩短至数小时自动搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有 NAS 方法要么只优化准确率，要么依赖与硬件成本相关性差的代理指标（如 BOPs），尤其对于 FPGA 部署——其成本由查找表、DSP、触发器、BRAM 和延迟等多维预算共同决定——这一缺口尤为突出。
AI.method: SNAC-Pack 采用多目标全局搜索（Optuna + NSGA-II），通过共享 SQLite 存储实现跨节点并行；硬件替代模型逐试验预测资源和延迟，避免合成开销；随后局部搜索阶段进行量化感知训练（QAT）与迭代幅度剪枝的联合压缩，最终通过 hls4ml 合成 FPGA 固件。用户可通过 YAML 配置或可选的智能体前端运行新数据集，无需修改框架。
AI.result: 在大强子对撞机喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任务上，发现的紧凑架构在任务指标上匹配或超越强基线，同时降低 FPGA 资源利用率；在量子比特读出案例中，设计空间探索从数月人工调优缩短至数小时自动搜索。
AI.conclusion: SNAC-Pack 证明了硬件感知的神经架构协同设计结合自动化搜索与硬件替代建模，能够高效地在 FPGA 部署场景下同时优化准确率和资源消耗，显著加速设计流程。

title: Exact Linear Attention
summary:
This paper introduces Exact Linear Attention (ELA), a mechanism that achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention by exploiting the exact decomposition property of kernel functions, thereby eliminating approximation error. We identify and address two key limitations of prior linear attention -- gradient explosion and token attention dilution -- by imposing kernel constraints that ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Several kernel functions are proposed, including the Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, each tailored for specific attention behaviors.
  Beyond the core attention formulation, the paper presents three engineering innovations: (1) a Hyper-Link structure that replaces traditional residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation; (2) a Memory Lobe module based on bidirectional linear attention, which captures "transformation flow" across layers to implement qualitative memory and an implicit reinforcement learning paradigm; and (3) a routing-score-based bias mechanism for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to improve interpretability and semantic alignment.
  Experimental results demonstrate that ELA achieves up to 6x faster decoding speed and 75% reduction in KV cache memory usage compared to full attention, while maintaining comparable or superior training performance. The proposed memory module accelerates convergence and enhances generalization. Furthermore, we extend the linear attention principle to vision models, yielding YOLO-LAT, which attains up to 4.3x GPU inference speedup and 7.9x parameter reduction with competitive detection accuracy. These results underline the broad applicability of exact linear attention for scaling Transformer models to ultra-long sequences and efficient visual tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Exact Linear Attention (ELA)机制，通过核函数的精确分解实现Transformer注意力的线性复杂度，消除了近似误差。针对梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释问题，提出非负、可判别、几何可解释的核约束，并设计了三种核函数。此外，提出了Hyper-Link结构、Memory Lobe模块和路由评分MoE偏置机制三项工程创新。实验表明，ELA相比全注意力实现高达6倍解码加速和75%KV缓存减少，在视觉任务中YOLO-LAT获得4.3倍GPU加速和7.9倍参数缩减。
AI.motivation: 现有线性注意力方法存在近似误差，且面临梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释两大关键限制，影响模型训练稳定性和长序列建模能力。
AI.method: 利用核函数的精确分解特性实现无近似误差的线性复杂度注意力；设计非负性、可判别性和几何可解释性约束的核函数（Hadamard Exp Kernel等）；提出Hyper-Link残差连接替代方案、基于双向线性注意力的Memory Lobe模块实现隐式强化学习、路由评分偏置机制增强MoE可解释性。
AI.result: 解码速度提升6倍，KV缓存内存减少75%，训练性能相当或更优；YOLO-LAT实现4.3倍GPU推理加速和7.9倍参数缩减，检测精度具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Exact Linear Attention为扩展Transformer到超长序列和高效视觉任务提供了广泛适用的解决方案，验证了精确线性注意力在语言和视觉领域的有效性。

title: Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era
summary: We show that time series foundation models scale: a single training recipe produces reliable forecast-quality improvements from 4M to 2.5B parameters. We release Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights forecasting models trained under this recipe. The Toto 2.0 family sets a new state of the art on three forecasting benchmarks: BOOM, our observability benchmark; GIFT-Eval, the standard general-purpose benchmark; and the recent contamination-resistant TIME benchmark. This report describes our experimental results and details the design decisions behind Toto 2.0: its architecture and training recipe, training data, and the u-muP hyperparameter transfer pipeline. All five base checkpoints are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了时间序列基础模型的规模扩展能力：从4M到2.5B参数均能稳定提升预测质量。发布了Toto 2.0系列五个开源模型，在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个基准上达到SOTA。详细介绍了架构、训练配方、数据以及u-muP超参数迁移pipeline。
AI.motivation: 验证时间序列基础模型是否具备scaling能力，即增大参数量能否持续提升预测性能，并在此基础上发布高性能开源模型。
AI.method: 采用统一的训练配方，从4M到2.5B参数范围内进行scaling实验；使用u-muP超参数迁移pipeline实现跨规模的高效调参；模型架构和训练数据经过精心设计。
AI.result: Toto 2.0系列在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个基准上均取得SOTA结果，证明了时间序列基础模型存在可靠的scaling law。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列基础模型具有显著的规模扩展能力，Toto 2.0作为开源模型在多个基准上达到最优，为时间序列预测领域提供了强有力的基线和实用工具。

title: Reflex: Reinforcement Learning with Reflection Symmetry Exploitation in State-Based Continuous Control
comment: Some of the data in the paper contain errors and need to be confirmed for modification
summary: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). Existing works in this direction have primarily focused on image-based RL and rotational symmetry such as $\mathrm{SO(2)}$, leaving state-based RL and reflection symmetry largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on state-based continuous control tasks and exploit reflection symmetry by introducing Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms. We formalize two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations. Building on a theoretical analysis of symmetry-preserving optimal value functions and policies, Reflex integrates reflection symmetry into policy learning through principled symmetry regularization mechanisms. We integrate Reflex with PPO and SAC, and evaluate it on a suite of OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance over standard baselines while improving sample efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/Reflex.

AI.tldr: Reflex是一种利用反射对称性提升强化学习样本效率的方法，通过对称性正则化机制，在连续控制任务中显著优于PPO和SAC基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习长期受困于样本效率低下问题，现有基于群不变MDP的方法多聚焦于图像RL和旋转对称性（如SO(2)），而基于状态的连续控制任务中的反射对称性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 形式化定义了两种反射对称性（轴向反射和双边反射）及其对应变换；在理论分析对称保持最优值函数和策略的基础上，通过对称性正则化机制将反射对称性融入策略学习，并与PPO和SAC等RL算法无缝集成。
AI.result: 在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control基准测试上的实验表明，Reflex在提升样本效率的同时，性能优于标准基线。
AI.conclusion: 反射对称性可有效提升连续控制任务的样本效率和性能，Reflex是一种通用且有效的对称性集成范式。

title: Class-Dependent Hybrid Data Augmentation for Multiclass Migraine Classification under Severe Class Imbalance
summary:
We conducted a reproducibility-oriented re-evaluation of prior migraine classification studies, correcting for data leakage and metric bias. We then introduced (i) a clinically motivated aggregation of two hemiplegic subtypes following ICHD-3 §1.2.3, (ii) a class-dependent hybrid augmentation strategy that assigns generation methods based on per-class sample size, and (iii) the concept of fidelity asymmetry, motivating proportionally constrained growth as an alternative to full class balance. Experiments were performed on a dataset of 400 patients across seven migraine subtypes under a two-stage protocol, including the six-class configuration described above. Models were evaluated using stratified 5-fold cross-validation with macro-averaged F1 as the primary metric.
  Correcting methodological flaws reduces previously inflated performance estimates, with the corrected macro-F1 baseline standing at 0.71. The proposed framework consistently outperformed individual augmenters in macro-F1 averaged across the eight evaluated classifiers (0.862 vs. 0.836 for Gaussian Copula, 0.815 for CTGAN, and 0.801 for the no-augmentation baseline), and achieved its peak result of 0.914 with FT-Transformer under proportional augmentation. The no-augmentation FT-Transformer baseline (0.896) shows that, at the per-classifier ceiling, clinically motivated class aggregation accounts for most of the absolute improvement; the framework's principal measurable contribution is the gain in average robustness across classifiers, highlighting the dominant role of problem formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了偏头痛分类研究，纠正了数据泄露和指标偏差问题，提出了一种临床驱动的子类型聚合、类别依赖的混合增强策略以及保真度不对称概念。在400名患者七种亚型的数据集上，改进后的框架将宏观F1从0.71提升至0.862（平均），最高达到0.914（FT-Transformer+比例增强），主要贡献在于提升了分类器间的平均鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 先前偏头痛分类研究存在数据泄露和指标偏差的方法学缺陷，导致性能估计虚高；同时需要解决偏头痛亚型分类中的类别不平衡和临床相关性问题。
AI.method: (i) 根据ICHD-3 §1.2.3对两种偏瘫亚型进行临床驱动的类别聚合；(ii) 基于每类样本量分配生成方法的类别依赖混合增强策略；(iii) 提出保真度不对称概念，采用比例约束增长替代完全类别平衡。采用两阶段协议，在7种亚型400名患者数据集上进行5折交叉验证，以宏观F1为主要指标。
AI.result: 纠正方法缺陷后基线宏观F1为0.71。提出框架在8个分类器上的平均宏观F1为0.862，优于高斯Copula（0.836）、CTGAN（0.815）和无增强基线（0.801）。在FT-Transformer+比例增强下达到峰值0.914。
AI.conclusion: 临床驱动的类别聚合贡献了大部分绝对性能提升，框架的主要可衡量贡献在于提升跨分类器的平均鲁棒性，凸显了问题表述的主导作用。

title: Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers
summary: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种三步法识别预训练Transformer中注意力头电路：基于谱信号的头排序、任务模式筛选、分组消融验证。跨8倍参数范围、两种架构家族和四种预训练流程验证有效，发现2-6头归纳电路是因果必要的，且频谱信号无需监督即可预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖标签或归因梯度来识别注意力头电路，缺乏无需监督的通用识别方法。作者希望提出一种可跨模型规模、架构和预训练流程迁移的电路识别方案。
AI.method: 三步法：(1) 每个注意力头输出的时间积分参与比作为谱信号，对持续内容相关计算的头进行排序；(2) 任务模式筛选将通用指标过滤为任务特定候选电路；(3) 分组消融与匹配随机对照完成因果归因。
AI.result: 在51M到1B激活/7B总参数范围内、密集和MoE两种架构、四种预训练流程上验证。2-6头归纳电路因果必要，消融后合成归纳top-1下降94-100%。谱信号在51M探针模型的6个独立种子上预测出种子特定电路。Pythia家族（124M-410M）中可识别专用计算的头比例守恒于17-19%，归纳电路规模为3-11头，呈亚线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为三篇论文的方法论锚点，可推广至预训练过程中的发展轨迹和组合任务电路分析，其中模式选择性与任务因果结构可解耦。

title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments reveal that aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid initial gains, but excessive updates cause trajectory probabilities to deviate and entropy to collapse, with performance plateauing early. Tightening KL constraints merely lowers the ceiling without resolving the degradation. This motivates Extreme Region Policy Distillation (ERPD), a two-stage framework that decouples sample efficiency from KL efficiency. The first stage performs weakly constrained off-policy optimization on fixed data to maximally extract training signals. The resulting policy provides token-level supervision. In the second stage, we distill these signals into the base policy under trust-region constraints, filtering harmful drift while preserving useful signals. The distilled policy achieves comparable or better performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that much of the first-stage divergence was spent on unnecessary drift rather than genuine improvement. Crucially, ERPD accommodates both strong and weak teachers: when aggressive optimization yields no stronger policy, even degenerate teachers provide effective supervision via alternative signal construction strategies. We validate ERPD on mathematical reasoning, showing gains for strong base models where on-policy training plateaus, and reliable improvements with weak teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERPD框架，将RL训练分解为两个阶段：第一阶段在固定数据上进行弱约束的离策略优化以充分提取训练信号，第二阶段通过信任区域约束将这些信号蒸馏回基础策略，从而在保持样本效率的同时解决分布偏移问题，在数学推理任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习面临样本效率与渐近性能之间的根本权衡：严格在策略方法在单次更新后就丢弃轨迹，而离策略复用会引入分布不匹配问题。现有信任区域技术主要通过保守优化来缓解，但往往未能充分利用丰富的训练信号。
AI.method: ERPD是一个两阶段框架：第一阶段在固定数据上执行弱约束的离策略优化（多步优化），最大程度提取训练信号；第二阶段在信任区域约束下将这些信号（token级监督）蒸馏回基础策略，过滤有害漂移同时保留有用信号。该框架兼容强教师和弱教师。
AI.result: 实验表明：激进的离策略优化能带来快速初始收益，但过度更新会导致轨迹概率偏离、熵坍缩和性能平台化；ERPD蒸馏策略在KL散度显著更小的情况下达到相当或更好的性能；在数学推理任务上，对强基础模型有效（在策略训练平台期仍能提升），弱教师也能带来可靠改进。
AI.conclusion: 第一阶段大量KL散度花在了非必要的漂移而非真正的改进上；ERPD成功解耦了样本效率与KL效率，通过蒸馏机制在利用丰富训练信号的同时避免了有害分布漂移。

title: Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run
summary: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过优化"金丝雀"样本（同时最大化可检测性与最小化相互干扰）来提升单次运行隐私审计效果的方法，结合贪婪初始化与双层优化，实现了比现有方法更强的隐私泄露估计和更低的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有单次运行审计方法因金丝雀样本间的干扰导致隐私泄露估计弱于多次运行方法，亟需高效构造既高可检测又低干扰的金丝雀样本以提升审计效果。
AI.method: 基于影响函数的贪婪初始化生成候选金丝雀，再通过双层优化同时最大化样本可区分性并促进嵌入空间多样性，采用计算高效的双层优化算法求解。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在更低计算成本下获得了比现有金丝雀构造方法更强的隐私泄露估计。
AI.conclusion: 优化金丝雀的干扰与可检测性可有效弥合单次与多次运行审计方法间的差距，为高效隐私审计提供了新途径。

title: Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy distillation (OPD) in large language models is shifting from full-trace KL supervision toward more selective training paradigms. Recent OPD methods increasingly focus on selecting which trajectories to learn from, which tokens are most informative, and which supervision signals are most reliable. Motivated by this trend, we rethink optimization granularity of OPD and propose \fireicon\ FiRe-OPD (Filter, then Reweight), which jointly adjusts supervision signals at both trajectory and token levels. In details, FiRe-OPD first filters trajectories to remove low-quality rollout samples, and then applies soft reweighting within the retained trajectories to emphasize informative tokens. Compared with hard token selection, FiRe-OPD leverages a soft-weighting mechanism to effectively mitigate information loss and enhance optimization stability, thereby achieving finer-grained OPD optimization. We validate the effectiveness of FiRe-OPD across strong-to-weak, single-teacher, and multi-teacher settings, and demonstrate its superiority over recent token-level OPD methods ( (e.g., +6.25 on AIME 2024 in strong-to-weak, +18.81 on Miner in multi-teacher). Our code is available at https://github.com/YuYingLi0/FiRe-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FiRe-OPD方法，在LLM的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中引入轨迹过滤+令牌软重加权的联合优化机制，在多种蒸馏场景下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD方法逐渐从全轨迹KL监督转向选择性训练范式，但缺乏对轨迹级和令牌级监督信号的联合精细优化，存在信息丢失和优化不稳定问题。
AI.method: FiRe-OPD采用两阶段策略：首先过滤低质量rollout轨迹，然后在保留轨迹内对令牌进行软重加权（而非硬选择），实现轨迹级和令牌级联合优化。
AI.result: 在强到弱、单教师、多教师三种蒸馏场景下均取得最优结果，例如在AIME 2024强到弱设置中提升+6.25，在多教师Miner任务中提升+18.81。
AI.conclusion: 软重加权机制相比硬令牌选择能更有效地缓解信息损失并增强优化稳定性，实现更细粒度的OPD优化。

title: ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL can instead be stabilized using only current-policy probabilities. We identify a scale-imbalance failure mode: when stale responses are evaluated under the current policy, positive and negative loss terms can appear at different negative log-probability scales, so zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced loss contributions. We propose Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO), which normalizes each response's token loss by its current average token negative log-probability. ASymPO requires no behavior-policy probabilities, restores response-level zero-sum balance, and preserves a nonzero learning signal. We also introduce Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO), a fixed negative-scaling baseline, and evaluate both current-policy-only objectives in asynchronous mathematical reasoning post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ASymPO和SPO两种仅依赖当前策略概率的异步强化学习目标，解决了异步组相对RL中因策略陈旧性导致的尺度失衡问题，在数学推理后训练中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习通过解耦响应生成与策略优化提升了语言模型后训练吞吐量，但陈旧响应会带来分布漂移。标准行为校正方法需要行为策略概率、重要性比率或裁剪，这要求 rollout 和 learner 系统之间具有 token 对齐、版本控制和数值一致的行为对数概率。本文探究能否仅用当前策略概率来稳定异步组相对RL。
AI.method: 1. 识别出尺度失衡失败模式：陈旧响应在当前策略下评估时，正负损失项出现在不同的负对数概率尺度上，导致零和优势不再意味着平衡的损失贡献。2. 提出ASymPO，通过当前平均token负对数概率对每个响应的token损失进行归一化。3. 提出SPO作为固定负缩放基线。
AI.result: ASymPO无需行为策略概率，恢复了响应级别的零和平衡，并保留了非零学习信号。在异步数学推理后训练中验证了这两种仅依赖当前策略的目标函数的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖当前策略概率即可稳定异步组相对RL，ASymPO通过归一化机制有效解决了尺度失衡问题，无需行为策略概率即可实现稳定训练。

title: Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (PMLR vol. 306). 26 pages, 12 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections
summary: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role. However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood. We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection). The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings. Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer. In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation. Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%, enabling practical on-device inference. We show that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality. Our results systematically characterize projection sharing as an underexplored instance of weight tying in attention, with direct, quantifiable inference memory benefits, particularly valuable for edge deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Transformer中QKV三个投影矩阵的共享策略，发现Q-K=V（共享Key-Value投影）在多数任务上性能与标准QKV相当甚至更优，在语言建模中可减少50% KV缓存且仅损失3.1%困惑度，与GQA/MQA结合可实现高达96.9%的缓存缩减，适合边缘端部署。
AI.motivation: Transformer中QKV注意力机制已被广泛采用，但三个投影各自的实际贡献以及省略其中某些投影的影响尚不明确。本文旨在系统性地探索投影共享约束，以理解其必要性并挖掘潜在的效率提升空间。
AI.method: 定义了三种投影共享变体：Q-K=V（共享KV）、Q=K-V（共享QK）和Q=K=V（单一投影）。针对后两种产生对称注意力图的问题，引入2D位置编码实现非对称注意力。在多种任务（合成任务、视觉任务、语言建模）上进行实验比较。
AI.result: Q-K=V在多数任务上性能与QKV相当或更优；语言建模中，Q-K=V仅造成3.1%困惑度下降但减少50% KV缓存；与GQA-4结合减少87.5%缓存，与MQA结合减少96.9%。Q=K-V和Q=K=V由于破坏注意力方向性而表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 投影共享是一种未被充分探索的注意力权重绑定方式，Q-K=V可行是因为keys和values可以共享相似的表示空间且注意力在低秩区域运作。该方法可直接量化地减少推理内存需求，尤其适合边缘部署场景。

title: Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Robust Markov Decision Processes
summary: The framework of robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) allows the design of reinforcement learning agents that satisfy performance guarantees under worst-case transition dynamics. Traditional RMDPs consider discrete-time dynamics and recently, sample-efficient policy gradient algorithms have been considered in this context. This paper investigates policy gradient algorithms within a continuous-time RMDP framework. Policy gradients and adversarial gradients are derived using pathwise and adjoint-based formulas for stochastic and ordinary differential equations. We propose double-loop optimisers to obtain linear convergence in the oracle-based setting and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$ sample complexity in the sample-based setting in an analysis which also derives novel tools for the framework of undiscounted total cost MDPs. Additionally, we propose mean-field optimisers as distributional optimisers with an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$ oracle-based convergence rate and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$ sample complexity under $N$-particle approximation. The effectiveness of continuous-time policy gradient algorithms is confirmed for both optimisers on continuous-time RMDPs with neural ordinary differential equation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续时间鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）中的策略梯度算法，提出了基于路径和伴随公式的策略梯度与对抗梯度，设计了双循环优化器（线性收敛）和均场优化器（分布优化），并在神经ODE动态上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统RMDP局限于离散时间动态，而许多实际控制问题本质上是连续时间的，现有连续时间强化学习在鲁棒性方面缺乏理论保证。本文旨在将策略梯度方法扩展到连续时间RMDP框架，同时保证收敛性能和样本效率。
AI.method: 1) 利用随机微分方程和常微分方程的路径wise和伴随法推导策略梯度和对抗梯度；2) 提出双循环优化器，实现基于oracle的线性收敛；3) 提出均场优化器作为分布优化器，具有$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/K)$的oracle收敛率和$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^2/\epsilon)$的样本复杂度（N-粒子近似）；4) 在神经ODE动态的连续时间RMDP上验证有效性。
AI.result: 双循环优化器在基于oracle的设置下达到线性收敛，在基于样本的设置下达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\epsilon^2)$的样本复杂度。均场优化器在oracle设置下以$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/K)$速率收敛，在N-粒子近似下样本复杂度为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^2/\epsilon)$。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将策略梯度方法推广到连续时间RMDP，提供了理论收敛保证和样本复杂度分析，并开发了适用于总成本非折扣MDP的新分析工具，实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) increasingly rival tree ensembles, but their performance is often compute-inefficient: with standard affine scalar tokenization, each feature injects value variation through an essentially one-dimensional channel, and feature IDs/positional signals cannot increase within-feature value degrees of freedom, yielding weak early-layer value sensitivity and redundant hidden states. We present a unified tokenize-and-route framework for strong TFMs: RaBEL expands each scalar into compact localized RBF features (optionally exponent-gated) to improve conditioning and shallow-layer effective rank, while a reordered bidirectional block S->N->F aligns computation with the readout by aggregating cross-sample context before feature mixing and using attention pooling. Together, these changes yield LimiX-2M, a 2M-parameter model that outperforms larger TabPFN-v2 and TabICL baselines on widely used tabular benchmarks while reducing training and inference costs. These results highlight value-aware tokenization and readout-aligned routing as key levers for improving the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in TFMs. Model checkpoints and inference code are available at https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RaBEL tokenization（RBF特征扩展+指数门控）和S->N->F双向块路由框架，构建了仅2M参数的LimiX-2M模型，在表格基准上超越更大规模的TabPFN-v2和TabICL，同时降低训练和推理成本。
AI.motivation: 标准仿射标量tokenization存在维度瓶颈：每个特征通过一维通道注入值变化，特征ID/位置信号无法增加特征内的值自由度，导致浅层值敏感性弱和隐藏状态冗余，使得表格基础模型（TFM）计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出统一tokenize-and-route框架：1) RaBEL：将每个标量扩展为紧凑局部RBF特征（可选指数门控），改善条件数和浅层有效秩；2) 重排序双向块S->N->F（样本->特征->混合），先聚合跨样本上下文再进行特征混合，并使用注意力池化与读出对齐。
AI.result: LimiX-2M（仅2M参数）在广泛使用的表格基准上优于更大的TabPFN-v2和TabICL基线，同时降低了训练和推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 值感知的token化策略和与读出对齐的路由机制是改善表格基础模型准确率-效率权衡的关键杠杆。

title: Rollout-Level Advantage-Prioritized Experience Replay for GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards with GRPO is a standard approach for post-training reasoning LLMs. It remains sample inefficient. Each rollout is used for a single gradient update and then discarded. Naive replay is not well suited in this setting because LLM policies drift quickly per gradient step. Stored rollouts therefore become stale and can destabilize training. We propose a rollout-level replay buffer for GRPO that stores and samples individual rollouts rather than whole groups. The buffer bounds staleness through age eviction. Any rollout older than tau_max training steps is removed. The buffer also preserves on-policy data via fresh-anchored composition. Each batch keeps its fresh on-policy rollouts and then concatenates replay rollouts drawn separately from the buffer. We prioritize replay by per-rollout advantage magnitude and recycle individual rollouts whose advantages are large. Across three Qwen3-Base scales on five math benchmarks, our method outperforms GRPO and naive replay baselines. Gains are positive at every scale and grow with model size. The largest gain is +4.35 pp on the five-benchmark average at 4B. Under an AES metric that jointly measures accuracy and token efficiency, the efficiency margin over GRPO is again largest at 4B, at +0.579.

AI.tldr: 针对GRPO样本效率低的问题，提出基于轨迹级回放缓冲区的方法，通过年龄驱逐限制陈旧性、新鲜锚定组合保证数据同策略性、按优势值优先级采样，在Qwen3-Base模型上平均提升4.35个百分点。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO样本效率低：每次 rollout 仅用于一次梯度更新即被丢弃。简单回放不适用，因为LLM策略每步梯度漂移快，存储的rollouts会变得陈旧，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出轨迹级回放缓冲区：(1) 年龄驱逐：超过τ_max训练步的rollout被移除；(2) 新鲜锚定组合：每个batch保留当前新鲜的同策略rollout，再从缓冲区中拼接采样的回放rollout；(3) 按每条轨迹的优势值大小进行优先级采样，回收优势值大的轨迹。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base三个规模、五个数学基准上均优于GRPO和简单回放基线。增益随模型规模增大而增长，4B规模平均提升+4.35个百分点；在AES指标（联合衡量准确率和token效率）上，4B规模提升+0.579。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹级回放缓冲区的方法有效提升了GRPO的样本效率，且增益随模型规模扩大而增加。

title: Learning Long Range Spatio-Temporal Representations over Continuous Time Dynamic Graphs with State Space Models
summary:
Continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) provide a richer framework to capture fine-grained temporal patterns in evolving relational data. Long-range information propagation is a key challenge while learning representations, wherein it is important to retain and update information over long temporal horizons. Existing approaches restrict models to capture one-hop or local temporal neighborhoods and fail to capture multi-hop or global structural patterns. To mitigate this, we derive a parameter-efficient state-space modeling framework for continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDG-SSM) from first principles. We first introduce continuous-time Topology-Aware higher order polynomial projection operator (CTT-HiPPO), a novel memory-based reformulation of HiPPO to jointly encode temporal dynamics and graph structure. The solution from CTT-HiPPO is obtained by projecting the classical HiPPO solution through a polynomial of the Laplacian matrix, yielding topology-aware memory updates that admit an equivalent state-space formulation for CTDGs (CTDG-SSM). Then a computationally efficient discrete formulation is obtained using the zero-order hold approach for model implementation.
  Across benchmarks on dynamic link prediction, dynamic node classification, and sequence classification, CTDG-SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it achieves large performance gains on datasets that require long range temporal (LRT) and spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTDG-SSM，一种基于状态空间模型的连续时间动态图框架，通过引入CTT-HiPPO算子联合编码时序动态与图结构，在长程时空推理任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CTDG方法局限于捕获一跳或局部时序邻域，无法捕获多跳或全局结构模式，长程信息传播是CTDG表示学习的关键挑战。
AI.method: 从第一性原理推导参数高效的状态空间建模框架CTDG-SSM。首先提出连续时间拓扑感知高阶多项式投影算子（CTT-HiPPO），将HiPPO解通过拉普拉斯矩阵多项式投影，得到拓扑感知的记忆更新，等效于CTDG的状态空间公式；随后利用零阶保持法得到计算高效的离散形式。
AI.result: 在动态链接预测、动态节点分类和序列分类基准上取得SOTA性能，在需要长程时序和空间推理的数据集上取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CTDG-SSM通过拓扑感知的状态空间建模有效解决了CTDG中的长程信息传播问题，验证了联合编码时序动态与图结构在长程时空推理任务中的有效性。

title: UniFair: A unified fair clustering approach based on separation and compactness
summary: Clustering is increasingly used to support high-impact decisions, yet standard objectives such as k-means can produce clusterings that treat demographic groups unequally. Existing fair clustering methods typically optimize a single notion of fairness and often overlook how clustering costs interact with the geometry of the induced decision boundaries. We propose UniFair, a unified framework that jointly optimizes separation fairness and social fairness. Separation fairness encourages protected groups to lie farther from the induced decision boundaries, while social fairness reduces disparities in within-cluster distortion by penalizing group-wise clustering costs. We develop gradient-based optimization procedures for separation-fair and unified k-means objectives, and extend them to deep clustering by enforcing the same criteria in the latent space of an autoencoder. Experiments on tabular and image datasets show that UniFair reduces both boundary-related and cost-based group disparities with only a modest increase in clustering loss.

AI.tldr: 提出UniFair统一框架，联合优化分离公平性（保护组远离决策边界）和社会公平性（减少组间聚类成本差异），通过梯度优化实现k-means和深度聚类的公平聚类，在表格和图像数据集上以轻微聚类损失代价降低了两种群体差异。
AI.motivation: 现有公平聚类方法通常只优化单一公平性概念，且忽略了聚类成本与决策边界几何结构之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出UniFair框架，联合优化分离公平性和社会公平性；开发基于梯度的优化过程用于分离公平和统一k-means目标；扩展到深度聚类，在自编码器潜空间中强制执行相同标准。
AI.result: 在表格和图像数据集上，UniFair在仅增加少量聚类损失的情况下，同时减少了边界相关的群体差异和成本相关的群体差异。
AI.conclusion: UniFair能够有效统一两种公平性目标，以较小的聚类损失代价显著改善聚类结果的群体公平性。

title: The Right Measure for Physics-Constrained Generation: A Co-Area Correction for Posterior-Consistent PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Generative models -- diffusion and flow matching -- are increasingly used to solve partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems, enforcing the governing physics as a \emph{hard constraint} (via projection or guidance) and reporting the resulting samples as a Bayesian posterior with calibrated uncertainty. We show that this widely adopted recipe samples the wrong distribution. Conditioning a generative prior on a hard PDE constraint is conditioning on a measure-zero manifold -- an operation that is intrinsically ambiguous (the Borel--Kolmogorov paradox) and whose physically correct resolution, the small-residual-noise limit, carries a co-area (Fixman) Jacobian factor $[det(JJ^{\top})]^{-1/2}$ that projection- and guidance-based methods silently omit. We make the bias precise, show that it grows with the heterogeneity of the constraint sensitivity, and validate it on controlled problems against an \emph{i.i.d.} ground-truth arbiter. The omitted factor is not a second-order detail: removing it inflates the posterior error to $20\times$ the sampling-noise floor; minimal-displacement projection (as in PCFM) is biased at $9\times$ the floor; and a naive scalar reweighting does not fix it. We introduce \textbf{CoCoS}, a measure-aware constrained sampler that targets the correct co-area posterior, and show that it matches the gold-standard posterior to within sampling noise. Our results imply that ``satisfying the physics'' is not the same as ``sampling the posterior,'' and give a principled correction for uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在扩散/流匹配模型中通过硬约束（投影或引导）求解PDE逆问题时，实际上采样到了错误的分布。问题根源在于对零测流形进行条件化会导致Borel-Kolmogorov悖论，正确的物理极限应包含co-area (Fixman) Jacobian因子[det(JJ^T)]^{-1/2}，而现有方法均忽略了这一因子。作者提出CoCoS方法，通过度量感知的约束采样器正确匹配后验分布。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型（扩散模型和流匹配）被广泛用于求解PDE逆问题，通过将物理规律作为硬约束（投影或引导）进行条件化，并将采样结果报告为具有校准不确定性的贝叶斯后验。然而，这种流行的方法实际上采样了错误的分布，需要揭示并修正这一系统性偏差。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明在零测流形上条件化（硬PDE约束）存在Borel-Kolmogorov悖论，正确的小残差噪声极限应包含co-area (Fixman) Jacobian因子。2. 实验验证：在受控问题上与i.i.d.真实基准进行对比，量化现有投影/引导方法的偏差（后验误差可达采样噪声底的20倍）。3. 提出CoCoS（Co-area Constrained Sampler）：一种度量感知的约束采样器，正确纳入co-area Jacobian因子以匹配真实后验分布。
AI.result: 1. 理论层面：明确指出现有投影法和引导法因忽略co-area Jacobian因子而产生系统性偏差，偏差大小随约束敏感性的异质性增加而增大。2. 实验层面：在受控问题中，不考虑该因子时后验误差达到采样噪声底的20倍；最小位移投影（如PCFM）偏差为9倍；简单标量重新加权无法修复。3. CoCoS方法成功匹配黄金标准后验，偏差降至采样噪声水平。
AI.conclusion: "满足物理约束"不等于"采样正确后验"。对于不确定性感知的科学推理，必须纳入co-area Jacobian因子进行校正。CoCoS提供了一种原则性的修正方案。
